A_AdHocWIPDataSetup.zh: 此设置用于配置WIP数据设置选择列表，可在任何时间用于收集批次、NDO或RDO对象的数据。其名称字段必须设置为对象类型名称。例如，若要为批次设置，名称必须设置为Lot。Lik
A_AdHocWIPDataSetup.en: This setup is used to configure a list of WIP Data Setup selection that can be used to collect data for Lot, NDO or RDO object at any time. Its Name field must be set to the object type name. For example, to setup for Lot, the Name must be set as Lot. Lik

A_AreaGroup.zh: 在批次调度请求期间可分配给调度的附加信息。
A_AreaGroup.en: Additional information that can be assigned to a schedule during Lot Schedule Request.

A_AttributeAccess.zh: 属性访问用于在事务期间验证服务字段。需要确切的对象表示法来访问要与有效值进行比较的值，因此需要充分理解服务中的字段。属性访问i
A_AttributeAccess.en: Attribute Access is used to verify a Service Field during transaction. The exact object notation to access the value to compare against the Valid Values is required hence a good understanding of the Fields within a Service is required. Attribute Access i

A_AttributeType.zh: 对允许使用修改属性服务修改的容器、批次属性和批次属性扩展字段进行分类。
A_AttributeType.en: Categorizes Container, Lot Attributes and Lot Attributes Ex fields that are allowed to be modified using the Modify Attrs service.

A_AutomationPlan.zh: 此对象用于指示进站和出站是预期来自手动事务（例如Web GUI）还是自动化事务（设备自动化程序）。此对象将附加到需要特殊控制的设备上。
A_AutomationPlan.en: This object is used to indicate whether track in and track out is expected to be from a manual transaction (e.g. Web GUI) or automated transaction (equipment automation program). This object will be attached to the equipment that requires the special cont

A_BinType.zh: 用于指示在规格处是否需要分箱。单层批次的分箱需要在已分配值的规格处进行。
A_BinType.en: Used to identify whether binning is required at a Spec. Binning for single level lots is required at Specs with a value assigned.

A_Calendar.zh: 此设置用于表示制造年度。制造年度的开始日期可设置为任意日期（例如2007年12月28日表示2008年）。系统将根据该设置自动生成整个年度的日历班次和日历工作周。
A_Calendar.en: This setup is used to represent the manufacturing year. The start of a manufacturing year can be set to any date (e.g. 28 December 2007 for year 2008). The system will auto generate the Calendar Shifts and Calendar Work Weeks for the entire year based on

A_CalendarHolidays.zh: 用于表示节假日的附加设置，不用于任何逻辑。仅用于提供报告信息。
A_CalendarHolidays.en: Additional setup used to represent holidays and is not used in any logic. It is meant to provide information for reporting purpose only.

A_CalendarShiftsCycle.zh: 这表示形成一个完整班次周期所需的班次。例如，白班A从周日开始持续4天，然后是B班4天，依此类推。因此，当白班A再次在周日开始时，就达到了一个完整周期。
A_CalendarShiftsCycle.en: This represents the shifts required to form a complete shifts cycle. Say for example the day shift A starts on a Sunday for 4 days followed by shift B for 4 days and so on. Thus a complete cycle is achieved when the day shift A starts back on a Sunday for

A_CarrierValidationSetup.zh: 维护载具验证设置的实例。
A_CarrierValidationSetup.en: Maintain the instance of the carrier validation setups.

A_CheckSheetMatrix.en: Setup B to configure check sheet

A_CountVarianceLimits.zh: 用于设置数量差异限制的设置。
A_CountVarianceLimits.en: Setup used to set the limits for Count Variance.

A_CycleTimeHolidays.zh: 在批次调度的结束日期周期时间计算中，用于抵消预计结束日期的节假日。
A_CycleTimeHolidays.en: Holidays to offset the estimated end date during Lot Schedule end date cycle time calculation.

A_DispatchPlan.zh: 为特定事务在某步骤分派批次时提供有效的计划列表。
A_DispatchPlan.en: Provide valid list of plans used for dispatching a lot at a step for a particular transaction.

A_EmployeeGroup.zh: 此设置用于将一个或多个员工分组。它用于验证登录员工组以及指示执行作业订单的员工。
A_EmployeeGroup.en: This setup is used to group one or more Employees. It is used to verify Login Employee Group as well as indicating the Employees tasked to carry out a Job Order.

A_EquipmentMatrix.zh: 这是一个基于条件的矩阵，用于指示设备组以提供工艺步骤的设备选择。
A_EquipmentMatrix.en: This is a criteria based matrix used to indicate the Equipment Group to provide the equipment selection for a process step.

A_EquipmentParamList.zh: 预定义分配给设备的参数列表。设备参数值通过设备设置服务设置。
A_EquipmentParamList.en: Predefines a list of parameters that is assigned to the Equipment. The Equipment parameter values are set through the Equipment Setup service.

A_ExpAutoHold.zh: 实验计划操作类型的步骤自动保留。
A_ExpAutoHold.en: Auto Hold at a Step for ExperimentPlan action type.

A_ExpAutoSplit.zh: 实验计划操作类型的步骤自动拆分。
A_ExpAutoSplit.en: Auto Split at a Step for ExperimentPlan action type.

A_ExpAutoSS.zh: 实验计划操作类型的步骤自动追加规格。
A_ExpAutoSS.en: Auto Supplementary Spec a Step for ExperimentPlan action type.

A_ExperimentPlan.zh: 实验计划用于定义对实验批次执行的一系列实验操作，这些操作会覆盖默认的工艺规格行为。
A_ExperimentPlan.en: The experiment plan is used to define a series of experiment action to be performed on the experiment lot, which override the default process spec behavior.

A_ExperimentPlanBase.zh: 实验计划用于定义对实验批次执行的一系列实验操作，这些操作会覆盖默认的工艺规格行为。
A_ExperimentPlanBase.en: The experiment plan is used to define a series of experiment action to be performed on the experiment lot, which override the default process spec behavior.

A_ExperimentPlanDetails.zh: 由步骤名称或规格定义的实验操作的详细信息。
A_ExperimentPlanDetails.en: The details of the experiment action defined by Step Name or Spec.

A_ExpSpecialCheckSheet.zh: 特殊检查表定义了实验所需的检查表。
A_ExpSpecialCheckSheet.en: Special Check Sheet defined the check sheet required for the experiment.

A_ExpSpecialInstructions.zh: 特殊指令用于在步骤处显示实验批次的警报消息。
A_ExpSpecialInstructions.en: Special Instructions is used to display alert message for an experiment lot at a Step.

A_ExternalInterface.zh: 此设置用于在执行车间服务期间触发以DLL（即自定义过程）编写的自定义逻辑。如果在服务执行期间相应的启用标志设置为true，则将调用ExternalInterface自定义过程。
A_ExternalInterface.en: Setup used to trigger custom logic written in a DLL (i.e. Custom Proc) during an execution of a Shop Floor service. The ExternalInterface Custom Proc will be called if the respective enable flag is set to true during the execution of a service.

A_ExternalInterfaceDetail.zh: 标识在预定义触发点触发外部接口所需的服务。
A_ExternalInterfaceDetail.en: Identifies the services required to trigger the external interface at pre-defined triggering points.

A_ExternalInterfaceDetailParam.zh: 可用于为外部接口自定义过程传递附加参数的可选参数。
A_ExternalInterfaceDetailParam.en: Optional parameters that can be used to pass in additional parameters for the External Interface custom procedure to execute.

A_ExternalInterfaceDetailRule.zh: 为服务名称触发的业务规则。这里的规则将独立于Enable***Event标志被触发。
A_ExternalInterfaceDetailRule.en: Business Rules to trigger for the Service Name. The rules here will be triggered independant of the Enable***Event flags.

A_ExternalLocation.en: Represents the location for an external system.

A_ExternalLocationType.zh: 对外部位置类型进行分类。

A_FutureHoldSetup.zh: 按条件的未来保留设置。

A_HoldLocation.zh: 保留位置用于从第二次保留开始将批次置于保留状态。可以将一个或多个保留位置分配给规格。在批次保留期间，将显示有效值以供选择。
A_HoldLocation.en: A Hold Location is used to put a lot on second hold onwards. One or more Hold Locations can be assigned to a Spec. During Lot Hold, the valid values will be displayed for selection.

A_ImpoundType.zh: 用于指示操作的类型。滞留操作通常用于将老化批次存储在库存中。一些示例包括IMPOUND和EXCEPTION。
A_ImpoundType.en: Used to indicate the type of impound for an Operation. Impound operations are typically used to store aged lots in inventory. Some examples include IMPOUND and EXCEPTION.

A_InsertionReason.zh: 创建新插入时原因的有效值。
A_InsertionReason.en: Valid values for the Reason in creating a new insertion.

A_ItemCategory.zh: 用于提供可存储在批次中的项目类型的层次结构。
A_ItemCategory.en: Used to provide a hierarchy of Item Types that can be stored in a lot.

A_ItemType.zh: 用于提供存储批次项目的有效列表。例如晶圆、条、面板等。
A_ItemType.en: Used to provide a valid list to store Lot Items. E.g. Wafers, Strips, Panels, etc.

A_Job.zh: 存储通过JobCreate从作业订单创建的作业。JobCreate之后的所有作业事务将使用此对象执行。
A_Job.en: Stores the jobs that have been created from the JobOrder through JobCreate. All job transactions after JobCreate will use this object to execute.

A_JobCauseCode.zh: 在作业进度期间用于识别已识别原因的原因代码。
A_JobCauseCode.en: Cause Code used during a Job Progress to identify the cause identified.

A_JobModel.zh: 定义资源从一个阶段移动到另一个阶段的流程。
A_JobModel.en: Defines the flow of moving the resource from one stage to another.

A_JobRepairCode.zh: 在作业进度期间用于标识所完成维修的维修代码。
A_JobRepairCode.en: Repair Code used during a Job Progress to identify the repair done.

A_JobStage.en: Defines the various stages within a JobModel.

A_JobSymptomCode.zh: 在作业进度期间用于识别症状的症状代码。
A_JobSymptomCode.en: Symptom Code used during a Job Progress to identify the symptom.

A_ldCSAMData.zh: CSAM数据。物理对应 A_ldCSAMData (CdoId: 671088644, Workspace: 200)。
A_ldCSAMData.en: CSAM data. Physically corresponds to A_ldCSAMData (CdoId: 671088644, Workspace: 200).

A_ldCSAMValidation.zh: CSAM验证。物理对应 A_ldCSAMValidation (CdoId: 671088643, Workspace: 200)。
A_ldCSAMValidation.en: CSAM validation. Physically corresponds to A_ldCSAMValidation (CdoId: 671088643, Workspace: 200).

A_ldMatReturnOrder.zh: 物料退回订单。物理对应 A_ldMatReturnOrder (CdoId: 671088662, Workspace: 200)。
A_ldMatReturnOrder.en: Material return order. Physically corresponds to A_ldMatReturnOrder (CdoId: 671088662, Workspace: 200).

A_ldMatReturnOrderHistory.zh: 物料退回订单历史。物理对应 A_ldMatReturnOrderHistory (CdoId: 671088661, Workspace: 200)。
A_ldMatReturnOrderHistory.en: Material return order history. Physically corresponds to A_ldMatReturnOrderHistory (CdoId: 671088661, Workspace: 200).

A_ldMatReturnOrderHistoryDet.zh: 物料退回订单历史明细。物理对应 A_ldMatReturnOrderHistoryDet (CdoId: 671088663, Workspace: 200)。
A_ldMatReturnOrderHistoryDet.en: Material return order history detail. Physically corresponds to A_ldMatReturnOrderHistoryDet (CdoId: 671088663, Workspace: 200).

A_ldMatReturnOrderItem.zh: 物料退回订单项。物理对应 A_ldMatReturnOrderItem (CdoId: 671088664, Workspace: 200)。
A_ldMatReturnOrderItem.en: Material return order item. Physically corresponds to A_ldMatReturnOrderItem (CdoId: 671088664, Workspace: 200).

A_ldReworkStatus.zh: 返工状态。物理对应 A_ldReworkStatus (CdoId: 671088646, Workspace: 200)。
A_ldReworkStatus.en: Rework status. Physically corresponds to A_ldReworkStatus (CdoId: 671088646, Workspace: 200).

A_ldReworkStatusldReEntryWorkf.zh: 返工状态重入工作流关联。物理对应 A_ldReworkStatusldReEntryWorkf (CdoId: 671088645, Workspace: 200)。
A_ldReworkStatusldReEntryWorkf.en: Rework status re-entry workflow association. Physically corresponds to A_ldReworkStatusldReEntryWorkf (CdoId: 671088645, Workspace: 200).

A_LocationMap.zh: 将名称映射到工作流和工作流步骤。
A_LocationMap.en: Maps a name to a Workflow and Workflow Step.

A_LotAttributes.zh: 用于存储属性的容器的主要扩展。每个属性是表中的一个列。修改属性服务用于更新字段。注意：所有持久字段必须设置为读/写可访问性。这是为了允许LotStart直接
A_LotAttributes.en: Main extension for the Container to store attributes. Each attribute is a column in the table. The Modify Attrs service is used to update the fields. NOTE: All persistent fields must be set to Read/Write accessibility. This is to allow LotStart to dire

A_LotItems.zh: 用于为批次添加任何类型的序列化附加信息的子实体。例如条、面板等。
A_LotItems.en: Subentity used to add any type of serialized additional information for a lot. E.g. strips, panels, etc.

A_LotWafers.zh: 存储批次的晶圆记录。此子实体列表形成第二个容器级别，用于晶圆（项目）跟踪和处理。添加新的可修改字段的注意事项：i) 将新字段添加到以下对象 a) LotWafers b
A_LotWafers.en: Stores the wafer records for the lot. This sub-entity list forms the second container level and is used for wafer (item) tracking and processing. NOTES for adding new modifiable fields: i) Add the new fields to the following objects a) LotWafers b

A_MachineGroup.en: Provides additional information for the Equipment.

A_MaskLayer.zh: 晶圆处理操作期间使用的掩模/光罩的层。
A_MaskLayer.en: The layer of the mask/reticle used during wafer processing operations.

A_MaskSet.zh: 为掩模组设置掩模层。每层可以有一个或多个掩模ID。
A_MaskSet.en: Setup the Mask Layers for a Mask Set. Each layer can have one or more Mask Ids.

A_MaterialCategory.zh: 进一步对材料进行分类的有效值。
A_MaterialCategory.en: Valid values to further categorize a material.

A_MaterialType.zh: 用于区分用作材料的物料零件或产品类型。每种类型可以指定一个或多个使用该材料的规格。
A_MaterialType.en: Used to differentiate the types of Material Parts or Products used as materials. Each type can specify one or more Specs where the material is to be used.

A_ModifyAttrsReason.en: Valid reasons for the ModifyAttrs service.

A_ModifyAttrsSetup.zh: 此设置用于允许修改属性服务更新容器（即批次）和批次属性中的字段。它还用于创建无需设计器更改即可存储在批次属性扩展中的用户属性。
A_ModifyAttrsSetup.en: This setup is used to allow the Modify Attrs service to update fields in both Container (i.e. Lot) and Lot Attributes. It is also used to create user attributes that will be stored in Lot Attributes Ex without any Designer changes.

A_OperationGroup.zh: 与工作中心类似，操作组可用于将多个操作链接在一起。它分配给一个操作。
A_OperationGroup.en: Similar to Work Center, an operation group can be used to link multiple Operations together. It is assigned to an Operation.

A_PackageGroup.zh: 设置一组或多组封装类型和引线。它分配给资源，并在进站期间用于确保批次的封装类型和引线与资源的封装组条目之一匹配。
A_PackageGroup.en: Setups one or more set of Package Type and Leads. It is assigned to a Resource and is used during Track In to ensure the lot's Package Type and Leads match one of the Resource's Package Group entries.

A_PackingQty.zh: 基于条件的设置，用于定义每包数量。
A_PackingQty.en: Criteria based setup used to define QtyPerPack.

A_ParamName.zh: 定义有效参数名称，这些名称由设备参数列表等设置使用。
A_ParamName.en: Defines valid parameter names that are used by setups such as Equipment Params List.

A_PDALimits.zh: 基于条件的设置，通过查看不合格品来计算限制。PDA代表不合格品聚合百分比。
A_PDALimits.en: Criteria based setup used to calculate the limits by looking at the rejects instead. PDA stands for Percentage Defective Aggregate.

A_PhysicalLocation.zh: 表示工厂内的物理位置。
A_PhysicalLocation.en: Represents the physical location within a factory.

A_PhysicalPosition.zh: 表示物理位置内的位置。
A_PhysicalPosition.en: Represents the positions within a PhysicalLocation.

A_PrintData.zh: 用于触发打印引擎执行所需打印的主表。如果至少需要一个打印设置，则每个事务（即整个事务）将创建一条记录。此对象保存打印l的高级信息。
A_PrintData.en: Main table used to trigger the printing engine to carry out the required printing. Each transaction (i.e. entire transaction) will create a record if at least one PrintingSetup is required. This object holds the high-level information for printing l

A_PrintDataItem.zh: 每个所需的打印设置将在此处有一条记录。
A_PrintDataItem.en: Each PrintingSetup required will have a record here.

A_Printer.zh: 用于配置服务器上有效的打印机。名称必须与服务器上的打印机设置匹配。
A_Printer.en: This is used to configure valid Printers setup on the server. The Name must match the printer setup on the server.

A_PrinterType.zh: 用于为打印机配置所需的打印机类型。
A_PrinterType.en: This is used to configure the types of printers required for a Printer.

A_PrintingAutomation.zh: 用于配置在服务成功完成其事务后自动执行的打印设置。
A_PrintingAutomation.en: Used to configure the Printing Setups to be executed automatically after a service completes its transaction successfully.

A_PrintingComputer.zh: 用于配置按计算机打印的目标打印机。
A_PrintingComputer.en: Used to configure the target printer to print by computer.

A_PrintingConnection.zh: 设置Crystal Report打印（即打印类型=报表）期间使用的连接参数。
A_PrintingConnection.en: Setup the connection parameter used during Crystal Report printing (i.e. Printing Type = REPORT).

A_PrintingSetup.zh: 用于定义打印要求的主要设置。
A_PrintingSetup.en: The main setup used to define a printing requirement.

A_PrintingType.zh: 标识支持的打印类型。打印引擎当前识别以下值：i) LABEL ii) REPORT iii) TEXTFILE - 主要用于测试设置。
A_PrintingType.en: Identifies the supported type of printing. The printing engine currently recognize the following values: i) LABEL ii) REPORT iii) TEXTFILE - Used mainly to test the setup.

A_ProcessArea.zh: 在批次调度请求期间可分配给调度的附加信息。
A_ProcessArea.en: Additional information that can be assigned to a schedule during Lot Schedule Request.

A_ProcessCode.zh: 为规格提供附加信息。一个规格只能链接到一个过程代码，但同一过程代码可以链接到多个规格。
A_ProcessCode.en: Provides additional information for a Spec. One Spec can only be linked to one Process Code but the same Process Code can be linked to multiple Specs.

A_ProcessData.zh: 为过程代码、过程规格和过程规格详细信息提供通用/标准的数据名称和值（标准文本）。
A_ProcessData.en: Provide common/standard set of data names and values (standard text) for Process Code, Process Spec and Process Spec Details.

A_ProcessSpec.zh: 过程规格指处理批次所需的加工规格。必须将过程规格分配给批次（通过批次调度），然后才能进入生产。
A_ProcessSpec.en: A Process Spec refers to the Processing Specification required to process a lot. A Process Spec must be assigned to a lot (through Lot Schedule) before it can proceed to production.

A_ProcessSpecBase.zh: i) 修订对象。ii) 无维护服务。iii) 为其子类提供公共字段。
A_ProcessSpecBase.en: i) Revisioned object. ii) No maintenance service. iii) Provides common fields to its sub-classes.

A_ProcessSpecBins.en: The bins setup for a Process Spec.

A_ProcessSpecDetails.zh: i) 过程规格的子实体。ii) 列表中的每个项目将有一个操作（规格）的处理详细信息。iii) 并非所有操作（规格）都会在此处有条目。
A_ProcessSpecDetails.en: i) Sub-entity of Process Spec. ii) Each item in the list will have processing details for an operation (spec). iii) Not all operations (specs) will have an entry here.

A_ProcessSpecDetailsParams.zh: i) 过程规格详细信息的子实体列表。ii) 提供参数组、链接、名称和值。iii) 有效参数列表来自参数名称用户代码。
A_ProcessSpecDetailsParams.en: i) Sub-entity list of Process Spec Details. ii) Provides the parameter groups, links, names and values. iii) Valid list of parameters comes from Param Name user code.

A_ProcessSpecParams.zh: i) 过程规格的子实体。ii) 设置过程规格的参数。iii) 有效参数列表来自参数名称用户代码。
A_ProcessSpecParams.en: i) Sub-entity of Process Spec. ii) Sets the parameters for the process spec. iii) Valid list of parameters comes from Param Name user code.

A_ProcessSpecStatus.zh: i) 定义有效的过程规格状态。ii) 例如 a. PR - 生产就绪
A_ProcessSpecStatus.en: i) Defines valid process spec status. ii) E.g. a. PR - Production Ready

A_ProcessType.zh: 过程类型的有效值。例如NORMAL、HOT、ROOM和COLD。
A_ProcessType.en: Valid values for Process Types. E.g. NORMAL, HOT, ROOM and COLD.

A_ProductBOM.zh: 用于生产产品的物料清单。
A_ProductBOM.en: Bill of Materials used to produce a product.

A_ProductBOMBase.zh: 用于生产产品的物料清单。
A_ProductBOMBase.en: Bill of Materials used to produce a product.

A_ProductLine.en: Used to identify a production line.

A_RecipeMatrix.zh: 这是ProcessControl的一个新对象（NDO）子类，创建用于存储基于矩阵确定所需配方所需的信息。
A_RecipeMatrix.en: This is a new object (NDO) subclass of ProcessControl that is created to store the information required to determine the recipe required based on a matrix

A_RejectCategory.zh: i) 在拒收记录期间定义拒收的类别。ii) 例如 a. INCIDENT - 事件案例 b. PROCESS - 过程相关 c. ESCAPEE - 逃逸 d. MATERIAL - 材料相关
A_RejectCategory.en: i) Defines the category for a reject during Rejects Recording. ii) E.g. a. INCIDENT - Incident case b. PROCESS - Process related c. ESCAPEE - Escapee d. MATERIAL - Material related

A_ResortNoteCode.zh: 分选期间使用的重排注释代码。
A_ResortNoteCode.en: Resort Note Code used during Sorting.

A_ResourceBOM.en: Bill of materials used for the Resource.

A_ResourceBOMBase.en: Bill of materials used for the Resource.

A_ResourceIcon.zh: 用于为资源标识图标的设置。供自定义应用显示资源时使用。
A_ResourceIcon.en: Setup used to identify an icon to a Resource. It is meant for custom applications to use to display a Resource.

A_RoleAccess.en: Additional access control for a role.

A_RunNumberSetup.zh: 用于设置引用编号规则的名称，该规则将用于生成分配给事务（如批次进站）的序列。其数据子实体列表字段用于记录为运行编号收集的WIP数据。
A_RunNumberSetup.en: Used to setup a Name that references a Numbering Rule that will be used to generate the sequence assigned to a transaction like Track In Lot. Its Data sub-entity list field is used to record the WIP Data that was collected for a Run Number.

A_RunNumberSetupData.zh: 此子实体列表字段用于记录为运行编号收集的WIP数据。
A_RunNumberSetupData.en: This sub-entity list field is used to record the WIP Data that was collected for a Run Number.

A_SamplingPlanSetup.zh: 此“设置B”对象，作为过程对象的子类，允许用户配置在运行时动态确定的抽样计划。
A_SamplingPlanSetup.en: This "Set-Up B" object, sub-classed from Process Object, allows a user to configure a sampling plan that is dynamically determined at run-time.

A_ScanningData.zh: 存储所有已完成的扫描数据。
A_ScanningData.en: Stores all Scanning Data that has been completed.

A_ScanningName.zh: 通过指示扫描计划以及链接到自定义Web GUI的Web地址来标识扫描要求。
A_ScanningName.en: Identifies the scanning requirement by indicating the Scanning Plan and the Web Address that links to the customized Web GUI.

A_ScheduleInstructions.zh: 基于条件的设置，用于在批次调度期间提供指令。
A_ScheduleInstructions.en: Criteria based setup used to provide instructions during Lot Schedule.

A_ScheduleSSPlan.zh: 用作参考，为调度提供补充规格详细信息指令列表。在批次调度和批次调度修改期间，该列表将被复制，然后用户可以在需要时修改调度。
A_ScheduleSSPlan.en: Used as a reference to provide a list of Supplementary Spec Details instructions for a schedule. During Lot Schedule and Lot Schedule Modify the list will be copied over and the user is then allowed to modify for the schedule if required.

A_ServiceAttrsSetup.zh: 这是一个基于条件的设置，用于标识允许为特定服务（例如批次修改属性和修改多批次属性）修改的一个或多个属性（即修改属性设置）。
A_ServiceAttrsSetup.en: This is a criteria based setup used to identify one or more attributes (i.e. Modify Attrs Setup) that are allowed to be modified for a particular service such as Lot Modify Attrs and Modify Multi Lots Attribute.

A_ServiceRules.zh: 将与服务一起执行的可配置验证规则。必须将一个或多个服务规则分配给所需服务的所需服务设置。
A_ServiceRules.en: Configurable validation rules that will be executed together with a service. One or more Service Rules must be assigned to the required Service Setup for the required Service.

A_ServiceRulesValidations.zh: 包含FailureExpression以评估自定义逻辑的验证。
A_ServiceRulesValidations.en: Validations that contains FailureExpression to evaluate custom logic.

A_ServiceSetup.zh: 用于为现有服务添加附加逻辑的设置。设置名称必须与现有服务匹配。例如，对于批次开始服务，设置必须称为LotStart。
A_ServiceSetup.en: Setup used to add additional logic onto an existing service. The name of the setup must match an existing Service. E.g. for Lot Start service the setup must be called LotStart.

A_ServiceSetupBusinessRules.zh: 可选列表，用于指定服务的业务规则。
A_ServiceSetupBusinessRules.en: Optional list to specify the Business Rules for the Service.

A_ShipErrors.zh: 存储发运事务的错误。即批次发运传输和批次发运接收。
A_ShipErrors.en: Stores the errors for shipping transactions. I.e. Lot Ship Transmit and Lot Ship Receiving.

A_ShipFactoryCode.zh: 与发运工厂代码类似，此设置通常用于为工厂提供替代名称。它可用于生成序列。一个示例是在批次发运期间生成文档编号序列。
A_ShipFactoryCode.en: Similar to Ship Plant Code, this setup is typically used to provide an alternative name for the Factory. It can be used to generate a sequence. An example would be to generate the Document Number sequence during Lot Ship.

A_ShipFromFactory.zh: 标识接收批次的来源（即工厂）。每个设置可以有一个或多个详细信息，用于指定在途位置和接收位置。
A_ShipFromFactory.en: Identifies the source (i.e. factory) where lots are being received. Each setup can have one or more Details that are used to specify the In-Transit Location and Receiving Location.

A_ShipPlantCode.zh: 与发运工厂代码类似，此设置通常用于为工厂提供替代名称。它可用于生成序列。一个示例是在批次发运期间生成文档编号序列。
A_ShipPlantCode.en: Similar to Ship Factory Code, this setup is typically used to provide an alternative name for the Factory. It can be used to generate a sequence. An example would be to generate the Document Number sequence during Lot Ship.

A_ShipToFactory.zh: 标识批次发往的目的地（即工厂）。
A_ShipToFactory.en: Identifies the destination (i.e. factory) where lots are to ship to.

A_ShipToProcess.zh: 标识发入或发出批次的预期过程。
A_ShipToProcess.en: Identifies the intended process for the lots being shipped in or out.

A_SortIQCLotCheck.zh: 分选IQC的批次检查有效值。
A_SortIQCLotCheck.en: Lot Checks valid values for Sort IQC.

A_SortIQCWaferCheck.zh: 分选IQC的晶圆检查有效值。
A_SortIQCWaferCheck.en: Wafer Check valid values for Sort IQC.

A_SortNoteCode.zh: 分选期间使用的分选注释代码。
A_SortNoteCode.en: Sort Note Code used during Sorting.

A_SortSQAFailure.zh: 分选SQA失败原因的有效值。
A_SortSQAFailure.en: Valid values for Sort SQA Failure Reasons.

A_SPCChart.zh: 半导体SPC图表主数据。 物理对应 A_SPCChart (CdoId: 679477366, Workspace: csi)。
A_SPCChart.en: Semiconductor SPC chart master data. Physically corresponds to A_SPCChart (CdoId: 679477366, Workspace: csi).

A_SPCConnection.zh: 由SPC宏用于链接数据库以获取数据用于绘图。
A_SPCConnection.en: Used by the SPC macro to link to a database to fetch data for plotting.

A_SPCExcludeReason.zh: 可用于解释数据点（SPCTxnDataPoint）为何被排除在未来计算之外的原因代码。
A_SPCExcludeReason.en: Reason code that can be used to give a reason why a data point (SPCTxnDataPoint) is being excluded for future calculation.

A_SPCMacro.zh: 链接到用于绘制图表的物理SPC宏文件。SEMI Suite解决方案提供了一个基础宏文件，该文件利用所有SPC控件对象来绘制SPC。
A_SPCMacro.en: Links to a physical SPC macro file that is used to plot the charts. SEMI Suite solution provides a base macro file that utilizes all the SPC controls objects to plot SPC.

A_SPCMatrix.zh: 基于条件的SPCSetup选择。在出站期间使用。
A_SPCMatrix.en: Criteria base selection of SPCSetup. Used during Track Out.

A_SPCMatrixParams.zh: 用于覆盖SPCSetupDetails参数中定义的相应参数的图表参数。
A_SPCMatrixParams.en: Chart parameteters that are used to override the corresponding parameters defined in SPCSetupDetails' Params.

A_SPCRules.zh: 链接到物理SPC规则文件，并由SPC设置用于定义应用于SPC图表的规则。注意，名称字段必须与Statit环境中设置的规则名称匹配。
A_SPCRules.en: Links to a physical SPC rules file and is used by SPC Setup to define the rules to be applied to an SPC Chart. Note that the Name field must match the rule name setup in the Statit environment.

A_SPCSetup.zh: 主要的SPC控件，用于定义要绘制的一个或多个图表、规则以及要执行的失败操作。
A_SPCSetup.en: The main SPC control that is used to define one or more charts to be plotted, rules and failure actions to be carried out.

A_SPCSetupDetailsInlineParam.zh: 定义SPC配置内联参数。 物理对应 A_SPCSetupDetailsInlineParam (CdoId: 681574519, Workspace: 40)。
A_SPCSetupDetailsInlineParam.en: Defines SPC configuration inline parameters. Physically corresponds to A_SPCSetupDetailsInlineParam (CdoId: 681574519, Workspace: 40).

A_SPCSetupDetailsParams.zh: 每个SPC设置详细信息的规则和图表参数。
A_SPCSetupDetailsParams.en: The Rules and Chart parameters for each SPC Setup Details.

A_SPCSetupDetailsTitle.zh: 支持动态表达式的SPC图表自定义标题。
A_SPCSetupDetailsTitle.en: Custom title for SPC chart that can support dynamic expression.

A_SPCSetupParams.zh: SPC设置的参数。例如用于提供动态值以解析SPC查询的where子句。
A_SPCSetupParams.en: Parameters for the SPC Setup. E.g. use to provide dynamic values to resolve where clauses for the SPC Query.

A_SPCTxnDataDetails.zh: 存储已执行的图表及其一些详细信息。
A_SPCTxnDataDetails.en: Stores the charts executed and some of its details.

A_SPCTxnDataPoint.zh: 存储特定数据点的注释和排除。
A_SPCTxnDataPoint.en: Stores annotation and exclusion for a particular Data Point.

A_SPCWIPDataMatrixParams.zh: WIP数据设置矩阵详细信息的参数。
A_SPCWIPDataMatrixParams.en: Parameters for WIP Data Setup Matrix Details

A_StepCycleTimeSetup.zh: 步骤周期时间设置。用于装配过程。
A_StepCycleTimeSetup.en: Setup for Step Cycle Time. Used for assembly processes.

A_StepLogic.zh: 提供一种在规格处执行自定义逻辑的标识方式。
A_StepLogic.en: Provides a way of identifying custom logic to be executed at a Spec.

A_TerminateAccount.zh: 终止账户的有效值。在TerminateLot期间使用。
A_TerminateAccount.en: Valid values for Terminate Account. Used during TerminateLot.

A_TestIQCOption.en: Facilitate the configuration of Test IQC.

A_TestIQCParams.zh: 测试IQC变量数据测试的关键参数。
A_TestIQCParams.en: Critical parameters for Test IQC Variable Data test.

A_TestProgramSetup.zh: 此设置用于标识规格的测试程序。
A_TestProgramSetup.en: Setup used to identify the Test Programs for a Spec.

A_TestProgramSetupDetails.zh: 每个测试程序设置的详细信息。
A_TestProgramSetupDetails.en: The Details for each Test Program setup.

A_ToolPlan.zh: 用于设置资源所需的工装类型。每个资源可分配一个工具计划。如果为资源分配了工具计划，则在资源能够用于处理批次之前，必须在该资源中设置所需工具。
A_ToolPlan.en: Used to setup the types of tooling required for the Resource. Each of the Resource can be assigned a Tool Plan. If a Tool Plan is assigned to the Resource, the required tools must be setup in the Resource before it can be used to process lots.

A_ToolPlanDetails.zh: 计划中每项工装需求的详细信息。
A_ToolPlanDetails.en: The details for each tooling requirement for the plan.

A_ToolPlanItem.en: Stores the items for each ToolPlan.

A_ToolPlanMatrix.zh: 这是ProcessControl的一个新的命名数据对象（NDO）子类，用于配置工具计划矩阵。
A_ToolPlanMatrix.en: This is a new named data object (NDO) sub-class of ProcessControl, use configure the Tool Plan matrix.

A_VarianceReason.zh: 用于数量差异的原因代码。
A_VarianceReason.en: The reason code used for Count Variance.

A_WaferAttributeSetup.zh: 用于标识可通过WIP Data更新的Lot Wafers中字段的设置。
A_WaferAttributeSetup.en: Setup used to identify the fields in Lot Wafers that can be updated through WIP Data.

A_WIPDataDisplayFilter.zh: 此设置用于在WIP Data Setup中为每个WIP Data Name（即Details）定义显示过滤器。它在WIP Data GUI中用于允许过滤显示内容，以满足不同用户组录入数据的目的。
A_WIPDataDisplayFilter.en: This setup is used to define Display Filters for each WIP Data Name (i.e. the Details) within a WIP Data Setup. It is used in the WIP Data GUI to allow filtering of what is displayed for the purpose of different groups of users entering data.

A_WIPDataName.zh: 指定在WIP Data期间可收集的数据，并在WIP Data Setup中用于指示所需的数据收集集。
A_WIPDataName.en: Specifies the data that can be collected during WIP Data and is used in WIP Data Setup to indicate the data collection set required.

A_WIPDataSetup.zh: 用于WIP Data（在Track In、Track Out、Complete Insertion及Move Out期间）、Ad-Hoc WIP Data以及Job Control事务的数据收集设置。请注意，某些字段在特定事务中被忽略。例如，对于所有Job Control事务
A_WIPDataSetup.en: Data collection setup for WIP Data (during Track In, Track Out, Complete Insertion and Move Out), Ad-Hoc WIP Data and Job Control transactions. Note that certain fields are ignored for certain transactions. For example, for all Job Control transactions

A_WIPInstructions.zh: 基于条件的设置，用于在使用WIPMain服务时在Move In、Track In、Track Out和Move Out期间显示指令。
A_WIPInstructions.en: Criteria based setup to display instructions during Move In, Track In, Track Out and Move Out when using the WIPMain service.

A_WIPLot.zh: i) Lot的子实体列表。ii) 存储批次的过程信息。iii) 当一个批次进入某步骤（或从上一步骤移出）且尚未进行任何操作时，必须首先触发Process Control以确定其处理需求。iv
A_WIPLot.en: i) Sub-entity list of Lot. ii) Stores the process information for a lot. iii) When a lot enters a step (or move out from the previous step) and nothing has been done yet, the Process Control must first be triggered to determine its processing needs. iv

A_YieldType.zh: 标识所需的良率处理类型
A_YieldType.en: Identifies the type of yield handling required

ActionCategory.en: ActionCategory object is using to collect Actions in categories on SourcePages

ActionDef.zh: Action CDO基于ActionRule，用于标识该操作是否可对对象执行。
ActionDef.en: The Action CDO is based on an ActionRule and used to identify if this action could be performed against an object.

ActionDefActionRules.zh: 连接动作定义与动作规则。 物理对应 ActionDefActionRules (CdoId: 1357, Workspace: csi)。
ActionDefActionRules.en: Links action definitions and action rules. Physically corresponds to ActionDefActionRules (CdoId: 1357, Workspace: csi).

ActionDefinition.zh: ActionDefinition — 定义系统在特定事件或WIP消息触发时执行的联动动作（如：发送邮件、冻结容器等）。
ActionDefinition.en: ActionDefinition — Defines the linked actions that the system executes when triggered by specific events or WIP messages (e.g., sending email, freezing containers, etc.).

ActionRule.en: ActionRules is used to define expressions for Actions.

Activity.zh: 活动是处理Quality对象期间的基本工作单元。
Activity.en: An activity is the basic unit of work during processing of a Quality object

ActivityPlan.zh: 活动执行顺序和计划配置。 物理对应 ActivityPlan (CdoId: 1156, Workspace: csi)。
ActivityPlan.en: Activity execution sequence and scheduling configuration. Physically corresponds to ActivityPlan (CdoId: 1156, Workspace: csi).

AlarmDefinition.zh: 告警消息、优先级、动作和通知配置。 物理对应 AlarmDefinition (CdoId: 272, Workspace: csi)。
AlarmDefinition.en: Alarm message, priority, action, and notification configuration. Physically corresponds to AlarmDefinition (CdoId: 272, Workspace: csi).

ApprovalDecision.zh: 定义为审批表上的条目可采取的选项。
ApprovalDecision.en: Defines an option that can be taken for an entry on an approval sheet.

ApprovalDecisionList.en: A list of decisions that are allowed for an ApprovalSheet.

ApprovalSheet.zh: 审批表用于收集审批者的签名以表示对对象的接受或拒绝。
ApprovalSheet.en: An approval sheet is used to collect signatures of approvers to indicate acceptance or rejection of an object

ApprovalSheetMap.en: The ApprovalSheetMap sets up that relationship of the ResolutionAction to the ApprovalSheetTemplate.

ApprovalSheetTemplate.zh: 审批表用于收集对对象状态做出决策的审批者的签名。模板用于预定义将附加到对象的审批表。
ApprovalSheetTemplate.en: An approval sheet is used to collect signatures of approvers who are making decisions regarding the status of an object. The template is used to pre-define the sheets that will be attached to the object.

AQLLevel.zh: 描述在给定样本量下特定AQL级别允许的拒收数量。此对象的每个实例表示分配给抽样计划的可接受质量水平（AQL）值（例如0.25、1.5、4.0等）。
AQLLevel.en: Describes the number of Rejects allowed for a specific AQL level for a given Sample Size. Each instance of this object represents an Acceptable Quality Level (AQL) value that is assigned to a Sample Plan (i.e. 0.25, 1.5, 4.0, etc.).

AttachedDocs.zh: 建模对象所附文档集合的配置实体。 物理对应 AttachedDocs (CdoId: 1094, Workspace: csi)。
AttachedDocs.en: Configuration entity for the document collection attached to modeled objects. Physically corresponds to AttachedDocs (CdoId: 1094, Workspace: csi).

BillOfProcess.zh: 工艺清单（Bill Of Process）用于指定对规范（spec）的覆盖，并分配给容器、制造订单或产品。
BillOfProcess.en: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

BillOfProcessBase.zh: 工艺清单（Bill Of Process）用于指定对规范（spec）的覆盖，并分配给容器、制造订单或产品。
BillOfProcessBase.en: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

BillOfProcessOverride.zh: 系统新增了一个命名子实体，用于维护工艺清单对Spec值的覆盖。
BillOfProcessOverride.en: A new Named Subentity is added to the system to maintain the Bill of Process overrides to the Spec values

BillType.zh: 用于区分此清单结构的意图。同一产品可存在多个清单。根据使用清单的部门，清单可以处于更高或更低的分解级别。可添加并非制造过程物理部分的项目，以协助标准成本计算或人工报告。
BillType.en: Used to distinguish the intent of this Bill structure. Several Bills can exist for the same product. Bills can be at higher or lower levels of resolution depending on the department that is using the Bill. Items that are not physically part of the manufacturing process can be added to assist standard costing calculations or labor reporting.

BizRuleHandlerParameter.zh: 业务规则处理程序参数

BOM.zh: 物料清单（BOM）定义了生产特定产品所需的物料。
BOM.en: A bill of material defines the materials needed to produce a specific product.

BOMBase.zh: 物料清单（BOM）定义了生产容器所需的物料（原材料、子组件、说明等）。BOM通常按产品定义，但也可按订单、容器等定义。
BOMBase.en: A bill of material(BOM) defines the materials (raw materials, sub-assemblies, instructions, etc.) needed to produce a container. BOMs are most often defined per product, but can be defined per order, per container, etc.

BOMMaterialListItem.zh: 表示完成给定制造或装配步骤所需的特定物料，如容器的当前WorkflowStep中引用的ERP RouteStep所定义。指定了必要的数量或比例以及适当的计量单位。此特定类型的物料清单项目用于ERPBOM（即由ERP系统创建并下载到InSite的BOM）。创建此特定对象类型是为了使BOM组件列表能够与MfgOrder或Container组件列表分开存储。
BOMMaterialListItem.en: Represents a particular material that is required to complete a given manufacturing or assembly step, as defined by the ERP RouteStep refenced in the current WorkflowStep of the container. The necessary quantities or proportions of the item are specified as are the appropriate units of measure. This particular type of material list item is used on ERPBOMs, which are BOMs created by the ERPsystem and downloaded to InSite. This particular object type was created so that BOM component lists could be stored in a separate table from MfgOrder or Container component lists.

BonusReason.en: The user code for bonus reason.

BonusReasonGroup.zh: 表示一组奖励原因的用户代码对象组。
BonusReasonGroup.en: A User Code Object Group that represents a group of Bonus Reasons.

BPSpecBizRuleTxnMap.zh: 包含在此spec处触发的业务规则列表。还包括应执行触发的容器事务以及在该事务中规则应触发的时间。
BPSpecBizRuleTxnMap.en: Contains a lisf ot business ruiles to fire at this spec. It also includes the container txn that should do the firing and when in that txn the rule should fire.

BusinessProcessSpec.zh: 规范（Spec）描述了工作流中某个步骤处发生的处理。它引用了许多其他建模组件。
BusinessProcessSpec.en: A specification (Spec) describes the processing that takes place at a Step within a Workflow. It references many other Modeling components.

BusinessProcessSpecBase.zh: 规范（Spec）描述了工作流中某个步骤处发生的处理。它引用了许多其他建模组件。
BusinessProcessSpecBase.en: A specification (Spec) describes the processing that takes place at a Step within a Workflow. It references many other Modeling components.

BusinessProcessWorkflow.zh: 工作流定义了工艺所需的路径和处理。工作流是由Paths链接的Steps集合，Steps引用其他工作流或Specs。
BusinessProcessWorkflow.en: A Workflow defines the route and processing required for a process, A Workflow is a collection of Steps that are linked by Paths, Steps reference either other Workflows or Specs

BusinessProcessWorkflowBase.zh: 工作流定义了工艺所需的路径和处理。工作流是由Paths链接的Steps集合，Steps引用其他工作流或Specs。
BusinessProcessWorkflowBase.en: A Workflow defines the route and processing required for a process, A Workflow is a collection of Steps that are linked by Paths, Steps reference either other Workflows or Specs

BusinessRuleHandlerData.zh: 业务规则处理程序数据

BuyReason.en: The user code for buy reason.

BuyReasonGroup.zh: 表示一组购买原因的用户代码对象组。
BuyReasonGroup.en: A User Code Object Group that represents a group of Buy Reasons.

CalendarShift.zh: 制造日历的主要功能。制造日历包含一组“日历班次”。每个日历班次在特定的日历日期/时间开始和结束，并包括在此时间段内使用哪个班次、制造日期等信息。
CalendarShift.en: The primary feature of the Manufacturing Calendar. The Manufacturing Calendar contains a collection (list) of "calendar shifts". Each calendar shift starts and ends at a particular calendar date/time, and includes information on which shift, mfg date, etc. to use for this time period.

CAPACustomData.en: Used to manage customer extensions to CAPA.

CategoryMap.en: The CategoryMap sets up that relationship of the QualityObject's Category to a particular TriageSpec.

ChangeMgtApplication.zh: 特定于变更管理的配置设置。
ChangeMgtApplication.en: Configuration settings specific to Change Management.

ChangePackage.zh: 变更包用于管理交付给目标系统以供使用的内容。
ChangePackage.en: A change package is used to manage what is delivered to a target system for consumption.

ChangePackagePriority.en: Various priorities for a change package

ChangePackageReason.zh: 创建变更包的各种原因。
ChangePackageReason.en: Various reasons for creating a change package.

ChangeStatusReason.zh: 容器状态变更原因的用户代码。
ChangeStatusReason.en: The user code for container status change reason.

Checklist.zh: 检查表连接到流程对象或模板，并包含从检查表模板复制的条目。
Checklist.en: Checklists are connected to process objects or templates and contain entries copied from Checklist Template.

ChecklistEntry.zh: 定义检查表配置中的响应条目。
ChecklistEntry.en: Defines the response entry within Checklist Configuration.

ChecklistTemplate.zh: 检查表模板对象允许用户配置检查表项目/问题，并将每个项目与适当的响应集关联。
ChecklistTemplate.en: The Checklist Template object allows the user to configure checklist items/questions and associate each item with the appropriate Response Set.

ChecklistTemplateBase.zh: 检查表模板对象允许用户配置检查表项目/问题，并将每个项目与适当的响应集关联。
ChecklistTemplateBase.en: The Checklist Template object allows the user to configure checklist items/questions and associate each item with the appropriate Response Set.

Classification.zh: 用于对质量对象进行分类

CollaboratorEntry.zh: 协作者表中的条目指定单个协作者的详细信息。
CollaboratorEntry.en: An entry in an collaborator sheet specifies the details for a single collaborator.

CollaboratorTemplate.zh: 模板用于预定义将附加到对象的协作者。
CollaboratorTemplate.en: The template is used to pre-define the collaborators that will be attached to the object.

CollectionGate.zh: 此功能在当前版本的InSite中未实现。集合门用于允许将容器分离成多个容器以便在门内进行处理，然后要求容器在离开门前重新组合。典型用途是拆分出一个单元（例如前送晶圆）进行至某一点的处理，利用该单元处理的反馈对批次剩余部分进行调整，然后确保批次在离开该区域前重新合并。
CollectionGate.en: This is not implemented in the current version of InSite. A Collection Gate is used to allow a Container to be separated into multiple Containers for processing with the Gate and then require the Containers to be regrouped before exiting the Gate. A typical use of this is splitting off a unit (i.e., Send-Ahead Wafer) for processing up to a certain point, using feedback from the processing of that unit to make adjustments for the remainder of the batch and then insuring that the batch is recombined before leaving the area.

CombineHistory.zh: Combine服务的历史摘要对象。每次合并将创建一个CombineHistory对象。CombineHistory对象及任何相关详细信息对象将包含Combine服务所需但尚未包含在HistoryMainline对象中的全部历史信息。
CombineHistory.en: History Summary object for the Combine Service. One CombineHistory object will be created for every combine. The CombineHistory object plus any related details objects will contain all the history information needed for the Combine service that is not already contained in the HistoryMainline object.

CombineHistoryDetail.zh: Combine服务的历史详细信息对象。每次合并将创建一个CombineHistory对象。CombineHistory对象将包含Combine服务所需但尚未包含在HistoryMainline对象中的全部历史信息。
CombineHistoryDetail.en: History Detail object for the Combine Service. One CombineHistory object will be created for every Combine. The CombineHistory object will contain all the history information needed for the Combine service that is not already contained in the HistoryMainline object.

CommentType.zh: 生产事件日志的注释类型
CommentType.en: Comment Type for Production Event Log

CompDefectReasonGroup.zh: CompDefectReasonGroup — 组件缺陷原因组。对具体的组件缺陷原因代码(CompDefectReason)进行分组管理的命名对象，用以在特定操作工位/工序(Operation)限制可选的组件缺陷原因代码列表。支持嵌套子组。
CompDefectReasonGroup.en: CompDefectReasonGroup — Component defect reason group. A named object that groups specific component defect reason codes (CompDefectReason) for management, used to restrict the selectable component defect reason code list at a specific operation/workstation (Operation). Supports nested subgroups.

ComponentDefectReason.zh: 组件缺陷原因的用户代码。
ComponentDefectReason.en: The user code for component defect reason.

Computation.zh: Computation CDO允许定义计算表达式。
Computation.en: Computation CDO allows to define computational expressions.

ComputationParamSpec.zh: 计算参数规范用于定义Computation中的参数。
ComputationParamSpec.en: Computation Parameter Specifications are used to define parameters in the Computation.

Container.zh: 容器（Container）描述一个离散的工作单元或离散数量的物料（例如，物料批次、序列化组件或序列化物料件、唯一标识的包含产品的包装或容器等）。容器可包括
Container.en: A Container describes a discrete unit of work or a discrete quantity of material (i.e., batch of material, a serialized component or serialized piece of material, a uniquely identified package or vessel that contains product, etc.) A Container can includ

ContainerAutoHoldReq.zh: 包含为保持容器而必须匹配的条件列表。
ContainerAutoHoldReq.en: Contains the list of criteria that should be matched in order to hold the Container.

ContainerDefectReason.zh: 容器缺陷原因的用户代码。
ContainerDefectReason.en: The user code for container defect reason.

ContainerGroup.zh: 此功能在当前版本的InSite中未实现。表示一组容器的对象组。
ContainerGroup.en: This is not implemented in the current version of InSite. An Object Group that represents a group of Containers.

ContainerLevel.zh: 容器级别是分配给容器的跟踪指定。该级别标识容器在容器结构中的位置。在InSite中，容器定义为工厂中生产的产品的一个离散集合。每个容器都有唯一的标识符，用于追溯和执行车间事务。常用的级别名称有批次（batch）和批次（lot）。容器级别根据各公司的具体需求进行定义。一些行业特定级别的示例包括卷（roll）、箱（bin）和盒（cassette）。许多公司还在更大的父容器内跟踪更小的级别。在InSite中，这通过多级跟踪实现。父级和子级容器通过Associate、Combine或Group Start事务关联。例如，一组容器可以有一个父容器（批次级别）和关联的子容器（托盘级别）。容器组也可以有超过两个级别。
ContainerLevel.en: A Container Level is the tracking designation assigned to a container. The level identifies the position of the container within a container structure. A container is defined within InSite as a discrete collection of products produced in a factory. Each container has a unique identifier used for traceability and performance of shop floor transactions. Commonly used level names are batch and lot. Container Levels are defined to meet the specific requirements of each company. Examples of some industry-specific levels are roll, bin, and cassette. Many companies also track smaller levels within the larger, parent container. With InSite, this is accomplished through multi-level tracking. Parent and child level containers are associated using the Associate, Combine or Group Start transactions. For example, a group of containers can have a parent with a batch level and associated child containers with tray levels. Container groups can also have more than two levels.

ContainerStatusChangeHistory.en: The history of container status change

ContDefectReasonGroup.zh: ContDefectReasonGroup — 容器缺陷原因组。对具体的容器缺陷原因代码(ContainerDefectReason)进行分组管理的命名对象，用以在特定操作工位/工序(Operation)限制可选的容器缺陷原因代码列表。支持嵌套子组。
ContDefectReasonGroup.en: ContDefectReasonGroup — Container defect reason group. A named object that groups specific container defect reason codes (ContainerDefectReason) for management, used to restrict the selectable container defect reason code list at a specific operation/workstation (Operation). Supports nested subgroups.

CurrentStatus.zh: 当前容器状态包含一个或多个容器的当前位置信息。多级容器结构中的每个容器都将引用单一的Current Container Status CDO。
CurrentStatus.en: The Current Container Status contains the current location information for one or more containers. Every container associated in a multilevel container structure will have a reference to a single Current Container Status CDO.

Customer.zh: 客户指接收商品和服务的公司。客户定义通常指您公司以外的公司，但也可用于需要从企业内部其他工厂或部门获得商品和服务的工厂或部门。
Customer.en: A Customer refers to a company that receives goods and services. A Customer definition typically refers to a company other than your own, but it can also be used for a factory or department that requires goods and services from another factory or department within the enterprise.

CycleTimeGate.zh: 此功能在当前版本的InSite中未实现。周期时间门用于定义测量完成工作所耗时间的起始点和停止点。典型的周期时间门在容器移入步骤时开始，在移出时结束。周期时间门跨越多个步骤也是常见的（同样从移入到移出测量）。
CycleTimeGate.en: This is not implemented in the current version of InSite. A Cycle-time Gate is used to define a Starting and Stopping Point to measure the elapsed time for completing work. A typical Cycle-time Gate would start when a Container is Moved-in to a Step and end when it is Moved-out. It will also be typical for a Cycle-time Gate to span multiple Steps (once again measuring from Move-in to Move-Out).

DataCollectionDef.zh: 数据收集定义用于为引用参数化数据CDO提供修订控制。
DataCollectionDef.en: A Data Collection Definition is used to provide revision control for referencing a parametircdata CDO.

DataCollectionDefBase.zh: 数据收集定义用于为引用ParametricData对象提供修订控制，该对象是需要记录的数据元素列表，如测量值。
DataCollectionDefBase.en: A Data Collection Definition is used to provide revision control for referencing a ParametricData object, which is a list of data elements such as measurements that need to be recorded.

DataPoint.en: A single data item to be collected for a DataPointCollectionDef.

DataPointCollection.zh: DataPointCollection包含DataPointCollectionGroup对象列表。DataPointCollection可附加到任何对象，允许录入数据的用户动态添加已定义DataPoint的额外样本，并动态定义和收集新的DataPoint。
DataPointCollection.en: A DataPointCollection contains a list of DataPointCollectionGroup objects. A DataPointCollection can be attached to any object and allows the User entering the data to dynamically add extra samples of defined DataPoints and also dynamically define and collect new DataPoints.

DataPointCollectionGroup.zh: DataPointCollectionGroup包含要收集的DataPointCollectionPoint对象列表。数据点可能互相关联，并以垂直或水平格式呈现，也可能不相关（未关联）并单独呈现。
DataPointCollectionGroup.en: A DataPointCollectionGroup contains a list of DataPointColletionPoint objects to be collected. The data points may be related to each other, and presented in a vertical or horizontal format, or unrelated (Unassociated) and presented individually.

DataTransport.zh: 描述用于发送出站XML文档的传输机制。
DataTransport.en: Describes the transport mechanism by which to send the outbound XML document

DelegateTaskHistory.en: History object for the DelegateTask service.

DelegationReasonCode.zh: 创建委托重新分配的各种原因。
DelegationReasonCode.en: Various reasons for creating a delegation reassignment.

DelegationTask.zh: 委托任务用于按日期期间配置从受托人（assignee）到目标员工的委托任务。
DelegationTask.en: Delegation Task is used to configure a delegation task from an assignee to a target employee by date period

DispatchDetail.zh: 单个调度详细将包含用于为特定类型事务生成用户优先工作列表的查询定义。支持的特定事务类型包括移入、移出以及按制造订单启动容器。
DispatchDetail.en: A single dispatch detail will contain the query definition used to generate a prioritized work list for the user for a particualr type of transaction. Particular transaction types supported include move-ins, move-outs, and starting of containers against a manufacturing order.

DispatchRule.zh: 车间物料加工顺序的优先级规则定义。调度规则可包含不同类型事务的单独详细信息。
DispatchRule.en: Definition of the prioritization rules for the order that material is processed on the shop floor. A dispatch rule can contain separate details for different types of transactions.

Disposition.zh: 标识可对分配给事件的批次采取的操作。例如报废、返工、退回供应商。
Disposition.en: Identifies the actions that can be taken on a Lot assigned to an Event. Examples are Scrap, Rework, Return to Vendor.

Document.zh: 大多数建模实体包含对文档的引用。在此上下文中，文档用于提供扩展（非结构化）信息，例如产品图纸、扫描图像、相关的现有制造规范或操作程序。每个文档（CDO）实例包括外部文档的标识符（即文件名或URL）和对用于呈现文档的程序的引用。文档还用于定义要下载到机器的配方文件。在这种情况下，呈现文档意味着将其呈现（下载）给机器。
Document.en: Most Modeling entities include a reference to a document. Documents are used in this context to provide extended (unstructured) information, such as product drawings, scanned images, relating existing manufacturing specifications, or operating procedures. Each instance of a document (CDO) includes an identifier for the external document (i.e., a file name or a URL) and a reference to the program used for presenting the document. Documents are also used to define recipe files for downloading to machines. In this case, presenting the Document means presenting it (downloading it) to a machine.

DocumentBase.zh: 大多数建模实体包含对文档的引用。在此上下文中，文档用于提供扩展（非结构化）信息，例如产品图纸、扫描图像、相关的现有制造规范或操作程序。每个文档（CDO）实例包括外部文档的标识符（即文件名或URL）和对用于呈现文档的程序的引用。文档还用于定义要下载到机器的配方文件。在这种情况下，呈现文档意味着将其呈现（下载）给机器。
DocumentBase.en: Most Modeling entities include a reference to a document. Documents are used in this context to provide extended (unstructured) information, such as product drawings, scanned images, relating existing manufacturing specifications, or operating procedures. Each instance of a document (CDO) includes an identifier for the external document (i.e., a file name or a URL) and a reference to the program used for presenting the document. Documents are also used to define recipe files for downloading to machines. In this case, presenting the Document means presenting it (downloading it) to a machine.

DocumentEntry.zh: 文档条目用于将文档包含在文档集中，并在文档集内为其提供描述。当请求显示文档集时，如果文档集中有多个文档，则使用文档条目列表构建选择列表。（请注意，文档集与文档之间的一对一关系可能是常见情况。）
DocumentEntry.en: A Document Entry is used to include a Document in a Document and provide a description for it within the Document Set. If there is more than one Document within a Document Set when a request is made to display a Document Set, the list of Document Entries is used to build a selection list. (Note that a one-to-one relationship between a Document Set and a Document is likely the common scenario).

DocumentSet.zh: 文档集是一个或多个文档的列表。大多数建模实体包含对文档集的引用。在此上下文中，文档用于提供扩展（非结构化）信息，例如产品图纸、扫描图像、相关的现有制造规范或操作程序。每个文档（CDO）实例包括外部文档的标识符（即文件名或URL）和对用于呈现文档的程序的引用。
DocumentSet.en: A Document Set is a list of one or more documents. Most Modeling entities include a reference to a Document Set. Documents are used in this context to provide extended (unstructured) information, such as product drawings, scanned images, relating existing manufacturing specifications, or operating procedures. Each instance of a Document (CDO) includes an identifier for the external document (i.e., a file name or a URL) and a reference to the program used for presenting the document.

DocumentViewer.zh: 文档查看器允许您指定用于查看InSite中定义的文档的应用程序。文档查看器定义包含应用程序的位置和启动该程序以显示文档的命令行字符串。例如，您可以定义使用Word、Excel或便携式文档格式（PDF）查看各种文档的文档查看器。
DocumentViewer.en: Document Viewer allows you to specify the application to use to view the documents that are defined within InSite. A Document Viewer definition contains the location of the application and a command line string that launches the program to display the document. For example, you may define Document Viewers that use Word, Excel, or Portable Document Format (PDF) to view various documents.

DynamicNumberingRule.zh: 使用多个序列的编号规则 - 每个解析的前缀值对应一个单独的序列
DynamicNumberingRule.en: A numbering rule that use multiple sequences - a separate sequence per resolved prefix value

ElectronicProcedure.zh: 提供在Spec处执行一系列任务（Tasks）的框架。电子规程（Electronic Procedure）定义一组指令（用于执行一组任务的检查表），并由一个或多个任务列表（TaskLists）组成。
ElectronicProcedure.en: Provides the framework for executing a series of Tasks at the Spec. An Electronic Procedure defines a set of instructions (a checklisst for performing a set of tasks), and is compose of one ore more TaskLists.

ElectronicProcedureBase.zh: 提供在Spec处执行一系列任务（Tasks）的框架。
ElectronicProcedureBase.en: Provides the framework for executing a series of Tasks at the Spec.

Employee.zh: 员工（Employee）是可以登录InSite、执行事务和/或获得工作积分的人员。员工必须具有Windows NT帐户。定义后，该用户将出现在Modeler Security窗口的用户列表中。这样，员工定义直接进入Modeler Security。员工定义还允许为每个用户设置其他选项，例如与用户关联的工厂和将使用的语言。将通过事务中的员工字段获得工作积分的人员必须作为InSite员工存在，但不需要作为Windows用户帐户存在。
Employee.en: An Employee is a person that can login to InSite, perform transactions, and/or be credited with work. The Employees must have a Windows NT account. Once defined, the user will then appear in the user list within the Modeler Security window. In this way the Employee definition feeds directly into the Modeler Security. The Employee definitions also allow for other options for each user such as the factory associate with the user and the language that will be used. Persons that will get credited with work by being entered in the employee field on a transaction, must exist as InSite employees, but are not required to exist as Windows user accounts.

EmployeeLoginInfo.zh: 包含有关员工登录的详细信息
EmployeeLoginInfo.en: Contains details about the employee's log in

EmployeeRole.zh: 员工在组织环境中的角色成员资格
EmployeeRole.en: Employee's Role membership in an Organizational context

Enterprise.zh: 企业（Enterprise）指工厂定义中的最高级别。企业可以代表公司本身，或公司的一个大部门。一个企业可包含一个或多个工厂。
Enterprise.en: The Enterprise refers to the highest level in the factory definition. The Enterprise can represent the company itself, or a large division of the company. An Enterprise can contain one or more factories.

EProcedureDetail.zh: 允许将TaskList按特定顺序分配给ElectronicProcedure。
EProcedureDetail.en: Allows a TaskList to be assigned to an ElectronicProcedure in a particular sequence.

ERPBOM.zh: 物料清单（BOM）定义了生产特定产品所需的物料。ERP BOM引用ERP路线中的步骤，而不是引用InSite工作流中的步骤。
ERPBOM.en: A bill of material (BOM) defines the materials needed to produce a specific product. An ERP BOM references steps in an ERP route instead of referencing steps in an InSite workflow.

ERPBOMBase.zh: 物料清单（BOM）定义了生产特定产品所需的物料。ERP BOM引用ERP路线中的步骤，而不是引用InSite工作流中的步骤。
ERPBOMBase.en: A bill of material (BOM) defines the materials needed to produce a specific product. An ERP BOM references steps in an ERP route instead of referencing steps in an InSite workflow.

ERPRoute.zh: ERP路线是与InSite工作流最接近的ERP概念。InSite中的ERPRoute对象旨在镜像ERP中的路线定义，其中存储在ERP中的定义是“主”定义，而InSite ERPRoute通过LiveConnect填充。ERPRoute用于将InSite的Moves和ComponentIssues与发生事务的ERPStep相关联。ERP路线中的步骤通常比InSite工作流中的步骤定义在更汇总的级别。
ERPRoute.en: ERP Routes are the closest ERP concept to an InSite workflow. The ERPRoute object in InSite is meant to be a mirror of the route definitions in the ERP, where the definition stored in the ERP is the "master" and the InSite ERPRoute is populated via LiveConnect. The ERPRoute is used to be able to relate InSite Moves and ComponentIssues to the ERPStep where the transaction occurred. Steps in an ERP route are usually defined at a more summarized level than is true for steps in an InSite workflow.

ERPRouteBase.zh: ERP路线是与InSite工作流最接近的ERP概念。InSite中的ERPRoute对象旨在镜像ERP中的路线定义，其中存储在ERP中的定义是“主”定义，而InSite ERPRoute通过LiveConnect填充。ERPRoute用于将InSite的Moves和ComponentIssues与发生事务的ERPStep相关联。ERP路线中的步骤通常比InSite工作流中的步骤定义在更汇总的级别。
ERPRouteBase.en: ERP Routes are the closest ERP concept to an InSite workflow. The ERPRoute object in InSite is meant to be a miiror of the route definitions in the ERP, where the definition stored in the ERP is the "master" and the InSite ERPRoute is populated via LiveConnect. The ERPRoute is used to be able to relate InSite Moves and ComponentIssues to the ERPStep where the transaction occurred. Steps in an ERP route are usually defined at a more summarized level than is true for steps in an InSite workflow.

ESigReqTxnMap.zh: 包含InSite服务与电子签名需求（ElectronicSignature Requirement）的匹配。
ESigReqTxnMap.en: Contains the matchup of an InSite service to an ElectronicSignature Requirement.

Event.zh: 事件标识需要进一步调查的可疑情况。事件可升级为NCR或附加到CAPA。
Event.en: An Event identifies something suspect for which more investigation must be done. Events may be escalated to an NCR or attached to CAPAs.

EventClassificationSpecMap.zh: 此子实体定义组织的有效分类/子分类组合。
EventClassificationSpecMap.en: This subentity defines the valid classification/subclassification combinations for the organization.

EventData.en: Identifies additional data for an Event.

EventDisposition.en: Identifies a Disposition for an Event.

EventFailure.zh: 标识事件的故障。故障是事件的外在症状，不一定是根本原因。
EventFailure.en: Identifies a failure for an Event. The failure is the outward symptom of the event, not necessarily the root cause.

EventFailureAction.zh: 标识事件或原因的操作。
EventFailureAction.en: Identifies a failure action for an Event or Cause.

EventLog.en: Identifies a Log for an Event.

ExecuteMfgOrderTaskHistory.zh: 制造订单任务执行的历史摘要
ExecuteMfgOrderTaskHistory.en: History summary for execution of Mfg Order task

Factory.zh: 工厂通常代表物理或逻辑的厂区。工厂可以是出于会计和报告目的而分离的任何部门、科室、工段或小组。工厂通常代表物理的制造厂房。
Factory.en: A Factory often represent a physical or logical plant. A Factory can be any division, department, section, or group that is separated for accounting and reporting purposes. A Factory often represents a physical manufacturing building.

FailureActionType.zh: 标识事件或原因的操作类型。
FailureActionType.en: Identifies a Action Type for an Event or Cause.

FailureActionTypeGroup.zh: FailureActionTypes的分组机制。标识可分配给事件或原因的可能的FailureActionTypes。
FailureActionTypeGroup.en: Grouping mechanism for the FailureActionTypes. Identifies the possible FailureActionTypes that can be assigned to an Event or Cause.

FailureActionTypeGroupEntries.zh: 连接失效处理动作类型组和动作类型。 物理对应 FailureActionTypeGroupEntries (CdoId: 1400, Workspace: csi)。
FailureActionTypeGroupEntries.en: Links failure handling action type groups and action types. Physically corresponds to FailureActionTypeGroupEntries (CdoId: 1400, Workspace: csi).

FailureMode.en: Identifies a FailureMode for an Event.

FailureModeGroup.zh: FailureModes的分组机制。标识可分配给事件的可能的FailureModes。
FailureModeGroup.en: Grouping mechanism for the FailureModes. Identifies the possible FailureModes that can be assigned to an Event.

FailureSeverity.zh: 标识事件故障的严重性。
FailureSeverity.en: Identifies the Severity of the Failure for an Event.

HistoryMainline.zh: 大多数或所有车间事务服务共有的历史信息存储在HistoryMainline中。通常每个车间事务有一个HistoryMainline条目，尽管复合事务可配置为在适当时生成多个HistoryMainlines。HistoryMainline是历史信息的主要来源。
HistoryMainline.en: History information that is common to most or all shop floor transaction services is stored in the HistoryMainline. Typically there is one HistoryMainline entry for each Shop floor transaction, although compound transactions can be configured to generate multiple HistoryMainlines when appropriate. The HistoryMainline is the primary source of History information.

HoldReason.zh: 将保留代码与容器关联可阻止对该容器执行事务。保留代码由用户定义，为保留提供多种描述（原因）。
HoldReason.en: Associating a Hold Code with a Container prevents transactions from being performed for that Container. Hold Codes are User Defined to provide multiple descriptions (reasons) for Holds.

HoldReleaseHistory.zh: Hold和Release服务的历史摘要对象。此对象及任何相关详细信息对象将包含服务所需但尚未包含在HistoryMainline对象中的全部历史信息。
HoldReleaseHistory.en: History Summary object for the Hold and Release Services. This object plus any related details objects will contain all the history information needed for the service that is not already contained in the HistoryMainline object.

HoldReleaseHistoryDetail.zh: HoldReleaseHistoryDetail用于存储在Release事务期间生成的容器及其祖先的历史。
HoldReleaseHistoryDetail.en: HoldReleaseHistoryDetail is used to store the history of a container and its ancestors generated durung the Release Txn.

HoldStatus.zh: Hold Status是跟踪特定对象的保留状态的实例。
HoldStatus.en: Hold Status is an instance to keep track of the Hold Status of a certain object

I_IntegrationMap.zh: 定义外部集成对象和字段映射。 物理对应 I_IntegrationMap (CdoId: 679477674, Workspace: 40)。
I_IntegrationMap.en: Defines external integration object and field mappings. Physically corresponds to I_IntegrationMap (CdoId: 679477674, Workspace: 40).

I_IntegrationMapDetails.zh: 连接集成映射与集成点。 物理对应 I_IntegrationMapDetails (CdoId: 679477673, Workspace: 40)。
I_IntegrationMapDetails.en: Links integration maps and integration points. Physically corresponds to I_IntegrationMapDetails (CdoId: 679477673, Workspace: 40).

I_IntegrationPoint.zh: 定义系统集成端点。 物理对应 I_IntegrationPoint (CdoId: 679477675, Workspace: 40)。
I_IntegrationPoint.en: Defines system integration endpoints. Physically corresponds to I_IntegrationPoint (CdoId: 679477675, Workspace: 40).

InspectionLevel.zh: 此对象的每个实例维护一组数量范围及其关联的批次大小代码，以分配给抽样计划。
InspectionLevel.en: Each instance of this object maintains a set of quantity ranges and their associated Lot Size Code to be assigned to a Sample Plan.

IssueActualsHistory.zh: 记录为满足BOM行项目需求而发放的实际值
IssueActualsHistory.en: Records the actual values issued to meet the BOM line item requirements

IssueCondition.zh: 发放条件用于控制使用“发放控制 - 发放容器（批量）”或“发放容器（序列化）”跟踪为容器的组件的发放。
IssueCondition.en: The Issue Condition is used to control the issuance of components that are tracked as Containers using Issue Control - Issue Container (Bulk) or Issue Container (Serialized).

IssueDifferenceReason.zh: 描述所需数量与实际发放数量之间差异的原因。
IssueDifferenceReason.en: Describes the reason for the difference between the required quantity and the actual quantity issued.

IssueReason.zh: 描述组件发放目的的原因代码列表。
IssueReason.en: A list of reason codes that describe the purpose of a component issue.

KPIEntry.en: Holds the definition for a single KPI

KPIMatrix.zh: KPI矩阵 - 保存KPI定义列表
KPIMatrix.en: KPI Matrix - holds the list of KPI definitions

KPITimeframe.zh: KPI时间范围 - 用于KPI矩阵条目定义
KPITimeframe.en: KPI Timeframe - used for KPI Matrix Entry definitions

KPIType.en: Defines the list of KPI Entry names

LabelTxnMap.zh: 包含服务与要打印的标签定义之间的匹配。
LabelTxnMap.en: Contains a match between a service and a label definition to be printed.

ldAssociateHistoryDetails.zh: 关联历史明细。物理对应 ldAssociateHistoryDetails (CdoId: 671088655, Workspace: 200)。
ldAssociateHistoryDetails.en: Association history details. Physically corresponds to ldAssociateHistoryDetails (CdoId: 671088655, Workspace: 200).

ldChangeIdHistory.zh: 标识变更历史。物理对应 ldChangeIdHistory (CdoId: 671088641, Workspace: 200)。
ldChangeIdHistory.en: Identifier change history. Physically corresponds to ldChangeIdHistory (CdoId: 671088641, Workspace: 200).

ldChangeIdHistoryDetails.zh: 标识变更历史明细。物理对应 ldChangeIdHistoryDetails (CdoId: 671088642, Workspace: 200)。
ldChangeIdHistoryDetails.en: Identifier change history details. Physically corresponds to ldChangeIdHistoryDetails (CdoId: 671088642, Workspace: 200).

ldContainerHistoryDetails.zh: 容器历史明细。物理对应 ldContainerHistoryDetails (CdoId: 671088665, Workspace: 200)。
ldContainerHistoryDetails.en: Container history details. Physically corresponds to ldContainerHistoryDetails (CdoId: 671088665, Workspace: 200).

ldInspectionPlan.zh: 检验计划。物理对应 ldInspectionPlan (CdoId: 671088654, Workspace: 200)。
ldInspectionPlan.en: Inspection plan. Physically corresponds to ldInspectionPlan (CdoId: 671088654, Workspace: 200).

ldInspPlanWIPData.zh: 检验计划WIP数据。物理对应 ldInspPlanWIPData (CdoId: 671088653, Workspace: 200)。
ldInspPlanWIPData.en: Inspection plan WIP data. Physically corresponds to ldInspPlanWIPData (CdoId: 671088653, Workspace: 200).

ldInspTask.zh: 检验任务。物理对应 ldInspTask (CdoId: 671088652, Workspace: 200)。
ldInspTask.en: Inspection task. Physically corresponds to ldInspTask (CdoId: 671088652, Workspace: 200).

ldInspTaskHistory.zh: 检验任务历史。物理对应 ldInspTaskHistory (CdoId: 671088649, Workspace: 200)。
ldInspTaskHistory.en: Inspection task history. Physically corresponds to ldInspTaskHistory (CdoId: 671088649, Workspace: 200).

ldInspTaskHistoryDetail.zh: 检验任务历史明细。物理对应 ldInspTaskHistoryDetail (CdoId: 671088648, Workspace: 200)。
ldInspTaskHistoryDetail.en: Inspection task history details. Physically corresponds to ldInspTaskHistoryDetail (CdoId: 671088648, Workspace: 200).

ldInspTaskList.zh: 检验任务列表。物理对应 ldInspTaskList (CdoId: 671088647, Workspace: 200)。
ldInspTaskList.en: Inspection task list. Physically corresponds to ldInspTaskList (CdoId: 671088647, Workspace: 200).

ldInspTaskWIPData.zh: 检验任务WIP数据。物理对应 ldInspTaskWIPData (CdoId: 671088651, Workspace: 200)。
ldInspTaskWIPData.en: Inspection task WIP data. Physically corresponds to ldInspTaskWIPData (CdoId: 671088651, Workspace: 200).

ldMaterialRequestOrder.zh: 物料请求订单。物理对应 ldMaterialRequestOrder (CdoId: 671088658, Workspace: 200)。
ldMaterialRequestOrder.en: Material request order. Physically corresponds to ldMaterialRequestOrder (CdoId: 671088658, Workspace: 200).

ldMaterialRequestOrderItem.zh: 物料请求订单项。物理对应 ldMaterialRequestOrderItem (CdoId: 671088657, Workspace: 200)。
ldMaterialRequestOrderItem.en: Material request order item. Physically corresponds to ldMaterialRequestOrderItem (CdoId: 671088657, Workspace: 200).

ldMaterialRequestTxnHistDetail.zh: 物料请求事务历史明细。物理对应 ldMaterialRequestTxnHistDetail (CdoId: 671088660, Workspace: 200)。
ldMaterialRequestTxnHistDetail.en: Material request transaction history details. Physically corresponds to ldMaterialRequestTxnHistDetail (CdoId: 671088660, Workspace: 200).

ldMaterialRequestTxnHistory.zh: 物料请求事务历史。物理对应 ldMaterialRequestTxnHistory (CdoId: 671088659, Workspace: 200)。
ldMaterialRequestTxnHistory.en: Material request transaction history. Physically corresponds to ldMaterialRequestTxnHistory (CdoId: 671088659, Workspace: 200).

ldModelPlan.zh: 模型计划。物理对应 ldModelPlan (CdoId: 671088656, Workspace: 200)。
ldModelPlan.en: Model plan. Physically corresponds to ldModelPlan (CdoId: 671088656, Workspace: 200).

LocalReworkReason.zh: 此功能在当前版本的InSite中未实现。LocalReworkReason
LocalReworkReason.en: This is not implemented in the current version of InSite. LocalReworkReason

LocalReworkReasonGroup.zh: 表示一组本地返工原因的用户代码对象组。
LocalReworkReasonGroup.en: A User Code Object Group that represents a group of Local Rework Reasons.

Location.zh: 定义工厂内的物理位置。这可以是定义整个工厂的单个Location这样的高级别，也可以是存放区内每个料箱的单独Location这样具体。每个容器均包含Location属性。该属性用于标识容器的物理位置。
Location.en: Defines a physical location within a Factory. This can be as high level as a single Location that defines the entire Factory or as specific as individual Locations for each bin within a holding area. Every Container includes a Location attribute. This is used to identify the physical location of the Container.

LossReason.en: The user code for loss reason.

LossReasonGroup.zh: 表示一组LossReasons的用户代码对象组。
LossReasonGroup.en: A User Code Object Group that represents a group of LossReasons.

LotSizeDetails.zh: 用于定义样本大小的最小/最大范围列表。
LotSizeDetails.en: A list of min./max. ranges used to define sample sizes.

MaintenanceClass.zh: 定义维护要求与一组资源之间的关系。
MaintenanceClass.en: Defines the relationship between a Maintenance Requirement and a group of Resources.

MaintenanceReason.en: Reason for maintence on a Resource.

MaintenanceReq.zh: 为资源或维护类别定义维护要求。
MaintenanceReq.en: Defines maintenance requirements for a Resource or MaintenanceClass.

MaintenanceReqBase.zh: 为资源或维护类别定义维护要求。
MaintenanceReqBase.en: Defines maintenance requirements for a Resource or MaintenanceClass.

MaintenanceReqss_UsageReqSetup.zh: 连接维护需求与使用需求配置明细。 物理对应 MaintenanceReqss_UsageReqSetup (CdoId: 681574408, Workspace: 40)。
MaintenanceReqss_UsageReqSetup.en: Links maintenance requirements and usage requirements configuration details. Physically corresponds to MaintenanceReqss_UsageReqSetup (CdoId: 681574408, Workspace: 40).

MasterDataCatalog.zh: 主数据目录使组织能够对其建模对象实施变更控制。
MasterDataCatalog.en: Master Data Catalog gives an organization the ability to enforce change control on their modeling objects.

MasterDataCatalogDtl.zh: 主数据目录的详细信息。
MasterDataCatalogDtl.en: The detail information for the Master Data Catalog

MasterRecipe.zh: 为执行配方中的一系列指令提供框架。定义一组指令（用于执行一组配方项目的检查表），并由一个或多个配方列表组成。
MasterRecipe.en: Provides the framework for executing a series of Instructions part of a Recipe. Defines a set of instructions (a checklist for performing a set of Recipe Items), and is compose of one ore more Recipe Lists.

MfgCalendar.zh: 用于将事务执行时间戳转换为特定制造日期和班次的日历。
MfgCalendar.en: Calendar that is used to translate the timestamp of when a transaction was performed into a specific manufacturing date and shift.

MfgLot.zh: 用于关联一组容器的新基类子类。
MfgLot.en: New subclass of Base object used to associate a group of containers.

MfgOrder.zh: 制造订单是对制造产品的请求。制造订单通常是为满足销售订单或库存需求而创建的，并且通常是 MES 与 ERP 系统之间的链接。制造订单可以包含产品容器列表。容器与制造订单的关系在容器的数据记录中建立和维护。该信息用于按制造订单提供在制品状态并向 ERP 系统提供在制品更新。
MfgOrder.en: A Manufacturing Order is a request to manufacture a product. Manufacturing orders are typically originated to fulfill a sales order or inventory requirements and are often a link between MES and an ERP system. A Manufacturing Order can contain a list of product containers. The relationship of a container to a manufacturing order is established and maintained in the containers data record. This information is used to provide WIP status by manufacturing order and WIP updates to the ERP system.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.zh: 表示完成给定制造或装配步骤所需的特定物料，由容器当前工作流步骤中引用的 ERP 工艺路线步骤定义。该项目的必要数量或比例以及适当的计量单位均已指定。此特定类型的物料列表项用于制造订单，其创建目的是使制造订单组件列表可以存储在与 BOM 或容器组件列表分开的表中。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.en: Represents a particular material that is required to complete a given manufacturing or assembly step, as defined by the ERP RouteStep refenced in the current WorkflowStep of the container. The necessary quantities or proportions of the item are specified as are the appropriate units of measure. This particular type of material list item is used on Mfg orders, and was created so that MfgOrder component lists could be stored in a separate table from BOM or Container component lists.

MfgOrderTaskStatus.zh: 指示制造订单任务状态的代码。
MfgOrderTaskStatus.en: Code to indicate status of Mfg Order task

MoveHistory.zh: Move 类服务的历史摘要对象。此对象加上任何相关的明细对象将包含该服务所需的、尚未包含在 HistoryMainline 对象中的所有历史信息。
MoveHistory.en: History Summary object for the Move-type services. This object plus any related details objects will contain all the history information needed for the service that is not already contained in the HistoryMainline object.

MoveInHistory.zh: Move In 服务的历史摘要对象。每次移入都会创建一个 MoveInHistory 对象。MoveInHistory 对象将包含 Move In 服务所需的所有历史信息，这些信息尚未包含在 HistoryMainline 对象中。
MoveInHistory.en: History Summary object for the Move In Service. One MoveInHistory object will be created for every move in. The MoveInHistory object will contain all the history information needed for the Move In service that is not already contained in the HistoryMainline object.

NamedObjectGroup.zh: NamedObjectGroup 用于提供命名对象的列表。
NamedObjectGroup.en: NamedObjectGroup is used to provide a list of named object.

NamedObjectGroupGroups.zh: 记录命名对象组的父子层级。 物理对应 NamedObjectGroupGroups (CdoId: 589, Workspace: csi)。
NamedObjectGroupGroups.en: Records the parent-child hierarchy of named object groups. Physically corresponds to NamedObjectGroupGroups (CdoId: 589, Workspace: csi).

NCRCauseCode.zh: 识别物料失效的根本原因。
NCRCauseCode.en: Identifies the Root Cause of why the material failed.

NCRCauseCodeGroup.zh: 表示一组 NCRCauseCodes 的用户代码对象组。
NCRCauseCodeGroup.en: A User Code Object Group that represents a group of NCRCauseCodes.

NCRDefectData.zh: NCRDefectData 表示已在 EventLotDetails 中标记的所有已跟踪和未跟踪组件。
NCRDefectData.en: The NCRDefectData represents all of the tracked and untracked components have been marked in the EventLotDetails.

NCRFailureCodeGroup.zh: 表示一组 NCRFailureCodes 的用户代码对象组。
NCRFailureCodeGroup.en: A User Code Object Group that represents a group of NCRFailureCodes.

NCRFailureCodeGroupEntries.zh: 连接NCR失效代码组和失效代码。 物理对应 NCRFailureCodeGroupEntries (CdoId: 978, Workspace: csi)。
NCRFailureCodeGroupEntries.en: Links NCR failure code groups and failure codes. Physically corresponds to NCRFailureCodeGroupEntries (CdoId: 978, Workspace: csi).

NCRFailureType.zh: 提供对不合格失效进行分类的方法。例如“可重复”。
NCRFailureType.en: Provides a means to categorize Nonconformance failures. For example "Repeatable".

NCRResolutionCode.zh: 识别为解决不合格所采取的措施。例如“原样使用”或“报废”。
NCRResolutionCode.en: Identifies what was done to resolve a Nonconformance. Examples would be "Use As Is" or "Scrap".

NCRResolutionCodeGroup.zh: 表示一组 NCRResolutionCodes 的用户代码对象组。
NCRResolutionCodeGroup.en: A User Code Object Group that represents a group of NCRResolutionCodes.

NonconformanceReport.zh: 不合格报告 (NCR) 用于跟踪不合格物料。它包括用于分析数据（失效、原因、解决等）的属性，以及用于识别失效物料（容器和组件信息）的属性。
NonconformanceReport.en: The NonconformanceReport (NCR) is used to track Non-conforming material. It includes attributes for analytic data (Failure, Cause, Resolution, etc) as well as attributes to identify the material that failed (Container and component information).

NonconformanceReportNCRFailure.zh: 连接不合格报告与NCR失效代码。 物理对应 NonconformanceReportNCRFailure (CdoId: 950, Workspace: csi)。
NonconformanceReportNCRFailure.en: Links nonconformance reports and NCR failure codes. Physically corresponds to NonconformanceReportNCRFailure (CdoId: 950, Workspace: csi).

NumberingRule.zh: 此服务用于维护将用于自动生成名称的属性。
NumberingRule.en: This service is used to maintain properties that will be used to auto generate names.

NumberingRuleMap.zh: 从 QualityObject（类别）到用于自动生成名称的编号规则的映射。
NumberingRuleMap.en: A mapping from a QualityObject (Category) to a numbering rule that will be used to auto generate names.

Occupation.zh: MedWatch 报告中可供选择的作业列表。
Occupation.en: A list of jobs available for selection in the MedWatch report.

Operation.zh: 工序是跟踪库存和生产活动的制造或加工点。工序描述了诸如原因代码、工作中心以及物料通过工作流移动所允许的事务等信息。
Operation.en: An Operation is a manufacturing or processing point where inventory and production activities are tracked. The Operation describes such things as the reason codes, the work center, and the allowed transactions for the movement of material through a workf

OrderStatus.zh: ERP 生产订单状态。可包含如“已发放”、“已完成”、“处理中”、“已关闭”、“已取消”等值。
OrderStatus.en: ERP Production Order status. Can include values like "Released", "Completed", "In Process", "Closed", "Cancelled"

OrderType.zh: ERP 制造订单类型。此处可能出现的几个不同值包括：“标准”、“返工”、“试运行”等。
OrderType.en: ERP Manufaturing Order type. Several different values that can appear here include: "Standard", "Rework", "Test Run", etc

Organization.zh: 识别用户可访问的组织信息范围。
Organization.en: Identifies the scope of organizational information that a user has access to

Owner.zh: 每个容器都有一个关联的所有者代码。所有者代码用作分组，以区分容器进行查询和处理。所有者代码的示例有“制造”、“工程”、“原型”、“销售样品”等。
Owner.en: Every Container has an associated Owner Code. The owner code is used as a grouping to separate Containers for inquiry and processing. Examples of Owner Code are "Manufacturing", "Engineering", "Prototypes", "SalesSamples", etc.

PackageType.zh: 有助于澄清包装的类型。
PackageType.en: Helps to clarify the type of package.

Path.zh: 路径定义了工作流内从一个步骤到另一个步骤的允许（标准）移动。每个步骤包含零个或多个（出站）路径。其中只有一个路径是默认路径，其余都是备用路径。如果步骤包含任何路径，则必须有一个是默认路径。工作流的默认路径是通过从第一个步骤（在工作流中定义）开始，使用每个步骤的默认路径遍历各步骤来确定的。路径通过名称或 ID 引用。路径名称在其步骤上下文中是唯一的。
Path.en: A Path defines an allowable (Standard) move from one Step to another within a Workflow. Each Step contains zero or more (outbound) Paths. Only one of the Paths is the default Path, all others are alternate paths. If a Step contains any Paths, one must be the default. The default Route for a Workflow is determined by traversing through the Steps, starting at the first Step (defined in the workflow), using the default Path for each. Paths are referenced by name or by Id. Path names are unique within the context of their Step.

PathSelector.zh: 路径选择器用于根据事务中特定数据的值选择路径。每个路径选择器包括一个要评估的表达式和一个要选择的路径。该表达式必须是布尔表达式，并使用标准的 InSite 表达式语法定义。路径选择器按定义的顺序评估。第一个评估为 true 的路径选择器决定要选择的路径。路径选择器的使用示例包括：根据容器中字段值与特定值匹配来确定路径；根据作为事务一部分记录的测量（数据收集字段）是否在两个值（上限和下限）范围内来确定路径；根据事务内的变更数量原因列表是否包含特定原因代码来确定路径。
PathSelector.en: Path selectors are used to select a Path based on the value of specific data within a transaction. Each Path selector includes an expression to evaluate and a Path to select. The expression must be a Boolean expression, and is defined using the standard InSite expression syntax. Path Selectors are evaluated in a defined sequence. The first path selector that evaluates to true determines the Path to select. Examples of the use of a Path Selector include: Determine the Path based on the value of a field within the Container matching a specific value; Determine the Path based on a measurement recorded (Data Collection Field) as part of the transaction being in the range of two values (upper and lower limits); Determine the Path based on whether or not the list of ChangeQty reasons (within the transaction) includes a particular reason code.

PauseReason.en: Reason for pausing working on a Task

PauseReasonGroup.en: Holds a list of Pause Reasons

PauseReasonGroupEntries.zh: 连接暂停原因组和暂停原因。 物理对应 PauseReasonGroupEntries (CdoId: 1815, Workspace: csi)。
PauseReasonGroupEntries.en: Links pause reason groups and pause reasons. Physically corresponds to PauseReasonGroupEntries (CdoId: 1815, Workspace: csi).

Phase.zh: 阶段描述了质量对象在处理过程中经历的一般阶段。
Phase.en: A phase describes the general stages that a Quality object goes through during processing.

PhaseTemplate.zh: 阶段模板。阶段描述了流程的不同阶段，例如分诊、调查、实施、审查。
PhaseTemplate.en: A template of a Phase. A phase describes different stages of the process, e.g. Triage, Investigation, Implementation, Review.

PlanTemplate.zh: 计划模板，即用于处理质量对象的活动列表。
PlanTemplate.en: A template of Plan, which is a list of acivities used to process the Quality object.

PrinterLabelDefinition.zh: 定义打印机标签的属性。
PrinterLabelDefinition.en: Defines the properties of a printer label.

PrinterLabelDefinitionBase.zh: 定义打印机标签的属性。
PrinterLabelDefinitionBase.en: Defines the properties of a printer label.

PrintQueue.zh: InSite 可用于打印标签的打印机。
PrintQueue.en: Printers InSite can use to print labels.

PriorityCode.zh: 优先级代码实例是用于为容器分配处理优先级的一种方法。每个优先级代码包括描述和相对优先级值。相对优先级值用于对容器进行排序以进行调度（与代码名称或描述无关）。优先级代码只是用于确定调度和排队数值的算法之一。
PriorityCode.en: An instance of a Priority Code is one method used to assign a processing priority to a Container. Each Priority Code includes a description and a Relative Priority value. The Relative Priority value is used to sequence Containers for dispatching (independent of the Code name or description). Priority Codes are only one of the algorithms used to determine a numeric value for Scheduling and Dispatching.

PriorityLevel.en: Identifies a Priority for an Event.

ProcessingGate.zh: 此功能在当前版本的 InSite 中未实现。处理门用于将一系列步骤组合在一起，表示该系列中的所有步骤都必须完成，但完成顺序并不重要。此外，处理门可以将系列中的任何步骤标识为可选。一旦容器进入处理门，在满足门要求（完成所需步骤）之前，不允许进行移出事务（任何类型）。
ProcessingGate.en: This is not implemented in the current version of InSite. A Processing Gate is used to group a series of Steps together to denote that all of the Steps in that series must be completed, but the sequence in which they are completed is not important. Additionally, A Processing Gate can identify any of the Steps within the series Optional. Once a Container enters a Processing Gate a Move-out transaction (of any type) is not allowed until the Gate requirements (required Steps completed) have been fulfilled.

ProcessModel.zh: 流程模型描述了解决被报告为质量对象的问题所需采取的措施。
ProcessModel.en: A process model describes what needs to be done to resolve the issue reported as a Quality Object

ProcessModelTemplate.zh: 描述质量对象所需处理的流程对象模板。
ProcessModelTemplate.en: A template of the Process object that describes the processing needed for a Quality Object

ProcessModelTemplateBase.zh: 描述质量对象所需处理的流程对象模板。
ProcessModelTemplateBase.en: A template of the Process object that describes the processing needed for a Quality Object

Product.zh: 产品通常是对需要提供给客户的物料种类或用作制造过程中的原材料或其他组件的物料种类的定义。产品可以属于产品族。要制造的产品...
Product.en: A Product is typically a definition of what kind of material needs to be provided to a customer or what kind of material is being used as a raw material or other component in a manufacturing process. Products can belong to a Product Family. A product to

ProductBase.zh: 产品通常是对需要提供给客户的物料种类，或用作制造过程中的原材料或其他组件的物料种类的定义。产品可以属于产品族。要制造的产品将具有关联的工作流。工作流的属性可以被覆盖为产品特定。可选地，产品可以属于产品族。产品族用于分组产品，以简化维护任务（用于建模数据）。然后可以为产品族提供诸如成本或处理信息之类的公共属性，并应用于族中的每个产品。
ProductBase.en: A Product is typically a definition of what kind of material needs to be provided to a customer or what kind of material is being used as a raw material or other component in a manufacturing process. Products can belong to a Product Family. A product to be manufactured will have an associated Workflow. Attributes of the Workflow may be overridden to be product specific. Optionally, a Product can belong to a Product Family. A Product Family is used to group products for the purpose of simplifying the maintenance task (for modeling data). Common attributes such as costing or processing information can then be provided for a Product Family and applied to each Product within the family.
