ProductFamily.zh: 产品族用于分组产品，以简化维护任务（用于建模数据）。每个产品可以属于一个产品族。然后可以为产品族提供诸如成本或处理信息之类的公共属性，并应用于族中的每个产品。产品族与对象组的概念略有不同。分组（产品基础、工序、资源等）用于验证和报告。组更自由，应用程序对组的了解不如产品族具体。另一个区别是一个对象可以属于多个组，但一个产品只能属于一个产品族。最后，组可以包含其他（子）组。产品族只能包含产品。
ProductFamily.en: A Product Family is used to group products for the purpose of simplifying the maintenance task (for modeling data). Each Product can belong to a Product Family. Common attributes such as costing or processing information can then be provided for a Product Family and applied to each Product within the family. Product Families are a slightly different concept from object groups. Grouping (Product bases, Operations, Resources, etc.) is done for validation and reporting. Groups are more free form and the application has less concrete knowledge of Groups (than Product Families). Another differentiation is that one object can belong to multiple Groups, but a product can only belong to one Product Family. Finally, Groups can contain other (sub-) Groups. Product Families can only contain Products.

ProductMaterialListItem.zh: 根据上下文，表示完成给定制造或装配操作所需的物料或产品。指定了该物料的必要数量或比例以及适当的计量单位。
ProductMaterialListItem.en: Represents, depending on context, an item or product that is required to complete a given manufacturing or assembly operation. The necessary quantities or proportions of the item are specified as are the appropriate units of measure.

ProductType.zh: 产品类型代码用于区分产品类型，例如在制品、原材料、成品等。
ProductType.en: Product Type Codes are used to differentiate between types of product such as WIP, Raw Material, Finished Goods, etc.

QtyAdjustGroup.zh: 数量调整原因的物理分组实体。 物理对应 QtyAdjustGroup (CdoId: 800, Workspace: csi)。
QtyAdjustGroup.en: Physical grouping entity for quantity adjustment reasons. Physically corresponds to QtyAdjustGroup (CdoId: 800, Workspace: csi).

QtyAdjustReason.zh: 数量调整原因的用户代码。
QtyAdjustReason.en: The user code for qty adjust reason.

QtyHistory.zh: ChangeQty 服务的历史摘要对象。此对象加上任何相关的明细对象将包含该服务所需的、尚未包含在 HistoryMainline 对象中的所有历史信息。
QtyHistory.en: History Summary object for the ChangeQty Service. This object plus any related details objects will contain all the history information needed for the service that is not already contained in the HistoryMainline object.

QualityReportConfig.zh: 质量报告配置指定为每个操作/类别/分类/子分类组合显示的报告页面。
QualityReportConfig.en: A Quality Report Configuration specifies what report page is displayed for each Action/Category/Classification/SubClassification combination.

QualityResolutionCode.zh: 识别关闭事件或 CAPA 的有效解决代码。
QualityResolutionCode.en: Identifies the valid resolution codes for closing an Event or CAPA.

RecipeList.zh: MasterRecipe 的 TaskList 等效项。
RecipeList.en: The equivalent of TaskList for MasterRecipe.

RemovalReason.zh: 从在制品容器中移除物料的原因。
RemovalReason.en: The reason material was removed from a WIP container

RemoveDifferenceReason.zh: 发出数量与移除数量之间可能存在差异的原因。
RemoveDifferenceReason.en: The reasons that a difference between the quantity that was issued and the quantity that was removed might exist.

RemoveHistoryDetail.zh: 记录差异消除原因、容器、产品、位置和数量单位。 物理对应 RemoveHistoryDetail (CdoId: 785, Workspace: csi)。
RemoveHistoryDetail.en: Records variance removal reason, container, product, location, and quantity unit. Physically corresponds to RemoveHistoryDetail (CdoId: 785, Workspace: csi).

ReprintLabelHistory.zh: RePrintLabel 服务的历史摘要对象。此对象加上任何相关的明细对象将包含该服务所需的、尚未包含在 HistoryMainline 对象中的所有历史信息。
ReprintLabelHistory.en: History Summary object for the RePrintLabel Service. This object plus any related details objects will contain all the history information needed for the service that is not already contained in the HistoryMainline object.

ReprintReason.zh: 重新打印原因的用户代码。
ReprintReason.en: The user code for reprint reason.

ResourceDef.zh: 半导体套件中的物理资源/设备定义。 物理对应 ResourceDef (CdoId: 293, Workspace: csi)。
ResourceDef.en: Physical resource/equipment definition in semiconductor suite. Physically corresponds to ResourceDef (CdoId: 293, Workspace: csi).

ResourceFamily.zh: 资源族用于区分资源类型，例如测试机和分选机。
ResourceFamily.en: Resource Family is used to differentiate between types of Resources such as Testers and Handlers.

ResourceGroup.zh: 表示一组资源的命名对象组。
ResourceGroup.en: A Named Object Group that represents a group of Resources.

ResourceLayout.zh: 用于定义一个或多个资源在布局中的位置的设置。它供自定义应用程序用于在用户界面上排列资源。
ResourceLayout.en: Setup used to define the locations of one or more Resources in a layout. It is meant for custom applications to use to arrange Resources on a user interface.

ResourceLogs.zh: ResourceLogs — 设备资源运行状况和日志记录子实体（CdoId: 296）。用于记录设备资源的各项运行度量、状态计数器或历史计数，是设备全生命周期管理中度量物理设备使用状况的核心日志。
ResourceLogs.en: ResourceLogs — Sub-entity for equipment resource operational status and log recording (CdoId: 296). Used to record various operational metrics, status counters, or historical counts of equipment resources. It is the core log in equipment lifecycle management for measuring physical equipment usage.

ResourceStatusCode.zh: 资源状态代码提供对资源当前可用性的描述。此值用于查询和报告（平均故障间隔时间、平均修复时间、状态持续时间等）。此外，资源状态代码标识资源的默认“下一个”（生产）事务。这旨在作为资源状态流（资源工作流）的简单实现。
ResourceStatusCode.en: A Resource Status Code is provides a description of the current availability for a Resource. This value is used for inquiry and in reporting. (Mean Time Between Failure, Mean Time to Repair, Time at Status, etc.). Additionally, a Resource Status code identifies the default “Next” (Production) Transaction for a Resource. This is intended to be a simple implementation of a Resource Status Flow (Resource Workflow).

ResourceStatusCodeGroup.zh: 表示一组资源状态代码的用户代码对象组。
ResourceStatusCodeGroup.en: A User Code Object Group that represents a group of Resource Status Codes.

ResourceStatusCodeGroupDef.zh: 资源状态代码组的定义记录。 物理对应 ResourceStatusCodeGroupDef (CdoId: 1383, Workspace: csi)。
ResourceStatusCodeGroupDef.en: Definition record for resource status code groups. Physically corresponds to ResourceStatusCodeGroupDef (CdoId: 1383, Workspace: csi).

ResourceStatusHistory.zh: ResourceSetup 类型服务的历史摘要对象。此对象加上任何相关的明细对象将包含该服务所需的、尚未包含在 HistoryMainline 对象中的所有历史信息。
ResourceStatusHistory.en: History Summary object for the ResourceSetup-type services. This object plus any related details objects will contain all the history information needed for the service that is not already contained in the HistoryMainline object.

ResourceStatusModel.zh: 定义资源状态模型，包括：1. 可用的初始化资源状态代码 2. 可用“从状态”和“到状态”的映射。
ResourceStatusModel.en: Defines a Resource Status Model which includes: 1. Available initialization Resource Status Codes 2. A Mapping of available "From Status" and "To Statuses"

ResourceStatusReason.zh: 资源状态原因代码用于提供额外的详细级别，描述资源当前状态的原因。例如，当前状态可能是维修。状态原因代码可用于提供附加细节，例如正在执行的维修类型。此详细信息包含在事务历史中，使其可用于分析报告。
ResourceStatusReason.en: A Resource Status Reason Code is used to provide an added level of detail describing the reason for the current status of a Resource. For example, the current status may be REPAIR. A Status Reason Code can be used to provide additional details such as the type of repair that is being performed. This detail is included in the transaction history, which makes it available for Analysis Reporting.

ResourceThruputHistory.zh: ResourceThruput 服务的历史摘要对象。此对象加上任何相关的明细对象将包含该服务所需的、尚未包含在 HistoryMainline 对象中的所有历史信息。
ResourceThruputHistory.en: History Summary object for the ResourceThruput Service. This object plus any related details objects will contain all the history information needed for the service that is not already contained in the HistoryMainline object.

ResourceThruputHistoryDetails.zh: 记录资源产出事务关联的明细数据。 物理对应 ResourceThruputHistoryDetails (CdoId: 773, Workspace: csi)。
ResourceThruputHistoryDetails.en: Records detailed data associated with resource throughput transactions. Physically corresponds to ResourceThruputHistoryDetails (CdoId: 773, Workspace: csi).

ResourceType.zh: 资源类型，一种资源分类。具有相同资源类型的资源可能共享相同的资源状态模型。
ResourceType.en: Resource Type, a Resource categorization. Resources with the same Resource Type may share the same Resources Status Model.

ResponseSet.zh: 响应集是一个允许用户配置各种响应集的对象。
ResponseSet.en: The Response Set is an object which allows the user to configure various response sets.

ResStatusReasonGroup.zh: 表示一组资源状态原因的用户代码对象组。
ResStatusReasonGroup.en: A User Code Object Group that represents a group of Resource Status Reasons.

ReturnedEquipmentAction.zh: 对返回设备采取的操作。

RevisionedObjectGroup.zh: RevisionedObjectGroup 用于提供已修订对象的列表。
RevisionedObjectGroup.en: RevisionedObjectGroup is used to provide a list of revisioned object.

ReworkReason.zh: 流程返工代码实例用于提供流程返工的原因列表。当容器进入返工循环时，该代码与容器关联。然后，它与容器在...
ReworkReason.en: An instance of a Process Rework Code is used to provide a list of reasons for Process Rework. The code is associated with a Container when it enters a rework loop. It is then associated with all throughput transactions generated by the container while it

ReworkReasonGroup.zh: 表示一组 ReworkReasons 的用户代码对象组。
ReworkReasonGroup.en: A User Code Object Group that represents a group of ReworkReasons.

ReworkStatus.zh: 返工状态实例用于跟踪容器的返工处理明细。这包括当前状态以及完成返工并恢复正常处理所需的信息。返工（因此返工状态条目）可以是递归的。
ReworkStatus.en: A instance of a Rework Status is used to keep track of rework processing details for a Container. This includes the current status and the information required to complete the rework and return to normal processing. Rework, and therefore Rework Status entries, can be recursive.

RiskAssessment.zh: 确定质量对象风险评分所需的信息。
RiskAssessment.en: Information needed to determine the risk score for a Quality object.

RoleDef.zh: RoleDef — 系统角色定义实体。物理上对应 RoleDef (CdoId: 914)。
RoleDef.en: RoleDef — System role definition entity. Physically corresponds to RoleDef (CdoId: 914).

RollupReason.en: The user code for rollup reason.

RollupReasonGroup.zh: 表示一组汇总原因的用户代码对象组。
RollupReasonGroup.en: A User Code Object Group that represents a group of Rollup Reasons.

RouteStep.zh: ERP 工艺路线中的步骤，是与 InSite 工作流最接近的 ERP 概念。ERP 工艺路线步骤通常定义在比 InSite 工作流步骤更汇总的级别。
RouteStep.en: A step in an ERPRoute, which is the closest ERP concept to an InSite workflow. ERP Route Steps are usually defined at a more summarized level than InSite workflow steps.

SalesOrder.zh: 销售订单定义客户在某个日期前期望的产品数量。这相当于典型（ERP）销售订单上的行项目。容器可选地分配给销售订单（通过将销售订单指定为属性）。这提供了将在制品（容器）与客户订单相关联的机制。
SalesOrder.en: A Sales Order defines a quantity of product expected by a customer by a date. This equates to a line item on a typical (ERP) Sales Order. Containers are optionally assigned to a Sales Order (by specifying the Sales Order as an attribute). This provides the mechanism for relating WIP (Containers) to Customer Orders.

SampleDataPoint.zh: 用于定义可重用数据点的对象。
SampleDataPoint.en: Object used for defining a reusable data points.

SampleDataPointBase.zh: 用于定义可重用数据点的对象。
SampleDataPointBase.en: Object used for defining a reusable data points.

SampleSizeDetails.zh: 存储特定 AQL 水平和样本大小代码的样本大小和拒收信息。
SampleSizeDetails.en: Stores the Sample Sizes and reject information for specific AQL level and Sample size Code

SampleTest.zh: 用于定义 AQL SampleTest 实例的对象，这些实例描述要收集的数据以及基于样本上收集的数据应发生的任何事件。
SampleTest.en: Object used for defining instances of AQL SampleTest that describe the Data to collect and any events that should happen based on the collected data on the sample.

SampleTestBase.zh: 用于定义 AQL SampleTest 实例的对象，这些实例描述要收集的数据以及基于样本上收集的数据应发生的任何事件。
SampleTestBase.en: Object used for defining instances of AQL SampleTest that describe the Data to collect and any events that should happen based on the collected data on the sample.

SamplingPlan.zh: 用于定义产品的抽样计划。抽样计划包含产品样本测试的详细信息，例如测试地点、AQL 水平和转换规则。
SamplingPlan.en: Used to Define a sampling plan for a Product. The sample plan contains the details about the Sample Test for a Product such as where it is to be tested, AQL Level, and switching rules.

SamplingPlanBase.zh: 用于定义产品的抽样计划。抽样计划包含产品样本测试的详细信息，例如测试地点、AQL 水平和转换规则。
SamplingPlanBase.en: Used to Define a sampling plan for a Product. The sample plan contains the details about the Sample Test for a Product such as where it is to be tested, AQL Level, and switching rules.

SamplingPlanDetails.zh: 具体描述抽样计划的样本测试的详细信息。对于每个样本测试，可以配置 AQL 水平、检验水平、转换规则、规范、供应商和资源。
SamplingPlanDetails.en: The specific describes the details for a Sampling Plan's Sample Test.. For each Sample Test, the AQL Level, Inspection Level, Switching Rule, Spec, Vendor and Resoruce can be configured.

SchedulingRoute.zh: 调度路径是一个建模对象，允许配置特定调度路径，而无需利用 ERP 路径。您可以定义和应用备用调度路径，用于标识调度集成的步骤。调度路径实例将优先于 ERP 路径。如果应用未配置或检测到调度路径，则默认使用 ERP 路径。
SchedulingRoute.en: Scheduling Route is a modeling object that allows configuration of specific scheduling routes without leveraging ERP routes. You can define and apply an alternative scheduling route that can be used to identify steps for scheduling integration. Instances of scheduling routes will take precedent over ERP route. If no Scheduling Routes are configured or detected by the application, the ERP Route will be used by default.

SchedulingRouteBase.zh: 调度路径是一个建模对象，允许配置特定调度路径，而无需利用 ERP 路径。您可以定义和应用备用调度路径，用于标识调度集成的步骤。调度路径实例将优先于 ERP 路径。如果应用未配置或检测到调度路径，则默认使用 ERP 路径。
SchedulingRouteBase.en: Scheduling Route is a modeling object that allows configuration of specific scheduling routes without leveraging ERP routes. You can define and apply an alternative scheduling route that can be used to identify steps for scheduling integration. Instances of scheduling routes will take precedent over ERP route. If no Scheduling Routes are configured or detected by the application, the ERP Route will be used by default.

ScrapReason.zh: 此功能在当前版本的 InSite 中未实现。ScrapReason
ScrapReason.en: This is not implemented in the current version of InSite. ScrapReason

scsBinCode.zh: BinCode 包含实际的箱代码值。
scsBinCode.en: The BinCode contains the actual bin code values.

scsBinDefinition.zh: BinDefinition 对象描述了图中可能出现的箱代码。
scsBinDefinition.en: The BinDefinition object describes a bin code that may be present in the map.

scsCarrierFamilyMatrix.zh: 这是一个新的对象（NDO）子类，属于 ProcessControl，用于存储基于矩阵确定所需载具族所需的信息。
scsCarrierFamilyMatrix.en: This is a new object (NDO) subclass of ProcessControl that is created to store the information required to determine the Carrier Family required based on a matrix

scsFailureHoldSetup.zh: 用于支持 Quantix 集成的失效保留设置。
scsFailureHoldSetup.en: Failure Hold Setup to support Quantix Integration

scsMapData.zh: MapData 对象包含零个或多个 MapDataLayout 对象的列表、零个或多个 MapDataSubstrateMap 对象的列表以及零个或多个 MapDataSubstrate 对象的列表。
scsMapData.en: The MapData object contains a list of zero or more MapDataLayout objects, a list of zero or more MapDataSubstrateMap objects, and a list of zero or more MapDataSubstrate objects.

scsOverlay.zh: Overlay 对象是一个数据数组，对应于分配了所含 SubstrateMap 的布局上的尺寸。Overlay 对象可能有一个或多个 ReferenceDevice 对象，以及一个 BinCodeMap 对象、一个 DeviceIdMap 对象或...
scsOverlay.en: The Overlay object is an array of data that corresponds to the dimensions on the Layout to which the containing SubstrateMap is assigned. An Overlay object may have one or more ReferenceDevice objects and either a BinCodeMap object, a DeviceIdMap object o

scsQuantixRecipe.zh: 名称将发送给 Quantix，以反映测试名称，供 Quantix 在数据处理期间引用。
scsQuantixRecipe.en: Name will be sent to Quantix to reflect the Test Name for Quantix to refer to during data processing.

scsStatusModel.zh: 此设置用于控制资源状态更改以及满足前提条件时的自动更改。它还有一个资源可以更改到的有效原因列表。
scsStatusModel.en: This setup is used to control Resource status change as well as automated change if a pre-condition is met. It also has a list of valid Reasons the Resource can change to.

SellReason.en: The user code for sell reason

SellReasonGroup.zh: 表示一组销售原因的用户代码对象组。
SellReasonGroup.en: A User Code Object Group that represents a group of Sell Reasons.

SessionValues.zh: 会话值用于确定默认值。一个实例与为应用程序定义的每个用户（可以登录）相关联。登录时，这些值被复制以供该会话使用。值可以在会话期间修改，并在会话完成时保存或丢弃。如果保存，更新后的值将在下次登录（对于该用户）时用于初始化。
SessionValues.en: Session Values are used to determine default values. An instance is associated with each User defined to the application (that can log-in). At login the values are copied for use by that session. Values can be modified during the session and saved or discarded when the session completes If they are saved, the updated values will be used for initialization at the next log-in (for that User).

Setup.zh: 设置是处理特定类型物料（通常是特定产品或引用特定规范的容器）所需的资源配置。通常，设置的定义仅包括硬件配置等项目，这些项目需要较长的更换时间，而配方将包括许多其他项目，例如可以立即更改的工艺设置。Camstar 提供的标准设置属性包括描述设置配置的适用文档集、配置设置所需时间的估计等。设置通常在 InSite 中定义，以帮助提供调度/派工信息，说明哪些容器/订单可以在项目之间无需显著更换时间的情况下进行处理。
Setup.en: A Setup is a configuration of a resource needed to process a certain type of material (typcially a particular product, or a container referencing a particular spec).. Normally the definition of a setup includes only items as hardware configurations, that take significant time to change, while a reciipe would include many other items such as process settings that may be changed instantly. Standard Camstar-provided attributes of a setup include items such as the applicable set of documents describing the setup configuration, an estimate of time need to configure the setup, etc. Setups are often defined in InSite to help provide scheduling/dispatching information on which containers/orders may be processed without significant changeover time between the items.

SetupBase.zh: 设置定义描述了所需的工作、所需的物料，并估计完成特定任务设置所需的时间。设置定义的典型用途是描述为处理一批或多批物料而准备机器所需的条件。设置可以引用外部文档和/或指令集来描述所需的设置工作。每个设置还可以包含对要下载到机器的配方文件的引用。配方文件作为文档存储。关联的文档查看器是用于将配方下载到机器而启动的程序。
SetupBase.en: A Setup Definition describes the work required, materials required, and estimates how long it will take to setup for a specific task. A typical use of a Setup Definition is to describe what it will take to prepare a machine for processing a batch or multiple batches of material. A Setup can reference an external document and/or an InstructionSet to describe the setup work required. Each Setup can also include a reference to a Recipe file for downloading to a machine. Recipe files are stored as Documents. The associated Document Viewer is the program to launch for downloading (the recipe) to a machine.

Shift.zh: 通常适用于制造公司，这些公司的区域在一天中配备人员的时间足够长，以至于工人不会都在同一时间开始和结束一天的工作。班次是一种基于管理责任对生产信息进行分组的机制，管理责任针对在特定时间开始和离开的工人。例如，“白班”可能从早上 6 点到下午 6 点工作，“夜班”则从下午 6 点到早上 6 点工作。
Shift.en: Typically applies to manufacturing companies that have areas staffed for a long enough during a day that workers do not all start and end their day at the same time. Shift is a mechanism for grouping production information based on management responsibilities for workers that start and leave at a particular time. For example, the "Day" shift might work from 6am to 6pm, and the "Night" shift would work from 6pm to 6am.

ShipmentDestination.zh: ShipmentDestination 是容器被运往的工厂或客户。ShipmentDestination 还包含路由信息，当 Ship 事务向目标站点发送远程事务时，RemoteProcessingInfo 对象会使用该信息。
ShipmentDestination.en: A ShipmentDestination is the factory or customer to which the container is shipped. ShipmentDestinaiton also contains routing information used by the RemoteProcessingInfo object when the Ship transaction is sending remote transactions to a destination site.

ShipmentDestinationGrp.zh: 表示一组 ShipmentDestination 的命名对象组，ShipmentDestination 是容器被运往的工厂或客户。ShipmentDestination 还包含路由信息，当 Ship 事务向目标站点发送远程事务时，RemoteProcessingInfo 对象会使用该信息。
ShipmentDestinationGrp.en: A Named Object Group that represents a group of ShipmentDestination which is the factory or customer to which the container is shipped. ShipmentDestinaiton also contains routing information used by the RemoteProcessingInfo object when the Ship transaction is sending remote transactions to a destination site.

ShippingReason.en: The user code for shipping reason

ShippingReasonGroup.zh: 表示一组发货原因的用户代码对象组。
ShippingReasonGroup.en: A User Code Object Group that represents a group of Shipping Reasons.

Site.zh: 站点被定义为制造组织内独立的 InSite 实体。工厂是物理设施概念，而站点是基于单一事务处理数据库的自包含 IT 结构，以及相关的 InSite 服务器，这些服务器提供在数据库中生成事务的能力。一个工厂可以有一个或多个站点；一个站点也可以运行一个或多个工厂。
Site.en: A site is defined as an independent InSite entity within a manufacturing organization. While a factory is a physical facilities concept, a site is a self contained IT structure based on a single transaction processing database, along with the associated InSite servers that provide the capability to generate transactions in the database. A factory could have one or more sites; and a site could run one or more factories.

SmartScanRule.zh: 定义从字符串中提取数据的过程。
SmartScanRule.en: Defines process to extract data from a string.

SPCChartDef.zh: 定义变量/图表类型组合的 SPC 图表信息。包括规则文件、宏、显示选项、OCAP 以及在图表生成、显示和 OCAP 处理期间使用的 10 个用户参数的指定。
SPCChartDef.en: Defines SPC Charting information for a variable/chart type combination. Includes designation for rules file, macro, display options, OCAPs and 10 user params to use during chart generation, display and OCAP processing

SPCChartVisualParams.zh: SPC图表可视化参数。物理对应 SPCChartVisualParams (CdoId: 1829, Workspace: csi)。
SPCChartVisualParams.en: SPC chart visualization parameters. Physically corresponds to SPCChartVisualParams (CdoId: 1829, Workspace: csi).

Spec.zh: 规范（Spec）描述了在工作流中的步骤处进行的处理。它引用了许多其他建模组件，包括工序、设置、数据收集定义和资源。规范还包括详细的调度和...
Spec.en: A specification (Spec) describes the processing that takes place at a Step within a Workflow. It references many other Modeling components including an Operation, Setup, Data Collection Definitions and Resources. Specs also include detailed scheduling and

SpecBase.zh: 规范（Spec）描述了在工作流中的步骤处进行的处理。它引用了许多其他建模组件，包括工序、设置、数据收集定义和资源。规范还包括详细的调度和处理参数信息。工作流中的步骤引用（使用）规范。许多工作流步骤可以使用一个规范。规范用于定义要执行的处理。工序用于定义物料通过工厂的流程或移动（规则）。
SpecBase.en: A Specification (Spec) describes the processing that takes place at a Step within a Workflow. It references many other Modeling components including an Operation, Setup, Data Collection Definitions and Resources. Specs also include detailed scheduling and processing parameter information. A Spec is referenced (used) by a Step within a Workflow. Many Workflow Steps can use one Spec. A Spec is used to define the processing that is to be performed. An Operation is used to define (rules for) the flow or movement of Material through the Factory.

SpecSchedulingDetail.zh: 工序使用调度详细信息的实例来定义最通用级别的调度信息。调度详细信息中的每个值都可以被规范覆盖。维护功能必须提供对调度详细信息访问的安全性（与对工序中其他字段的访问分开）。周期时间的计算公式为：(((运行时间 + 设置时间) / 利用率) + 移动时间 + [快速/正常]排队时间) [/ 每天小时数] 应用模型内置的层次结构是，在工序级别指定的调度详细信息可以被规范覆盖。反过来，规范中的值可以被引用该规范的每个步骤覆盖。还假设调度详细信息将在产品或产品族级别被覆盖。此外，假设这将是针对少数步骤（如果有），并且向产品或产品族定义添加用户定义字段（然后更新字段覆盖）将解决这个问题。
SpecSchedulingDetail.en: An Operation uses an instance of Scheduling Details to define scheduling information at the most generic level. Each value in the scheduling details can be overridden by a Spec. The Maintenance function must provide security for access to Scheduling Details (separate from access to other fields in the Operation. The calculation for cycle time is: ( ( (RunTime + SetupTime) / Utilitzation ) + MoveTime + [Fast/Normal]QueueTime ) [/ HoursPerDay] The hierarchy built-in to the application model is that Scheduling details specified at the Operation level can be overridden by a Spec. In turn the values in the Spec can be overridden by each Step that references that Spec. It is also assumed that Scheduling Details will be overridden at the Product or Product Family level. Further, the assumption is that this will be for a few Steps (if any) and that adding user-defined fields to the Product or Product Family definition (and then updating the field overrides) will address it.

SplitHistory.zh: Split 服务的历史摘要对象。每次拆分都会创建一个 SplitHistory 对象。SplitHistory 对象加上任何相关的明细对象将包含该服务所需的、尚未包含在 HistoryMainline 对象中的所有历史信息。
SplitHistory.en: History Summary object for the Split Service. One SplitHistory object will be created for every split. The SplitHistory object plus any related details objects will contain all the history information needed for the Split service that is not already contained in the HistoryMainline object.

SplitHistoryDetails.zh: Split 服务的历史明细对象。每次拆分都会创建一个 SplitHistory 对象。SplitHistory 对象将包含 Split 服务所需的所有历史信息，这些信息尚未包含在 HistoryMainline 对象中。
SplitHistoryDetails.en: History Detail object for the Split Service. One SplitHistory object will be created for every split. The SplitHistory object will contain all the history information needed for the Split service that is not already contained in the HistoryMainline object.

ss_BlanketExperiments.zh: 这是一个新的对象（NDO）子类，属于 ProcessControl，用于存储基于矩阵确定所需实验计划所需的信息。
ss_BlanketExperiments.en: This is a new object (NDO) subclass of ProcessControl that is created to store the information required to determine the Experiment Plan required based on a matrix

ss_ContainerDimension.zh: 描述容器最大可用区域（X-Y）的 NDO。
ss_ContainerDimension.en: NDO describing the maximum available areas of a container (X-Y)

ss_CustomSPCGridFilter.zh: 可配置网格，允许将自定义过滤器添加到系统定义的 SPC 基本查询中。注意：所有包含的过滤器将仅通过 SQL“AND”子句添加。注意：此网格中的内容不会影响临时查询。
ss_CustomSPCGridFilter.en: Configurable grid to allow custom filters to be added to a system defined SPC Basic Query. Note: All included filters will be exclusively added with the SQL "AND" clause. Note: Content in this grid will not affect an Adhoc query.

ss_EqpConstraintDetails.zh: 设备约束明细的子实体列表。
ss_EqpConstraintDetails.en: The subentity list of equipment constraint details

ss_EqpConstraintMatrix.zh: 这是一个基于条件的矩阵，用于根据设备组或设备为设备配置条件上升。
ss_EqpConstraintMatrix.en: This is a criteria based matrix used to configure conditional up for an equipment based on equipment group or equipment.

ss_FailureFutureHoldSetup.zh: 此对象保存未来保留设置明细列表，例如：- 规范 - 保留原因 - 电子邮件组 - 保留位置 - 预期保留天数 - 包括计划批次
ss_FailureFutureHoldSetup.en: This object holds a list of future hold setup details like: - Spec - Hold Reason - Email Group - Hold Location - Expected Hold Days - Include Schedule Lots

ss_FailureNCRSetup.zh: 这将保存生成 NCR 时要使用的默认 NCR 失效信息。字段将包括：- 失效模式组 - 失效模式列表 - 失效模式描述列表
ss_FailureNCRSetup.en: This will hold the default NCR failure information to be used when generating the NCR. Fields will include: - Failure Mode Group - List of Failure Modes - List of Failure Mode Descriptions

ss_FeederPlan.zh: 用于指示资源上容器与供料器与插槽关系的计划。此计划将在 ResourceComponentSetup 期间使用，以确保正确的容器（即物料部件）连接到资源上正确的供料器和插槽。
ss_FeederPlan.en: Plan used to indicate the relationship of Container to Feeder to Slot on a Resource. This plan will be used during ResourceComponentSetup to ensure the correct Container (i.e. Material Part) is attached to the correct Feeder and Slot on the Resource.

ss_FeederPlanBase.zh: 用于指示资源上容器与供料器与插槽关系的计划。此计划将在 ResourceComponentSetup 期间使用，以确保正确的容器（即物料部件）连接到资源上正确的供料器和插槽。
ss_FeederPlanBase.en: Plan used to indicate the relationship of Container to Feeder to Slot on a Resource. This plan will be used during ResourceComponentSetup to ensure the correct Container (i.e. Material Part) is attached to the correct Feeder and Slot on the Resource.

ss_FeederSlot.zh: 表示 Resource 内可安装 Feeder 的 Slot。Resource 具有名为 Slots 的子实体列表，用于设置 Resource 在 Resource Component Setup 期间可使用的有效 Slot。
ss_FeederSlot.en: Represents the slots within a Resource where a Feeder can be attached. A Resource has a sub-entity list called Slots used to setup valid slots the Resource can use during Resource Component Setup.

ss_FutureHoldSetupDetails.zh: 用于输入未来保留设置详细信息的网格（Spec、Hold Reason、Email Group、Hold Location、Expected Hold Days、Include Schedule Lots 和 Comments）。
ss_FutureHoldSetupDetails.en: A grid to input future hold setup details (Spec, Hold Reason, Email Group, Hold Location, Expected Hold Days, Include Schedule Lots, & Comments)

ss_LabelPlan.zh: 定义标签设置及其层次结构。
ss_LabelPlan.en: Defines label setups and their hierarchy

ss_LabelSetup.zh: 定义生成标签的基本参数。
ss_LabelSetup.en: Defines basic parameters for generating labels

ss_MfgLine.zh: Manufacturing Line 用于表示处理容器的生产线。可分配给 Spec、Resource、Container 和 Mfg Order。在容器开始生产或更准确地说进行生产线验证时使用。
ss_MfgLine.en: Manufacturing Line is used to represent the line where containers are being processed. It can be assigned to Spec, Resource, Container and Mfg Order. It is used during manufacturing line verification when a container start production or more accurately tr

ss_ParameterMatrix.zh: 此矩阵中定义的参数将覆盖 Process Spec 参数。
ss_ParameterMatrix.en: The parameters define in this matrix will override the process spec parameters.

ss_ParameterMatrixList.zh: 作为矩阵解析值的参数列表，包含 a. Parameter Name，b. Override Default Value，用于在需要时覆盖该值。
ss_ParameterMatrixList.en: The Parameter List as the resolved value of the matrix, which contains a. Parameter Name b. Override Default Value, to override the value if required

ss_ProcessTimerMatrix.zh: 这是 ProcessControl 的新对象 (NDO) 子类，用于存储根据矩阵确定所需 Process Timer 所需的信息。
ss_ProcessTimerMatrix.en: This is a new object (NDO) subclass of ProcessControl that is created to store the information required to determine the Process Timer required based on a matrix

ss_SendAheadMatrix.zh: 用于支持 Send Ahead 逻辑配置的矩阵。
ss_SendAheadMatrix.en: Matrix to support the configuration of Send Ahead logic

ss_SPCAnnotationCategory.zh: SPC Txn Data Point 注释的缩写，用于 ANNVAR 第三个参数。
ss_SPCAnnotationCategory.en: Abbreviation for SPC Txn Data Point annotation. used for the ANNVAR third parameter

ss_SPCCustomFilterTable.zh: 为 SPC Query 中使用的过滤定义带别名的表名。
ss_SPCCustomFilterTable.en: define the table name with alias for filtering used in SPC Query

ss_SPCGPCChartData.zh: 存储 SPC GPC Chart 数据的子实体对象。
ss_SPCGPCChartData.en: subentity object that store the data of a SPC GPC Chart

ss_Surveillance.zh: Surveillance 允许基于时间和批次间隔在 Work Center、Equipment、Equipment Group 或 Operation 上收集数据。
ss_Surveillance.en: Surveillance allows data collection on Work Center, Equipment, Equipment Group, or Operation based on time and on lot intervals.

ss_SurveillanceBase.zh: Surveillance 允许基于时间和批次间隔在 Work Center、Equipment、Equipment Group 或 Operation 上收集数据。
ss_SurveillanceBase.en: Surveillance allows data collection on Work Center, Equipment, Equipment Group, or Operation based on time and on lot intervals.

ss_TrackLabel.zh: 存储用于 Pack Labelling 的所有已生成标签。
ss_TrackLabel.en: Stored all the generated labels for Pack Labelling

ss_UsageReqSetupDetails.zh: Usage Requirement 设置详细信息。

ss_WIPDataSetupMatrix.zh: 这是 ProcessControl 的新对象 (NDO) 子类，用于存储根据矩阵确定所需 WIP Data Setup 所需的信息。
ss_WIPDataSetupMatrix.en: This is a new object (NDO) subclass of ProcessControl that is created to store the information required to determine the WIP Data Setup required based on a matrix

StartHistoryDetail.zh: Start Service 的历史记录对象。StartHistory 对象及任何相关的详细信息对象将包含 Start Service 所需的、尚未包含在 HistoryMainline 对象中的所有历史记录信息。
StartHistoryDetail.en: History object for the Start Service. The StartHistory object plus any related details objects will contain all the history information needed for the start service that is not already contained in the HistoryMainline object.

StartHistoryDetailIssueConditi.zh: 连接开工历史明细与物料发行条件。 物理对应 StartHistoryDetailIssueConditi (CdoId: 1797, Workspace: csi)。
StartHistoryDetailIssueConditi.en: Links start history details and material issue conditions. Physically corresponds to StartHistoryDetailIssueConditi (CdoId: 1797, Workspace: csi).

StartReason.zh: 每个 Container 都有关联的 Start Code。Start Code 可用于 WIP Status 查询的选择条件以及事务报告（基于事务历史记录）。
StartReason.en: Each Container has an associated Start Code. Start Codes are available for selection criteria on WIP Status Inquiries and for transaction reporting (based on the transaction history).

StepSchedulingDetail.zh: Operation 使用 Scheduling Details 的实例在最通用的级别定义调度信息。调度详细信息中的每个值都可被 Spec 覆盖。Spec 中的值又可被 Step 覆盖。Maintenance 功能必须提供对 Scheduling Details 访问的安全性。周期时间的计算为：(((RunTime + SetupTime) / Utilization) + MoveTime + [Fast/Normal]QueueTime) [/ HoursPerDay]。应用程序模型中内置的层次结构是：在 Operation 级别指定的 Scheduling Details 可被 Spec 覆盖。反过来，Spec 中的值可被每个引用该 Spec 的 Step 覆盖。还假设 Scheduling Details 将在 Product 或 Product Family 级别被覆盖。此外，假设这将适用于少数 Step（如果有），并且向 Product 或 Product Family 定义添加用户定义字段（然后更新字段覆盖）将解决此问题。
StepSchedulingDetail.en: An Operation uses an instance of Scheduling Details to define scheduling information at the most generic level. Each value in the scheduling details can be overridden by a Spec. The values in the Spec can in turn be overridden by a Step. The Maintenance function must provide security for access to Scheduling Details. The calculation for cycle time is: ( ( (RunTime + SetupTime) / Utilitzation ) + MoveTime + [Fast/Normal]QueueTime ) [/ HoursPerDay] The hierarchy built-in to the application model is that Scheduling details specified at the Operation level can be overridden by a Spec. In turn the values in the Spec can be overridden by each Step that references that Spec. It is also assumed that Scheduling Details will be overridden at the Product or Product Family level. Further, the assumption is that this will be for a few Steps (if any) and that adding user-defined fields to the Product or Product Family definition (and then updating the field overrides) will address it.

SubClassification.zh: 用于对 QualityObjects 进行子分类。

SubstitutionReason.zh: 记录实际使用的产品与指定使用的产品不同的原因。
SubstitutionReason.en: Records the reason that the product actually used differed from the product specified for use.

SwitchingRule.zh: 用于定义 AQL Sampling 计划的 Switching Rules 的对象。定义检验级别之间的切换规则。
SwitchingRule.en: Object used to define the Switching Rules for an AQL Sampling plan. Defines the rule for switching between inspection levels.

SwitchingRuleBase.zh: 用于定义 AQL Sampling 计划的 Switching Rules 的对象。定义检验级别之间的切换规则。
SwitchingRuleBase.en: Object used to define the Switching Rules for an AQL Sampling plan. Defines the rule for switching between inspection levels.

SwitchingRuleDetails.zh: 定义 AQL Sampling 计划的切换规则详细信息。切换规则允许自动更改 Product 的抽样计划的检验级别。
SwitchingRuleDetails.en: Defines the switching rule details for an AQL Sampling plan. Switching rules allow for automatic changing of the Inpsection level for a Product’s sampling plan.

TargetSystem.zh: 将系统标识为用于各种目的（如导出）的目标。
TargetSystem.en: Identifies a system as a target for various purposes such as export.

TaskItem.zh: TaskListDetail 标识要为 TaskList 完成的特定 Task。
TaskItem.en: The TaskListDetail identifies a specific Task to be completed for a TaskList.

TaskList.zh: 标识要为 ElectronicProcedure 执行的一组 Task。
TaskList.en: Identifies a group of Tasks to be executed for an ElectronicProcedure.

TaskListBase.zh: 标识要为 ElectronicProcedure 执行的一组 Task。
TaskListBase.en: Identifies a group of Tasks to be executed for an ElectronicProcedure.

Team.zh: 将生产信息分组到“班次”的另一种方式。例如，计划在周一至周四工作的“白班”和“夜班”可分配给“Red”团队，而在周五至周日工作的白班和夜班则分配给“Blues”团队。
Team.en: An alternate means of grouping production information to "shift". For example, "day" and "night" shifts that are schedule to work on Monday-Thursday might be assigned to team "Red", while day and night shifts that work Friday-Sunday would be assigned to team "Blues".

Terminal.zh: 基于终端的产线设置 - 为工厂中的特定终端（例如 PC）配置 Line Settings。
Terminal.en: Terminal based line settings - configure Line Settings for a specific terminal (e.g. PC) in the factory.

ThruputHistory.zh: Thruput Service 的历史记录摘要对象。此对象及任何相关的详细信息对象将包含该服务所需的、尚未包含在 HistoryMainline 对象中的所有历史记录信息。
ThruputHistory.en: History Summary object for the Thruput Service. This object plus any related details objects will contain all the history information needed for the service that is not already contained in the HistoryMainline object.

ThruputHistoryDetail.zh: thruput 事务详细信息的历史记录。
ThruputHistoryDetail.en: The history for the detail of the thruput transaction.

TrainingPlan.zh: 培训计划定义培训要求（认证）的时间表以及员工应接受所列要求培训的目标日期。培训计划也可用作更大培训计划的组成部分。
TrainingPlan.en: A training plan defines a schedule of training requirements (certifications) and target dates for when employees should be trained on the listed requirement. Training plans can also be used as components in larger training plans.

TrainingPlanDetail.zh: 由一个培训要求或另一个培训计划以及完成该培训的目标日期组成的培训计划详细记录。
TrainingPlanDetail.en: Training plan detail record composed of a training requirement or another training plan, along with a target date for completing that training.

TrainingRecord.zh: 跟踪特定用户在特定培训要求下的状态的项目。
TrainingRecord.en: Item that tracks the status of a particular user for a specific training requirement

TrainingRecordStatus.zh: Employee Training Records 的状态代码。
TrainingRecordStatus.en: Status codes for the Employee Training Records

TrainingRequirement.zh: 在允许用户执行特定任务之前所需培训的定义。
TrainingRequirement.en: Definition of the training required before a user is allowed to perform a specific task

TrainingRequirementBase.zh: 在允许用户执行特定任务之前所需培训的定义。
TrainingRequirementBase.en: Definition of the training required before a user is allowed to perform a specific task

TrainingRequirementGroup.zh: Training Requirement Group — 培训要求的分组容器。将多个 TrainingRequirement 按岗位、设备、工艺等分组管理，支持嵌套子分组。物理上对应 TrainingRequirementGroup (CdoId: 971)。
TrainingRequirementGroup.en: Training Requirement Group — Grouping container for training requirements. Groups multiple TrainingRequirement items by job position, equipment, process, etc., supporting nested subgroups. Physically corresponds to TrainingRequirementGroup (CdoId: 971).

TriageSpec.zh: 用于对 Event 或 CAR 进行分类（Triaging）的规范。Triage 流程处理 Event 或 CAR 的升级或关闭。
TriageSpec.en: The specifications for Triaging an Event or CAR. The Triage process handles escalating or closing the Event or CAR.

TriageSpecDetail.zh: TriageSpecDetail 标识作为升级流程的一部分分配给 Event 或 CAR 的默认值。
TriageSpecDetail.en: The TriageSpecDetail identifies the default values to assign to the Event or CAR as part of the Escalation process.

TxnDetails.zh: 这未在当前版本的 InSite 中实现。Transaction Details 用于定义“向下移动”Path 所需的处理类型（事务类型）。例如，用于定义是使用 Move 还是 Combine 事务。每个 Path 都有相关的 Transaction Details 条目。这在直接选择 Path 时使用。可用于选择 Path 的 Bin 和其他实体也有其自己的相关 Transaction Details（覆盖 Path 的 Transaction Details）。
TxnDetails.en: This is not implemented in the current version of InSite. Transaction details are used to define the type of processing (transaction type) required to "move-down" a Path. This is used to define, for example, whether a Move or a Combine transaction is to be used. Each Path has an associated Transaction Details entry. This is used when the Path is selected directly. Bins and other entities that can be used to select a Path also have their own associated Transaction Details (which overrides the Transaction Details for the Path).

TxnMap.zh: Transaction Map 在 Specification 中用于三个目的。第一个是指定替代标准事务的用户定义事务。第二个是将 Data Collection Definition 与事务关联。第三个是确定必须执行哪些事务（如果有）以及以何种顺序执行，以认为工作完成（并允许 Move-out 事务）。对事务进行排序并将其定义为 Required 与 Optional，是在处理步骤中定义“下一步是什么？”的简单方法。虽然这对于首个版本已足够，但在未来版本中可能需要更全面的方法（即脚本逻辑）。其他类似领域包括 Instructions 和 Path Selection。
TxnMap.en: A Transaction Map is used within a Specification for three purposes. The first is to specify a User Defined transaction that is to take the place of a standard transaction. The second is to associate a Data Collection Definition to a transaction. The third is to determine which transactions (if any) must be performed and in what order, to consider the work complete (and allow a Move-out transaction). Sequencing transactions and defining them as Required versus Optional is a simplistic approach to defining “What’s Next?” within a processing step. While this is more than adequate for a first release, this is an area where a more comprehensive approach (i.e., scripting logic) may be appropriate in future releases. Other similar areas include Instructions and Path Selection.

UIAction.zh: UIAction 用于保存与 Action 相关的 Portal Studio 数据。
UIAction.en: UIAction is used to save Portal Studio data related to an Action

UIPreferenceMap.zh: UI（User Interface）Preference Map 对象用于存储 Organization 与 UI Preference 之间的引用。
UIPreferenceMap.en: The UI (User Interface) Preference Map object is used to store references between Organization and UI Preference.

UOM.en: The user code for unit of material.

UserCodeGroup.zh: UserCodeGroup 表示一组用户代码。
UserCodeGroup.en: UserCodeGroup represents a group of user code.

UserCodeGroupEntries.zh: 记录用户代码组及原因代码条目。 物理对应 UserCodeGroupEntries (CdoId: 751, Workspace: csi)。
UserCodeGroupEntries.en: Records user code groups and reason code entries. Physically corresponds to UserCodeGroupEntries (CdoId: 751, Workspace: csi).

UserConstant.zh: 当服务器在表达式中看到诸如 'Constants::<name of a Constant>' 之类的值时，使用 User Constant。
UserConstant.en: User Constant is used by the server when it sees a value in the expression like 'Constants::<name of a Constant>'

Vendor.zh: 供应商是商品和服务的提供者。这些商品和服务的示例包括用于制造产品的组件和子组件、为转售而购买的产品、非生产性物料，以及资源和建筑维护等服务。
Vendor.en: A vendor is a provider of goods and services. An example of these goods and services are components and subassemblies used to manufacture products, products purchased for resale, non-production materials, services such as resource and building maintenance and so on.

VendorItem.zh: Vendor Items 是供应商销售的产品。此项目在 Product 中指定，对于采购产品，可以将产品关联到可购买该产品的来源列表。此外，在向容器发放组件时，可以指定用于满足组件需求的 VendorItem。
VendorItem.en: Vendor Items are the products the vendor sells. This item is specified in the Product where, for purchased products, one can relate the product to a list of sources where the product can be purchased. In addition, when issuing components to a container, one can specify the VendorItem used to fulfill the component requirement.

WhereUsedConfig.zh: 用于对象向上依赖搜索的配置对象。
WhereUsedConfig.en: Configuration object used in object upward dependency search.

WorkCenter.zh: Work Center 通常是执行类似性质工作的区域。Work Center 包含零个或多个 Operation。Work Center 是 InSite 中执行调度的组件。调度可以按员工或资源进行。如果多个 Operation 共享员工、资源或两者，则 Work Center 可以有多个 Operation。例如，名为 Grind 的 Operation 和名为 Polish 的 Operation 使用相同的资源，因此它们指向同一 Work Center 进行调度。也可以一个 Operation 对应一个 Work Center。
WorkCenter.en: A work center is typically an area where work of a similar nature is performed. A work Center contains zero or more operations. The work center is the component through which scheduling is performed through InSite. Scheduling can be conducted according to either employees or resources. A work center may have multiple operations if the operations are sharing employees, resources, or both. For example, an operation called Grind and an operation called Polish both use the same resources so they point to the same work center for scheduling purposes. There can also be one operation to one work center.

Workflow.en: A Workflow defines the route and processing required for a manufacturing process, and is the primary driving object of the InSite factory model. When a Container is created (started) it references a Workflow (and a Step within that Workflow). The default

WorkflowBase.zh: RevisionBase 保存对象所有修订版本共有的信息，以及记录修订版本的信息。WorkflowBase 是用于 Workflow 的 RevisionBase 特定类型，定义制造过程所需的路线和处理详细信息。
WorkflowBase.en: The RevisionBase holds information common to all revisions of an object, plus information on which revision is the revision of record. WorkflowBase is the specific type of RevisionBase used for a workflow, which defines the route and processing details required for a manufacturing process.

WorkflowStep.zh: 工作流中的一个步骤，指向一个规范或子工作流，定义该步骤的处理要求。
WorkflowStep.en: A step in a workflow that points to a specification or sub-workflow, defining the processing requirements for that step.

A_Job.jobModel.zh: 定义资源从一个阶段移动到另一个阶段的流程。
A_Job.jobModel.en: Defines the flow of moving the resource from one stage to another.

A_Job.jobOrder.zh: 将作业模型链接到一个或多个资源。每个资源可以有多个作业，每个作业可以有多个资源。资源可以同时处理多个作业。
A_Job.jobOrder.en: Links a Job Model to one or more Resources. Each Resource can have multiple Jobs and each Job can have multiple Resources. A Resource can process multiple jobs at the same time.

A_Job.jobStatus.zh: 作业在资源上的状态。值包括：i) CREATED - 作业已创建但尚未确认。ii) ASSIGNED - 作业已分配。iii) ACKNOWLEDGED - 作业已确认。iv) INPROGRESS - 作业已时钟开启。v) ACTIVE - 作业已完全时钟关闭（即没有其他技术人员仍时钟开启）。vi) COMPLETED - 作业已完成。vii) CANCELLED - 作业已取消。
A_Job.jobStatus.en: The status of the job for the resource. Values include: i) CREATED - Job has been created but have not been acknowledged. ii) ASSIGNED - Job has been assigned. iii) ACKNOWLEDGED - Job has been acknowledged. iv) INPROGRESS - Job has been clocked on. v) ACTIVE - Job has been fully clocked off (i.e. no other technicians still clocked on). vi) COMPLETED - Job has been completed. vii) CANCELLED - Job has been canceled.

A_Job.lastClockOffDate.zh: 技术人员最后一次为该资源时钟关闭作业的时间戳。
A_Job.lastClockOffDate.en: The timestamp when a technician last clock off the job for the resource.

A_Job.lastIntegrationTxn.zh: 存储最后的IntegrationTxn。有关更多信息，请参阅History Mainline Integration Txn字段。
A_Job.lastIntegrationTxn.en: Stores the last IntegrationTxn. Refer to History Mainline Integration Txn field for more information.

A_Job.repairCode.zh: 在作业进度期间用于标识所完成维修的维修代码。
A_Job.repairCode.en: Repair Code used during a Job Progress to identify the repair done.

A_Job.stage.en: Stores the stage the job is in.

A_Job.stageSequence.en: Stores the sequence of the stage within the JobModel.

A_Job.symptomCode.zh: 在作业进度期间用于识别症状的症状代码。
A_Job.symptomCode.en: Symptom Code used during a Job Progress to identify the symptom.

A_LocationMap.workflow.en: A Workflow defines the route and processing required for manufacturing a product. Zero or more product definitions and or product families reference a Workflow. This reference defines the default Workflow to use for manufacturing that product. When a new

A_LocationMap.workflowStep.zh: 步骤用于在工作流中离散地定义某个点（步骤）的处理。工作流是使用路径关联的步骤集合。每个步骤包含零个或多个路径，这些路径链接到另一个步骤。每个步骤中的一个路径被标识为...
A_LocationMap.workflowStep.en: Steps are used to discretely define processing for a point (step) within a Workflow. A Workflow is a collection of Steps that are related using Paths. Each Step contains zero or more Paths, which link to another Step. One Path at each Step is identified a

A_LotAttributes.allowLotSchedule.zh: 指示批次是否允许被安排生产的标志。
A_LotAttributes.allowLotSchedule.en: Flag indicating whether the lot is allowed to be scheduled for production.

A_LotAttributes.assemblyArea.zh: 工厂的装配区域名称。在批次排程期间复制到批次属性。
A_LotAttributes.assemblyArea.en: The Assembly Area name for the Factory. Copied over to Lot Attributes during Lot Schedule.

A_LotAttributes.assemblyCountry.zh: 工厂的装配国家名称。在批次排程期间复制到批次属性。
A_LotAttributes.assemblyCountry.en: The Assembly Country name for the Factory. Copied over to Lot Attributes during Lot Schedule.

A_LotAttributes.binNumber.zh: 存储批次拆分出的料箱编号。
A_LotAttributes.binNumber.en: Stores the bin number the lot is split out from.

A_LotAttributes.bucketNumber.zh: 存储批次拆分出的桶号。
A_LotAttributes.bucketNumber.en: The bucket number the lot is split out from.

A_LotAttributes.dummyQty.zh: i) 批次的虚拟数量。ii) 在移出事务期间收集虚拟数量时设置。
A_LotAttributes.dummyQty.en: i) The dummy quantity for the lot. ii) Set during a move out transaction where dummy quantity was collected.

A_LotAttributes.firstSortCompleted.zh: 指示首次分选是否完成的标志。
A_LotAttributes.firstSortCompleted.en: Flag indicating whether first sort is completed.

A_LotAttributes.hotLotIndicator.zh: 热批次指示符 - 在载具设置顺序期间使用。
A_LotAttributes.hotLotIndicator.en: Hot Lot Indicator - Used during Carrier Set Sequence.

A_LotAttributes.materialReturnCount.zh: 存储批次被退回仓库的次数。
A_LotAttributes.materialReturnCount.en: Stores the number of times the lot was returned back to store.

A_LotAttributes.materialVendor.zh: 供应商是商品和服务的提供者。这些商品和服务的示例包括用于制造产品的组件和子组件、采购转售的产品、非生产材料、服务和资源及建筑维护。
A_LotAttributes.materialVendor.en: A vendor is a provider of goods and services. An example of these goods and services are components and subassemblies used to manufacture products, products purchased for resale, non-production materials, services such as resource and building maintenanc

A_LotAttributes.materialVendorLotNumber.zh: 最长 40 个字符的字符串字段。

A_LotAttributes.numberOfStrips.zh: i) 批次的条带数量。ii) 在移出事务期间收集条带数量时设置。
A_LotAttributes.numberOfStrips.en: i) The number of strips for the lot. ii) Set during a move out transaction where number of strips was collected.

A_LotAttributes.packingComments.zh: 在批次包装期间输入的包装备注。
A_LotAttributes.packingComments.en: The Packing Comments that was entered during Lot Packing.

A_LotAttributes.packingNumberOfBoxes.zh: 在批次包装期间使用的盒子数量。
A_LotAttributes.packingNumberOfBoxes.en: The number of boxes used during Lot Packing.

A_LotAttributes.packingPartialBoxNumber.zh: 在批次包装期间使用的部分盒子编号。
A_LotAttributes.packingPartialBoxNumber.en: The partial box number used during Lot Packing.

A_LotAttributes.packingPartialBoxQty.zh: 在批次包装期间使用的部分盒子数量。
A_LotAttributes.packingPartialBoxQty.en: The partial box quantity used during Lot Packing.

A_LotAttributes.packingQty.zh: 在批次包装期间使用的包装数量。
A_LotAttributes.packingQty.en: The packing quantity used during Lot Packing.

A_LotAttributes.packingSize.zh: 在批次包装期间使用的包装尺寸。
A_LotAttributes.packingSize.en: The packing size used during Lot Packing.

A_LotAttributes.shelfLocation.en: The shelf location for the lot.

A_LotAttributes.shipToFactory.en: Factories to ship the lots to.

A_LotAttributes.shipToProcess.en: Processes to ship the lots to.

A_LotAttributes.testArea.zh: 工厂的测试区域名称。在批次排程期间复制到批次属性。
A_LotAttributes.testArea.en: The Test Area name for the Factory. Copied over to Lot Attributes during Lot Schedule.

A_LotAttributes.testCountry.zh: 工厂的测试国家名称。在批次排程期间复制到批次属性。
A_LotAttributes.testCountry.en: The Test Country name for the Factory. Copied over to Lot Attributes during Lot Schedule.

A_LotAttributes.thirdSortCompleted.zh: 指示第三次分选是否完成的标志。
A_LotAttributes.thirdSortCompleted.en: Flag indicating that 3rd sort is completed.

A_LotAttributes.waferBin.zh: 批次从晶圆料箱摘要中拆分出时的晶圆料箱。
A_LotAttributes.waferBin.en: The Wafer Bin for the lot when it was split out from the wafer bins summary.

A_LotAttributes.waferSortArea.zh: 工厂的晶圆分选区域名称。在批次调度期间复制到批次属性。
A_LotAttributes.waferSortArea.en: The Wafer Sort Area name for the Factory. Copied over to Lot Attributes during Lot Schedule.

A_LotAttributes.waferSortCountry.zh: 工厂的晶圆分选国家名称。在批次调度期间复制到批次属性。
A_LotAttributes.waferSortCountry.en: The Wafer Sort Country name for the Factory. Copied over to Lot Attributes during Lot Schedule.

A_LotItems.container.zh: 拥有此实例的批次对象。
A_LotItems.container.en: The lot object that owns this instance.

A_LotItems.inheritedTimestamp.zh: 记录被继承时的时间戳。
A_LotItems.inheritedTimestamp.en: The timestamp when the record was inherited.

A_LotItems.inheritedUsername.zh: 记录被继承时的用户名。
A_LotItems.inheritedUsername.en: The username when the record was inherited.

A_LotItems.itemCategory.zh: 用于区分批次的不同类型的项。例如：晶圆、条带、面板等。
A_LotItems.itemCategory.en: Used to differentiate the different types of Items for a lot. E.g. Wafers, Strips, Panels, etc.

A_LotItems.itemLevel.zh: 系统计算值。直接与批次相关的项为第 1 级。第一个子项记录设为第 2 级，依此类推。
A_LotItems.itemLevel.en: System calculated value. Items directly related to the lot is at level one. The first sub-item records are set at level 2 and so on.

A_LotItems.itemSequence.zh: 用于排序/显示目的的实例顺序。
A_LotItems.itemSequence.en: The sequence for the instance for sorting/display purpose.

A_LotItems.itemsCount.en: Stores the number of Items for the Instance.

A_LotItems.parent.zh: 包含此 CDO 的 CDO 的 Id。
A_LotItems.parent.en: Id of the CDO containing this CDO.

A_LotItems.txnTimestamp.zh: 记录插入或更新的时间戳。
A_LotItems.txnTimestamp.en: The timestamp the record was inserted or updated.

A_LotItems.username.zh: 插入或最后更新记录的用户。
A_LotItems.username.en: The user who inserted or last updated the record.

A_LotSizeSamplingSetup.spec.en: A specification (Spec) describes the processing that takes place at a Step within a Workflow. It references many other Modeling components including an Operation, Setup, Data Collection Definitions and Resources. Specs also include detailed scheduling and

A_LotWafers.container.zh: 返回容器对象类型的虚拟字段。由 Web 表单（如 ModifyMultiLotsWafers）用于从 LotWafers 记录中检索容器名称。
A_LotWafers.container.en: Virtual field to return the Container object type. Used by Web Forms such as ModifyMultiLotsWafers to retrieve the Container name from the LotWafers records.

A_LotWafers.grade.zh: 分选晶圆的等级或级别。
A_LotWafers.grade.en: The Grade or Level for the sorted wafers.

A_LotWafers.gradeLocation.zh: 将分出的晶圆移动到的位置。仅当 GradeProduct 存在时才考虑此值，因为它会导致晶圆分裂。
A_LotWafers.gradeLocation.en: The Location to move the split out wafers to. This value will only be considered if GradeProduct exists since it will cause splitting of wafers.

A_LotWafers.gradeProduct.zh: 该等级的产品。如果此处存在值，则属于同一等级的晶圆将被分出。这在 SORTING 步骤逻辑规范的移出事务期间完成。
A_LotWafers.gradeProduct.en: The Product for the Grade. If a value exists here, Wafers belonging to the same grade will be split out. This is done during the move out transaction of the SORTING Step Logic Spec.

A_LotWafers.isBadWafer.zh: 指示晶圆是否为不良品的标志。如果是，则在批次移出期间将该晶圆从批次中移除。
A_LotWafers.isBadWafer.en: Flag indicating whether the wafer is bad. If it is, the wafer will be removed from the lot during LotMoveOut.

A_LotWafers.isOnLoan.zh: 指示晶圆是否外借的标志。
A_LotWafers.isOnLoan.en: Flag indicating whether the wafer is on loan.

A_LotWafers.requireDataCollection.zh: 指示晶圆是否已通过 WIP 数据被选择进行数据收集的标志。
A_LotWafers.requireDataCollection.en: Flag indicating whether the wafer has been selected for Data Collection through WIP Data.

A_LotWafers.requireTracking.zh: 指示晶圆是否需要设备处理的标志。
A_LotWafers.requireTracking.en: Flag indicating whether the wafer requires equipment processing.

A_LotWafers.resortNoteCode.zh: 分选期间使用的重排注释代码。
A_LotWafers.resortNoteCode.en: Resort Note Code used during Sorting.

A_LotWafers.sortEquipment.zh: i) Resource 的子类。ii) 无维护服务。iii) 为其子类提供公共字段。
A_LotWafers.sortEquipment.en: i) Sub-class of Resource. ii) No maintenance service. iii) Provides common fields to its sub-classes.

A_LotWafers.sortIqcResult.zh: PASS 或 FAIL。如果为 FAIL，则 LotSortIQCWafersFailures 中至少需要一条记录。
A_LotWafers.sortIqcResult.en: Either PASS or FAIL. If FAIL, at least one record in LotSortIQCWafersFailures is required.

A_LotWafers.sortNoteCode.zh: 分选期间使用的分选注释代码。
A_LotWafers.sortNoteCode.en: Sort Note Code used during Sorting.

A_LotWafers.sortSqaResult.zh: PASS 或 FAIL。如果为 FAIL，则 LotSortIQCWafersFailures 中至少需要一条记录。
A_LotWafers.sortSqaResult.en: Either PASS or FAIL. If FAIL, at least one record in LotSortIQCWafersFailures is required.

A_LotWafers.txnTimestamp.zh: i) 数据收集时的时间戳。
A_LotWafers.txnTimestamp.en: i) The timestamp when the data is collected.

A_LotWafers.username.en: i) The user who collected the data.

A_LotWafers.waferBatchId.zh: 用于将一片或多片晶圆分组以一起处理的批次 ID。用于来自不同批次的晶圆需要一起跟踪进出而无需拆分和合并的情况。
A_LotWafers.waferBatchId.en: Batch id used to group one or more wafers to be processed together. This is used for cases where wafers from different lots are to be tracked in and out together without splitting and combining.

A_LotWafers.waferBatchSequence.zh: 按其 WaferBatchId 排列的晶圆顺序。

A_ProcessSpec.changeHistory.zh: 每个建模实体都包含 Change Status。它用于记录当前的变更（维护）状态（例如，特定 Product Definition 的维护正在进行中），并跟踪最后一次更改的人员和时间。这应该可扩展为随时间变化的完整历史记录。
A_ProcessSpec.changeHistory.en: Every modeling entity includes a Change Status. It is used to record the current Change (Maintenance) Status (i.e., maintenance is currently in progress for a specific Product Definition) and to track who made the last change and when. This should be extendible to a complete history over time.

A_ProcessSpec.cycleTime.zh: Process Spec 的预期周期时间。
A_ProcessSpec.cycleTime.en: Expected cycle time for the Process Spec.

A_ProcessSpec.objectType.en: i) The process specification type. ii) System identification for the record. iii) This field will be automatically updated.

A_ProcessSpec.owner.zh: 可选字段，指示可以使用 Process Spec 调度的批次类型。如果未输入值，则对象类型中的任何批次都可以使用它。如果输入值，则批次的 Owner 必须与此值匹配。
A_ProcessSpec.owner.en: Optional field to indicate the types of lots that can be scheduled with the Process Spec. If no value is entered, any lot within the Object Type can use it. If a value is entered, the lot's Owner must match this value.

A_ProcessSpec.processSpecStatus.zh: i) 过程规格的状态。ii) 引用 ProcessSpecStatus 用户代码。
A_ProcessSpec.processSpecStatus.en: i) The status of the process spec. ii) Reference the ProcessSpecStatus user code.

A_ProcessSpec.status.en: Determines the current status (Active, In-Active) of this instance. Valid values and their meanings are: 1 = Active 2 = Inactive Note there are no validations (rules enforced) concerning active vs. inactive revisions.

A_ProcessSpec.wipMsgDefMgr.zh: WIP消息定义，包含适用于此实体的所有WIP消息的WIP消息键列表。

A_ProcessSpec.workflow.en: i) The workflow for the process.

A_ProcessSpecDetails.allowParallelProces.en: Flag indicating whether to allow multiple Process Types to be executing at any one time.

A_ProcessSpecDetails.dispatchPlan.zh: 用于在步骤处 Track In 时调度批次的计划。
A_ProcessSpecDetails.dispatchPlan.en: Plan used for dispatching lots for Track In at a step.

A_ProcessSpecDetails.followProcessSequen.en: Flag indicating whether to ensure the Process Type sequence. If set to true, the order in which the Process Types was added must be followed.

A_ProcessSpecDetails.fullProcessing.zh: 用于强制每个 Process Type 进行全数量处理的标志。
A_ProcessSpecDetails.fullProcessing.en: Flag used to force full quantity processing for each Process Type.

A_ProcessSpecDetails.inputCarrierFamily.zh: TrackInLot 期间预期的输入 Carrier Family。
A_ProcessSpecDetails.inputCarrierFamily.en: The expected input Carrier Family during TrackInLot.

A_ProcessSpecDetails.maskLayer.zh: 提供有效的 Mask Layer 列表。
A_ProcessSpecDetails.maskLayer.en: Provide valid list of Mask Layer.

A_ProcessSpecDetails.maxReworkCount.zh: 用于设置最大返工次数的字段。
A_ProcessSpecDetails.maxReworkCount.en: A field to set the maximum count of rework

A_ProcessSpecDetails.outputCarrierFamily.zh: 由 Carrier 跟踪逻辑用于在 Track Out 验证和自动化期间加载输出处的 Carrier Family。对于其他 Process Spec 类型，它用于在 LotMoveOut 期间验证。
A_ProcessSpecDetails.outputCarrierFamily.en: Used by carrier tracking logic to load the Carrier Family at the output during Track Out verification and automation. For other Process Spec types, it is used to verify during LotMoveOut.

A_ProcessSpecDetails.recipe.zh: 描述配方（recipe）的 Document 子类。
A_ProcessSpecDetails.recipe.en: A subclass of Document describes recipe.

A_ProcessSpecDetails.requiredProcessCapa.zh: 在步骤/规格上处理批次所需的过程能力。
A_ProcessSpecDetails.requiredProcessCapa.en: The required Process Capability to process the lot on the Step / Spec

A_ProcessSpecDetails.resetReworkCount.zh: 指示在 Lot Move Out 时是否重置批次当前返工次数的布尔字段。
A_ProcessSpecDetails.resetReworkCount.en: A Boolean field to indicate whether the lot’s current rework count will be reset on Lot Move Out

A_ProcessSpecDetails.reworkHoldReason.zh: 用于设置持有原因（hold reason）的字段。
A_ProcessSpecDetails.reworkHoldReason.en: A field to set hold reason

A_ProcessSpecDetails.rptBulkDelta.zh: 从特定对象（例如：Process Spec、SupplementarySpec）确定的批量处理时间的差异。可以是0或负值。
A_ProcessSpecDetails.rptBulkDelta.en: Difference in bulk processing time determine from the specific object (E.g.: Process Spec, SupplementarySpec)​ Can be 0 or negative value.

A_ProcessSpecDetails.rptUnitDelta.zh: 从特定对象（例如：Process Spec、SupplementarySpec）确定的单位处理时间的差异。可以是0或负值。
A_ProcessSpecDetails.rptUnitDelta.en: Difference in unit processing time determine from the specific object (E.g.: Process Spec, SupplementarySpec)​ Can be 0 or negative value.

A_ProcessSpecDetails.scsDurationPerUnit.zh: 此值指定处理单个单元所需的时间。用于周期时间和成本核算计算。
A_ProcessSpecDetails.scsDurationPerUnit.en: This value specifies the amount of time needed to process a single unit. This is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

A_ProcessSpecDetails.scsEqpCompletenessV.zh: 指示是否阻止与相关 StartParentContainer 相关的所有容器的移动，直到所有相关容器都已从设备上 Track Off 的标志。
A_ProcessSpecDetails.scsEqpCompletenessV.en: Flag indicating whether to block the movement of all containers related to the related StartParentContainer until all related containers have tracked off the equipment.

A_ProcessSpecDetails.scsFastCycleTime.zh: 这是一个计算值，表示使用此 Spec 处理标准尺寸批次物料所需的时间，假设快速队列时间。用于确定例如作业通过工厂加速需要多快。计算...
A_ProcessSpecDetails.scsFastCycleTime.en: This is a calculated value that denotes the time required processing a standard size batch of material using this Spec, assuming fast queue time. This is used to determine, for example, how quickly a job can be expedited through the Factory. The calcul

A_ProcessSpecDetails.scsNormalCycleTime.zh: 这是一个计算值，表示使用此 Spec 处理标准尺寸批次物料所需的时间，假设正常队列时间。此值的计算使用其他 CDO 的属性。这意味着更改 Work Center 值...
A_ProcessSpecDetails.scsNormalCycleTime.en: This is a calculated value that denotes the time required processing a standard size batch of material using this Spec, assuming normal queue time. The calculation for this value uses attributes of other CDOs. This means that changing a Work Center val

A_ProcessSpecDetails.scsRunRateOption.zh: 此选项确定运行速率是指定为每小时小时数还是每小时单位数。值及其含义为：1 = 每小时小时数（RunRateTime）2 = 每小时单位数（RunRateQuantity）
A_ProcessSpecDetails.scsRunRateOption.en: This option determines if run rate is specified as hours per unit or units per hour. The values and their meanings are: 1 = Hours per unit (RunRateTime) 2 = Unites per hour (RunRateQuantity)

A_ProcessSpecDetails.scsSetupTime.zh: 此值指定在此操作处进行 Setup 所需的时间。用于周期时间和成本核算计算。
A_ProcessSpecDetails.scsSetupTime.en: This value specifies the time required for a Setup at this Operation. This is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

A_ProcessSpecDetails.scsSlotMappingRequi.zh: 指示已分配的批次需要执行 Slot Mapping Requirement 任务的位置。
A_ProcessSpecDetails.scsSlotMappingRequi.en: Indicate where the assigned lot that will need to perform Slot Mapping Requirement task

A_ProcessSpecDetails.scsUnitsPerHour.zh: 此值指定每小时处理的单位数。用于周期时间和成本核算计算。
A_ProcessSpecDetails.scsUnitsPerHour.en: This value specifies the number of units processed in an hour. This is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

A_ProcessSpecDetails.scsYield.zh: 指定使用此 Spec 处理时预期的标准良率。此值用于周期时间和成本核算计算。
A_ProcessSpecDetails.scsYield.en: Specifies the standard yield expected for processing with this Spec. This value is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

A_ProcessSpecDetails.spec.zh: i) 在 Process Spec 中选择的 Workflow 中的规格。ii) 有效规格列表取自 Process Spec 的 Workflow。
A_ProcessSpecDetails.spec.en: i) The spec within the Workflow selected in the Process Spec. ii) Valid list of spec is taken from the Process Spec’s Workflow.

A_ProcessSpecDetails.stepName.zh: 表示 Workflow 中的步骤名称。不保存 Workflow Step Id，因为 Workflow 可能被修改，因此 Workflow Step Id 可能改变。因此使用字符串关系代替。
A_ProcessSpecDetails.stepName.en: Represent the Step Name within the Workflow. The Workflow Step Id is not saved since the Workflow may be modifed and thus the Workflow Step Id may be changed. Hence a string relationship is used instead.

A_ProcessSpecDetails.toolPlan.zh: 用于设置设备所需的工装类型。每台设备可以分配一个 ToolMatrix。如果为设备分配了 ToolMatrix，则必须先设置设备中所需的工装，然后才能用于处理批次。
A_ProcessSpecDetails.toolPlan.en: Used to setup the types of tooling required for the equipment. Each equipment can be assigned a ToolMatrix. If a ToolMatrix is assigned to the equipment, the required tools must be setup in the equipment before it can be used to process lots.

A_ProductBOM.billType.zh: 用于区分此清单结构的意图。同一产品可存在多个清单。根据使用清单的部门，清单可以处于更高或更低的分解级别。可添加并非制造过程物理部分的项目，以协助标准成本计算或人工报告。
A_ProductBOM.billType.en: Used to distinguish the intent of this Bill structure. Several Bills can exist for the same product. Bills can be at higher or lower levels of resolution depending on the department that is using the Bill. Items that are not physically part of the manufacturing process can be added to assist standard costing calculations or labor reporting.

A_ProductBOM.changeHistory.zh: 每个建模实体都包含 Change Status。它用于记录当前的变更（维护）状态（例如，特定 Product Definition 的维护正在进行中），并跟踪最后一次更改的人员和时间。这应该可扩展为随时间变化的完整历史记录。
A_ProductBOM.changeHistory.en: Every modeling entity includes a Change Status. It is used to record the current Change (Maintenance) Status (i.e., maintenance is currently in progress for a specific Product Definition) and to track who made the last change and when. This should be extendible to a complete history over time.

A_ProductBOM.wipMsgDefMgr.en: WIP Message Definition which contains a list of WIP message keys that contain all of the WIP messages that apply to this entity.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.adjustmentType.zh: 此字段定义调整的类型（例如百分比或数量）。所选类型决定如何解释和应用 AdjustmentValue 以进行自动调整计算。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.adjustmentType.en: This field defines the type of the adjustment (e.g. Percentage or Quantity). The chosen type determines how the AdjustmentValue is interpreted and applied for the auto-adjustment calculations.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.adjustmentValue.zh: 此字段定义用于自动调整计算的值，基于所选的调整类型。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.adjustmentValue.en: This field defines the value used for auto-adjustments calculations based on the chosen Adjustment Type.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.allowAllRevisio.zh: 为 true 时，将允许物料需求使用产品的所有修订版。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.allowAllRevisio.en: When true it will allow all revisions of the product to be allowed for the material requirement

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.allowOverConsum.zh: 此标志确定物料消耗检查是否允许发放多于 MaterialListItem 条目中指定的物料。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.allowOverConsum.en: This flag determines if the material consumption check will allow more materials to be issued than specified in the MaterialListItem entry

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.allowUnderConsu.zh: 此标志确定物料消耗检查是否允许发放少于 MaterialListItem 条目中指定的物料。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.allowUnderConsu.en: This flag determines if the material consumption check will allow less materials to be issued than specified in the MaterialListItem entry

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.assemblySequenc.zh: 物料应被组装的顺序。仅当物料分配给步骤/规格时，此值才使用。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.assemblySequenc.en: Sequence the item should be assembled. The value is only used if the item is assigned to a Step/Spec

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.autoUnload.zh: 定义受影响的物料（如果序列化）在数量消耗到0时是否自动从设备卸载。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.autoUnload.en: Defines if the affected Material (if serialized) is to be auto unloaded from Equipment if qty has been consumed to 0.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.consumeFactor.zh: i) Consume Factor 用于计算从物料批次消耗到生产批次的数量。例如，数量为1000的生产批次在 Consume Factor 为2时将消耗物料批次的2000个单位。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.consumeFactor.en: i) The Consume Factor is used to calculate the quantity to consume from the Material Lot to the production lot. E.g. a production lot with a quantity of 1000 will consume 2000 units of the Material Lot if the Consume Factor is 2.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.displaySequence.en: The sequence to display the attributes.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.effectiveFromDa.zh: 如果指定，这是此需求变为可用的开始日期和时间。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.effectiveFromDa.en: If specified, this is the starting date and time when this Requirement becomes available.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.effectiveFromDa.zh: 如果指定，这是此需求变为可用的开始日期和时间。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.effectiveFromDa.en: If specified, this is the starting date and time when this Requirement becomes available.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.effectiveThruDa.zh: 如果指定，这是此需求不再可用的结束日期和时间。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.effectiveThruDa.en: If specified, this is the ending date and time when this Requirement becomes no longer available.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.effectiveThruDa.zh: 如果指定，这是此需求不再可用的结束日期和时间。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.effectiveThruDa.en: If specified, this is the ending date and time when this Requirement becomes no longer available.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.isImage.zh: 与物料列表项关联的图像
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.isImage.en: Image associated to the material list item

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.isPhantom.zh: 表示这是一个虚拟物料列表项。虚拟项不是实际物料，而是从 BOM 结构中的组件项分组中人为构造的，以减少 BOM 维护。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.isPhantom.en: Denotes this is a phantom material list item. Phantom items are not actual materials, but are artifical constructs added from grouping component items in a BOM structure to reduce BOM maintenance.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.isSourceProduct.zh: 指示是否应将产品用作构建目标产品的源物料的标志。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.isSourceProduct.en: Flag indicating whether the Product should be used as the source material to build the target Product.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.issueControl.zh: 1 - 容器在 InSite 中以序列级别跟踪 2 - 容器在 InSite 中以批量级别跟踪 3 - 容器不在 InSite 中跟踪...记录数量和批次 4 - 非批次控制（现场库存）记录位置无容器 5 - 记录数量但不记录容器或位置 6 - 发放数量显示但不记录
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.issueControl.en: 1 - Container is tracked in InSite at the serial level 2 - Container is tracked in InSite at the bulk level 3 - Container is not tracked in InSite ... quantity and lot is recorded 4 - non lot controlled ( floor stock ) location is recorded no container 5 - recording quantities but not container or location 6 - issue quantities are displayed but not recorded

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.name.zh: 名称子实体的唯一名称。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.name.en: Unique name for the name subentity.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.phantomBill.zh: 物料清单定义了生产特定产品所需的物料。虚拟 BOM 是不存在实际装配的产品的物料清单，仅用于保存一组相关组件。当这种逻辑组件分组用于许多成品时，创建虚拟 BOM 以减少维护工作，这样逻辑组件组的维护可以在一处完成。注意物料列表项上直接引用的虚拟 BOM 通常只是指向与物料列表项关联的产品定义的 BOM 的指针。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.phantomBill.en: A bill of material defines the materials needed to produce a specific product. A Phantom Bill is a bill of material for a product that does not exist as an actual assembly, but is created only for the purpose of holding a group of related components. A phantom bill is created to reduce maintenance efforts, when such a logical grouping of components is used for many finished products, so that the maintenance of the logical group of components can be done in one place only. Note the Phantom Bill referenced on the material list item directly will ordinarily just be a pointer to a bill defined as part of the associated Product referenced by the material list item.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.processType.zh: 物料用于的可选过程类型。如果指定，则物料部件用于特定的过程类型。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.processType.en: Optional Process Type the material is used for. If specified the Material Part is used for the particular Process Type.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.producingOrder.zh: 生产订单是一个字符串字段。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.producingOrder.en: Producing Order is a String field

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.qty2Required.zh: 如果跟踪多个数量，则此组件项所需的数量。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.qty2Required.en: Quantity of this component item required, if multiple quantities are being tracked.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.qtyRequired.en: Quantity of this component item required.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.referenceDesign.zh: 此物料放置在装配体上或内部的特定位置。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.referenceDesign.en: The specific position on or in the assembly where this item is placed.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.scrapPercent.zh: 此物料预计报废的百分比。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.scrapPercent.en: Percent of this item expected to be scrapped.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.scsIsComponentI.zh: 指示物料是通过 CEP Component Issue 还是 SCS Material Consumption 逻辑消耗的标志。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.scsIsComponentI.en: Flag to denote if the material is to be consumed via CEP Component Issue or SCS Material Consumption logic

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.setupQty.zh: 初始化处理资源所需的此组件项的数量。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.setupQty.en: The amount of this component item needed to initialize the processing resource.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.setupQty2.zh: 初始化处理资源所需的此组件项的数量。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.setupQty2.en: The amount of this component item needed to initialize the processing resource.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.spec.zh: 可选规格，如果指定，则物料专门用于该规格。物料类型的 Consume Specs 将被忽略。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.spec.en: Optional Spec if specified means the material is used specifically for the spec. The Material Type's Consume Specs will be ignored.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.uom.en: The unit of measure for the QtyRequired.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.uom2.en: The unit of measure for Qty2Required.

A_ProductBOMMaterialList.vendorControl.zh: 指示此物料是否需要供应商信息。
A_ProductBOMMaterialList.vendorControl.en: Denotes whether Vendor information is required for this item.

A_ResourceBOM.billType.zh: 用于区分此清单结构的意图。同一产品可存在多个清单。根据使用清单的部门，清单可以处于更高或更低的分解级别。可添加并非制造过程物理部分的项目，以协助标准成本计算或人工报告。
A_ResourceBOM.billType.en: Used to distinguish the intent of this Bill structure. Several Bills can exist for the same product. Bills can be at higher or lower levels of resolution depending on the department that is using the Bill. Items that are not physically part of the manufacturing process can be added to assist standard costing calculations or labor reporting.

A_ResourceBOM.changeHistory.en: Every modeling entity includes a Change Status. It is used to record the current Change (Maintenance) Status (i.e., maintenance is currently in progress for a specific Product Definition) and to track who made the last change and when. This should be extendible to a complete history over time.

A_ToolPlan.documentSet.zh: 文档集是一个或多个文档的列表。大多数建模实体包含对文档集的引用。在此上下文中，文档用于提供扩展（非结构化）信息，例如产品图纸、扫描图像、相关的现有制造规范或操作程序。每个文档（CDO）实例包括外部文档的标识符（即文件名或URL）和对用于呈现文档的程序的引用。
A_ToolPlan.documentSet.en: A Document Set is a list of one or more documents. Most Modeling entities include a reference to a Document Set. Documents are used in this context to provide extended (unstructured) information, such as product drawings, scanned images, relating existing manufacturing specifications, or operating procedures. Each instance of a Document (CDO) includes an identifier for the external document (i.e., a file name or a URL) and a reference to the program used for presenting the document.

A_WIPDataSetup.failureSpec.en: Specifies the last Spec where the lot processed in. If this field is specified, the Equipment that was last used at the Spec will be set to the FailureStatus instead of the Equipment during TrackOutLot. This field will only be used if FailureStatus is set
