A_WIPInstructions.setupAccess.zh: 用于验证用户对特定建模记录的访问权限。必须首先将一个或多个 Setup Access 分配给 Role。每个建模记录将有一个 Setup Access。当建模记录被事务处理时，系统将比较其 Setup Access。
A_WIPInstructions.setupAccess.en: This is used to verify the user's access to a particular modeling record. One or more Setup Access must first be assigned to a Role. Each modeling record will have one Setup Access. When a modeling record in transacted the system will compare its Setup Ac

A_WIPLot.autoMoveOut.zh: 指示批次成功完成加工后是否自动移出的标志。
A_WIPLot.autoMoveOut.en: Flag indicating whether to Auto Move Out once the lot successfully complete its processing.

A_WIPLot.autoRejectsRescreens.zh: 用于指定在检测到拒绝时是否自动创建新插入的字段。值 3 表示将自动创建重筛直至第 3 次插入（即直至第 2 次重筛）。对于晶圆加工，只有选定的晶圆
A_WIPLot.autoRejectsRescreens.en: Field used to specify whether to automatically create a new insertion if there is a reject detected. A value of 3 means rescreen will be automatically created up to the 3rd insertion (i.e. up to 2nd rescreen). For Wafer Processing, only wafers selected to

A_WIPLot.carrierName.zh: 创建插入时批次所在载具名称。
A_WIPLot.carrierName.en: The Carrier Name the lot was in when the insertion is created.

A_WIPLot.containerName.zh: i) 事务发生时的批次 ID。
A_WIPLot.containerName.en: i) The lot id at the point of transaction.

A_WIPLot.creationEmployeeName.zh: 创建插入时的员工姓名。
A_WIPLot.creationEmployeeName.en: The employee name when the insertion was created.

A_WIPLot.creationTimestamp.zh: i) 创建插入时的时间戳。
A_WIPLot.creationTimestamp.en: i) The timestamp when the insertion was created.

A_WIPLot.creationUsername.zh: i) 创建插入时的用户名。
A_WIPLot.creationUsername.en: i) The username when the insertion was created.

A_WIPLot.failureAction.zh: i) 批次未通过产率时要采取的操作。ii) 此值从工序属性复制。iii) 主要目的是允许用户按批次覆盖默认值。iv) 固定值：a. HOLD b. WARNING
A_WIPLot.failureAction.en: i) The action to take when the lot fails the yield. ii) This value is copied over from the operation attributes. iii) Main purpose is to allow the user to overwrite the default value by lot. iv) Fixed values: a. HOLD b. WARNING

A_WIPLot.failureActionHoldCount.zh: 来自 WIP 批次详细信息的 HOLD 失败操作数量。每个工序失败操作 = WIP 批次详细信息中的 HOLD 将增加 1。
A_WIPLot.failureActionHoldCount.en: The number of HOLD Failure Actions from WIP Lot Details. Each Process Failure Action = HOLD in WIP Lot Details will increment by 1.

A_WIPLot.failureHoldTimestamp.zh: 在批次移出期间因产率和/或 SPC 失败而将批次置于保持状态的时间戳。
A_WIPLot.failureHoldTimestamp.en: The timestamp when the lot was put on hold during LotMoveOut due to yield and/or SPC failures.

A_WIPLot.finalProcessStopTimestamp.zh: 整个插入的最后一次跟踪出的时间戳。此值将始终为每个 TrackOutLot 事务更新。注意，对于不需要设备跟踪的情况，此字段将为 null。
A_WIPLot.finalProcessStopTimestamp.en: The timestamp of the last track out for the entire insertion. This value will always be updated for every TrackOutLot transaction. Note that this field will be null for cases where equipment tracking is not required.

A_WIPLot.firstProcessStartTimestamp.zh: 批次在整个插入中首次跟踪进的时间戳。即无论首先启动哪个 ProcessType。这意味着此值将保存 WIPLotDetails 的最早的 ProcessStartTimestamp。注意，对于某些情况，此字段将为 null
A_WIPLot.firstProcessStartTimestamp.en: The timestamp when the lot is first tracked in for the entire insertion. I.e. regardless of which ProcessType was started first. This means this value will hold the oldest ProcessStartTimestamp of WIPLotDetails. Note that this field will be null for cases

A_WIPLot.grossQty.zh: i) 这是一个数据收集字段，用户在首次运行引线检查期间输入。ii) 此值将复制到后续插入。
A_WIPLot.grossQty.en: i) This is a data collection field where the user enters during the 1st run lead inspection. ii) This value will be copied over to subsequent insertions.

A_WIPLot.holdLocationDuration.zh: 存储当前插入的总保持位置持续时间。
A_WIPLot.holdLocationDuration.en: Stores the total hold location duration for the current insertion.

A_WIPLot.holdLocationTotalDuration.zh: 存储当前步骤中所有插入的总持续时间。此值将复制到下一次插入以进行累加。这意味着最后一次插入将具有该步骤所有持续时间的总和。
A_WIPLot.holdLocationTotalDuration.en: Stores the total duration for all insertions in the current step. This value will be copied over to the next insertion for accumulation. This means the last insertion will have the sum of all duration for the step.

A_WIPLot.holdLotIfLimitsNotFound.zh: i) 如果找不到限值条件，则保持批次的标志。ii) 此值从规范属性复制。iii) 主要目的是允许用户按批次覆盖默认值。iv) 此值将复制到后续插入
A_WIPLot.holdLotIfLimitsNotFound.en: i) Flag to hold the lot if limits criteria could not be found. ii) This value is copied over from the spec attributes. iii) Main purpose is to allow the user to overwrite the default value by lot. iv) This value will be copied over to subsequent insert

A_WIPLot.insertionNumber.zh: i) 指示记录的插入编号。ii) 从 1 开始。iii) 每个插入编号都有其自己的记录。
A_WIPLot.insertionNumber.en: i) Indicate the insertion number of the record. ii) Starts with 1. iii) Every insertion number will have its own record.

A_WIPLot.insertionReason.zh: 创建新插入时原因的有效值。
A_WIPLot.insertionReason.en: Valid values for the Reason in creating a new insertion.

A_WIPLot.isBinSplitBeforeMoveOut.zh: 系统标志，指示批次在其父批次移出之前是否作为 bin 被分出。此标志在批次移出事务期间设置。一旦设置为 true（即在其父批次移出事务期间），则无法收集任何 bin 信息
A_WIPLot.isBinSplitBeforeMoveOut.en: System flag indicating whether the lot was split out as a bin before its parent lot moved out. This flag is set during the Lot Move Out transaction. Once it is set to true (i.e. during its parent move out transaction), it cannot collect any bin informatio

A_WIPLot.isCompleted.zh: i) 指示插入是否完成的标志。ii) 当所有 WIP 批次详细信息的 ProcessStatus 均为 COMPLETED 时，插入视为完成。
A_WIPLot.isCompleted.en: i) The flag indicating whether the insertion is completed. ii) Insertion is considered completed when all WIP Lot Details' ProcessStatus are COMPLETED.

A_WIPLot.isLastInsertion.zh: i) 默认为 false。ii) 最后一个插入编号将此标志设置为 true。iii) 最后一个插入编号将是批次移出时的插入。
A_WIPLot.isLastInsertion.en: i) The default is false. ii) The last insertion number will have this flag set to true. iii) The last insertion number will be the insertion when the lot is moved out.

A_WIPLot.isWaferProcessing.zh: 指示 WIP 规范是否使用晶圆进行跟踪的标志。如果此标志设置为 true，则所有加工都必须使用容器和晶圆刻号进行。
A_WIPLot.isWaferProcessing.en: Flag indicating whether the WIP Spec is tracked using wafers. If this flag is set to true all processing must be done using Container and Wafer Scribe Number.

A_WIPLot.lastMoveOutTimestamp.en: Stores the last move out timestamp.

A_WIPLot.lastMoveOutUsername.en: Stores the last move out username.

A_WIPLot.maxInsertion.zh: i) 允许的最大插入数。ii) 此值从工序属性复制。iii) 主要目的是允许用户覆盖工序属性中设置的默认值。iv) 此值将复制到后续插入
A_WIPLot.maxInsertion.en: i) The maximum allowable insertion. ii) This value is copied over from the operation attributes. iii) Main purpose is to allow the user to overwrite the default value setup in the operation attributes. iv) This value will be copied over to subsequent i

A_WIPLot.moveInQty.zh: i) 第一次插入生成时的批次数量。ii) 此值将复制到后续插入。
A_WIPLot.moveInQty.en: i) The lot quantity when the 1st insertion was generated. ii) This value will be copied over to subsequent insertions.

A_WIPLot.moveInQty2.zh: i) 第一次插入生成时的批次数量。ii) 此值将复制到后续插入。
A_WIPLot.moveInQty2.en: i) The lot quantity when the 1st insertion was generated. ii) This value will be copied over to subsequent insertions.

A_WIPLot.moveInTimestamp.zh: i) 第一次插入生成时的时间戳。
A_WIPLot.moveInTimestamp.en: i) The timestamp when the 1st insertion was generated.

A_WIPLot.moveInUsername.zh: 执行 MoveInLot 事务的用户名。
A_WIPLot.moveInUsername.en: The username that did the MoveInLot transaction.

A_WIPLot.moveOutEmployeeName.en: i) The move out employee name.

A_WIPLot.moveOutQty.zh: i) 批次在本次插入中的最终移出数量。
A_WIPLot.moveOutQty.en: i) The final move out quantity for the lot for the insertion.

A_WIPLot.moveOutQty2.zh: i) 批次在本次插入中的最终移出数量。
A_WIPLot.moveOutQty2.en: i) The final move out quantity for the lot for the insertion.

A_WIPLot.previousWipLotLink.zh: 存储上一个 WIP 批次对象引用。
A_WIPLot.previousWipLotLink.en: Stores the Previous WIP Lot object reference.

A_WIPLot.processSpecDetailsItem.zh: 存储用于设置 WIP 数据的工序规范详细信息项。
A_WIPLot.processSpecDetailsItem.en: Stores the Process Spec Details item used to set the WIP data.

A_WIPLot.processTypesRequired.zh: 存储加工所需的工序类型数。
A_WIPLot.processTypesRequired.en: Stores the number of Process Types required for Processing.

A_WIPLot.requireTrackInQty.zh: i) 指示是否需要跟踪进数量的标志。ii) 此值从工序属性复制。iii) 此字段的主要目的是确保一旦加工开始，更改工序属性不会
A_WIPLot.requireTrackInQty.en: i) The flag indicating whether the track in quantity is required. ii) This value is copied over from the operation attributes. iii) The main purpose of this field is to ensure that once processing has started, changing the operation attributes will not

A_WIPLot.scheduleMoveDataWasSet.zh: 指示是否设置了计划移出数据的标志。如果已设置，则 ScheduleMoveData 将不会更新。
A_WIPLot.scheduleMoveDataWasSet.en: Flag indicating whether the Schedule Move Data was set. If so, the ScheduleMoveData will not be updated.

A_WIPLot.scsCreationTimestampGmt.zh: i) 创建插入时的 GMT 时间戳。
A_WIPLot.scsCreationTimestampGmt.en: i) The timestamp when the insertion was created in GMT.

A_WIPLot.scsForceYieldCheck.zh: 指示执行产率检查的字段。
A_WIPLot.scsForceYieldCheck.en: Field indicate to perform yield check.

A_WIPLot.secondHalfRejectQty.zh: i) 这是一个数据收集字段，用户在实际第二次运行引线检查期间输入。ii) 此值将复制到后续插入。
A_WIPLot.secondHalfRejectQty.en: i) This is a data collection field where the user enters during the physical 2nd run lead inspection. ii) This value will be copied over to subsequent insertions.

A_WIPLot.spec.zh: 规范（Spec）描述了在工作流中的步骤处进行的处理。它引用了许多其他建模组件，包括工序、设置、数据收集定义和资源。规范还包括详细的调度和...
A_WIPLot.spec.en: A specification (Spec) describes the processing that takes place at a Step within a Workflow. It references many other Modeling components including an Operation, Setup, Data Collection Definitions and Resources. Specs also include detailed scheduling and

A_WIPLot.stepCount.zh: i) 批次到达此步骤的次数。
A_WIPLot.stepCount.en: i) The number of times the lot reached this step.

A_WIPLot.stepLogicName.zh: i) 检查限值类型的名称。
A_WIPLot.stepLogicName.en: i) The name for the check limits type.

A_WIPLot.totalBonusQty.zh: i) 通过奖励事务添加的总数量。ii) 此值将用于从产率计算中抵消。iii) 此值将复制到后续插入。
A_WIPLot.totalBonusQty.en: i) Total quantity added through the bonus transaction. ii) This value will be used to offset from the yield calculation. iii) This value will be copied over to subsequent insertions.

A_WIPLot.totalConsumedOutQty.zh: 本次插入中消耗到另一个批次的总数量。
A_WIPLot.totalConsumedOutQty.en: The total quantity consumed out to another lot for the insertion.

A_WIPLot.totalDefectQty.zh: 整个插入中无法产出的总拒绝数量。
A_WIPLot.totalDefectQty.en: Total reject quantity that cannot be yielded off for an entire insertion.

A_WIPLot.totalDummyQty.zh: i) 默认为 ProcessDummyQty 的总和。ii) 此值可能会更改，并将在移出期间复制到批次对象。
A_WIPLot.totalDummyQty.en: i) Default to the sum of ProcessDummyQty. ii) This value may change and will be copied to the Lot object during move out.

A_WIPLot.totalInProcessCombinedQty.zh: i) ProcessSplitQty 的总和。ii) 指加工中的合并数量。
A_WIPLot.totalInProcessCombinedQty.en: i) The sum of ProcessSplitQty. ii) Refers to the In-Process combine quantity.

A_WIPLot.totalInProcessSplitQty.zh: i) ProcessSplitQty 的总和。ii) 指加工中的拆分数量。
A_WIPLot.totalInProcessSplitQty.en: i) The sum of ProcessSplitQty. ii) Refers to the In-Process split quantity.

A_WIPLot.totalNumberOfStrips.zh: i) 默认为 ProcessNumberOfStrips 的总和。ii) 此值可能会更改，并将在移出期间复制到批次对象。
A_WIPLot.totalNumberOfStrips.en: i) Default to the sum of ProcessNumberOfStrips. ii) This value may change and will be copied to the Lot object during move out.

A_WIPLot.totalScrapRejectQty.zh: i) 使用批次拒绝执行的废品拒绝总数量。ii) 此值将用于从产率计算中抵消。iii) 每次临时拒绝被产出时，拒绝总数将在此处添加。iv) 此值将复制到后续插入
A_WIPLot.totalScrapRejectQty.en: i) Total Scrap reject quantity carried out using Lot Reject. ii) This value will be used to offset from the yield calculation. iii) Each time ad-hoc rejects are yielded off, the total rejects will be added here. iv) This value will be copied over to su

A_WIPLot.totalTrackOutQtyCombined.zh: 合并出的已加工总数量。
A_WIPLot.totalTrackOutQtyCombined.en: Total Processed Qty that was combined out.

A_WIPLot.totalTrackOutQtySplit.zh: 拆分出的已加工数量。该拆分数量取自 ProcessTrackOutQty。因此，记录的实际已加工数量将是 ProcessTrackOutQty 减去 ProcessTrackOutQtySplit。
A_WIPLot.totalTrackOutQtySplit.en: The Processed Qty that was split out. Such split quantity is taken from the ProcessTrackOutQty. Hence the actual Processed Qty for the record would be ProcessTrackOutQty minus ProcessTrackOutQtySplit.

A_WIPLot.totalYieldOffWaferQty.zh: 存储要产出的晶圆数量。
A_WIPLot.totalYieldOffWaferQty.en: Stores the number of wafers to yield off.

A_WIPLot.wipDataSpcFailureAction.zh: 整个插入中收集的所有 WIP 数据的总体 SPC 失败操作。
A_WIPLot.wipDataSpcFailureAction.en: Overall SPC Failure Action for all WIP Data collected in the entire insertion.

A_WIPLot.wipDataSpcResult.zh: 整个插入中收集的所有 WIP 数据的总体 SPC 结果。
A_WIPLot.wipDataSpcResult.en: Overall SPC Result for all WIP Data collected in the entire insertion.

A_WIPLot.wipStatus.zh: 指示当前 WIP 插入的状态。例如 ACTIVE、COMPLETED、PASS、FAIL、RELEASED 或 CANCELED。
A_WIPLot.wipStatus.en: Indicate the status of the current WIP insertion. E.g. ACTIVE, COMPLETED, PASS, FAIL, RELEASED or CANCELED.

A_WIPLot.wipTrackingGroupKey.zh: i) 用于将插入分组在一起的主系统键。ii) 此值将从创建第一次插入时的实例 ID 复制。iii) 此值将复制到后续插入。
A_WIPLot.wipTrackingGroupKey.en: i) The main system key used to group the insertions together. ii) This value will be copied from the instance id when the 1st insertion is created. iii) This value will be copied over to subsequent insertions.

A_WIPLot.wipType.zh: i) 说明所需的 WIP 跟踪类型。ii) 固定值：a. MOVE - 不需要设备跟踪。b. TRACK - 需要设备跟踪。
A_WIPLot.wipType.en: i) States the type of WIP tracking required. ii) Fixed values: a. MOVE - Equipment tracking is not required. b. TRACK - Equipment tracking is required.

A_WIPLot.wipYieldResult.zh: i) 指示整个批次通过或未通过产率的标志。ii) 如果批次未通过产率，则产率失败将添加到 WIP 批次失败中。iii) 固定值：a. NULL - 尚未计算。b. PASS - 所有产率检查通过。c.
A_WIPLot.wipYieldResult.en: i) The flag indicating whether the entire lot pass or fail the yield. ii) If the lot fails the yield, the yield failures will be added to the WIP Lot Failures. iii) Fixed values: a. NULL - Not calculated yet. b. PASS - All yield checks passed. c.

A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.bonusBackRejectQt.zh: i) 奖励退回拒绝数量。
A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.bonusBackRejectQt.en: i) The bonus back rejects quantity.

A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.defectQty.en: Reject quantity that cannot be yielded off.

A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.lossReasonName.zh: i) 损失原因名称。ii) 当记录插入或更新时，此值将自动从损失原因对象复制。
A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.lossReasonName.en: i) The loss reason name. ii) This value will be automatically copied over from the loss reason object when the record is inserted or updated.

A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.rejectCategory.zh: i) 在拒收记录期间定义拒收的类别。ii) 例如 a. INCIDENT - 事件案例 b. PROCESS - 过程相关 c. ESCAPEE - 逃逸 d. MATERIAL - 材料相关
A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.rejectCategory.en: i) Defines the category for a reject during Rejects Recording. ii) E.g. a. INCIDENT - Incident case b. PROCESS - Process related c. ESCAPEE - Escapee d. MATERIAL - Material related

A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.rejectCategoryNam.zh: i) 使用的拒绝类别用户代码名称。
A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.rejectCategoryNam.en: i) The name of the reject category user code used.

A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.rejectWholeSubPro.zh: 指示在物料上拒绝整个子产品部分的标志。
A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.rejectWholeSubPro.en: The flag to indicate rejects the whole sub-product section on the item

A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.scsChargeToResour.zh: Resource 描述工厂内的任何非物料实体。Resource 的常见用途（也是最具体的示例）是描述 Machine。Resource 与单个工厂相关联，以定义其物理位置。Resource 还属于 z
A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.scsChargeToResour.en: A Resource describes any non-material entity within a factory. The common use (and most concrete example) of a Resource is to describe a Machine. Resources are associated with a single factory, to define their physical location. Resources also belong to z

A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.txnTimeStamp.zh: i) 数据收集时的时间戳。
A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.txnTimeStamp.en: i) The timestamp when the data is collected.

A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.unidentifiableRej.zh: i) 无法识别的拒绝数量。

A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.username.en: i) The user who collected the data.

A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.waferRejectsAtBot.zh: 指示在晶圆左下象限是否发现废品的标志。
A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.waferRejectsAtBot.en: Flag indicating whether the Rejects are found at the Bottom Left quadrant of the wafer.

A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.waferRejectsAtBot.zh: 指示在晶圆右下象限是否发现废品的标志。
A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.waferRejectsAtBot.en: Flag indicating whether the Rejects are found at the Bottom Right quadrant of the wafer.

A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.waferRejectsAtCen.zh: 指示在晶圆中心是否发现废品的标志。
A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.waferRejectsAtCen.en: Flag indicating whether the Rejects are found at the Center of the wafer.

A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.waferRejectsAtTop.zh: 指示在晶圆左上象限是否发现废品的标志。
A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.waferRejectsAtTop.en: Flag indicating whether the Rejects are found at the Top Left quadrant of the wafer.

A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.waferRejectsAtTop.zh: 指示在晶圆右上象限是否发现废品的标志。
A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.waferRejectsAtTop.en: Flag indicating whether the Rejects are found at the Top Right quadrant of the wafer.

A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.waferRejectsQty.zh: 用于收集所发现废品价值单位的可选信息。
A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.waferRejectsQty.en: Optional information used to collect a unit of value for the rejects found.

A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.waferRejectsType.zh: 晶圆废品的类型。有效值：i) QUADRANT - 将更新 WaferRejectsAt*** 字段。ii) LOCATION - 将更新 WaferRejects*Location 字段。iii) WHOLE - 整个晶圆。因此上述字段将全部为0。
A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.waferRejectsType.en: The type of Wafer Rejects. Valid values: i) QUADRANT - WaferRejectsAt*** fields will be updated. ii) LOCATION - WaferRejects*Location fields will be updated. iii) WHOLE - The entire wafer. Hence the above fields will all be 0.

A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.waferRejectsXLoca.zh: 发现晶圆废品的 X 位置。
A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.waferRejectsXLoca.en: The X Location whether the wafer rejects were found.

A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.waferRejectsYLoca.zh: 发现晶圆废品的 Y 位置。
A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.waferRejectsYLoca.en: The Y Location whether the wafer rejects were found.

A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.waferRejectsZLoca.zh: 发现晶圆废品的 Z 位置。
A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.waferRejectsZLoca.en: The Z Location whether the wafer rejects were found.

A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.waferScribeNumber.en: The wafer scribe number that was tracked in.

A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.wipLotRejectsItem.zh: i) 用于在移出期间最终产出废品时链接 QtyHistoryDetails。
A_WIPLotRejectsHistory.wipLotRejectsItem.en: i) Used to link the QtyHistoryDetails when the rejects are finally yielded off during move out.

Activity.allowReassignment.en: 1 = To a user within the specified Role(s) 2 = To any user 3 = Reassignment not allowed

Activity.assignee.zh: 负责处理此对象的人员
Activity.assignee.en: The person responsible for the processing of this object

Activity.assigneeOption.zh: 受分配人选项的枚举：1 = 受分配人 2 = 所有者 3 = 协作者
Activity.assigneeOption.en: Enumeration for the Assignee Option: 1 = Assignee 2 = Owner 3 = Collaborator

Activity.assigneeRole.zh: 如果指定，流程对象的受分配人必须具有此角色，并且如果此对象是 ProcessModel 的一部分（相对于模板），该角色必须对 QualityObject 的组织有效。
Activity.assigneeRole.en: If specified, the assignee of a process object must have this role, and the role must be valid for the organization of the QualityObject if this object is part of a ProcessModel (versus a template).

Activity.autoComplete.zh: 如果设置此项，阶段将自动从“已完成”变为“已关闭”。
Activity.autoComplete.en: If this is set, the stage will go from Completed to Closed automatically.

Activity.autoCompleteFailure.zh: 标识 ProcessObject 的自动完成是否失败。此标志目前仅对 ProcessModel 实现。
Activity.autoCompleteFailure.en: Identifies whether AutoComplete failed for the ProcessObject. This flag is currently only implemented for the ProcessModel.

Activity.autoExecute.zh: 无需用户干预自动执行活动。
Activity.autoExecute.en: Automatically execute the activity without user intervention.

Activity.changeHistory.zh: 每个建模实体都包含 Change Status。它用于记录当前的变更（维护）状态（例如，特定 Product Definition 的维护正在进行中），并跟踪最后一次更改的人员和时间。这应该可扩展为随时间变化的完整历史记录。
Activity.changeHistory.en: Every modeling entity includes a Change Status. It is used to record the current Change (Maintenance) Status (i.e., maintenance is currently in progress for a specific Product Definition) and to track who made the last change and when. This should be extendible to a complete history over time.

Activity.checklist.zh: 检查表连接到流程对象或模板，并包含从检查表模板复制的条目。
Activity.checklist.en: Checklists are connected to process objects or templates and contain entries copied from Checklist Template.

Activity.completeBy.zh: 处理必须在 CompleteWithin 指定的时间范围内完成。处理开始时，会创建计划条目并设置此字段。
Activity.completeBy.en: Processing must be complete within the timeframe specified by CompleteWithin. Upon the start of processing, a schedule entry is created and this field is set.

Activity.completeByGmt.zh: 此功能必须完成的日期。
Activity.completeByGmt.en: The date by which this function must be completed.

Activity.completeWithinQty.zh: 此值将与 CompleteWithinUOM 相乘，以计算 CompleteWithin 字段值。
Activity.completeWithinQty.en: This value will be multiplied by the CompleteWithinUOM to calculate the CompleteWithin field value.

Activity.completeWithinUom.zh: 描述用于持续时间的不同度量 1=小时 24=天 168=周
Activity.completeWithinUom.en: Describes the different measurements used for a duration 1=Hour(s) 24=Day(s) 168=Week(s)

Activity.completionAttachments.zh: 活动完成时的文档附件
Activity.completionAttachments.en: Document Attachments for the activity completion

Activity.dataPointCollection.zh: 标识要为 ProcessObject 收集的数据点。数据点按组结构化，每个组内包含数据点列表。
Activity.dataPointCollection.en: Identifies the data points to collect for the ProcessObject. The data points are structured as groups, with lists of data points within each group.

Activity.defaultAssigneeInfo.zh: 如果受分配人信息具有默认值，则此值为 True。
Activity.defaultAssigneeInfo.en: The value is True if Assignee Info has default value.

Activity.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
Activity.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

Activity.documentSet.zh: 文档集是一个或多个文档的列表。大多数建模实体包含对文档集的引用。在此上下文中，文档用于提供扩展（非结构化）信息，例如产品图纸、扫描图像、相关的现有制造规范或操作程序。每个文档（CDO）实例包括外部文档的标识符（即文件名或URL）和对用于呈现文档的程序的引用。
Activity.documentSet.en: A Document Set is a list of one or more documents. Most Modeling entities include a reference to a Document Set. Documents are used in this context to provide extended (unstructured) information, such as product drawings, scanned images, relating existing manufacturing specifications, or operating procedures. Each instance of a Document (CDO) includes an identifier for the external document (i.e., a file name or a URL) and a reference to the program used for presenting the document.

Activity.firstRoutedOn.zh: ProcessObject 首次路由的日期。后续重新路由不会更改此字段。
Activity.firstRoutedOn.en: The date when the ProcessObject was first routed. Subsequent re-routings will not change this field.

Activity.firstRoutedOnGmt.zh: ProcessObject 首次路由的日期（GMT）。后续重新路由不会更改此字段。
Activity.firstRoutedOnGmt.en: The date (GMT) when the ProcessObject was first routed. Subsequent re-routings will not change this field.

Activity.lastCompletedBy.en: Identifies the employee credited with completing the ProcessObject.

Activity.lastCompletedOn.zh: 此 ProcessObject 上次完成/执行的日期。
Activity.lastCompletedOn.en: The date on which this ProcessObject was last completed/executed.

Activity.lastCompletedOnGmt.zh: 此 ProcessObject 上次完成/执行的日期（GMT）。

It is used to record the current Change (Maintenance) Status (i.e., maintenance is currently in progress for a specific Product Definition) and to track who made the last change and when. This should be extendible to a complete history over time.

BillOfProcessOverride.documentSet.zh: 对提供与此 BillOfProcess 覆盖处理相关的附加信息的文档的引用。此文档可在操作员请求时作为引用此 BillOfProcess 覆盖的服务的一部分显示。
BillOfProcessOverride.documentSet.en: Reference to a Document that provides additional information relating to processing with this BillOfProcess override. This Document may be displayed (upon Operator request) as part of a service that is referencing this BillOfProcess override.

BillOfProcessOverride.electronicProcedur.zh: 提供用于在 BillOfProcess 覆盖处执行一系列任务框架。
BillOfProcessOverride.electronicProcedur.en: Provides the framework for executing a series of Tasks at the BillOfProcess override.

BillOfProcessOverride.electronicProcedur.zh: 覆盖的电子程序基准版本 → ElectronicProcedureBase
BillOfProcessOverride.electronicProcedur.en: Overridden electronic procedure baseline version → ElectronicProcedureBase

BillOfProcessOverride.recipeFile.zh: 大多数建模实体包含对文档的引用。在此上下文中，文档用于提供扩展（非结构化）信息，例如产品图纸、扫描图像、相关的现有制造规范或操作程序。每个文档（CDO）实例包括外部文档的标识符（即文件名或URL）和对用于呈现文档的程序的引用。文档还用于定义要下载到机器的配方文件。在这种情况下，呈现文档意味着将其呈现（下载）给机器。
BillOfProcessOverride.recipeFile.en: Most Modeling entities include a reference to a document. Documents are used in this context to provide extended (unstructured) information, such as product drawings, scanned images, relating existing manufacturing specifications, or operating procedures. Each instance of a document (CDO) includes an identifier for the external document (i.e., a file name or a URL) and a reference to the program used for presenting the document. Documents are also used to define recipe files for downloading to machines. In this case, presenting the Document means presenting it (downloading it) to a machine.

BillOfProcessOverride.recipeFileBase.zh: 覆盖的配方文档基准版本 → DocumentBase
BillOfProcessOverride.recipeFileBase.en: Overridden recipe document baseline version → DocumentBase

BillOfProcessOverride.resourceGroup.zh: 对此 BillOfProcess 覆盖有效的资源列表
BillOfProcessOverride.resourceGroup.en: The list of resources that are valid for this BillOfProcess override

BillOfProcessOverride.setup.zh: 要与此 BillOfProcessOverride 一起使用的设置详情的引用。如果指定，则必须是有效的（已定义的）设置。
BillOfProcessOverride.setup.en: Reference to the Setup details to use with this BillOfProcessOverride. If specified, this must be a valid (defined) Setup.

BOM.billType.zh: 用于区分此清单结构的意图。同一产品可存在多个清单。根据使用清单的部门，清单可以处于更高或更低的分解级别。可添加并非制造过程物理部分的项目，以协助标准成本计算或人工报告。
BOM.billType.en: Used to distinguish the intent of this Bill structure. Several Bills can exist for the same product. Bills can be at higher or lower levels of resolution depending on the department that is using the Bill. Items that are not physically part of the manufacturing process can be added to assist standard costing calculations or labor reporting.

BOMMaterialListItem.adjustmentType.zh: 此字段定义调整的类型（例如百分比或数量）。所选类型决定如何解释和应用 AdjustmentValue 以进行自动调整计算。
BOMMaterialListItem.adjustmentType.en: This field defines the type of the adjustment (e.g. Percentage or Quantity). The chosen type determines how the AdjustmentValue is interpreted and applied for the auto-adjustment calculations.

BOMMaterialListItem.adjustmentValue.zh: 此字段定义用于自动调整计算的值，基于所选的调整类型。
BOMMaterialListItem.adjustmentValue.en: This field defines the value used for auto-adjustments calculations based on the chosen Adjustment Type.

BOMMaterialListItem.allowAllRevisionsAsS.zh: 为 true 时，将允许物料需求使用产品的所有修订版。
BOMMaterialListItem.allowAllRevisionsAsS.en: When true it will allow all revisions of the product to be allowed for the material requirement

BOMMaterialListItem.allowOverConsumption.zh: 此标志确定物料消耗检查是否允许发放多于 MaterialListItem 条目中指定的物料。
BOMMaterialListItem.allowOverConsumption.en: This flag determines if the material consumption check will allow more materials to be issued than specified in the MaterialListItem entry

BOMMaterialListItem.allowSubstitution.zh: 允许替代要发放的产品。
BOMMaterialListItem.allowSubstitution.en: Allow substitution of the product to be issued.

BOMMaterialListItem.allowUnderConsumptio.zh: 此标志确定物料消耗检查是否允许发放少于 MaterialListItem 条目中指定的物料。
BOMMaterialListItem.allowUnderConsumptio.en: This flag determines if the material consumption check will allow less materials to be issued than specified in the MaterialListItem entry

BOMMaterialListItem.assemblySequence.zh: 物料应被组装的顺序。仅当物料分配给步骤/规格时，此值才使用。
BOMMaterialListItem.assemblySequence.en: Sequence the item should be assembled. The value is only used if the item is assigned to a Step/Spec

BOMMaterialListItem.defaultLot.zh: 如果需要发放特定批次/批次的组件，这将指示要发放的批次/批次标识
BOMMaterialListItem.defaultLot.en: If a specific lot/batch of the component needs to be issued, this would indicate the lot/batch indicator to be issued

BOMMaterialListItem.defaultStockPoint.zh: 如果组件需要从库存系统内的特定位置拉取，这将指示该位置。
BOMMaterialListItem.defaultStockPoint.en: If the component needs to be pulled from a specific location within the Inventory System, this would indicate it.

BOMMaterialListItem.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
BOMMaterialListItem.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

BOMMaterialListItem.effectiveFromDate.zh: 如果指定，这是此需求变为可用的开始日期和时间。
BOMMaterialListItem.effectiveFromDate.en: If specified, this is the starting date and time when this Requirement becomes available.

BOMMaterialListItem.effectiveFromDateGmt.zh: 如果指定，这是此需求变为可用的开始日期和时间。
BOMMaterialListItem.effectiveFromDateGmt.en: If specified, this is the starting date and time when this Requirement becomes available.

BOMMaterialListItem.effectiveThruDate.zh: 如果指定，这是此需求不再可用的结束日期和时间。
BOMMaterialListItem.effectiveThruDate.en: If specified, this is the ending date and time when this Requirement becomes no longer available.

BOMMaterialListItem.effectiveThruDateGmt.zh: 如果指定，这是此需求不再可用的结束日期和时间。
BOMMaterialListItem.effectiveThruDateGmt.en: If specified, this is the ending date and time when this Requirement becomes no longer available.

BOMMaterialListItem.erpLineItem.zh: 指示来自 ERP 的 BOM 结构中唯一标识此行项目的行指示符
BOMMaterialListItem.erpLineItem.en: indicates the Line indicator within the BOM structure from the ERP that uniquely identifies this line item

BOMMaterialListItem.erpReportingFlag.zh: 用于指示此组件是否需要将实际数量报告回 ERP，或者 ERP 内部是否会发生反冲而不需要报告此数量。
BOMMaterialListItem.erpReportingFlag.en: Used to indicate if this component needs to have actual qty reported back to ERP or if a backflush will occur within the ERP that does not require this to be reported.

BOMMaterialListItem.isEnabled.zh: 根据状态和生效日期及截止日期确定是否应考虑处理 CDO。如果在 CDO 中未找到字段，则假定为肯定结果。
BOMMaterialListItem.isEnabled.en: Determines, based on Status and Effective From and Thru dates whether a CDO should be considered for processing. If a field is not found within the CDO, a positive result is assumed.

BOMMaterialListItem.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。
BOMMaterialListItem.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

BOMMaterialListItem.isImage.zh: 与物料列表项关联的图像
BOMMaterialListItem.isImage.en: Image associated to the material list item

BOMMaterialListItem.isPhantom.zh: 表示这是一个虚拟物料列表项。虚拟项不是实际物料，而是从 BOM 结构中的组件项分组中人为构造的，以减少 BOM 维护。
BOMMaterialListItem.isPhantom.en: Denotes this is a phantom material list item. Phantom items are not actual materials, but are artifical constructs added from grouping component items in a BOM structure to reduce BOM maintenance.

BOMMaterialListItem.isSourceProduct.zh: 指示是否应将产品用作构建目标产品的源物料的标志。
BOMMaterialListItem.isSourceProduct.en: Flag indicating whether the Product should be used as the source material to build the target Product.

BOMMaterialListItem.issueControl.zh: 1 - 容器在 InSite 中以序列级别跟踪 2 - 容器在 InSite 中以批量级别跟踪 3 - 容器不在 InSite 中跟踪...记录数量和批次 4 - 非批次控制（现场库存）记录位置无容器 5 - 记录数量但不记录容器或位置 6 - 发放数量显示但不记录
BOMMaterialListItem.issueControl.en: 1 - Container is tracked in InSite at the serial level 2 - Container is tracked in InSite at the bulk level 3 - Container is not tracked in InSite ... quantity and lot is recorded 4 - non lot controlled ( floor stock ) location is recorded no container 5 - recording quantities but not container or location 6 - issue quantities are displayed but not recorded

BOMMaterialListItem.name.zh: 名称子实体的唯一名称。
BOMMaterialListItem.name.en: Unique name for the name subentity.

BOMMaterialListItem.parentRevision.zh: 修订版本（在基础实体上下文中唯一）
BOMMaterialListItem.parentRevision.en: Revision (unique within the context of the base entity)

BOMMaterialListItem.phantomBill.zh: 物料清单定义了生产特定产品所需的物料。虚拟 BOM 是不存在实际装配的产品的物料清单，仅用于保存一组相关组件。当这种逻辑组件分组用于许多成品时，创建虚拟 BOM 以减少维护工作，这样逻辑组件组的维护可以在一处完成。注意物料列表项上直接引用的虚拟 BOM 通常只是指向与物料列表项关联的产品定义的 BOM 的指针。
BOMMaterialListItem.phantomBill.en: A bill of material defines the materials needed to produce a specific product. A Phantom Bill is a bill of material for a product that does not exist as an actual assembly, but is created only for the purpose of holding a group of related components. A phantom bill is created to reduce maintenance efforts, when such a logical grouping of components is used for many finished products, so that the maintenance of the logical group of components can be done in one place only. Note the Phantom Bill referenced on the material list item directly will ordinarily just be a pointer to a bill defined as part of the associated Product referenced by the material list item.

BOMMaterialListItem.producingOrder.zh: 最长 255 个字符的字符串字段。

BOMMaterialListItem.qty2Required.zh: 如果跟踪多个数量，则此组件项所需的数量。
BOMMaterialListItem.qty2Required.en: Quantity of this component item required, if multiple quantities are being tracked.

BOMMaterialListItem.qtyIssued.zh: 已为该物料发放的材料数量（单独）
BOMMaterialListItem.qtyIssued.en: Material quantity (individual) that has been issued for the item

BOMMaterialListItem.qtyRequired.en: Quantity of this component item required.

BOMMaterialListItem.referenceDesignator.zh: 此物料放置在装配体上或内部的特定位置。
BOMMaterialListItem.referenceDesignator.en: The specific position on or in the assembly where this item is placed.

BOMMaterialListItem.routeStep.zh: ERP 工艺路线中的步骤，是与 InSite 工作流最接近的 ERP 概念。ERP 工艺路线步骤通常定义在比 InSite 工作流步骤更汇总的级别。
BOMMaterialListItem.routeStep.en: A step in an ERPRoute, which is the closest ERP concept to an InSite workflow. ERP Route Steps are usually defined at a more summarized level than InSite workflow steps.

CalendarShift.calendarDate.zh: 工厂通常有班次安排，导致一个班次在一个日期开始工作并在另一个日期结束；其中午夜12点位于班次中间。对于这些工厂，通常有“制造日期”的概念，使任何特定班次完全落在一个特定的制造日内。一个班次从早上7点、下午3点和晚上11点开始的工厂，通常其“制造日期”从上一天的晚上11点开始，到当天的晚上11点结束。
CalendarShift.calendarDate.en: Factories often have shift schedules that result in a shift starting work on one date and ending on another date; where 12 midnight is in the middle of the shift. For these factories, it is normal to have a concept of "Manufacturing Date" that enables any particular shift to fall entirely on one particular manufacturing day. A factory with shifts that start at 7am, 3pm, and 11pm will normally have a "Manufacturing Date" that begins on 11pm of the previous clock date, and ends at 11pm of the current clock date.

CalendarShift.fiscalMonth.zh: 描述如何将制造日期分组为会计期间（通常是年、季度、月和星期）的会计信息。
CalendarShift.fiscalMonth.en: Accounting information that describes how to group manufacturing dates into accounting periods (typically Year, Quarter, Month, and Week).

CalendarShift.fiscalQuarter.zh: 描述如何将制造日期分组为会计期间（通常是年、季度、月和星期）的会计信息
CalendarShift.fiscalQuarter.en: Accounting information that describes how to group manufacturing dates into accounting periods (typically Year, Quarter, Month, and Week)

CalendarShift.fiscalYear.zh: 描述如何将制造日期分组为会计期间（通常是年、季度、月和星期）的会计信息。
CalendarShift.fiscalYear.en: Accounting information that describes how to group manufacturing dates into accounting periods (typically Year, Quarter, Month, and Week).

CalendarShift.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

CalendarShift.shift.zh: 通常适用于制造公司，这些公司的区域在一天中配备人员的时间足够长，以至于工人不会都在同一时间开始和结束一天的工作。班次是一种基于管理责任对生产信息进行分组的机制，管理责任针对在特定时间开始和离开的工人。例如，“白班”可能从早上 6 点到下午 6 点工作，“夜班”则从下午 6 点到早上 6 点工作。
CalendarShift.shift.en: Typically applies to manufacturing companies that have areas staffed for a long enough during a day that workers do not all start and end their day at the same time. Shift is a mechanism for grouping production information based on management responsibilities for workers that start and leave at a particular time. For example, the "Day" shift might work from 6am to 6pm, and the "Night" shift would work from 6pm to 6am.

CalendarShift.shiftEnd.en: The end time of the shift.

CalendarShift.shiftStart.en: The start time of the shift.

CalendarShift.team.zh: 将生产信息分组到“班次”的另一种方式。例如，计划在周一至周四工作的“白班”和“夜班”可分配给“Red”团队，而在周五至周日工作的白班和夜班则分配给“Blues”团队。
CalendarShift.team.en: An alternate means of grouping production information to "shift". For example, "day" and "night" shifts that are schedule to work on Monday-Thursday might be assigned to team "Red", while day and night shifts that work Friday-Sunday would be assigned to team "Blues".

CAPA.closedBy.zh: 员工（Employee）是可以登录InSite、执行事务和/或获得工作积分的人员。员工必须具有Windows NT帐户。定义后，该用户将出现在Modeler Security窗口的用户列表中。这样，员工定义直接进入Modeler Security。员工定义还允许为每个用户设置其他选项，例如与用户关联的工厂和将使用的语言。将通过事务中的员工字段获得工作积分的人员必须作为InSite员工存在，但不需要作为Windows用户帐户存在。
CAPA.closedBy.en: An Employee is a person that can login to InSite, perform transactions, and/or be credited with work. The Employees must have a Windows NT account. Once defined, the user will then appear in the user list within the Modeler Security window. In this way the Employee definition feeds directly into the Modeler Security. The Employee definitions also allow for other options for each user such as the factory associate with the user and the language that will be used. Persons that will get credited with work by being entered in the employee field on a transaction, must exist as InSite employees, but are not required to exist as Windows user accounts.

CategoryMap.owner.zh: 员工（Employee）是可以登录InSite、执行事务和/或获得工作积分的人员。员工必须具有Windows NT帐户。定义后，该用户将出现在Modeler Security窗口的用户列表中。这样，员工定义直接进入Modeler Security。员工定义还允许为每个用户设置其他选项，例如与用户关联的工厂和将使用的语言。将通过事务中的员工字段获得工作积分的人员必须作为InSite员工存在，但不需要作为Windows用户帐户存在。
CategoryMap.owner.en: An Employee is a person that can login to InSite, perform transactions, and/or be credited with work. The Employees must have a Windows NT account. Once defined, the user will then appear in the user list within the Modeler Security window. In this way the Employee definition feeds directly into the Modeler Security. The Employee definitions also allow for other options for each user such as the factory associate with the user and the language that will be used. Persons that will get credited with work by being entered in the employee field on a transaction, must exist as InSite employees, but are not required to exist as Windows user accounts.

CombineHistoryDetail.combineAllQty.zh: 记录是否合并了 FromContainer 的全部数量。
CombineHistoryDetail.combineAllQty.en: Records if the entire amount of the FromContainer was combined.

CombineHistoryDetail.containerClosed.en: Indicates if the container is closed or not.

CombineHistoryDetail.fromContainer.zh: 执行合并事务的 FromContainer 的 ID。
CombineHistoryDetail.fromContainer.en: The ID of the FromContainer that the combine transaction was performed against.

CombineHistoryDetail.integrationTxn.zh: 在复合/容器/资源事务后插入 TxnId 与历史主线。
CombineHistoryDetail.integrationTxn.en: Inserts the TxnId after a compound/container/resource transaction with history mainline.

CombineHistoryDetail.qty.zh: 在合并事务期间从 FromContainer 移除的物料数量。
CombineHistoryDetail.qty.en: The amount of material that was removed from the FromContainer during the combine transaction.

CombineHistoryDetail.qty2.zh: 在合并事务期间使用与数量字段不同的计量单位从 FromContainer 移除的物料数量。
CombineHistoryDetail.qty2.en: The amount of material that was removed from the FromContainer during the combine transaction using a different unit of measure than the Qty Field.

CommentType.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
CommentType.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

CommentType.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
CommentType.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

CommentType.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。
CommentType.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions).

CommentType.notes.zh: 与此对象关联的注释和评论。
CommentType.notes.en: Notations and comments associated with this object.

CommentType.setupAccess.zh: 用于验证用户对特定建模记录的访问权限。必须首先将一个或多个 Setup Access 分配给 Role。每个建模记录将有一个 Setup Access。当建模记录被事务处理时，系统将比较其 Setup Access。
CommentType.setupAccess.en: This is used to verify the user's access to a particular modeling record. One or more Setup Access must first be assigned to a Role. Each modeling record will have one Setup Access. When a modeling record in transacted the system will compare its Setup Ac

CompDefectReasonGroup.entryType.zh: 条目类型名称，固定为 ComponentDefectReason
CompDefectReasonGroup.entryType.en: Entry Type Name, fixed as ComponentDefectReason

CompDefectReasonGroup.name.zh: 组件缺陷原因组名称（必填）

ComponentDefectHistoryDetail.actualCompo.zh: 如果缺陷应用于 BOM 组件，则指向该组件的 IssueHistory 记录。从而可以访问所有组件字段。
ComponentDefectHistoryDetail.actualCompo.en: If the defect is applied against a BOM Component , this points to the IssueHistory record for that component. Thus giving access to all Component fields

ComponentDefectHistoryDetail.container.en: The container where the defect was found.

ComponentDefectHistoryDetail.defectCount.zh: 为指定原因发现的缺陷数量。
ComponentDefectHistoryDetail.defectCount.en: The number of defects found for the specified reason.

ComponentDefectHistoryDetail.integration.zh: 在复合/容器/资源事务后插入 TxnId 与历史主线。
ComponentDefectHistoryDetail.integration.en: Inserts the TxnId after a compound/container/resource transaction with history mainline.

ComponentDefectHistoryDetail.product.zh: 具有此缺陷的组件的产品。
ComponentDefectHistoryDetail.product.en: The product of the component which had this defect.

ComponentDefectHistoryDetail.reasonCode.zh: 指示此缺陷分类的用户代码。
ComponentDefectHistoryDetail.reasonCode.en: A UserCode indicating the classification of this defect.

ComponentDefectHistoryDetail.referenceDe.zh: 移除该组件的位置或放置处。
ComponentDefectHistoryDetail.referenceDe.en: The position or placement from which this componenent was removed

ComponentDefectHistoryDetail.vendorItem.zh: 所需组件的供应商名称
ComponentDefectHistoryDetail.vendorItem.en: The vendor name of the required component

ComponentDefectReason.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
ComponentDefectReason.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

ComponentDefectReason.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
ComponentDefectReason.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

ComponentDefectReason.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。
ComponentDefectReason.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions).

ComponentDefectReason.notes.zh: 与此对象关联的注释和评论。
ComponentDefectReason.notes.en: Notations and comments associated with this object.

ComponentDefectReason.setupAccess.zh: 用于验证用户对特定建模记录的访问权限。必须首先将一个或多个 Setup Access 分配给 Role。每个建模记录将有一个 Setup Access。当建模记录被事务处理时，系统将比较其 Setup Access。
ComponentDefectReason.setupAccess.en: This is used to verify the user's access to a particular modeling record. One or more Setup Access must first be assigned to a Role. Each modeling record will have one Setup Access. When a modeling record in transacted the system will compare its Setup Ac

ComponentReplaceHistoryDetail.hvRemovalD.zh: 通过 HVComponentIssue 发放的组件的移除详细信息。
ComponentReplaceHistoryDetail.hvRemovalD.en: Removal details for components issued via HVComponentIssue

ComponentReplaceHistoryDetail.issueDetai.zh: 记录特定组件发放需求的详细信息以及实际值的摘要。
ComponentReplaceHistoryDetail.issueDetai.en: Records the requirement details for a particular Component issue requirement, along with a summary of the actuals.

ComponentReplaceHistoryDetail.parent.zh: 包含此 CDO 的 CDO 的 Id。
ComponentReplaceHistoryDetail.parent.en: Id of the CDO containing this CDO.

ComponentReplaceHistoryDetail.removalDet.zh: 记录从在制品容器中移除组件的详细信息。
ComponentReplaceHistoryDetail.removalDet.en: Records the details of the removal of components from a WIP container

ComponentReplaceHistoryDetail.substituti.zh: 记录实际使用的产品与指定使用的产品不同的原因。
ComponentReplaceHistoryDetail.substituti.en: Records the reason that the product actually used differed from the product specified for use.

Computation.attributeName.en: A unique name for an attribute of a object.

Computation.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
Computation.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

Computation.displayLimits.zh: 控制是否在运行时向最终用户显示界限。
Computation.displayLimits.en: Controls whether the limits are displayed to the end user at run-time

Computation.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
Computation.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

Computation.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。
Computation.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions).

Computation.isLimitOverrideAllowed.zh: 标识界限验证是否可以被覆盖。覆盖界限违规是一种运行时操作，即使计算未能通过界限验证，也允许将其视为成功。
Computation.isLimitOverrideAllowed.en: Identifies whether the limit validation may be overridden. Overriding a limit violation is a runtime action that will allow a computation to be considered successful even if it fails the limit validation.

Computation.lowerLimit.zh: 此计算可接受值的下限。
Computation.lowerLimit.en: The lower limit of acceptable values for this computation.

Computation.notes.zh: 与此对象关联的注释和评论。
Computation.notes.en: Notations and comments associated with this object.

Computation.roundingRule.zh: 1 = 向下舍入 2 = 向上舍入 3 = 四舍五入
Computation.roundingRule.en: 1 = Round Down (Floor) 2 = Round Up (Ceiling) 3 = Round to Nearest

Computation.setupAccess.zh: 用于验证用户对特定建模记录的访问权限。必须首先将一个或多个 Setup Access 分配给 Role。每个建模记录将有一个 Setup Access。当建模记录被事务处理时，系统将比较其 Setup Access。
Computation.setupAccess.en: This is used to verify the user's access to a particular modeling record. One or more Setup Access must first be assigned to a Role. Each modeling record will have one Setup Access. When a modeling record in transacted the system will compare its Setup Ac

Computation.upperLimit.zh: 此计算可接受值的上限。
Computation.upperLimit.en: The upper limit of acceptable values for this computation.

ComputationParamSpec.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。
ComputationParamSpec.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

ComputationParamSpec.name.zh: 名称子实体的唯一名称。
ComputationParamSpec.name.en: Unique name for the name subentity.

ComputationParamSpec.parent.zh: 包含此 CDO 的 CDO 的 Id。
ComputationParamSpec.parent.en: Id of the CDO containing this CDO.

Container.billOfProcess.zh: 工艺清单（Bill Of Process）用于指定对规范（spec）的覆盖，并分配给容器、制造订单或产品。
Container.billOfProcess.en: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Container.bom.zh: 物料清单（BOM）定义了生产特定产品所需的物料。
Container.bom.en: A bill of material defines the materials needed to produce a specific product.

Container.childCount.zh: 此容器的直接子级数量。
Container.childCount.en: A count of the direct children of this container.

Container.consumingOrder.zh: 消耗订单是字符串字段。
Container.consumingOrder.en: Consuming Order is a String field

Container.containerComments.zh: 特定于此容器的评论或备注。
Container.containerComments.en: Comments or notes specific to this Container.

Container.currentHoldCount.zh: 从该容器开始并向下追踪其所有后代，容器结构中处于保留状态的容器数量计数。如果该容器本身当前直接处于保留状态，并且其 2 个子级也处于保留状态，则 CurrentHoldCount 将等于 3。
Container.currentHoldCount.en: Count of the number of containers on hold in the container structure starting at this container and tracing down through of all its descendants. If this container itself is currently directly on hold, and 2 of its children are also on hold, the CurrentHoldCount would equal 3.

Container.currentStatus.zh: 当前状态 CDO 包含一个或多个容器的当前位置信息。每个容器将引用单个当前状态 CDO。
Container.currentStatus.en: The Current Status CDO contains the current location information for one or more containers. Each container will have a reference to a single Current Status CDO.

Container.currentThruputChildCount.zh: 这是在当前步骤已处理的子容器数量。
Container.currentThruputChildCount.en: This is the number of child containers that have been processed at the current step.

Container.currentThruputQty.zh: 这是在当前步骤已处理的物料数量。
Container.currentThruputQty.en: This is the quantity of the material that has been processed at the current step.

Container.currentThruputQty2.zh: 这是在当前步骤已处理的物料的 quantity2。
Container.currentThruputQty2.en: This is the quantity2 of the material that has been processed at the current step.

Container.currentThruputUnitCount.zh: 这是在此步骤已处理的单位数量。
Container.currentThruputUnitCount.en: This is the number of Units that have been processed at this step.

Container.customer.zh: 如果指定，此字段是对此容器所属客户的引用。用于按客户查询提供在制品状态。
Container.customer.en: If specified, this field is a reference to the Customer to which this Container belongs. This is used to provide WIP Status by Customer inquiries.

Container.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
Container.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

Container.detail.zh: 容器 CDO 的详细信息对象。目的是让最终用户扩展详细信息对象，而不是扩展容器对象本身。
Container.detail.en: A detail object of the container CDO. The intent is that the end user extends the detail object instead of extending the container object itself.

Container.direction.zh: 指定物料安装在机器上的方向 - 0、90、180 等
Container.direction.en: Specifies the direction the material is mounted on a machine - 0, 90, 180, etc

Container.dueDate.zh: 此容器计划完成的日期和时间。用于与预计完成时间进行绩效报告。
Container.dueDate.en: Date and time by which this Container is scheduled to complete. This is used with projected completion time for performance reporting

Container.dueDateGmt.zh: 此容器计划完成的日期和时间。用于与预计完成时间进行绩效报告。
Container.dueDateGmt.en: Date and time by which this Container is scheduled to complete. This is used with projected completion time for performance reporting

Container.expirationDate.zh: 在此日期/时间之后，容器不再被视为一等质量。
Container.expirationDate.en: The date/time after which the Container is no longer considered first quality.

Container.factoryStartDate.zh: 此容器到达当前工厂或在该工厂创建的日期和时间。
Container.factoryStartDate.en: Date and time when this container arrived at or was created in the current factory.

Container.factoryStartDateGmt.zh: 此容器到达当前工厂或在该工厂创建的日期和时间。
Container.factoryStartDateGmt.en: Date and time when this container arrived at or was created in the current factory.

Container.factoryStartQty.zh: 此容器到达当前工厂或在该工厂创建时的数量。
Container.factoryStartQty.en: Quantity for this Container when it arrived at or was created in the current factory.

Container.factoryStartQty2.zh: 此容器到达当前工厂或在该工厂创建时的数量。
Container.factoryStartQty2.en: Quantity for this Container when it arrived at or was created in the current factory.

Container.factoryStartUom.zh: 此容器到达当前工厂或在该工厂创建时的计量单位。
Container.factoryStartUom.en: The UOM for the container when it arrived at or was created in the current factory.

Container.factoryStartUom2.zh: 此容器到达当前工厂或在该工厂创建时的计量单位。
Container.factoryStartUom2.en: The UOM for the container when it arrived at or was created in the current factory.

Container.holdMessage.zh: 如果指定，要显示的保留消息。
Container.holdMessage.en: Hold Message to be displayed if specified

Container.holdReason.zh: 容器可以被置于“保留”状态以防止进一步工作（针对该容器）。如果指定，此字段是标识容器为何被保留的原因代码。
Container.holdReason.en: A Container can be placed on "Hold" for the purpose of preventing additional work (for that Container). If specified, this field is the reason code identifying why the Container is Held.

Container.inQualityControl.zh: 此标志设置为改进报告并防止受影响产品的发运。
Container.inQualityControl.en: This flag set to improve reporting and prevent shipping of affected product.

Container.issuedToContainer.zh: 此容器作为组件发放到的容器。
Container.issuedToContainer.en: The container to which this container was issued as a component.

Container.lastActivityDate.zh: 此特定容器的上次事务的日期和时间。对父级执行事务时不更改此值。
Container.lastActivityDate.en: Date and time for the last transaction for this specific Container. This is not changed when a transaction is executed against the parent.

Container.lastActivityDateGmt.zh: 此容器的上次事务的日期和时间。对父级执行事务时不更改此值。
Container.lastActivityDateGmt.en: Date and time for the last transaction for this Container. This is not changed when a transaction is executed against the parent.

Container.lastCarrier.zh: 上次载具字段是对上次载具实例的引用。
Container.lastCarrier.en: Last Carrier field is a reference to last Carrier instance.

Container.lastCompletionDate.zh: 上次为此容器记录吞吐量的日期和时间。
Container.lastCompletionDate.en: Date and time that thruput was last recorded for this Container.

Container.lastCompletionDateGmt.zh: 上次为此容器记录吞吐量的日期和时间。
Container.lastCompletionDateGmt.en: Date and time that thruput was last recorded for this Container.

Container.lastIntegrationTxn.en: The Last Integration Txn for the container.

Container.level.zh: 标识此容器的跟踪级别。此值在创建容器时设置，可能（不应该？）被更改。
Container.level.en: Identifies the tracking level for this container. This value is set when the Container is created and may not (should not?) be changed.

Container.mfgOrder.zh: 对此容器所属制造订单的引用。用于按制造订单提供在制品状态，并作为与 ERP 系统集成的接口信息。
Container.mfgOrder.en: Reference to the Manufacturing Order to which this Container belongs. This is used to provide WIP Status by Manufacturing Order and as interface information for integration with an ERP system.

Container.moveInQty.zh: i) 存储批次进入步骤时的数量。ii) 此数量将用于插入到移动事务中以指示进入数量。
Container.moveInQty.en: i) Stores the quantity when the lot moves into a step. ii) This quantity will be used to insert into the move transaction to indicate the in quantity.

Container.moveInQty2.zh: i) 存储批次进入步骤时的 quantity 2。ii) 此数量将用于插入到移动事务中以指示进入数量。
Container.moveInQty2.en: i) Stores the quantity 2 when the lot moves into a step. ii) This quantity will be used to insert into the move transaction to indicate the in quantity.

Container.name.zh: 此容器的名称。容器级别定义用于确定此值是否必须唯一。
Container.name.en: Name for this Container. Container level definition is used to determine if this value must be unique.

Container.onHoldDate.zh: 容器在 CurrentHoldCount = 0 时被置于保留状态的日期和时间。换句话说，容器从“未保留”状态变为“保留”状态的日期/时间。
Container.onHoldDate.en: The date and time the container was put on hold when the CurrentHoldCount = 0. In other words, then date/time the container changed from a status of "not held" to "held".

Container.originalContainer.zh: 对此容器来源容器的引用。仅当此容器由拆分类型事务创建时，此值才不同于当前容器 ID。
Container.originalContainer.en: Reference to the Container from which this Container originated. This will only be different from the current Container Id if this Container was created by a Split-type transaction.

Container.originalFactory.zh: 对此容器来源工厂（创建或拆分到事务）的引用。
Container.originalFactory.en: Reference to the Factory where this Container originated (Create or Split-to transaction).

Container.originalStartDate.zh: 此容器产生（开始或拆分到事务）的日期和时间。
Container.originalStartDate.en: Date and time when this Container originated (Start or Split-to transaction).

Container.originalStartDateGmt.zh: 此容器产生（开始或拆分到事务）的日期和时间。
Container.originalStartDateGmt.en: Date and time when this Container originated (Start or Split-to transaction).

Container.originalUom.zh: 容器最初创建时的计量单位。
Container.originalUom.en: The UOM for the container when it was originally created.

Container.originalUom2.zh: 容器最初创建时的计量单位。
Container.originalUom2.en: The UOM for the container when it was originally created.

Container.owner.zh: 对此容器所有者（代码）的引用。所有者用于选择和分组容器以进行报告。也可以为所有者代码定义在制品消息，这意味着它们适用于具有该所有者的所有容器。
Container.owner.en: Reference to the Owner (Code) for this Container. Owners are used to select and group Containers for reporting. WIP Messages can also be defined for an Owner Code, which means they apply to all Containers with that Owner.

Container.plannedProduct.zh: 标识此容器旨在生产的产品（特定修订版）。
Container.plannedProduct.en: Identifies the product (a specific revision) this Container is intended to produce.

Container.plannedQty.zh: 此容器旨在生产的产品（计划）数量。
Container.plannedQty.en: Quantity of Product (planned) this Container is intended to produce.

Container.plannedStartDate.zh: 计划在此容器上开始处理的日期。
Container.plannedStartDate.en: The date when processing is scheduled to commence on this container.

Container.plannedStartDateGmt.zh: 计划在此容器上开始处理的日期。
Container.plannedStartDateGmt.en: The date when processing is scheduled to commence on this container.

Container.product.zh: 此容器的当前产品（始终是产品的特定修订版）。
Container.product.en: Current product for this Container (this will always be a specific revision of a Product).

Container.productionComplete.zh: 将容器标记为已完成生产的标志。
Container.productionComplete.en: Flag to mark the container as having completed production.

Container.qty.zh: 容器中当前的物料数量。
Container.qty.en: Current quantity of material in the container.

Container.qty2.zh: 容器中当前的物料数量。
Container.qty2.en: Current quantity of material in the container.

Container.qualityStatusReason.zh: 容器缺陷原因的用户代码。
Container.qualityStatusReason.en: The user code for container defect reason.

Container.relativePriority.zh: 这是一个用于对容器进行排序以进行派工（接下来我处理什么？）的数值。有多种算法可以解析为单个数值。这（使用字段）是一种将算法与派工分开的简单方法。
Container.relativePriority.en: This is a numeric value that is used to sequence Containers for Dispatching (What do I work on next?). There are multiple algorithms that can be resolved to a single numeric value. This (use of a field) is a simple approach to dividing the algorithm from the Dispatching.

Container.remainingProcessTime.zh: 剩余处理时间值，用于 RPT 计算。
Container.remainingProcessTime.en: Remaining Process Time value, used for RPT calculation.

Container.requestDate.zh: 如果指定，此字段表示客户希望收到此容器（所代表的物料）的日期和时间。
Container.requestDate.en: If specified, this field represents the date and time when the Customer would like to receive (the material represented by) this Container.

Container.requestDateGmt.zh: 如果指定，此字段表示客户希望收到此容器（所代表的物料）的日期和时间。
Container.requestDateGmt.en: If specified, this field represents the date and time when the Customer would like to receive (the material represented by) this Container.

Container.salesOrder.zh: 这是一个可选字段，用于将此Container关联到特定销售订单。它提供了一种将WIP分配（和重新分配）到客户订单的机制。
Container.salesOrder.en: This is an optional field available for relating this Container to a specific Sales Order. This provides a mechanism for allocating (and re-allocating) WIP to customer orders.

Container.samplingLot.zh: 用于关联一组Container进行抽样。例如，入库检验批次中多个Container来自同一物料批次，收货时间不同但执行一次AQL抽样。
Container.samplingLot.en: Used to associate a group of containers for sampling. For example, an Incoming inspection lot where multiple containers are from the same lot of material, received at different times but has one AQL Sampling.

Container.samplingPassed.zh: 标识该Container的抽样结果。如果所有抽样测试通过则SamplingPassed为True；如果任一抽样测试失败则SamplingPassed为False。
Container.samplingPassed.en: Identifies the result of Sampling for the container. If All Sample Test Passed for this container then SamplingPassed = True. If one Sampling Test Failed then SamplingPassed = False

Container.samplingRequired.zh: 确定此Container是否需要抽样。值为true时需要抽样。
Container.samplingRequired.en: Determines if sampling is required for this container. Sampling is required when value is true

Container.shapeName.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
Container.shapeName.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

Container.spcChartSaveOptionsEnum.zh: 1.总是 - 自动创建并保存图表图像；2.失败时 - 仅当发生SPC失败时才创建并保存SPC图表图像；3.从不 - 从不生成SPC图表图像。
Container.spcChartSaveOptionsEnum.en: 1.Always - Automatically creates and saves the chart image 2.On Failure - Only creates and saves the SPC chart image if a SPC failure resulted 3.Never - never generates a SPC Chart image

Container.specStatus.zh: Spec状态用于管理Container在其当前Spec处理期间的状态。包括跟踪已完成的交易（如适用），并确定Container是否可以移动到另一个步骤（当前Spec处理已完成）。
Container.specStatus.en: A Spec Status is used to manage the status of a Container for the duration of processing against its current Spec. This includes tracking completed Transactions (when applicable), and determining if it is valid for the Container to Move to another Step (processing is completed for the current Spec).

Container.splitFrom.zh: 创建此Container的来源Container的引用。仅当此Container由Split类型交易创建时才有值。
Container.splitFrom.en: Reference to the Container from which this Container was created. This will only have a value if this Container was created by a Split-type transaction.

Container.startParentContainer.zh: 起始父Container字段是对初始父Container的引用。
Container.startParentContainer.en: Start Parent Container field is a reference to initial Parent Container.

Container.startReason.zh: 此Container的起始原因（代码）的引用。起始原因主要用于交易报告（基于交易历史）。也可以为起始原因代码定义WIP消息，这意味着它们适用于具有该起始原因的所有Container。
Container.startReason.en: Reference to the Start Reason (Code) for this Container. Start reasons are primarily used for transaction reporting (based on the transaction history). WIP Messages can also be defined for an Start Reason Code, which means they apply to all Containers with that Start Reason.

Container.status.zh: 此Container的当前状态。该值用于区分活动、已关闭和已删除的Container。有效值及含义：0=已删除，1=活动，2=已关闭，3=在途（已发运），4=已发放（组件）。已删除的Container是指所有交易（包括创建或拆分的交易）都已冲销。
Container.status.en: Current status of this Container. This value is used to distinguish between Containers that are active, closed and those that have been deleted. Valid values and their meanings are: 0 = Deleted 1 = Active 2 = Closed 3 = In Transit (shipped) 4 = Issued (component) A deleted Container is one where all of the transactions, including the Create (or Split-to) transaction have been reversed.

Container.supplyFromType.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
Container.supplyFromType.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

Container.thisContainerLost.zh: 指示此Container是否被ChangeQty交易标识为丢失（完全报废）。
Container.thisContainerLost.en: Indicates whether or not this container was indicated as lost (completely scrapped) by the ChangeQty transaction.

Container.thruputAdjustmentChildCount.en: Count of children adjusted during Thruput.

Container.thruputAdjustmentUnitCount.en: Count of units adjusted in Thruput.

Container.unitCount.en: The number of Unit containers in this container.

Container.vendorItem.zh: Vendor Items 是供应商销售的产品。此项目在 Product 中指定，对于采购产品，可以将产品关联到可购买该产品的来源列表。此外，在向容器发放组件时，可以指定用于满足组件需求的 VendorItem。
Container.vendorItem.en: Vendor Items are the products the vendor sells. This item is specified in the Product where, for purchased products, one can relate the product to a list of sources where the product can be purchased. In addition, when issuing components to a container, one can specify the VendorItem used to fulfill the component requirement.

Container.wipMsgDefMgr.zh: 包含用于处理Container的WIP消息和逻辑的WIPMsgDef CDO。
Container.wipMsgDefMgr.en: A WIPMsgDef CDO that contains WIP messages and logic to process for a container

ContainerAutoHoldReq.containerIdentifier.zh: 与Container比较的范围结束值。如果Container在范围内，将被保留。
ContainerAutoHoldReq.containerIdentifier.en: End value of range to compare with the Container. The Container will be hold if it is within the range values.

ContainerAutoHoldReq.containerIdentifier.zh: 与Container比较的范围起始值。如果Container在范围内，将被保留。
ContainerAutoHoldReq.containerIdentifier.en: Start value of range to compare with the Container. The Container will be hold if it is within the range values.

ContainerAutoHoldReq.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
ContainerAutoHoldReq.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

ContainerAutoHoldReq.expression.zh: 用于定义附加自定义逻辑的条件表达式，匹配时将保留Container。
ContainerAutoHoldReq.expression.en: Conditional Expression that is used to defined any additional custom logic that will be matched to hold the Container.

ContainerAutoHoldReq.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
ContainerAutoHoldReq.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

ContainerAutoHoldReq.mfgOrder.zh: 如果匹配，此MfgOrder的所有Container将被保留。
ContainerAutoHoldReq.mfgOrder.en: If matched, all Containers of this MfgOrder will be hold.

ContainerLevel.allowMove.en: Determines if a Container of this level can be the primary Container in a Move transaction. This is in contrast to being moved as a Child (or other descendent) of another Container.

ContainerLevel.uiPreference.en: UIPreference is a reference to a list of fields to be displayed in the Manufacturing Audit Trail application when Container history is returned for a Container.

ContainerStatusChangeHistory.integration.zh: 在复合/容器/资源事务后插入 TxnId 与历史主线。
ContainerStatusChangeHistory.integration.en: Inserts the TxnId after a compound/container/resource transaction with history mainline.

ContainerStatusChangeHistory.remoteCompl.zh: 在远程站点执行的交易的完成消息。系统在将“SuccessResponse”和“FailureResponse”服务发送回源站点之前设置。
ContainerStatusChangeHistory.remoteCompl.en: Completion message of the transaction executed on a remote site. Set by the system for "SuccessResponse" and "FailureResponse" services before they are sent back to originating site.

ContainerStatusChangeHistory.status.zh: 此Container的当前状态。该值用于区分活动、已关闭和已删除的Container。有效值及含义：0=已删除，1=活动，2=已关闭，3=在途（已发运），4=已发放（组件）。已删除的Container是指所有交易（包括创建或拆分的交易）都已冲销。

CurrentStatus.carrier.zh: 载体是容纳物料的物理实体，用于批处理。载体是类似容器、大桶、桶、托盘等的资源。
CurrentStatus.carrier.en: A carrier is a physical entity that holds material which is used in batch processing. Carriers are resources like: Vessels, Vats, drums, trays etc.

CurrentStatus.currentStepPass.zh: Container进入当前工作流步骤的已跟踪次数。
CurrentStatus.currentStepPass.en: The number of tracked times the Container has entered the Current Workflow Step.

CurrentStatus.factory.zh: 向应用程序描述工厂。工厂在企业内定义。用户被授权在工厂内执行工作（交易）。产品包括可以制造的工厂列表。工厂包含零个或多个位置。
CurrentStatus.factory.en: Describes a factory to the application. Factories are defined within an Enterprise. Users are authorized to perform work (Transactions) within Factories. Products include a list of the Factories where they can be manufactured. A Factory contains zero or more Locations.

CurrentStatus.inProcess.zh: 此字段确定在当前步骤是否已开始工作。用于区分正在处理的Container和排队中的Container。当Container首次“到达”步骤时，此值设置为false。有多个交易（移入、收集数据等）会将此值更改为True。
CurrentStatus.inProcess.en: This field determines whether or not work has been started at the current step. This is used to differentiate between Containers that are being processed and those that are In-Queue. This value is set to false when a Container first "arrives" at a Step. There are several transactions (Move-in, collect data, etc.) that change this value to True.

CurrentStatus.inQueueTime.zh: Container在队列中等待的时间量
CurrentStatus.inQueueTime.en: Amount of time container was waiting in queue

CurrentStatus.inRework.en: Whether the container is in rework.

CurrentStatus.initialRecipeList.en: This is the RecipeList used to start the MaterialContainer

CurrentStatus.lastCompletedTask.zh: 为此任务完成的最后一个任务。
CurrentStatus.lastCompletedTask.en: The last Task completed for the Task.

CurrentStatus.lastMoveDate.zh: 最后步骤变更或开始工作时的日期和时间。
CurrentStatus.lastMoveDate.en: The date and time of the last step change or when work was started.

CurrentStatus.lastMoveDateGmt.zh: 最后步骤变更或开始工作时的日期和时间。
CurrentStatus.lastMoveDateGmt.en: The date and time of the last step change or when work was started.

CurrentStatus.lastRevTxn.zh: 最后一个可冲销交易的ID

CurrentStatus.location.zh: 定义工厂内的物理位置。可以是定义整个工厂的单个位置，也可以是存放区域内每个箱体的单独位置。每个Container都包含一个Location属性，用于标识Container的物理位置并生成按位置统计的WIP等报告。
CurrentStatus.location.en: Defines a physical location within a Factory. This can be as high level as a single Location that defines the entire Factory or as specific as individual Locations for each bin within a holding area. Every Container includes a Location attribute. This is used to identify the physical location of the Container and produce reports such as WIP by Location.

CurrentStatus.loopPass.zh: Container移动后仍留在同一步骤的次数
CurrentStatus.loopPass.en: The number of times the container has moved and remained at the same step

CurrentStatus.resource.zh: 描述工厂内的任何非物料实体。Resource的常见用途（也是最具体的示例）是描述机器。Resource与单个工厂关联以定义其物理位置。Resource还属于零个或多个Resource Group以提供逻辑分组。Resource是静态（建模）实体。每个Resource可以有一个Resource Status条目，用于跟踪每个已定义状态类别的当前状态。应用程序附带三个特定的状态类别：生产、预防性维护和日志。生产用于确定生产可用性。预防性维护用于跟踪Resource的每个预防性维护的当前状态。日志用于提供记录自由格式注释以及可选分配预定义状态和原因代码的机制。客户可以定义其他日志类型状态类别，以多种用户定义的方式同时跟踪Resource状态。
CurrentStatus.resource.en: Describes any non-material entity within a factory. The common use (and most concrete example) of a Resource is to describe a Machine. Resources are associated with a single factory, to define their physical location. Resources also belong to zero or more Resource Groups, to provide a logical grouping. A Resource is a static (modeling) entity. Each Resource can have a Resource Status entry to track the current status for each Status Category defined. The application is delivered with three specific Status Categories. They are Production, Preventative Maintenance and Log. Production is used to determine availability for production. Preventative Maintenance is used to track the current status of each Preventative Maintenance for a Resource. Log is used to provide a mechanism for logging freeform comments and optionally assigning predefined status and reason codes. Customers can define additional Log-type Status Categories to concurrently track Resource status is multiple user-defined ways.

CurrentStatus.reworkTotalCount.en: Total number of times the container is reworked.

CurrentStatus.spec.zh: Container进入操作时步骤中指定的规格。
CurrentStatus.spec.en: The spec specified in the step when the container enterred the operation.

CurrentStatus.workstation.zh: Resource描述工厂内的任何非物料实体。Resource的常见用途（也是最具体的示例）是描述机器。Resource与单个工厂关联以定义其物理位置。Resource还属于零个或多个Resource Group以提供逻辑分组。Resource是静态（建模）实体。每个Resource可以有一个Resource Status条目，用于跟踪每个已定义状态类别的当前状态。应用程序附带三个特定的状态类别：生产、预防性维护和日志。生产用于确定生产可用性。预防性维护用于跟踪Resource的当前预防性维护状态。日志用于提供记录自由格式注释以及可选分配预定义状态和原因代码的机制。客户可以定义其他状态类别，以多种用户定义的方式同时跟踪Resource状态。
CurrentStatus.workstation.en: A Resource describes any non-material entity within a factory. The common use (and most concrete example) of a Resource is to describe a Machine. Resources are associated with a single factory, to define their physical location. Resources also belong to zero or more Resource Groups, to provide a logical grouping. A Resource is a static (modeling) entity. Each Resource can have a Resource Status entry to track the current status for each Status Category defined. The application is delivered with three specific Status Categories. They are Production, Preventative Maintenance and Log. Production is used to determine availability for production. Preventative Maintenance is used to track the current Preventative Maintenance status for a Resource. Log is used to provide a mechanism for logging freeform comments and optionally assigning predefined status and reason codes. Customers can define additional Status categories to concurrently track Resource status is multiple user-defined ways.

Customer.company.zh: 公司名称或其他标识客户的文本，因为客户名称在许多情况下是数字或其他ID类型字段。
Customer.company.en: Company Name, or other text identifying the customer, since customer name will in many cases be a number or other ID type of field.

Customer.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

Customer.wipMsgDefMgr.zh: 附加到建模实体实例，包含适用于该实体的消息。当被要求提供其WIP消息时，建模实体将要求其WIPMsgDefMgr提供已过滤的WIP消息列表，仅包含适用于当前情况（步骤、操作和标签）的消息。WIPMsgDefMgr将检查AllKey WIPMsgKey（如果指定，包含适用于所有步骤的消息），并遍历OperationKeys和LabelKeys列表中的条目，过滤找到的每条消息。
Customer.wipMsgDefMgr.en: Attached to an instance of a modeling entity, this contains the messages that apply to the entity. When asked to supply its WIP Messages, a modeling entity will ask its WIPMsgDefMgr to supply a list of WIP Messages that have been filtered to include only the messages that apply to the current circumstances (step, operation and label). The WIPMsgDefMgr will check the AllKey WIPMsgKey (which contains a message that applies to all steps) if specified, and run through the entries in the OperationKeys and LabelKeys lists and filter each message found.

CustomerContact.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

CustomerContact.name.en: Unique name for the name subentity.

CustomerContact.primaryContact.zh: 标识联系人是否为主要联系人。只有一个联系人应被标记为主要联系人。
CustomerContact.primaryContact.en: Identifies whether the Contact is the primary contact. Only one Contact should be marked as the primary contact.

CycleTimeGate.description.zh: 此门禁的描述。如果未指定，则默认为此门禁的名称。
CycleTimeGate.description.en: Description of this Gate. Defaults to the name of this Gate if not specified

CycleTimeGate.entryType.zh: 标识触发进入门禁的事务类型：1 = 开始工作 2 = 完成工作 3 = 任何事务
CycleTimeGate.entryType.en: Identifies the type of transaction that triggers the Entry into the Gate: 1 = Start Work 2 = Complete Work 3 = Any transaction

CycleTimeGate.exitType.zh: 标识触发从门禁退出的事务类型：1 = 开始工作 2 = 完成工作 3 = 任何事务
CycleTimeGate.exitType.en: Identifies the type of transaction that triggers the exit from the Gate: 1 = Start Work 2 = Complete Work 3 = Any transaction

CycleTimeGate.gateType.zh: 标识门禁类型。具体值及其含义：1 = 周期时间门 2 = 处理门 3 = 收集门
CycleTimeGate.gateType.en: Identifies the gate type. Specific values are their meanings are: 1 = Cycle time gate 2 = Processing gate 3 = Collection gate

CycleTimeGate.iconId.zh: 与此门禁关联的图标的标识符
CycleTimeGate.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Gate

CycleTimeGate.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。
CycleTimeGate.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

CycleTimeGate.name.en: Unique name for this Gate (unique within the context of the Workflow).

CycleTimeGate.workflow.en: Workflow with which this Gate is associated

DataCollectionDef.changeHistory.zh: 每个建模实体都包含 Change Status。它用于记录当前的变更（维护）状态（例如，特定 Product Definition 的维护正在进行中），并跟踪最后一次更改的人员和时间。这应该可扩展为随时间变化的完整历史记录。
DataCollectionDef.changeHistory.en: Every modeling entity includes a Change Status. It is used to record the current Change (Maintenance) Status (i.e., maintenance is currently in progress for a specific Product Definition) and to track who made the last change and when. This should be extendible to a complete history over time.

DataCollectionDef.displayLimits.zh: 运行期间是否向操作员显示数据上下限
DataCollectionDef.displayLimits.en: Whether to display data upper and lower limits to operator during run

Employee.webDrillDownMenuDefinition.zh: 菜单定义用于在客户自己的用户界面上创建自定义菜单。菜单定义由预定义命令集合组成。通过使用菜单定义，可以满足工厂中不同员工群体的需求。例如，一个工序中的员工可能负责移动容器和收集容器参数数据，而另一个工序中的员工可能负责开始和分组容器。在这两种情况下，他们应该看到不同的菜单，因此他们会有不同的菜单定义。
Employee.webDrillDownMenuDefinition.en: Menu definitions are used to create custom menus on the customers own user interface. Menu Definitions consist of a collection of predefined commands. For example, employees in an operation might be responsible for moving containers and collecting container parametric data, while employees in another operation might be responsible for starting and grouping containers. In both cases, they should see a different menu and therefore they would have a different Menu Definition.

EmployeeRole.employee.zh: 员工（Employee）是可以登录InSite、执行事务和/或获得工作积分的人员。员工必须具有Windows NT帐户。定义后，该用户将出现在Modeler Security窗口的用户列表中。这样，员工定义直接进入Modeler Security。员工定义还允许为每个用户设置其他选项，例如与用户关联的工厂和将使用的语言。将通过事务中的员工字段获得工作积分的人员必须作为InSite员工存在，但不需要作为Windows用户帐户存在。
EmployeeRole.employee.en: An Employee is a person that can login to InSite, perform transactions, and/or be credited with work. The Employees must have a Windows NT account. Once defined, the user will then appear in the user list within the Modeler Security window. In this way the Employee definition feeds directly into the Modeler Security. The Employee definitions also allow for other options for each user such as the factory associate with the user and the language that will be used. Persons that will get credited with work by being entered in the employee field on a transaction, must exist as InSite employees, but are not required to exist as Windows user accounts.

ERPBOM.erpRoute.zh: ERP路线是与InSite工作流最接近的ERP概念。InSite中的ERPRoute对象旨在镜像ERP中的路线定义，其中存储在ERP中的定义是“主”定义，而InSite ERPRoute通过LiveConnect填充。ERPRoute用于将InSite的Moves和ComponentIssues与发生事务的ERPStep相关联。ERP路线中的步骤通常比InSite工作流中的步骤定义在更汇总的级别。
ERPBOM.erpRoute.en: ERP Routes are the closest ERP concept to an InSite workflow. The ERPRoute object in InSite is meant to be a mirror of the route definitions in the ERP, where the definition stored in the ERP is the "master" and the InSite ERPRoute is populated via LiveConnect. The ERPRoute is used to be able to relate InSite Moves and ComponentIssues to the ERPStep where the transaction occurred. Steps in an ERP route are usually defined at a more summarized level than is true for steps in an InSite workflow.
