ERPBOM.status.en: Determines the current status (Active, In-Active) of this instance. Valid values and their meanings are: 1 = Active 2 = Inactive Note there are no validations (rules enforced) concerning active vs. inactive revisions.

ERPBOM.wipMsgDefMgr.zh: WIP消息定义，包含适用于此实体的所有WIP消息的WIP消息键列表。
ERPBOM.wipMsgDefMgr.en: WIP Message Definition which contains a list of WIP message keys that contain all of the WIP messages that apply to this entity.

ERPBOMBase.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
ERPBOMBase.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

ERPBOMBase.revOfRcd.zh: 此基础实体当前修订版本的Id。
ERPBOMBase.revOfRcd.en: Id of the current revision for this Base entity.

ERPRoute.changeHistory.zh: 每个建模实体都包含 Change Status。它用于记录当前的变更（维护）状态（例如，特定 Product Definition 的维护正在进行中），并跟踪最后一次更改的人员和时间。这应该可扩展为随时间变化的完整历史记录。
ERPRoute.changeHistory.en: Every modeling entity includes a Change Status. It is used to record the current Change (Maintenance) Status (i.e., maintenance is currently in progress for a specific Product Definition) and to track who made the last change and when. This should be extendible to a complete history over time.

ERPRoute.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
ERPRoute.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

ERPRoute.erpItem.zh: 使用此工艺路线的ERP物料（通常等于InSite产品）的引用。由于一个工艺路线可能被多个物料使用，这通常是可选字段。
ERPRoute.erpItem.en: Reference to the ERP Item (usually equal to the InSite Product) that uses this route. Since a route could be used by multiple items, this is usually an optional field.

ERPRoute.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
ERPRoute.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

ERPRoute.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例进行更改。
ERPRoute.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance

ERPRoute.notes.zh: 与此对象关联的注释和评论。
ERPRoute.notes.en: Notations and comments associated with this object.

ERPRoute.product.zh: 使用此工艺路线的产品的引用。这是一个可选字段，因为多个产品可能使用相同的工艺路线。
ERPRoute.product.en: Reference to the Product that uses this route. This is an optional field, since more than one product could use the same route.

ERPRoute.revision.zh: 修订版本（在基础实体上下文中唯一）
ERPRoute.revision.en: Revision (unique within the context of the base entity)

ERPRoute.setupAccess.zh: 用于验证用户对特定建模记录的访问权限。必须首先将一个或多个 Setup Access 分配给 Role。每个建模记录将有一个 Setup Access。当建模记录被事务处理时，系统将比较其 Setup Access。
ERPRoute.setupAccess.en: This is used to verify the user's access to a particular modeling record. One or more Setup Access must first be assigned to a Role. Each modeling record will have one Setup Access. When a modeling record in transacted the system will compare its Setup Ac

ERPRoute.status.zh: 确定此实例的当前状态（活动、非活动）。有效值及其含义为：1 = 活动 2 = 非活动。注意，对于活动与非活动修订版本，没有强制执行的验证（规则）。
ERPRoute.status.en: Determines the current status (Active, In-Active) of this instance. Valid values and their meanings are: 1 = Active 2 = Inactive Note there are no validations (rules enforced) concerning active vs. inactive revisions.

ERPRoute.wipMsgDefMgr.zh: WIP消息定义，包含适用于此实体的所有WIP消息的WIP消息键列表。
ERPRoute.wipMsgDefMgr.en: WIP Message Definition which contains a list of WIP message keys that contain all of the WIP messages that apply to this entity.

ERPRouteBase.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
ERPRouteBase.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

ERPRouteBase.revOfRcd.zh: 此基础实体当前修订版本的Id。
ERPRouteBase.revOfRcd.en: Id of the current revision for this Base entity.

ESigReqTxnMap.allTxns.zh: 标识是否所有事务都应使用此实例中标识的要求。
ESigReqTxnMap.allTxns.en: Identifies whether all transactions should use the Requirement identified in this instance.

ESigReqTxnMap.eSigRequirement.zh: 包含应为事务收集的签名列表。
ESigReqTxnMap.eSigRequirement.en: Contains the list of signatures that should be collected for the transaction.

ESigReqTxnMap.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。
ESigReqTxnMap.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

ESigReqTxnMap.parent.zh: 包含此 CDO 的 CDO 的 Id。
ESigReqTxnMap.parent.en: Id of the CDO containing this CDO.

ESigReqTxnMap.txnId.en: The definition id of the TxnToUse.

ESigReqTxnMap.txnToUse.zh: 标识需要一个或多个电子签名的事务的InSite服务。
ESigReqTxnMap.txnToUse.en: Identifies the InSite Service that requires one or more electronic signatures for a transaction.

Event.checklist.zh: 检查表连接到流程对象或模板，并包含从检查表模板复制的条目。
Event.checklist.en: Checklists are connected to process objects or templates and contain entries copied from Checklist Template.

Event.checklistSaved.zh: 标识检查表是否与质量对象一起保存。
Event.checklistSaved.en: Identifies if Checklist is saved with the QualityObject

Event.closeDescription.zh: 作为“关闭”过程的一部分输入的描述性注释。
Event.closeDescription.en: Descriptive comments entered as part of the Close process.

Event.closedBy.zh: 员工（Employee）是可以登录InSite、执行事务和/或获得工作积分的人员。员工必须具有Windows NT帐户。定义后，该用户将出现在Modeler Security窗口的用户列表中。这样，员工定义直接进入Modeler Security。员工定义还允许为每个用户设置其他选项，例如与用户关联的工厂和将使用的语言。将通过事务中的员工字段获得工作积分的人员必须作为InSite员工存在，但不需要作为Windows用户帐户存在。
Event.closedBy.en: An Employee is a person that can login to InSite, perform transactions, and/or be credited with work. The Employees must have a Windows NT account. Once defined, the user will then appear in the user list within the Modeler Security window. In this way the Employee definition feeds directly into the Modeler Security. The Employee definitions also allow for other options for each user such as the factory associate with the user and the language that will be used. Persons that will get credited with work by being entered in the employee field on a transaction, must exist as InSite employees, but are not required to exist as Windows user accounts.

Event.discoveryArea.zh: 事件详细信息描述区域名称。
Event.discoveryArea.en: Description area name for the event detail

Event.eventData.en: Identifies additional data for an Event

Event.initiator.en: The Employee that discovered the event.

Event.initiatorOrganization.zh: 发现事件的员工所属组织。
Event.initiatorOrganization.en: The organization of the employee that discovered the Event.

Event.isCarRequiredToClose.zh: 关闭事件是否需要纠正措施报告。
Event.isCarRequiredToClose.en: Is a Corrective Action Report required to close the event.

Event.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。
Event.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

Event.isSubmitted.zh: 确定创建事件是否已提交。
Event.isSubmitted.en: Determines if the create event has been submitted

Event.occurrenceDate.en: The date/time that the Event occurred.

Event.organization.en: The Organization that the Event is assigned to.

Event.origProcessModelTemplate.zh: 最初分配给记录的 ProcessModel 的模板。分配后，ProcessModel 与原始模板没有任何连接，但此值对于验证用户不会尝试第二次分配 ProcessModel 是必要的。
Event.origProcessModelTemplate.en: The Template that was originally assigned as the ProcessModel for the record. After assigned, the ProcessModel has no connection to the original template, but this value is necessary to validate that the user doesn't try to assign the ProcessModel a second time.

Event.owner.zh: 对 QualityObject 负有主要责任的员工。
Event.owner.en: The Employee that has primary responsibility for the QualityObject.

Event.priorityLevel.en: Identifies the Priority of the Event.

Event.processModel.zh: 流程模型描述了解决作为质量对象报告的问题所需采取的措施
Event.processModel.en: The process model describes what needs to be done to resolve the issue reported as a Quality Object

Event.qualityResolutionCode.zh: 标识 QualityObject 的解决方案。
Event.qualityResolutionCode.en: Identifies the resolution of the QualityObject.

Event.reportedDate.zh: 事件进入系统的日期/时间。
Event.reportedDate.en: The date/time when the Event was entered into the system.

Event.reportedDateGmt.zh: 事件进入系统的日期/时间。
Event.reportedDateGmt.en: The date/time when the Event was entered into the system.

Event.reporter.en: The Employee that reported the Event.

Event.reporterOrganization.zh: 报告事件的员工所属组织。
Event.reporterOrganization.en: The Organization of the Employee that reported the Event.

Event.riskAssessment.zh: 确定质量对象风险评分所需的信息。
Event.riskAssessment.en: Information needed to determine the risk score for a Quality object.

Event.role.zh: 角色是工作职能的定义，例如法规事务经理的角色。
Event.role.en: A role is a definition of a job function, for example the role of Regulatory Affairs Manager.

Event.status.zh: 质量状态的枚举：1 = 活动 2 = 待处理 3 = 已升级 5 = 已关闭 6 = 已删除 7 = 已启动 8 = 审核中
Event.status.en: Enumeration for the Quality Status: 1 = Active 2 = Pending 3 = Escalated 5 = Closed 6 = Deleted 7 = Initiated 8 = InReview

Event.triageComplete.zh: 此标志用于确定是否有任何 QualityTxn 必须更新 QualityObject 中的值
Event.triageComplete.en: The flag is used to determine if any QualityTxn have to update value in QualityObject

EventClassificationSpecMap.checklistTemp.zh: 检查表模板对象允许用户配置检查表项目/问题，并将每个项目与适当的响应集关联。
EventClassificationSpecMap.checklistTemp.en: The Checklist Template object allows the user to configure checklist items/questions and associate each item with the appropriate Response Set.

EventClassificationSpecMap.failureModeGr.zh: FailureModes的分组机制。标识可分配给事件的可能的FailureModes。
EventClassificationSpecMap.failureModeGr.en: Grouping mechanism for the FailureModes. Identifies the possible FailureModes that can be assigned to an Event.

EventClassificationSpecMap.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。
EventClassificationSpecMap.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

EventClassificationSpecMap.owner.zh: 员工（Employee）是可以登录InSite、执行事务和/或获得工作积分的人员。员工必须具有Windows NT帐户。定义后，该用户将出现在Modeler Security窗口的用户列表中。这样，员工定义直接进入Modeler Security。员工定义还允许为每个用户设置其他选项，例如与用户关联的工厂和将使用的语言。将通过事务中的员工字段获得工作积分的人员必须作为InSite员工存在，但不需要作为Windows用户帐户存在。
EventClassificationSpecMap.owner.en: An Employee is a person that can login to InSite, perform transactions, and/or be credited with work. The Employees must have a Windows NT account. Once defined, the user will then appear in the user list within the Modeler Security window. In this way the Employee definition feeds directly into the Modeler Security. The Employee definitions also allow for other options for each user such as the factory associate with the user and the language that will be used. Persons that will get credited with work by being entered in the employee field on a transaction, must exist as InSite employees, but are not required to exist as Windows user accounts.

EventClassificationSpecMap.role.zh: 角色是工作职能的定义，例如法规事务经理的角色。为了满足电子签名要求，必须使用 ESig 角色组将角色分配给员工以进行签核。
EventClassificationSpecMap.role.en: A role is a definition of a job function, for example the role of Regulatory Affairs Manager. A role that must be assigned to an Employee using an ESig role group in order to sign off for an Electronic Signature requirement.

EventData.adverseEvent.zh: 产品是否引起不良影响？
EventData.adverseEvent.en: Did the product cause an adverse effect?

EventData.causeCodeName.zh: 来自制造部门的升级不符合项的关联原因代码名称。
EventData.causeCodeName.en: The associated CauseCodeName from manufacturing for the escalated nonconformance.

EventData.contactCustomer.zh: 分配给事件的客户数据。
EventData.contactCustomer.en: The Customer data assigned to an Event.

EventData.correctiveActionComments.zh: 来自制造部门的升级不符合项的关联纠正措施评论。
EventData.correctiveActionComments.en: The associated CorrectiveActionComments from manufacturing for the escalated nonconformance.

EventData.deviceEvaluated.zh: 制造商是否已评估设备。
EventData.deviceEvaluated.en: Has the manufacturer evaluated the device.

EventData.deviceReturned.en: Was the device returned to the manufacturer

EventData.event.zh: 反向关联的质量事件 → Event

EventData.eventCustomData.zh: 用于管理事件的客户扩展。
EventData.eventCustomData.en: Used to manage customer extensions to the Event.

EventData.eventType.zh: 在设备/产品操作期间发生了哪种类型的事件。
EventData.eventType.en: What type of event occured during the operation of the device/product.

EventData.failureInvestigationComments.zh: 来自制造部门的升级不符合项的关联故障调查评论。
EventData.failureInvestigationComments.en: The associated FailureInvestigationComments from manufacturing for the escalated nonconformance.

EventData.healthProfessional.zh: 报告问题的人是否是医疗专业人员。
EventData.healthProfessional.en: Was the person reporting the problem a health professional

EventData.maintenanceReqName.zh: 事件发生时正在使用的维护要求的名称。
EventData.maintenanceReqName.en: The name of the Maintenance Requirment in use when the Event occured.

EventData.maintenanceReqRev.zh: 事件发生时正在使用的维护要求的修订版。
EventData.maintenanceReqRev.en: The revision of the Maintenance Requirement in use when the Event occured.

EventData.nonconformanceNumber.zh: 从制造部门升级的不符合项报告。

EventData.occupation.zh: MedWatch 报告中可供选择的作业列表。
EventData.occupation.en: A list of jobs available for selection in the MedWatch report.

EventData.operationName.zh: 事件发生所在工序的名称。
EventData.operationName.en: The name of the Operation where the event occured.

EventData.preventiveActionComments.zh: 来自制造部门的升级不符合项的关联预防措施评论。
EventData.preventiveActionComments.en: The associated PreventiveActionComments from manufacturing for the escalated nonconformance.

EventData.productName.zh: 此事件中使用的产品名称。
EventData.productName.en: Name of the Product used on this Event

EventData.productRev.zh: 用于此事件的给定产品名称的产品修订版。
EventData.productRev.en: Product Revision for the given Product Name used on this Event

EventData.reportFiledWithFda.zh: 向制造商报告问题的人是否也向FDA报告了问题。
EventData.reportFiledWithFda.en: Did the person who reported the problem to the manufacturer also report the problem to the FDA

EventData.reportSource.en: The source of the information provided with the event.

EventData.reportingCustomer.zh: 分配给事件的客户数据。
EventData.reportingCustomer.en: The Customer data assigned to an Event.

EventData.resourceName.zh: 事件发生所在资源的名称。
EventData.resourceName.en: The name of the Resource where the Event occured.

EventData.returnedPhoneNumber.zh: 返回的联系人电话号码。
EventData.returnedPhoneNumber.en: Returned phone number of the contact.

EventData.specName.zh: 事件发生所在规格的名称。
EventData.specName.en: The name of the Spec where the Event occured.

EventData.specRev.zh: 事件发生所在规格的修订版。
EventData.specRev.en: The revision of the Spec where the Event occured.

EventData.workCenterName.zh: 事件发生所在工作中心的名称。
EventData.workCenterName.en: The name of the WorkCenter where the Event occured.

EventData.workflowName.zh: 事件发生所在工作流的名称。
EventData.workflowName.en: Name of the Workflow where the Event occurred.

EventData.workflowRev.zh: 事件发生所在工作流的修订版。
EventData.workflowRev.en: Revision of the Workflow where the Event occurred.

EventDisposition.disposition.zh: 标识可对分配给事件的批次采取的操作。例如报废、返工、退回供应商。
EventDisposition.disposition.en: Identifies the actions that can be taken on a Lot assigned to an Event. Examples are Scrap, Rework, Return to Vendor.

EventDisposition.parent.zh: 包含此 CDO 的 CDO 的 Id。
EventDisposition.parent.en: Id of the CDO containing this CDO.

EventDispositionHistoryDetail.dispositio.zh: 标识可对分配给事件的批次采取的操作。例如报废、返工、退回供应商。
EventDispositionHistoryDetail.dispositio.en: Identifies the actions that can be taken on a Lot assigned to an Event. Examples are Scrap, Rework, Return to Vendor.

EventDispositionHistoryDetail.lot.zh: 标识事件发生的容器/批次。
EventDispositionHistoryDetail.lot.en: Identifies the Container/Lot for which the Event occurred.

EventFailure.failureMode.en: Identifies the FailureMode of the Failure.

EventFailure.failureSeverity.en: Identifies the Severity of the Failure.

EventFailure.failureType.en: Categorization of the failure. For example "Repeatable".

EventFailureAction.actionType.zh: 标识事件或原因的操作类型。
EventFailureAction.actionType.en: Identifies a Action Type for an Event or Cause.

EventFailureAction.parent.zh: 包含此 CDO 的 CDO 的 Id。
EventFailureAction.parent.en: Id of the CDO containing this CDO.

EventLog.commentType.zh: 生产事件日志的注释类型
EventLog.commentType.en: Comment Type for Production Event Log

EventLog.employee.zh: 员工（Employee）是可以登录InSite、执行事务和/或获得工作积分的人员。员工必须具有Windows NT帐户。定义后，该用户将出现在Modeler Security窗口的用户列表中。这样，员工定义直接进入Modeler Security。员工定义还允许为每个用户设置其他选项，例如与用户关联的工厂和将使用的语言。将通过事务中的员工字段获得工作积分的人员必须作为InSite员工存在，但不需要作为Windows用户帐户存在。
EventLog.employee.en: An Employee is a person that can login to InSite, perform transactions, and/or be credited with work. The Employees must have a Windows NT account. Once defined, the user will then appear in the user list within the Modeler Security window. In this way the Employee definition feeds directly into the Modeler Security. The Employee definitions also allow for other options for each user such as the factory associate with the user and the language that will be used. Persons that will get credited with work by being entered in the employee field on a transaction, must exist as InSite employees, but are not required to exist as Windows user accounts.

ExecuteMfgOrderTaskHistory.integrationTx.zh: 在复合/容器/资源事务后插入 TxnId 与历史主线。
ExecuteMfgOrderTaskHistory.integrationTx.en: Inserts the TxnId after a compound/container/resource transaction with history mainline.

ExecuteMfgOrderTaskHistory.mfgOrder.en: Order for which task was performed

ExecuteMfgOrderTaskHistory.mfgOrderInstr.zh: 制造订单指令类型 1 = 通过/失败 2 = 数据收集 3 = 确认 4 = 主管审核。
ExecuteMfgOrderTaskHistory.mfgOrderInstr.en: Mfg Order Instruction Type 1 = Pass/Fail 2 = Data Collection 3 = Acknowledgement 4 = SupervisorReview

ExecuteMfgOrderTaskHistory.pass.zh: 指示通过/失败指令类型任务的通过/失败状态。
ExecuteMfgOrderTaskHistory.pass.en: Indicates pass/fail status for a pass/fail instruction type task

ExecuteMfgOrderTaskHistory.taskComments.zh: 执行任务时的用户评论。
ExecuteMfgOrderTaskHistory.taskComments.en: User comments at time of performing task

ExecuteMfgOrderTaskHistory.taskComplete.zh: 指示任务完成的标志。取自执行任务时的MfgOrderTaskStatus。
ExecuteMfgOrderTaskHistory.taskComplete.en: Flag indicating task is complete. Taken from MfgOrderTaskStatus at time of task execution

ExecuteMfgOrderTaskHistory.taskFailed.zh: 指示任务处于失败状态的标志。取自执行任务时的MfgOrderTaskStatus。
ExecuteMfgOrderTaskHistory.taskFailed.en: Flag indicating task is in a fail state. Taken from MfgOrderTaskStatus at time of task execution

ExecuteMfgOrderTaskHistory.taskListSeque.zh: 制造订单程序中任务列表的顺序。
ExecuteMfgOrderTaskHistory.taskListSeque.en: Sequence of Task List within the Mfg Order Procedure

ExecuteMfgOrderTaskHistory.taskSequence.zh: 制造订单任务列表中任务的顺序。
ExecuteMfgOrderTaskHistory.taskSequence.en: Sequence of task within an Mfg Order Task List

ExecuteMfgOrderTaskHistory.taskStatus.zh: 指示制造订单任务状态的代码。
ExecuteMfgOrderTaskHistory.taskStatus.en: Code to indicate status of Mfg Order task

ExecuteMfgOrderTaskHistory.taskType.zh: TaskType枚举。1 = 开始流程任务 2 = 结束流程任务 3 = 常规流程任务。
ExecuteMfgOrderTaskHistory.taskType.en: Enumeration for TaskType. 1 = Start Process Task 2 = End Process Task 3 = Regular Process Task

ExecuteSamplingLotHistory.integrationTxn.zh: 在复合/容器/资源事务后插入 TxnId 与历史主线。
ExecuteSamplingLotHistory.integrationTxn.en: Inserts the TxnId after a compound/container/resource transaction with history mainline.

ExecuteSamplingLotHistory.reworkReason.zh: 流程返工代码的实例用于提供流程返工的原因列表。当容器进入返工回路时，该代码与容器关联。然后它与容器在返工回路中生成的所有吞吐量事务关联。这提供了例如在报告中区分首次通过和返工吞吐量的手段。
ExecuteSamplingLotHistory.reworkReason.en: An instance of a Process Rework Code is used to provide a list of reasons for Process Rework. The code is associated with a Container when it enters a rework loop. It is then associated with all throughput transactions generated by the container while it is in the rework loop. This provides, for example, a means of differentiating between first pass and rework throughput in reporting.

ExecuteSamplingLotHistory.samplingLotRes.zh: 用于标识取样批次结果。1 = 正常 2 = 返工 3 = 报废。
ExecuteSamplingLotHistory.samplingLotRes.en: Used to identify the Sampling Lot Result. 1 = OK 2 = REWORK 3 = SCRAP

ExecuteSamplingLotHistory.scrapReason.zh: 此功能在当前版本的 InSite 中未实现。ScrapReason
ExecuteSamplingLotHistory.scrapReason.en: This is not implemented in the current version of InSite. ScrapReason

Factory.allowLineSettingsOverride.zh: 如果由终端设置，允许覆盖生产线分配设置。
Factory.allowLineSettingsOverride.en: Allow Line Assignment Settings Override if set by Terminal

Factory.assemblyArea.zh: 工厂的装配区域名称。在批次排程期间复制到批次属性。
Factory.assemblyArea.en: The Assembly Area name for the Factory. Copied over to Lot Attributes during Lot Schedule.

Factory.assemblyCountry.zh: 工厂的装配国家名称。在批次排程期间复制到批次属性。
Factory.assemblyCountry.en: The Assembly Country name for the Factory. Copied over to Lot Attributes during Lot Schedule.

Factory.assemblyPlant.zh: 工厂的组装厂名称。在批次调度时复制到批次属性。
Factory.assemblyPlant.en: The Assembly Plant name for the Factory. Copied over to Lot Attributes during Lot Schedule.

Factory.assemblyPlantCode.zh: （例如）设置日期代码使用的组装厂代码。
Factory.assemblyPlantCode.en: The Assembly Plant Code used by (for example) Set Date Code.

Factory.changeMgtApplication.zh: 特定于变更管理的配置设置。
Factory.changeMgtApplication.en: Configuration settings specific to Change Management.

Factory.containerAutoHoldReason.zh: 将保留代码与容器关联可阻止对该容器执行事务。保留代码由用户定义，为保留提供多种描述（原因）。
Factory.containerAutoHoldReason.en: Associating a Hold Code with a Container prevents transactions from being performed for that Container. Hold Codes are User Defined to provide multiple descriptions (reasons) for Holds.

Factory.containerNumberingRule.zh: 此字段用于定义对象的编号规则。
Factory.containerNumberingRule.en: This field is used to define the numbering rule for object.

Factory.dateCodeRule.zh: 用于生成日期代码的业务规则。预计业务规则将执行所有必要的更新或准备对象（如服务属性）。当批次处于具有…的规格中时，此业务规则将由MoveTxn触发。
Factory.dateCodeRule.en: Business Rule used to generate the Date Code. It is expected the Business Rule to carry out all the necessary updates or preparation of objects like the Service Attributes. This Business Rule will be triggered by the MoveTxn when the lot is in a Spec with

Factory.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
Factory.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

Factory.eSigReqForLabelReprint.zh: 标签重新打印的电子签名要求。
Factory.eSigReqForLabelReprint.en: E Sig Requirement For Label Reprint

Factory.enterprise.en: Id of the Enterprise for this Factory.

Factory.factoryLevelIndex.zh: 标识此工厂在同一企业下相对于其他工厂的位置。
Factory.factoryLevelIndex.en: Identifies the position of this factory relative to other factories under the same enterprise.

Factory.generalMessage.zh: 要向用户显示的常规消息。
Factory.generalMessage.en: General Message to be displayed to users

Factory.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
Factory.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

Factory.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。
Factory.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions).

Factory.lastRptMonthly.zh: 上次RPT月度更新发生时间的跟踪。
Factory.lastRptMonthly.en: Tracking for Last RPT Monthly of RPTUpdate Occurance.

Factory.lastRptQuarterly.zh: 上次RPT季度更新发生时间的跟踪。
Factory.lastRptQuarterly.en: Tracking for Last RPT Quarterly of RPTUpdate Occurance.

Factory.lastRptWeekly.zh: 上次RPT周度更新发生时间的跟踪。
Factory.lastRptWeekly.en: Tracking for Last RPT Weekly of RPTUpdate Occurance.

Factory.maxTimeSinceMsgsRetrieved.zh: 这是允许在重新检索WIPMsgs之前，检索WIPMsgs与实际验证消息之间的最大时间延迟。
Factory.maxTimeSinceMsgsRetrieved.en: This is the maximum time delay between the retrieval of the WIPMsgs and the actual validation of the messages allowed before the messages are retrieved again.

Factory.mfgCalendar.zh: 用于将事务执行时间戳转换为特定制造日期和班次的日历。
Factory.mfgCalendar.en: Calendar that is used to translate the timestamp of when a transaction was performed into a specific manufacturing date and shift.

Factory.notes.zh: 与此对象关联的注释和评论。
Factory.notes.en: Notations and comments associated with this object.

Factory.organization.zh: 识别用户可访问的组织信息范围。
Factory.organization.en: Identifies the scope of organizational information that a user has access to

Factory.partRequestEmailGroup.zh: 当触发PartRequest时向其发送电子邮件的员工组。该组的EmailTransport也用于在PartRequestAcknowledge期间发送确认电子邮件。
Factory.partRequestEmailGroup.en: The group of employees to send email to when PartRequest is triggered. The EmailTransport of the group is also used to send the acknowledgement email during PartRequestAcknowledge.

Factory.printQueue.zh: InSite 可用于打印标签的打印机。
Factory.printQueue.en: Printers InSite can use to print labels.

Factory.recipePattern.zh: 用于确定加载到此工厂机器的指令集的InSite统一表达式。
Factory.recipePattern.en: InSite Unified Expression for determining what set of instructions to load to machines in this factory

Factory.remainingProcessTimeEnabled.en: A flag that enable RPT calculation.

Factory.reprintReasonRequired.zh: 如果“重新打印原因”字段在“重新打印容器标签”页面中必须是必填字段，用户将此设置为True。
Factory.reprintReasonRequired.en: User sets this to True if Reprint Reason field is required to be a mandatory field in Reprint Container Label page.

Factory.requireLocation.zh: 确定此工厂的位置管理是否处于活动状态。
Factory.requireLocation.en: Determines if Location Management is active for this factory

Factory.resourceStatusModel.zh: 定义资源状态模型，包括：1. 可用的初始化资源状态代码 2. 可用“从状态”和“到状态”的映射。
Factory.resourceStatusModel.en: Defines a Resource Status Model which includes: 1. Available initialization Resource Status Codes 2. A Mapping of available "From Status" and "To Statuses"

Factory.retentionDays.zh: 容器关闭后（未归档）在系统中保留的天数。
Factory.retentionDays.en: Number of days a container remains in the system (not archived) after it is closed.

Factory.rptMaxLimitNumberLots.zh: 指示RPT最大批次数量限制。
Factory.rptMaxLimitNumberLots.en: Indicates the number of RPT Maximum Limit Number of Lots.

Factory.rptMinLimitNumberLots.zh: 指示最小批次数量限制。
Factory.rptMinLimitNumberLots.en: Indicates the number of Minimum Limit Number of Lots

Factory.scsCarrierNumberingRule.zh: 此服务用于维护在工单调度中自动生成载具容器重命名名称时使用的属性。
Factory.scsCarrierNumberingRule.en: This service is used to maintain properties that will be used to auto generate names for Carrier Container Rename in Work Order Dispatch.

Factory.scsCarrierRenameRule.zh: 此服务用于维护在工单调度中自动生成载具容器重命名名称时使用的属性。
Factory.scsCarrierRenameRule.en: This service is used to maintain properties that will be used to auto generate names for Carrier Container Rename in Work Order Dispatch.

Factory.scsEnabledHybridHpe.zh: 启用混合HPE功能的复选框。
Factory.scsEnabledHybridHpe.en: Checkbox to enabled Hybrid HPE Function

Factory.scsMaxScheduleStepsToProcess.zh: “MaxScheduleStepsToProcess”的目的是限制逻辑在创建要发送到Preactor的调度数据时评估的步骤数。
Factory.scsMaxScheduleStepsToProcess.en: The purpose of "MaxScheduleStepsToProcess" is to restrict the number of steps the logic evaluates when creating scheduling data to send to Preactor

Factory.scsPreactorEnabled.zh: 检查IS是否已激活的标志。如果IS未激活，该值将始终为false，直到IS被激活。
Factory.scsPreactorEnabled.en: flag to check if IS is activated . if IS not active, value will always false untill IS is activated

Factory.scsUnloadCarrierContainer.zh: 指示当批次从WIP移回库存时，载具是否将与载具容器解除关联的标志。此标志当前不在UI中显示，仅在ScheduleData.Complete事件期间在后端逻辑中使用。
Factory.scsUnloadCarrierContainer.en: Flag to indicate if the Carrier will be delinked from a Carrier Container when the lot moves from WIP back to Inventory. This flag is currently not displayed in the UI and only used in the backend logic during the ScheduleData.Complete event

Factory.scsUpdatePreactorStepCnt.zh: “UpdatePreactorStepCnt”的目的是帮助Move事务知道何时向Preactor发送额外的调度数据。我们不希望等到到达等于“MaxScheduleStepsToProcess”的步骤。Preactor可能没有时间重新调度…
Factory.scsUpdatePreactorStepCnt.en: The purpose of “UpdatePreactorStepCnt” is assist the Move transaction to know when to send additional scheduling data to Preactor. We do not want to wait till we arrive at the Step equal to “MaxScheduleStepsToProcess”. Preactor may not have time to resch

Factory.setupAccess.zh: 用于验证用户对特定建模记录的访问权限。必须首先将一个或多个 Setup Access 分配给 Role。每个建模记录将有一个 Setup Access。当建模记录被事务处理时，系统将比较其 Setup Access。
Factory.setupAccess.en: This is used to verify the user's access to a particular modeling record. One or more Setup Access must first be assigned to a Role. Each modeling record will have one Setup Access. When a modeling record in transacted the system will compare its Setup Ac

Factory.shipFactoryCode.zh: ShipFactoryCode附加到工厂对象。它在批次发货事务期间用于生成文档编号。
Factory.shipFactoryCode.en: ShipFactoryCode is attached to the Factory object. It is used to generate the Document Number during Lot Ship transaction.

Factory.shipPlantCode.zh: ShipPlantCode附加到工厂对象。它在批次发货事务期间用于生成文档编号。
Factory.shipPlantCode.en: ShipPlantCode is attached to the Factory object. It is used to generate the Document Number during Lot Ship transaction.

Factory.slitNumberingRule.zh: 此字段用于定义分切容器的编号规则。
Factory.slitNumberingRule.en: This field is used to define the numbering rule for Slit Containers.

Factory.smartScanRule.zh: 定义从字符串中提取数据的过程。
Factory.smartScanRule.en: Defines process to extract data from a string.

Factory.statusModel.zh: 此设置用于控制资源状态更改以及满足前提条件时的自动更改。它还有一个资源可以更改到的有效原因列表。
Factory.statusModel.en: This setup is used to control Resource status change as well as automated change if a pre-condition is met. It also has a list of valid Reasons the Resource can change to.

Factory.testArea.zh: 工厂的测试区域名称。在批次排程期间复制到批次属性。
Factory.testArea.en: The Test Area name for the Factory. Copied over to Lot Attributes during Lot Schedule.

Factory.testCountry.zh: 工厂的测试国家名称。在批次排程期间复制到批次属性。
Factory.testCountry.en: The Test Country name for the Factory. Copied over to Lot Attributes during Lot Schedule.

Factory.testPlant.zh: 工厂的测试厂名称。在批次调度时复制到批次属性。
Factory.testPlant.en: The Test Plant name for the Factory. Copied over to Lot Attributes during Lot Schedule.

Factory.waferSortArea.zh: 工厂的晶圆分选区域名称。在批次调度期间复制到批次属性。
Factory.waferSortArea.en: The Wafer Sort Area name for the Factory. Copied over to Lot Attributes during Lot Schedule.

Factory.waferSortCountry.zh: 工厂的晶圆分选国家名称。在批次调度期间复制到批次属性。
Factory.waferSortCountry.en: The Wafer Sort Country name for the Factory. Copied over to Lot Attributes during Lot Schedule.

Factory.waferSortPlant.zh: 工厂的晶圆分选厂名称。在批次调度时复制到批次属性。
Factory.waferSortPlant.en: The Wafer Sort Plant name for the Factory. Copied over to Lot Attributes during Lot Schedule.

Factory.webLoginTimeLimit.zh: 用户允许再次登录的自上次登录以来的天数时间限制。0或更小的值表示没有时间限制。
Factory.webLoginTimeLimit.en: The time limit in days from the last login the user is allowed to login again. A value of 0 or less means no time limit.

Factory.wipMsgDefMgr.zh: 附加到建模实体实例，包含适用于该实体的消息。当被要求提供其WIP消息时，建模实体将要求其WIPMsgDefMgr提供已过滤的WIP消息列表，仅包含适用于当前情况（步骤、操作和标签）的消息。WIPMsgDefMgr将检查AllKey WIPMsgKey（如果指定，包含适用于所有步骤的消息），并遍历OperationKeys和LabelKeys列表中的条目，过滤找到的每条消息。
Factory.wipMsgDefMgr.en: Attached to an instance of a modeling entity, this contains the messages that apply to the entity. When asked to supply its WIP Messages, a modeling entity will ask its WIPMsgDefMgr to supply a list of WIP Messages that have been filtered to include only the messages that apply to the current circumstances (step, operation and label). The WIPMsgDefMgr will check the AllKey WIPMsgKey (which contains a message that applies to all steps) if specified, and run through the entries in the OperationKeys and LabelKeys lists and filter each message found.

Factory.xmlPassword.zh: 执行XML事务所需的密码。由外部应用程序（如ObjectUpdate）使用。
Factory.xmlPassword.en: The password required to transact an XML. Used by external applications like ObjectUpdate.

Factory.xmlPort.zh: 执行XML事务所需的端口。由外部应用程序（如ObjectUpdate）使用。
Factory.xmlPort.en: The port required to transact an XML. Used by external applications like ObjectUpdate.

Factory.xmlServerName.zh: 执行XML事务所需的服务器名称。由外部应用程序（如ObjectUpdate）使用。
Factory.xmlServerName.en: The server name required to transact an XML. Used by external applications like ObjectUpdate.

Factory.xmlUsername.zh: 对XML进行事务处理所需的用户名。由外部应用程序（如ObjectUpdate）使用。
Factory.xmlUsername.en: The username required to transact an XML. Used by external applications like ObjectUpdate.

FailureMode.defaultSeverity.zh: 标识事件故障的严重性。
FailureMode.defaultSeverity.en: Identifies the Severity of the Failure for an Event.

FailureMode.defaultType.zh: 提供对不合格失效进行分类的方法。例如“可重复”。

HistoryMainline.application.zh: 创建此事务的应用程序的唯一标识符。
HistoryMainline.application.en: Unique identifier for the Application which created this transaction.

HistoryMainline.baseTxnType.zh: 按交付状态，大多数事务将返回当前事务类型。然而有些事务是分组的。例如，MoveOut、MoveStd、MoveNonStd、Rework都是MoveTxn。
HistoryMainline.baseTxnType.en: As delivered, most transactions will return the current transaction type. Some transactions are grouped however. MoveOut, MoveStd, MoveNonStd, Rework are all MoveTxns for example.

HistoryMainline.batch.zh: 批次代表生产过程的最终结果物料。批次包含或引用关于特定容器（代表被跟踪的物料，即过程的最终结果）的所有信息。
HistoryMainline.batch.en: A Batch represents the materials that are the final result of the production process. The Batch contains or references all the information about the specific Containers that represent the tracked materials that are the final result of the process.

HistoryMainline.binningIncluded.zh: 此事务记录了分批（Binning）信息。

HistoryMainline.bonusIncluded.zh: 此事务记录了奖励（Bonus）数据。

HistoryMainline.calendarJulianDay.zh: 返回当前日历的儒略日（即ddd）。
HistoryMainline.calendarJulianDay.en: Returns the current Calendar's Julian Day (i.e. ddd).

HistoryMainline.calendarShift.zh: 基于执行工作的工作中心的TxnTime和工作计划确定的制造班次。
HistoryMainline.calendarShift.en: Manufacturing shift based on the TxnTime and WorkSchedule from the WorkCenter where the work was perfomed.

HistoryMainline.calendarWorkWeek.zh: 返回当前日历的工作周（即ww）。
HistoryMainline.calendarWorkWeek.en: Returns the current Calendar's Work Week (i.e. ww).

HistoryMainline.calendarYear.zh: 返回当前日历的年份（即yyyy）。
HistoryMainline.calendarYear.en: Returns the current Calendar's year (i.e. yyyy).

HistoryMainline.callByCdoName.zh: 调用实际创建历史主线记录的CDO名称的CDO名称。
HistoryMainline.callByCdoName.en: The CDO Name that called the actual CDO Name that creates the History Mainline record.

HistoryMainline.carrier.zh: 载体是容纳物料的物理实体，用于批处理。载体是类似容器、大桶、桶、托盘等的资源。
HistoryMainline.carrier.en: A carrier is a physical entity that holds material which is used in batch processing. Carriers are resources like: Vessels, Vats, drums, trays etc.

HistoryMainline.carrierName.zh: 最长 40 个字符的字符串字段。

HistoryMainline.cdoName.en: The CDO Name that finally transacts a transaction.

HistoryMainline.cdoTxnSequence.zh: CDO的事务序列。用于复合事务。
HistoryMainline.cdoTxnSequence.en: The transaction sequence for the CDO. Useful for Compound transactions.

HistoryMainline.cioMessageId.en: GUID representing a CIO Message - Inbound

HistoryMainline.cioMessageIdOutbound.en: GUID representing a CIO Message - outbound

HistoryMainline.client.zh: 记录事务的工作站（客户端）的唯一标识符。
HistoryMainline.client.en: Unique identifier for the workstation (Client) where the transaction was recorded.

HistoryMainline.compoundTxnType.zh: 外部复合事务的事务类型（如果有）。
HistoryMainline.compoundTxnType.en: Transaction type of outer compound transaction if any

HistoryMainline.computerName.zh: 执行服务的计算机。例如，打印自动化使用此字段来确定在何处打印报告或标签。
HistoryMainline.computerName.en: The Computer that transacted the service. E.g the Printing Automation uses this field to figure out where to print the reports or labels.

HistoryMainline.container.zh: 与事务关联的容器（如果适用）。
HistoryMainline.container.en: Container associated with the transaction, if applicable.

HistoryMainline.containerChangeCount.zh: 存储容器被事务处理时的变更计数。此值可与TxnDate和CDOTxnSequence一起用于报告中的排序。
HistoryMainline.containerChangeCount.en: Stores the Container's Change Count when it is transacted. This value can be used together with TxnDate and CDOTxnSequence for sorting purpose in reporting.

HistoryMainline.containerTxnSequence.zh: 设置历史的下一事务序列。
HistoryMainline.containerTxnSequence.en: Sets the history's next transaction sequence.

HistoryMainline.defectIncluded.zh: 此事务记录了缺陷数据。

HistoryMainline.eSigRequirement.zh: 包含为事务收集的签名列表。
HistoryMainline.eSigRequirement.en: Contains the list of signatures that were collected for the transaction.

HistoryMainline.employee.en: Indentifies the person who performed the work.

HistoryMainline.factory.en: Factory where the work was perfomed.

HistoryMainline.fromContainer.zh: 实际事务发生前的容器。
HistoryMainline.fromContainer.en: The container before the actual transaction takes place.

HistoryMainline.fromQty.zh: 存储服务事务处理前批次的数量。
HistoryMainline.fromQty.en: Stores the lot's Qty before the service is transacted.

HistoryMainline.fromQty2.zh: 存储服务事务处理前批次的Qty2。
HistoryMainline.fromQty2.en: Stores the lot's Qty2 before the service is transacted.

HistoryMainline.fromSpecName.zh: 服务执行所需事务前的规格名称。
HistoryMainline.fromSpecName.en: The Spec Name before the service carries out the required transaction.

HistoryMainline.fromSpecPass.zh: 当前步骤的规格通过次数。
HistoryMainline.fromSpecPass.en: The spec pass count for the current step.

HistoryMainline.fromStatus.zh: 确定此实例的当前状态（活动、非活动）。有效值及其含义：1 = 活动，2 = 非活动。
HistoryMainline.fromStatus.en: Determines the current status (Active, In-Active) of this instance. Valid values and their meanings are: 1 = Active 2 = Inactive

HistoryMainline.fromWorkflowName.zh: 事务执行前的工作流名称。
HistoryMainline.fromWorkflowName.en: The Workflow Name before the transaction is carried out.

HistoryMainline.historySummary.zh: 用于链接到附加历史摘要。
HistoryMainline.historySummary.en: i) Used to link to an additional history summary.

HistoryMainline.iconId.zh: 图标的唯一标识符。大多数数据实例都有关联的图标。这是用于在图标库中唯一标识图标的ID。
HistoryMainline.iconId.en: Unique identifier for an Icon. Most instances of data have an associated Icon. This is the ID used to uniquely identify the Icon within the Icon library.

HistoryMainline.implicit.zh: 生成此CDO的事务对此主线CDO指定的容器产生了隐式影响。
HistoryMainline.implicit.en: The transaction that generated this CDO had an implicit effect on the container specified by this mainline CDO.

HistoryMainline.inRework.zh: 指示容器是否处于返工状态。主要用于显示因返工情况而产生的额外工作量/成本的报告。
HistoryMainline.inRework.en: Indicates if the container is in Rework. Used primarily for reports that show the extra effort/cost that was incurred due to rework conditions.

HistoryMainline.integrationTxn.zh: 在复合/容器/资源事务后插入 TxnId 与历史主线。
HistoryMainline.integrationTxn.en: Inserts the TxnId after a compound/container/resource transaction with history mainline.

HistoryMainline.lastLotCarriersSetupHist.zh: 存储上次对批次执行批次载体设置的时间引用。此字段映射到HistoryMainline，以便其他事务在需要时引用批次的最后已知载体设置。
HistoryMainline.lastLotCarriersSetupHist.en: Stores a reference to the last time Lot Carriers Setup was carried out on the lot. This field is mapped to HistoryMainline for other transactions to reference to the last know Carriers setup on the lot if required.

HistoryMainline.lastMoveOutTimestamp.en: Stores the last move out timestamp.

HistoryMainline.lastMoveOutUsername.en: Stores the last move out username.

HistoryMainline.localReworkIncluded.zh: 此事务记录了本地返工信息。
HistoryMainline.localReworkIncluded.en: This transaction recorded Local Rework information.

HistoryMainline.login.zh: 记录事务时登录的用户。
HistoryMainline.login.en: The user logged in when the transaction was recorded.

HistoryMainline.mfgDate.zh: 工厂通常有班次安排，导致一个班次在一个日期开始工作并在另一个日期结束；其中午夜12点位于班次中间。对于这些工厂，通常有“制造日期”的概念，使任何特定班次完全落在一个特定的制造日内。一个班次从早上7点、下午3点和晚上11点开始的工厂，通常其“制造日期”从上一天的晚上11点开始，到当天的晚上11点结束。
HistoryMainline.mfgDate.en: Factories often have shift schedules that result in a shift starting work on one date and ending on another date; where 12 midnight is in the middle of the shift. For these factories, it is normal to have a concept of "Manufacturing Date" that enables any particular shift to fall entirely on one particular manufacturing day. A factory with shifts that start at 7am, 3pm, and 11pm will normally have a "Manufacturing Date" that begins on 11pm of the previous clock date, and ends at 11pm of the current clock date.

HistoryMainline.mfgProcessOverrides.zh: 工艺清单（Bill Of Process）用于指定对规范（spec）的覆盖，并分配给容器、制造订单或产品。
HistoryMainline.mfgProcessOverrides.en: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

HistoryMainline.moveInQty.zh: i) 存储批次进入步骤时的数量。ii) 此数量将用于插入到移动事务中以指示进入数量。
HistoryMainline.moveInQty.en: i) Stores the quantity when the lot moves into a step. ii) This quantity will be used to insert into the move transaction to indicate the in quantity.

HistoryMainline.moveInQty2.zh: i) 存储批次进入步骤时的 quantity 2。ii) 此数量将用于插入到移动事务中以指示进入数量。
HistoryMainline.moveInQty2.en: i) Stores the quantity 2 when the lot moves into a step. ii) This quantity will be used to insert into the move transaction to indicate the in quantity.

HistoryMainline.moveInTimestamp.zh: 存储下一次移动事务的移入时间戳。
HistoryMainline.moveInTimestamp.en: Stores the Move In Timestamp for the next Move transaction.

HistoryMainline.operation.en: Operation where the transaction took place.

HistoryMainline.owner.zh: 每个容器都有一个关联的所有者代码。所有者代码用作分组，以区分容器进行查询和处理。所有者代码的示例有“制造”、“工程”、“原型”、“销售样品”等。
HistoryMainline.owner.en: Every Container has an associated Owner Code. The owner code is used as a grouping to separate Containers for inquiry and processing. Examples of Owner Code are "Manufacturing", "Engineering", "Prototypes", "SalesSamples", etc.

HistoryMainline.processSpec.zh: 事务后批次的工艺规格。
HistoryMainline.processSpec.en: The Process Spec of the lot after the transaction.

HistoryMainline.product.zh: 产品定义的实例向应用程序描述产品。这可以是待制造的产品、原材料、成品等。产品可以属于产品族。待制造的产品将具有关联的工作流。工作流的属性可以被覆盖以特定于产品。可选地，产品可以属于产品族。产品族用于对产品进行分组，以简化维护任务（用于建模数据）。然后可以为产品族提供公共属性（如成本或加工信息），并应用于族内的每个产品。
HistoryMainline.product.en: An instance of a Product Definition describes a product to the application. This may be a Product to be manufactured, raw materials, finished, etc. Products can belong to a Product Family. A product to be manufactured will have an associated Workflow. Attributes of the Workflow may be overridden to be product specific. Optionally, a Product can belong to a Product Family. A Product Family is used to group products for the purpose of simplifying the maintenance task (for modeling data). Common attributes such as costing or processing information can then be provided for a Product Family and applied to each Product within the family.

HistoryMainline.productName.en: Stores the name for the Product.

HistoryMainline.qty.en: The lot quantity after the transaction.

HistoryMainline.qty2.en: The lot Qty2 after the transaction.

HistoryMainline.qualityESigConfirmed.zh: 该标志指示事务是否已通过质量电子签名确认。
HistoryMainline.qualityESigConfirmed.en: The flag indicates is the Txn confirmed by the Quality Electronic Signature

HistoryMainline.remainingProcessTime.zh: 剩余处理时间值，用于 RPT 计算。
HistoryMainline.remainingProcessTime.en: Remaining Process Time value, used for RPT calculation.

HistoryMainline.resource.en: Resource where the transaction took place.

HistoryMainline.resourceAvailability.zh: 定义资源的当前可用性状态。有效值及其含义：1 = 可用，2 = 不可用。
HistoryMainline.resourceAvailability.en: Defines the current availability status for a Resource. Valid values and their meanings are: 1 = Up (Available) 2 = Down (Not available)

HistoryMainline.resourceStatusCode.zh: 资源状态代码提供对资源当前可用性的描述。此值用于查询和报告（平均故障间隔时间、平均修复时间、状态持续时间等）。此外，资源状态代码标识资源的默认“下一个”（生产）事务。这旨在作为资源状态流（资源工作流）的简单实现。
HistoryMainline.resourceStatusCode.en: A Resource Status Code is provides a description of the current availability for a Resource. This value is used for inquiry and in reporting. (Mean Time Between Failure, Mean Time to Repair, Time at Status, etc.). Additionally, a Resource Status code identifies the default “Next” (Production) Transaction for a Resource. This is intended to be a simple implementation of a Resource Status Flow (Resource Workflow).

HistoryMainline.resourceStatusReason.zh: 资源状态原因代码用于提供额外的详细级别，描述资源当前状态的原因。例如，当前状态可能是维修。状态原因代码可用于提供附加细节，例如正在执行的维修类型。此详细信息包含在事务历史中，使其可用于分析报告。
HistoryMainline.resourceStatusReason.en: A Resource Status Reason Code is used to provide an added level of detail describing the reason for the current status of a Resource. For example, the current status may be REPAIR. A Status Reason Code can be used to provide additional details such as the type of repair that is being performed. This detail is included in the transaction history, which makes it available for Analysis Reporting.

HistoryMainline.reversalStatus.zh: 此记录相对于事务冲销的状态。值：1 =“活动”（已执行未冲销的事务。ReversalStatus最初对所有已提交事务设置为此值）。2 =“已删除”（已执行冲销事务。事务被冲销后，其原始HistoryMainline记录被保留，但“ReversalStatus”更改为已删除）。3 =“冲销”（已执行冲销事务。为每个“已删除”的事务创建新的HistoryMainline记录。新HistoryMainline的数据基于原始事务数据，但ReversalStatus设置为“冲销”。用户和日期时间戳反映ContainerTxnRev服务的详细信息。为冲销的事务创建对应的历史摘要和历史详细信息的新副本。在属性高级选项卡上标记了“Txn Reversal-Compensate”标志的字段（如历史详细信息中的数量字段）将被取反。“已删除”记录将具有正数量，“冲销”记录将具有负数量，当求和（即：报告）时，总计为零。
HistoryMainline.reversalStatus.en: The status of this record in relation to Transaction Reversal. Values are: 1 = "Active" A non-reversed transaction has been executed. The ReversalStatus is initially set to this value for all committed transactions. 2 = "Deleted" A reversal transaction has been executed. Once a transaction has been reversed, it's original HistoryMainline record is preserved, but the "ReversalStatus" is changed to deleted. 3 = "Reversal" A reversal transaction has been executed. A new HistoryMainline record is created for each "deleted" transaction. The data of the new HistoryMainline is based on the original transaction data, but the ReversalStatus is set to "Reversal". The User and DateTime stamp reflect the details of the ContainerTxnRev service. New copies of the corresponding history summaries and history details are created for the reversed transaction. Fields (such as the quantity fields in the history detail) are negated that have the flag "Txn Reversal-Compensate" checked on the Properties advanced tab. The "deleted" record will have a positive quantity, and the "reversal" record will have a negative quantity, and when summed (ie:reporting), the total will be zero.

HistoryMainline.server.zh: 处理事务的服务器的唯一标识符。
HistoryMainline.server.en: Unique identifier of the Server that processed the transaction.

HistoryMainline.serverName.zh: 存储运行服务的服务器名称。
HistoryMainline.serverName.en: Stores the name of the server running the service.

HistoryMainline.shiftName.zh: 通常适用于制造公司，这些公司的区域在一天中配备人员的时间足够长，以至于工人不会都在同一时间开始和结束一天的工作。班次是一种基于管理责任对生产信息进行分组的机制，管理责任针对在特定时间开始和离开的工人。例如，“白班”可能从早上 6 点到下午 6 点工作，“夜班”则从下午 6 点到早上 6 点工作。
HistoryMainline.shiftName.en: Typically applies to manufacturing companies that have areas staffed for a long enough during a day that workers do not all start and end their day at the same time. Shift is a mechanism for grouping production information based on management responsibilities for workers that start and leave at a particular time. For example, the "Day" shift might work from 6am to 6pm, and the "Night" shift would work from 6pm to 6am.

HistoryMainline.spec.zh: 规格（Spec）描述了在工作流中的步骤处发生的处理。它引用许多其他建模组件，包括工序、设置、数据采集定义和资源。规格还包括详细的计划和加工参数信息。规格被工作流中的步骤引用（使用）。许多工作流步骤可以使用一个规格。规格用于定义要执行的处理。工序用于定义物料通过工厂的流动或移动的（规则）。请参阅工序定义以获取计划详细信息。
HistoryMainline.spec.en: A specification (Spec) describes the processing that takes place at a Step within a Workflow. It references many other Modeling components including an Operation, Setup, Data Collection Definitions and Resources. Specs also include detailed scheduling and processing parameter information. A Spec is referenced (used) by a Step within a Workflow. Many Workflow Steps can use one Spec. A Spec is used to define the processing that is to be performed. An Operation is used to define (rules for) the flow or movement of Material through the Factory. See the Operation Definition for Scheduling Details information.

HistoryMainline.specPass.zh: 存储事务后的规格通过次数。因此对于移动，它显示目标步骤的规格通过次数。
HistoryMainline.specPass.en: Stores the Spec Pass after transaction. Hence for move, it shows the Spec Pass of the destination step.

HistoryMainline.status.zh: 确定此实例的当前状态（活动、非活动）。有效值及其含义：1 = 活动，2 = 非活动。
HistoryMainline.status.en: Determines the current status (Active, In-Active) of this instance. Valid values and their meanings are: 1 = Active 2 = Inactive

HistoryMainline.stepPass.zh: 容器通过此步骤的次数。
HistoryMainline.stepPass.en: The number of times the Container has passed through this Step.

HistoryMainline.systemDate.zh: 记录此事务的日期和时间。
HistoryMainline.systemDate.en: The date and time that this transaction was recorded.

HistoryMainline.systemDateGmt.zh: 记录此事务的日期和时间。
HistoryMainline.systemDateGmt.en: The date and time that this transaction was recorded.

HistoryMainline.txnDate.zh: 执行此事务所代表工作的日期和时间。
HistoryMainline.txnDate.en: The date and time the work represented by this transaction was performed.

HistoryMainline.txnDateGmt.zh: 执行此事务所代表工作的日期和时间。
HistoryMainline.txnDateGmt.en: The date and time the work represented by this transaction was performed.

HistoryMainline.txnId.zh: 用于标识此事务的唯一编号。此值用于逻辑链接（并在SQL中连接）与单个服务关联的所有条目。
HistoryMainline.txnId.en: Unique number used to identify this transaction. This value is used to logically link (and join in SQL) all of the entries associated with a single Service.

HistoryMainline.txnServiceName.zh: 服务的名称，并存储在现场服务的History Mainline中。
HistoryMainline.txnServiceName.en: The name of the service and is stored in History Mainline for shop floor services

HistoryMainline.txnServiceSequence.zh: 存储事务内正在执行的服务序列。在复合事务或调用其他容器事务的容器事务中，可能会调用多个服务。由于它们都具有相同的TxnId和TxnDate，因此此字段用于指示正在执行的服务的顺序。
HistoryMainline.txnServiceSequence.en: Stores the sequence of services being executed within a transaction. In a compound transaction or container transactions that calls other container transactions, multiple services may be called. Since all of them are having the same TxnId and TxnDate, this field is then used to indicate the sequence of services being executed.

HistoryMainline.txnType.en: Transaction type. Returns "MyMove" as opposed to "Move".

HistoryMainline.uom2Name.en: The UOM Name after the transaction.

HistoryMainline.uomName.en: The UOM Name after the transaction.

HistoryMainline.user.en: Identifies the person who recorded the transaction.

HistoryMainline.wipTrackingGroupKey.zh: i) 用于将插入分组在一起的主系统键。ii) 此值将从创建第一次插入时的实例 ID 复制。iii) 此值将复制到后续插入。
HistoryMainline.wipTrackingGroupKey.en: i) The main system key used to group the insertions together. ii) This value will be copied from the instance id when the 1st insertion is created. iii) This value will be copied over to subsequent insertions.

HistoryMainline.workflowName.zh: 事务执行后的工作流名称。
HistoryMainline.workflowName.en: The Workflow Name after the transaction is carried out.

HistoryMainline.workflowStep.zh: 发生事务（或开始，即对于诸如<Move>的事务写入<From>步骤）的工作流步骤。
HistoryMainline.workflowStep.en: Workflow Step where the transaction took place (or started, i.e. <From> step is written for transactions like <Move>).

HistoryMainline.workstation.zh: Resource描述工厂内的任何非物料实体。Resource的常见用途（也是最具体的示例）是描述机器。Resource与单个工厂关联以定义其物理位置。Resource还属于零个或多个Resource Group以提供逻辑分组。Resource是静态（建模）实体。每个Resource可以有一个Resource Status条目，用于跟踪每个已定义状态类别的当前状态。应用程序附带三个特定的状态类别：生产、预防性维护和日志。生产用于确定生产可用性。预防性维护用于跟踪Resource的当前预防性维护状态。日志用于提供记录自由格式注释以及可选分配预定义状态和原因代码的机制。客户可以定义其他状态类别，以多种用户定义的方式同时跟踪Resource状态。
HistoryMainline.workstation.en: A Resource describes any non-material entity within a factory. The common use (and most concrete example) of a Resource is to describe a Machine. Resources are associated with a single factory, to define their physical location. Resources also belong to zero or more Resource Groups, to provide a logical grouping. A Resource is a static (modeling) entity. Each Resource can have a Resource Status entry to track the current status for each Status Category defined. The application is delivered with three specific Status Categories. They are Production, Preventative Maintenance and Log. Production is used to determine availability for production. Preventative Maintenance is used to track the current Preventative Maintenance status for a Resource. Log is used to provide a mechanism for logging freeform comments and optionally assigning predefined status and reason codes. Customers can define additional Status categories to concurrently track Resource status is multiple user-defined ways.

HoldReason.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
HoldReason.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

HoldReason.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
HoldReason.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

HoldReason.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。
HoldReason.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions).

HoldReason.notes.zh: 与此对象关联的注释和评论。
HoldReason.notes.en: Notations and comments associated with this object.

HoldReason.setupAccess.zh: 用于验证用户对特定建模记录的访问权限。必须首先将一个或多个 Setup Access 分配给 Role。每个建模记录将有一个 Setup Access。当建模记录被事务处理时，系统将比较其 Setup Access。
HoldReason.setupAccess.en: This is used to verify the user's access to a particular modeling record. One or more Setup Access must first be assigned to a Role. Each modeling record will have one Setup Access. When a modeling record in transacted the system will compare its Setup Ac

HoldReason.wipMsgDefMgr.zh: 包含此CDO的WIP消息的WIP消息定义
HoldReason.wipMsgDefMgr.en: WIP Message Definition which contains WIP messages for this CDO

HoldReleaseHistory.holdReason.zh: 将保留代码与容器关联可阻止对该容器执行事务。保留代码由用户定义，为保留提供多种描述（原因）。
HoldReleaseHistory.holdReason.en: Associating a Hold Code with a Container prevents transactions from being performed for that Container. Hold Codes are User Defined to provide multiple descriptions (reasons) for Holds.

HoldReleaseHistory.integrationTxn.zh: 在复合/容器/资源事务后插入 TxnId 与历史主线。
HoldReleaseHistory.integrationTxn.en: Inserts the TxnId after a compound/container/resource transaction with history mainline.

HoldReleaseHistory.releaseReason.en: Reason code for releasing the Container

HoldReleaseHistoryDetail.container.en: The container entered in the service

HoldReleaseHistoryDetail.containerReleas.zh: 如果子容器被释放且不再处于保留状态（CurrentHoldCount = 0），它会为自身和所有祖先（其CurrentHoldCount = 0）生成HoldReleaseHistoryDetail记录。ContainerReleased字段用于记录不再处于保留状态的当前容器或祖先。
HoldReleaseHistoryDetail.containerReleas.en: If a child container is released and is no longer on hold( CurrentHoldCount = 0 ) it generates HoldReleaseHistoryDetail records for itself and all ancestors ( whose CurrentHoldCount = 0 ). The ContainerReleased field is used to record the current container or ancestors which are no longer on hold.

HoldReleaseHistoryDetail.holdDuration.zh: 容器处于保留状态的总持续时间（即首次保留和最后释放之间的时间差）。
HoldReleaseHistoryDetail.holdDuration.en: Is the total duration when the container was on hold ( i.e. the time difference between the first hold and last release)

HoldReleaseHistoryDetail.integrationTxn.zh: 在复合/容器/资源事务后插入 TxnId 与历史主线。
HoldReleaseHistoryDetail.integrationTxn.en: Inserts the TxnId after a compound/container/resource transaction with history mainline.

HoldStatus.holdMessage.zh: 如果对象处于保留状态，则显示保留消息。
HoldStatus.holdMessage.en: Hold Message to be displayed if object is on hold

HoldStatus.holdReason.zh: 将保留代码与对象关联可防止对该对象执行事务。保留代码是用户定义的，以提供多种保留描述（原因）。
HoldStatus.holdReason.en: Associating a Hold Code with a object prevents transactions from being performed for that objectHold Codes are User Defined to provide multiple descriptions (reasons) for Holds.

HoldStatus.lastRevTxn.zh: 最后一个可冲销交易的ID

HoldStatus.onHold.zh: 对象是否处于保留状态

HoldStatus.parent.zh: 包含此 CDO 的 CDO 的 Id。
HoldStatus.parent.en: Id of the CDO containing this CDO.

InspectionLevel.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
InspectionLevel.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

InspectionLevel.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
InspectionLevel.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

InspectionLevel.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。
InspectionLevel.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions).

InspectionLevel.notes.zh: 与此对象关联的注释和评论。
InspectionLevel.notes.en: Notations and comments associated with this object.

InspectionLevel.setupAccess.zh: 用于验证用户对特定建模记录的访问权限。必须首先将一个或多个 Setup Access 分配给 Role。每个建模记录将有一个 Setup Access。当建模记录被事务处理时，系统将比较其 Setup Access。

It is used to record the current Change (Maintenance) Status (i.e., maintenance is currently in progress for a specific Product Definition) and to track who made the last change and when. This should be extendible to a complete history over time.

IssueActualsHistory.resource.zh: Resource描述工厂内的任何非物料实体。Resource的常见用途（也是最具体的示例）是描述机器。Resource与单个工厂关联以定义其物理位置。Resource还属于零个或多个Resource Group以提供逻辑分组。Resource是静态（建模）实体。每个Resource可以有一个Resource Status条目，用于跟踪每个已定义状态类别的当前状态。应用程序附带三个特定的状态类别：生产、预防性维护和日志。生产用于确定生产可用性。预防性维护用于跟踪Resource的当前预防性维护状态。日志用于提供记录自由格式注释以及可选分配预定义状态和原因代码的机制。客户可以定义其他状态类别，以多种用户定义的方式同时跟踪Resource状态。
IssueActualsHistory.resource.en: A Resource describes any non-material entity within a factory. The common use (and most concrete example) of a Resource is to describe a Machine. Resources are associated with a single factory, to define their physical location. Resources also belong to zero or more Resource Groups, to provide a logical grouping. A Resource is a static (modeling) entity. Each Resource can have a Resource Status entry to track the current status for each Status Category defined. The application is delivered with three specific Status Categories. They are Production, Preventative Maintenance and Log. Production is used to determine availability for production. Preventative Maintenance is used to track the current Preventative Maintenance status for a Resource. Log is used to provide a mechanism for logging freeform comments and optionally assigning predefined status and reason codes. Customers can define additional Status categories to concurrently track Resource status is multiple user-defined ways.

IssueActualsHistory.substitutionReason.zh: 记录实际使用的产品与指定使用的产品不同的原因。
IssueActualsHistory.substitutionReason.en: Records the reason that the product actually used differed from the product specified for use.

IssueActualsHistory.vendorItem.zh: 作为组件发放的实际供应商物料。
IssueActualsHistory.vendorItem.en: The actual vendor item that was issued as a component.

KPIEntry.operation.zh: 工序是跟踪库存和生产活动的制造或加工点。工序描述诸如原因代码、工作中心以及物料通过工作流步骤的允许事务。相比之下，规格定义在工序处执行的特定加工。工序还提供过程的一般规则并提供一般报告结构。工序由工作流步骤处的规格引用。
KPIEntry.operation.en: An Operation is a manufacturing or processing point where inventory and production activities are tracked. The Operation describes such things as the reason codes, the work center, and the allowed transactions for the movement of material through a workflow step. In contrast, specifications define the specific processing that is performed at an operation. The Operation also provides the general rules for the process and provides a general reporting construct. An Operation is referenced by a specification at a workflow step.

KPIEntry.product.zh: 产品通常是对需要提供给客户的物料种类，或用作制造过程中的原材料或其他组件的物料种类的定义。产品可以属于产品族。要制造的产品将具有关联的工作流。工作流的属性可以被覆盖为产品特定。可选地，产品可以属于产品族。产品族用于分组产品，以简化维护任务（用于建模数据）。然后可以为产品族提供诸如成本或处理信息之类的公共属性，并应用于族中的每个产品。
KPIEntry.product.en: A Product is typically a definition of what kind of material needs to be provided to a customer or what kind of material is being used as a raw material or other component in a manufacturing process. Products can belong to a Product Family. A product to be manufactured will have an associated Workflow. Attributes of the Workflow may be overridden to be product specific. Optionally, a Product can belong to a Product Family. A Product Family is used to group products for the purpose of simplifying the maintenance task (for modeling data). Common attributes such as costing or processing information can then be provided for a Product Family and applied to each Product within the family.

KPIEntry.resource.zh: Resource描述工厂内的任何非物料实体。Resource的常见用途（也是最具体的示例）是描述机器。Resource与单个工厂关联以定义其物理位置。Resource还属于零个或多个Resource Group以提供逻辑分组。Resource是静态（建模）实体。每个Resource可以有一个Resource Status条目，用于跟踪每个已定义状态类别的当前状态。应用程序附带三个特定的状态类别：生产、预防性维护和日志。生产用于确定生产可用性。预防性维护用于跟踪Resource的当前预防性维护状态。日志用于提供记录自由格式注释以及可选分配预定义状态和原因代码的机制。客户可以定义其他状态类别，以多种用户定义的方式同时跟踪Resource状态。
KPIEntry.resource.en: A Resource describes any non-material entity within a factory. The common use (and most concrete example) of a Resource is to describe a Machine. Resources are associated with a single factory, to define their physical location. Resources also belong to zero or more Resource Groups, to provide a logical grouping. A Resource is a static (modeling) entity. Each Resource can have a Resource Status entry to track the current status for each Status Category defined. The application is delivered with three specific Status Categories. They are Production, Preventative Maintenance and Log. Production is used to determine availability for production. Preventative Maintenance is used to track the current Preventative Maintenance status for a Resource. Log is used to provide a mechanism for logging freeform comments and optionally assigning predefined status and reason codes. Customers can define additional Status categories to concurrently track Resource status is multiple user-defined ways.

KPIEntry.resourceType.zh: 资源类型，一种资源分类。具有相同资源类型的资源可能共享相同的资源状态模型。
KPIEntry.resourceType.en: Resource Type, a Resource categorization. Resources with the same Resource Type may share the same Resources Status Model.

KPIEntry.routeStep.zh: ERP 工艺路线中的步骤，是与 InSite 工作流最接近的 ERP 概念。ERP 工艺路线步骤通常定义在比 InSite 工作流步骤更汇总的级别。
KPIEntry.routeStep.en: A step in an ERPRoute, which is the closest ERP concept to an InSite workflow. ERP Route Steps are usually defined at a more summarized level than InSite workflow steps.

KPIEntry.spec.zh: 规格（Spec）描述了在工作流中的步骤处发生的处理。它引用许多其他建模组件，包括工序、设置、数据采集定义和资源。规格还包括详细的计划和加工参数信息。规格被工作流中的步骤引用（使用）。许多工作流步骤可以使用一个规格。规格用于定义要执行的处理。工序用于定义物料通过工厂的流动或移动的（规则）。请参阅工序定义以获取计划详细信息。
KPIEntry.spec.en: A specification (Spec) describes the processing that takes place at a Step within a Workflow. It references many other Modeling components including an Operation, Setup, Data Collection Definitions and Resources. Specs also include detailed scheduling and processing parameter information. A Spec is referenced (used) by a Step within a Workflow. Many Workflow Steps can use one Spec. A Spec is used to define the processing that is to be performed. An Operation is used to define (rules for) the flow or movement of Material through the Factory. See the Operation Definition for Scheduling Details information.

KPIEntry.uom.en: The user code for unit of material.

MasterRecipe.workflow.zh: 工作流定义了制造过程所需的路线和加工，是InSite工厂模型的主要驱动对象。当容器被创建（启动）时，它引用一个工作流（以及该工作流中的一个步骤）。Start事务的默认工作流是产品定义中引用的工作流。工作流是由路径和返工路径链接的步骤的集合。步骤引用其他工作流或规格，规格引用工序。注意，步骤、规格和工序的定义控制工作流中任何单独点的加工细节。
MasterRecipe.workflow.en: A Workflow defines the route and processing required for a manufacturing process, and is the primary driving object of the InSite factory model. When a Container is created (started) it references a Workflow (and a Step within that Workflow). The default Workflow for the Start transaction is the Workflow referenced in the Product definition. A Workflow is a collection of Steps that are linked by Paths and ReworkPaths. Steps reference either other Workflows or Specs, and a Spec references an Operation. Note that the definition of Step, Spec, and Operation controls the processing details at any individual point in the workflow.
