MfgOrder.erpRoute.zh: ERP路线是与InSite工作流最接近的ERP概念。InSite中的ERPRoute对象旨在镜像ERP中的路线定义，其中存储在ERP中的定义是“主”定义，而InSite ERPRoute通过LiveConnect填充。ERPRoute用于将InSite的Moves和ComponentIssues与发生事务的ERPStep相关联。ERP路线中的步骤通常比InSite工作流中的步骤定义在更汇总的级别。
MfgOrder.erpRoute.en: ERP Routes are the closest ERP concept to an InSite workflow. The ERPRoute object in InSite is meant to be a mirror of the route definitions in the ERP, where the definition stored in the ERP is the "master" and the InSite ERPRoute is populated via LiveConnect. The ERPRoute is used to be able to relate InSite Moves and ComponentIssues to the ERPStep where the transaction occurred. Steps in an ERP route are usually defined at a more summarized level than is true for steps in an InSite workflow.

MfgOrder.erpbom.zh: 指示此生产订单应使用的InSite ERPBOM
MfgOrder.erpbom.en: Indicates the InSite ERPBOM that should be used with this Mfg Order

MfgOrder.externallyControlled.zh: 指示此对象由InSite外部控制，并且InSite内的更新/编辑应受控制或限制。
MfgOrder.externallyControlled.en: Indicates that this object is controlled externally from InSite and updates/edits should be controlled or restricted within InSite

MfgOrder.holdStatus.zh: Hold Status是跟踪特定对象的保留状态的实例。
MfgOrder.holdStatus.en: Hold Status is an instance to keep track of the Hold Status of a certain object

MfgOrder.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
MfgOrder.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

MfgOrder.isCanceled.zh: 指示工单是否已取消的标志。可更新此标志以取消工单，使其不出现在批次排程中。
MfgOrder.isCanceled.en: Flag indicating whether the Work Order was canceled. This flag can be updated to cancel the Work Order such that it will not appear during Lot Schedule.

MfgOrder.isCompleted.zh: 指示工单是否完成的标志。当工单数量达到或超出，或达到大于0的ScheduleLimit且所有排程完成时，更新此值。
MfgOrder.isCompleted.en: Flag indicaiting whether the Work Order is completed. This value is updated when the Work Order quantity is met or exceeded or when the ScheduleLimit with value greater than 0 is reached and all schedules are completed.

MfgOrder.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。
MfgOrder.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions).

MfgOrder.notes.zh: 与此对象关联的注释和评论。
MfgOrder.notes.en: Notations and comments associated with this object.

MfgOrder.orderCompletionDate.zh: 存储订单完成时的时间戳。
MfgOrder.orderCompletionDate.en: Stores the timestamp when the order is completed.

MfgOrder.orderCompletionDateGmt.en: GMT value of Order Completion Date.

MfgOrder.orderStartDate.zh: 存储首次为工单创建排程时的时间戳。
MfgOrder.orderStartDate.en: Stores the timestamp when a schedule was first created for the Work Order.

MfgOrder.orderStartDateGmt.en: GMT value of Order Start Date.

MfgOrder.orderStatus.zh: ERP 生产订单状态。可包含如“已发放”、“已完成”、“处理中”、“已关闭”、“已取消”等值。
MfgOrder.orderStatus.en: ERP Production Order status. Can include values like "Released", "Completed", "In Process", "Closed", "Cancelled"

MfgOrder.orderType.zh: ERP 制造订单类型。此处可能出现的几个不同值包括：“标准”、“返工”、“试运行”等。
MfgOrder.orderType.en: ERP Manufaturing Order type. Several different values that can appear here include: "Standard", "Rework", "Test Run", etc

MfgOrder.plannedCompletionDate.zh: 指示此订单的计划完成日期
MfgOrder.plannedCompletionDate.en: Indicates the planned completion date for this order

MfgOrder.plannedCompletionDateGmt.zh: 指示此订单的计划完成日期
MfgOrder.plannedCompletionDateGmt.en: Indicates the planned completion date for this order

MfgOrder.plannedStartDate.zh: 指示此订单的计划开始日期
MfgOrder.plannedStartDate.en: Indicates the planned start date for this order

MfgOrder.plannedStartDateGmt.zh: 指示此订单的计划开始日期
MfgOrder.plannedStartDateGmt.en: Indicates the planned start date for this order

MfgOrder.postProductionCompleteDateGmt.zh: 生产后程序完成的时间

MfgOrder.postProductionProcedureState.zh: MfgOrderTaskState枚举：1-未开始，2-进行中，3-失败，4-完成
MfgOrder.postProductionProcedureState.en: MfgOrderTaskState 1 - Not Started 2 - In Progress 3 - Failed 4 - Complete

MfgOrder.postProductionStartDateGmt.zh: 生产后程序开始的时间。

MfgOrder.preProductionCompleteDateGmt.zh: 生产前程序完成的时间
MfgOrder.preProductionCompleteDateGmt.en: Time when pre-production procedure was completed

MfgOrder.preProductionProcedureRequired.zh: 指示此订单是否需要生产前程序。0=否，1=是，默认-1。首次移动/移入事务处理期间处理容器时，将查询工作流中任何设置RequirePreProductionProcedure选项的规格。若有规格具有该选项，字段值更新为1，否则设置为0。
MfgOrder.preProductionProcedureRequired.en: Indicates if a Pre-Production Procedure is required for this order. 0 = No 1 = Yes Default is -1. Processing during the first Move/MoveIn Txn for the a container will query the workflow for any spec with the RequirePreProductionProcedure option set. If any spec has it, the field value is updated to 1, else set to 0.

MfgOrder.preProductionProcedureState.zh: MfgOrderTaskState枚举：1-未开始，2-进行中，3-失败，4-完成
MfgOrder.preProductionProcedureState.en: MfgOrderTaskState 1 - Not Started 2 - In Progress 3 - Failed 4 - Complete

MfgOrder.preProductionStartDateGmt.zh: 生产前程序开始的时间

MfgOrder.priority.zh: ERP分配给此生产订单的优先级
MfgOrder.priority.en: ERP Assigned priority to this Production Order

MfgOrder.processSpec.zh: 可选ProcessSpec，如果指定则必须使用且不能更改。
MfgOrder.processSpec.en: Optional ProcessSpec that must be used and not changed if specified.

MfgOrder.product.zh: 标识为完成此生产订单要创建的（最终）产品
MfgOrder.product.en: Identifies the (final) product to be created to fulfill this Manufacturing Order

MfgOrder.productBom.zh: 用于指定工单BOM的可选字段。
MfgOrder.productBom.en: Optional field to specify the BOM to be used for the Work Order.

MfgOrder.qty.zh: 标识为完成此生产订单要生产的（最终）数量
MfgOrder.qty.en: Identifies the (final) quantity to be produced to fulfill this Manufacturing Order

MfgOrder.qty2.zh: 标识为完成此生产订单要生产的（最终）数量
MfgOrder.qty2.en: Identifies the (final) quantity to be produced to fulfill this Manufacturing Order

MfgOrder.releaseDate.zh: 指示此订单从ERP下发给InSite的日期
MfgOrder.releaseDate.en: Indicates the date this order was released from the ERP down to InSite

MfgOrder.releaseDateGmt.zh: 指示此订单从ERP下发给InSite的日期
MfgOrder.releaseDateGmt.en: Indicates the date this order was released from the ERP down to InSite

MfgOrder.reportingFactory.zh: 拥有此订单的ERP业务实体。通常但不总是等同于处理订单的InSite工厂。
MfgOrder.reportingFactory.en: ERP business entity that owns this Order. This will typically but not always equate to the InSite factory that is processing the order.

MfgOrder.scheduleCanceled.zh: 存储工单已取消的排程数量。排程取消时自动更新此值。
MfgOrder.scheduleCanceled.en: Stores the number of schedules that was canceled for the Work Order. This value will be automatically updated when a schedule is canceled.

MfgOrder.scheduleCompleted.zh: 存储工单已完成的排程数量。排程成功完成时自动更新此值。
MfgOrder.scheduleCompleted.en: Stores the number of schedules completed for the Work Order. This value will be automatically updated when a schedule completes successfully.

MfgOrder.scheduleCount.zh: 存储工单所使用的排程数量。为工单创建排程时自动更新此值。
MfgOrder.scheduleCount.en: Stores the number of schedules used for the Work Order. This value is automatically updated when a schedule is created for the Work Order.

MfgOrder.scheduleLimit.zh: 此字段用于指示满足工单所允许的最大排程数量。如果完成数量达到或超出所需数量，则工单视为完成。值为0或更小表示无限制，因此该工单
MfgOrder.scheduleLimit.en: This field is used to indicate the maximum number of schedules allowed to meet the Work Order. A Work Order is considered completed if the completed quantity meets or exceeds its required quantity. A value of 0 or less means no limits hence the Work Or

MfgOrder.scheduleQty.zh: 存储工单的总排程数量。创建排程时更新此值。
MfgOrder.scheduleQty.en: Stores the total quantity scheduled for the Work Order. This value will be updated when a schedule is created.

MfgOrder.scheduleQtyCanceled.zh: 存储已取消排程的数量。通过LotScheduleCancel取消排程时更新此值。
MfgOrder.scheduleQtyCanceled.en: Stores the quantity from schedules that were canceled. This value will be updated when a schedule is canceled through LotScheduleCancel.

MfgOrder.scheduleQtyCompleted.zh: 存储工单的总完成数量。当排程从WIP完成到INVENTORY时更新此值。
MfgOrder.scheduleQtyCompleted.en: Stores the total quantity completed for the Work Order. This value is updated when the schedule completes from WIP to INVENTORY.

MfgOrder.scheduleType.zh: 可选值，用于指示订单所需的排程类型。如果未输入值，任何排程类型均可使用。有效值包括：i) WAFER ii) WAFERSORT iii) ASSEMBLYCARRIER iv) ASSEMBLYMOTHERLOT v) ASSEMBLYSUBLOT vi) BACKG
MfgOrder.scheduleType.en: Optional value used to indicate the type of schedule required for the order. If a value is not entered any schedule type can be used. Valid values include: i) WAFER ii) WAFERSORT iii) ASSEMBLYCARRIER iv) ASSEMBLYMOTHERLOT v) ASSEMBLYSUBLOT vi) BACKG

MfgOrder.setupAccess.zh: 用于验证用户对特定建模记录的访问权限。必须首先将一个或多个 Setup Access 分配给 Role。每个建模记录将有一个 Setup Access。当建模记录被事务处理时，系统将比较其 Setup Access。
MfgOrder.setupAccess.en: This is used to verify the user's access to a particular modeling record. One or more Setup Access must first be assigned to a Role. Each modeling record will have one Setup Access. When a modeling record in transacted the system will compare its Setup Ac

MfgOrder.uom.zh: 包含生产订单所需产品的计量单位。
MfgOrder.uom.en: Contains the unit of measure associated with product required by the manufacturing order.

MfgOrder.uom2.zh: 包含生产订单所需产品的辅助计量单位。仅当产品容器使用辅助计量单位跟踪时使用此字段。
MfgOrder.uom2.en: Contains the secondary unit of measure associated with product required by the manufacturing order. This field is only used if the product containers use secondary unit of measure tracking.

MfgOrder.wipMsgDefMgr.zh: 附加到建模实体实例，包含适用于该实体的消息。当被要求提供其WIP消息时，建模实体将要求其WIPMsgDefMgr提供已过滤的WIP消息列表，仅包含适用于当前情况（步骤、操作和标签）的消息。WIPMsgDefMgr将检查AllKey WIPMsgKey（如果指定，包含适用于所有步骤的消息），并遍历OperationKeys和LabelKeys列表中的条目，过滤找到的每条消息。
MfgOrder.wipMsgDefMgr.en: Attached to an instance of a modeling entity, this contains the messages that apply to the entity. When asked to supply its WIP Messages, a modeling entity will ask its WIPMsgDefMgr to supply a list of WIP Messages that have been filtered to include only the messages that apply to the current circumstances (step, operation and label). The WIPMsgDefMgr will check the AllKey WIPMsgKey (which contains a message that applies to all steps) if specified, and run through the entries in the OperationKeys and LabelKeys lists and filter each message found.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.adjustmentType.zh: 此字段定义调整的类型（例如百分比或数量）。所选类型决定如何解释和应用 AdjustmentValue 以进行自动调整计算。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.adjustmentType.en: This field defines the type of the adjustment (e.g. Percentage or Quantity). The chosen type determines how the AdjustmentValue is interpreted and applied for the auto-adjustment calculations.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.adjustmentValue.zh: 此字段定义用于自动调整计算的值，基于所选的调整类型。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.adjustmentValue.en: This field defines the value used for auto-adjustments calculations based on the chosen Adjustment Type.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.allowAllRevisio.zh: 为 true 时，将允许物料需求使用产品的所有修订版。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.allowAllRevisio.en: When true it will allow all revisions of the product to be allowed for the material requirement

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.allowOverConsum.zh: 此标志确定物料消耗检查是否允许发放多于 MaterialListItem 条目中指定的物料。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.allowOverConsum.en: This flag determines if the material consumption check will allow more materials to be issued than specified in the MaterialListItem entry

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.allowSubstituti.zh: 允许替代要发放的产品。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.allowSubstituti.en: Allow substitution of the product to be issued.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.allowUnderConsu.zh: 此标志确定物料消耗检查是否允许发放少于 MaterialListItem 条目中指定的物料。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.allowUnderConsu.en: This flag determines if the material consumption check will allow less materials to be issued than specified in the MaterialListItem entry

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.assemblySequenc.zh: 物料应被组装的顺序。仅当物料分配给步骤/规格时，此值才使用。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.assemblySequenc.en: Sequence the item should be assembled. The value is only used if the item is assigned to a Step/Spec

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.defaultLot.zh: 如果需要发放特定批次/批次的组件，这将指示要发放的批次/批次标识
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.defaultLot.en: If a specific lot/batch of the component needs to be issued, this would indicate the lot/batch indicator to be issued

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.defaultStockPoi.zh: 如果组件需要从库存系统内的特定位置拉取，这将指示该位置。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.defaultStockPoi.en: If the component needs to be pulled from a specific location within the Inventory System, this would indicate it.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.effectiveFromDa.zh: 如果指定，这是此需求变为可用的开始日期和时间。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.effectiveFromDa.en: If specified, this is the starting date and time when this Requirement becomes available.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.effectiveFromDa.zh: 如果指定，这是此需求变为可用的开始日期和时间。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.effectiveFromDa.en: If specified, this is the starting date and time when this Requirement becomes available.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.effectiveThruDa.zh: 如果指定，这是此需求不再可用的结束日期和时间。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.effectiveThruDa.en: If specified, this is the ending date and time when this Requirement becomes no longer available.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.effectiveThruDa.zh: 如果指定，这是此需求不再可用的结束日期和时间。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.effectiveThruDa.en: If specified, this is the ending date and time when this Requirement becomes no longer available.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.erpLineItem.zh: 指示来自 ERP 的 BOM 结构中唯一标识此行项目的行指示符
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.erpLineItem.en: indicates the Line indicator within the BOM structure from the ERP that uniquely identifies this line item

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.erpReportingFla.zh: 用于指示此组件是否需要将实际数量报告回 ERP，或者 ERP 内部是否会发生反冲而不需要报告此数量。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.erpReportingFla.en: Used to indicate if this component needs to have actual qty reported back to ERP or if a backflush will occur within the ERP that does not require this to be reported.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.isEnabled.zh: 根据状态和生效日期及截止日期确定是否应考虑处理 CDO。如果在 CDO 中未找到字段，则假定为肯定结果。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.isEnabled.en: Determines, based on Status and Effective From and Thru dates whether a CDO should be considered for processing. If a field is not found within the CDO, a positive result is assumed.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.isImage.zh: 与物料列表项关联的图像
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.isImage.en: Image associated to the material list item

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.isPhantom.zh: 表示这是一个虚拟物料列表项。虚拟项不是实际物料，而是从 BOM 结构中的组件项分组中人为构造的，以减少 BOM 维护。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.isPhantom.en: Denotes this is a phantom material list item. Phantom items are not actual materials, but are artifical constructs added from grouping component items in a BOM structure to reduce BOM maintenance.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.isSourceProduct.zh: 指示是否应将产品用作构建目标产品的源物料的标志。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.isSourceProduct.en: Flag indicating whether the Product should be used as the source material to build the target Product.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.issueControl.zh: 1 - 容器在 InSite 中以序列级别跟踪 2 - 容器在 InSite 中以批量级别跟踪 3 - 容器不在 InSite 中跟踪...记录数量和批次 4 - 非批次控制（现场库存）记录位置无容器 5 - 记录数量但不记录容器或位置 6 - 发放数量显示但不记录
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.issueControl.en: 1 - Container is tracked in InSite at the serial level 2 - Container is tracked in InSite at the bulk level 3 - Container is not tracked in InSite ... quantity and lot is recorded 4 - non lot controlled ( floor stock ) location is recorded no container 5 - recording quantities but not container or location 6 - issue quantities are displayed but not recorded

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.name.zh: 名称子实体的唯一名称。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.name.en: Unique name for the name subentity.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.parentRevision.zh: 修订版本（在基础实体上下文中唯一）
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.parentRevision.en: Revision (unique within the context of the base entity)

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.phantomBill.zh: 物料清单定义了生产特定产品所需的物料。虚拟 BOM 是不存在实际装配的产品的物料清单，仅用于保存一组相关组件。当这种逻辑组件分组用于许多成品时，创建虚拟 BOM 以减少维护工作，这样逻辑组件组的维护可以在一处完成。注意物料列表项上直接引用的虚拟 BOM 通常只是指向与物料列表项关联的产品定义的 BOM 的指针。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.phantomBill.en: A bill of material defines the materials needed to produce a specific product. A Phantom Bill is a bill of material for a product that does not exist as an actual assembly, but is created only for the purpose of holding a group of related components. A phantom bill is created to reduce maintenance efforts, when such a logical grouping of components is used for many finished products, so that the maintenance of the logical group of components can be done in one place only. Note the Phantom Bill referenced on the material list item directly will ordinarily just be a pointer to a bill defined as part of the associated Product referenced by the material list item.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.producingOrder.zh: 最长 255 个字符的字符串字段。

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.qty2Required.zh: 如果跟踪多个数量，则此组件项所需的数量。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.qty2Required.en: Quantity of this component item required, if multiple quantities are being tracked.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.qtyIssued.zh: 已为该物料发放的材料数量（单独）
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.qtyIssued.en: Material quantity (individual) that has been issued for the item

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.qtyRequired.en: Quantity of this component item required.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.referenceDesign.zh: 此物料放置在装配体上或内部的特定位置。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.referenceDesign.en: The specific position on or in the assembly where this item is placed.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.routeStep.zh: ERP 工艺路线中的步骤，是与 InSite 工作流最接近的 ERP 概念。ERP 工艺路线步骤通常定义在比 InSite 工作流步骤更汇总的级别。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.routeStep.en: A step in an ERPRoute, which is the closest ERP concept to an InSite workflow. ERP Route Steps are usually defined at a more summarized level than InSite workflow steps.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.scrapPercent.zh: 此物料预计报废的百分比。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.scrapPercent.en: Percent of this item expected to be scrapped.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.scsIsComponentI.zh: 指示物料是通过 CEP Component Issue 还是 SCS Material Consumption 逻辑消耗的标志。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.scsIsComponentI.en: Flag to denote if the material is to be consumed via CEP Component Issue or SCS Material Consumption logic

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.setupQty.zh: 初始化处理资源所需的此组件项的数量。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.setupQty.en: The amount of this component item needed to initialize the processing resource.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.setupQty2.zh: 初始化处理资源所需的此组件项的数量。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.setupQty2.en: The amount of this component item needed to initialize the processing resource.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.subFactory.zh: 用于指示此组件是否需要从特定的库存桶拉取。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.subFactory.en: used to indicate if this component needs to be pulled from a specific bucket of inventory.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.uom.en: The unit of measure for the QtyRequired.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.uom2.en: The unit of measure for Qty2Required.

MfgOrderMaterialListItem.vendorControl.zh: 指示此物料是否需要供应商信息。
MfgOrderMaterialListItem.vendorControl.en: Denotes whether Vendor information is required for this item.

MfgOrderProcedure.changeHistory.zh: 每个建模实体都包含 Change Status。它用于记录当前的变更（维护）状态（例如，特定 Product Definition 的维护正在进行中），并跟踪最后一次更改的人员和时间。这应该可扩展为随时间变化的完整历史记录。
MfgOrderProcedure.changeHistory.en: Every modeling entity includes a Change Status. It is used to record the current Change (Maintenance) Status (i.e., maintenance is currently in progress for a specific Product Definition) and to track who made the last change and when. This should be extendible to a complete history over time.

MfgOrderProcedure.completedOrderStatus.zh: 程序完成时在生产订单上设置的状态。
MfgOrderProcedure.completedOrderStatus.en: Status to set on Mfg Order when procedure is complete.

MfgOrderProcedure.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
MfgOrderProcedure.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

MfgOrderProcedure.displayMode.zh: 标识电子程序在UI上的显示方式。1=下钻，2=大纲
MfgOrderProcedure.displayMode.en: Identifies how the Electronic Procedure is to be displayed on the UI. 1 = DrillDown 2 = Outline

MfgOrderProcedure.executionMode.zh: 标识电子程序中的TaskList是否按顺序处理。1=顺序，2=非顺序
MfgOrderProcedure.executionMode.en: Identifies whether the TaskLists in the Electronic Procedure are to be processed in sequence. 1 = Sequential 2 = Non-Sequential

MfgOrderProcedure.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
MfgOrderProcedure.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

MfgOrderProcedure.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例进行更改。
MfgOrderProcedure.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance

MfgOrderProcedure.keepCompletedTasks.zh: 为true时将防止删除容器在当前步骤的ContainerCompletedTasks数据
MfgOrderProcedure.keepCompletedTasks.en: When true will prevent deleting ContainerCompletedTasks data for the container at the current step

MfgOrderProcedure.keepCompletedTasksOnOp.zh: 为true时不删除任何已完成任务历史
MfgOrderProcedure.keepCompletedTasksOnOp.en: When true will not delete any completed task history

MfgOrderProcedure.notes.zh: 与此对象关联的注释和评论。
MfgOrderProcedure.notes.en: Notations and comments associated with this object.

MfgOrderProcedure.revision.zh: 修订版本（在基础实体上下文中唯一）
MfgOrderProcedure.revision.en: Revision (unique within the context of the base entity)

MfgOrderProcedure.status.zh: 确定此实例的当前状态（活动、非活动）。有效值及其含义为：1 = 活动 2 = 非活动。注意，对于活动与非活动修订版本，没有强制执行的验证（规则）。
MfgOrderProcedure.status.en: Determines the current status (Active, In-Active) of this instance. Valid values and their meanings are: 1 = Active 2 = Inactive Note there are no validations (rules enforced) concerning active vs. inactive revisions.

MfgOrderProcedure.wipMsgDefMgr.zh: WIP消息定义，包含适用于此实体的所有WIP消息的WIP消息键列表。

MfgOrderTaskList.changeHistory.zh: 每个建模实体都包含 Change Status。它用于记录当前的变更（维护）状态（例如，特定 Product Definition 的维护正在进行中），并跟踪最后一次更改的人员和时间。这应该可扩展为随时间变化的完整历史记录。
MfgOrderTaskList.changeHistory.en: Every modeling entity includes a Change Status. It is used to record the current Change (Maintenance) Status (i.e., maintenance is currently in progress for a specific Product Definition) and to track who made the last change and when. This should be extendible to a complete history over time.

MfgOrderTaskList.variantExpression.en: Variant expression to be resolved to allow for filtering out configurable activities.

MfgOrderTaskList.workstationGroup.zh: 可处理TaskList的工作站组。这允许执行等效处理的多个工作站分配到不同工作单元。
MfgOrderTaskList.workstationGroup.en: A group of Workstations that can process the TaskList. This allows multiple Workstations that perform equivalent processing to be assigned to different WorkCells.

MfgOrderTaskStatus.taskComplete.en: Indicates that a task with this status will be considered complete.

MfgOrderTaskStatus.taskFailed.zh: 指示具有此状态的生产订单任务处于失败状态。
MfgOrderTaskStatus.taskFailed.en: Indicates that an Mfg Order Task with this status is in a failed state.

MoveHistory.childCount.zh: 指示与正在执行服务的父容器关联的直接子容器数量。
MoveHistory.childCount.en: This indicates the number of direct child containers associated to the parent container for which the service is being performed.

MoveHistory.cycleTime.zh: 当前，CycleTime字段与ElapsedTime字段保持相同值。最终，此字段旨在保存Elapsed Time减去非计划时间（在Mfg Calendar中定义为该工作中心的非工作时间）。
MoveHistory.cycleTime.en: Currently, the CycleTime field holds the same value as the ElapsedTime field. Eventually, the intent of this field is to hold the Elapsed Time minus the non-scheduled time (defined in the Mfg Calendar as non-working time for this Work Center).

MoveHistory.elapsedTime.zh: 此事务的TxnDate与ContainerCurrentStatus中的LastMoveDate之间的持续时间（时间差）。LastMoveDate由Start、MoveIn和Move类型服务更新。
MoveHistory.elapsedTime.en: Duration (time difference) between the TxnDate of this transaction and the LastMoveDate found in the ContainerCurrentStatus. The LastMoveDate is updated by Start, MoveIn, and Move type services.

MoveHistory.integrationTxn.zh: 在复合/容器/资源事务后插入 TxnId 与历史主线。
MoveHistory.integrationTxn.en: Inserts the TxnId after a compound/container/resource transaction with history mainline.

MoveHistory.location.zh: 定义工厂内的物理位置。可以是定义整个工厂的单个位置，也可以是存放区域内每个箱体的单独位置。每个Container都包含一个Location属性，用于标识Container的物理位置并生成按位置统计的WIP等报告。
MoveHistory.location.en: Defines a physical location within a Factory. This can be as high level as a single Location that defines the entire Factory or as specific as individual Locations for each bin within a holding area. Every Container includes a Location attribute. This is used to identify the physical location of the Container and produce reports such as WIP by Location.

MoveHistory.moveAllQty.zh: 用于指示容器全量是否已移到下一工序。“true”值（选中）表示容器全量已移动。“false”值仅在复合事务上下文中有意义，此时用户必须指定要移动的数量，并使用ChangeQty服务处理差异。（在V1.4中可用）。
MoveHistory.moveAllQty.en: Used to indicate whether or not the entire quantity of the container was moved to the next operation. A "true" value (checked) indicates that the entire quantity of the container was moved. A value of "false" only makes sense in the context of a compound transaction, where the user must specify the quantity to be moved, and must account for the differences using the ChangeQty service. (Available in V1.4).

MoveHistory.owner.zh: 事务发生时容器的Owner属性。提供此字段便于报告。
MoveHistory.owner.en: The Owner attribute of the container at the time of the transaction. This field is provided for ease of reporting.

MoveHistory.path.zh: 服务实际使用的路径。此路径可由用户输入，通过路径选择器评估确定，或由事务开始时容器所在WorkflowStep的默认路径标记确定。
MoveHistory.path.en: The path actually used by the service. This path could have been input by the user, determined from path selector evaluation, or determined by the path marked as the default path for the WorkflowStep where the container was located at the beginning of the transaction.

MoveHistory.product.zh: 事务发生时容器的Product属性。提供此字段便于报告。
MoveHistory.product.en: The Product attribute of the container at the time of the transaction. This field is provided for ease of reporting.

MoveHistory.qty.zh: 正在处理的物料数量。每个数量都有对应的计量单位。注意，如果同时跟踪两个计量单位，Qty2字段也将包含一个值。
MoveHistory.qty.en: The quantity of material being processed. Each quanity has a corresponding Unit of Measure. Note that if two Units of Measure are being tracked concurrently, the Qty2 field will also contain a value.

MoveHistory.qty2.zh: 正在处理的物料数量。每个数量都有对应的计量单位。仅当需要同时跟踪2个计量单位时才使用此字段。例如，指定容器时可能需要同时记录长度和重量作为数量。
MoveHistory.qty2.en: A quantity of material being processed. Each quantity has a corresponding unit of measure. This field is only used if 2 units of measure need to be tracked at once. For instance, when specifying a container one might need to record both length and weight as quantities.

MoveHistory.run.zh: 事务发生时Resource ProductionStatus中的“Run”字段。提供此字段便于报告。
MoveHistory.run.en: The "Run" field from the Resource ProductionStatus at the time of the transaction. This field is provided for ease of reporting.

MoveHistory.setup.zh: 事务发生时Resource ProductionStatus中的“Setup”字段。提供此字段便于报告。
MoveHistory.setup.en: The "Setup" field from the Resource ProductionStatus at the time of the transaction. This field is provided for ease of reporting.

MoveHistory.step.zh: 这是容器移动的起始步骤。
MoveHistory.step.en: This is the step from which the container was moved.

MoveHistory.toLocation.zh: 容器正在移入的工厂当前物理位置。
MoveHistory.toLocation.en: The current physical location in the factory that the Container is being moved to.

MoveHistory.toResource.zh: 此字段指示容器移动到的资源。资源定义为需要跟踪/度量的非WIP实体，如机器、人员或存储位置。
MoveHistory.toResource.en: This field indicates which resource the container was moved to. A resource is defined as a non-WIP entity which needs to be tracked/measured, such as a machine, person or storage location.

MoveHistory.toSpec.zh: 规格（Spec）描述了在工作流中的步骤处发生的处理。它引用许多其他建模组件，包括工序、设置、数据采集定义和资源。规格还包括详细的计划和加工参数信息。规格被工作流中的步骤引用（使用）。许多工作流步骤可以使用一个规格。规格用于定义要执行的处理。工序用于定义物料通过工厂的流动或移动的（规则）。请参阅工序定义以获取计划详细信息。
MoveHistory.toSpec.en: A specification (Spec) describes the processing that takes place at a Step within a Workflow. It references many other Modeling components including an Operation, Setup, Data Collection Definitions and Resources. Specs also include detailed scheduling and processing parameter information. A Spec is referenced (used) by a Step within a Workflow. Many Workflow Steps can use one Spec. A Spec is used to define the processing that is to be performed. An Operation is used to define (rules for) the flow or movement of Material through the Factory. See the Operation Definition for Scheduling Details information.

MoveHistory.toStep.zh: 容器被发送到的工作流步骤。此步骤可由用户输入，或根据所使用的路径确定。
MoveHistory.toStep.en: The Workflow Step where the container was sent. This step could have been input by the user, or determined based on the path that was used.

MoveHistory.unitCount.zh: 这是正在执行服务的容器结构内的单位容器数量。
MoveHistory.unitCount.en: This is the number of unit containers within the container structure for which the service is being performed.

MoveHistory.uom.zh: 与Qty字段中存储的数量对应的计量单位。
MoveHistory.uom.en: The Unit of Measure corresponding to the quantity stored in the Qty field.

MoveHistory.uom2.zh: 与Qty2字段中存储的数量对应的计量单位。
MoveHistory.uom2.en: The Unit of Measure corresponding to the quantity stored in the Qty2 field.

MoveInHistory.childCount.zh: 指示与正在执行服务的父容器关联的直接子容器数量。
MoveInHistory.childCount.en: This indicates the number of direct child containers associated to the parent container for which the service is being performed.

Every Container includes a Location attribute. This is used to identify the physical location of the Container and produce reports such as WIP by Location.

NCRDefectData.actualComponentIssue.en: Records the actual values issued to meet the BOM line item requirements

NCRDefectData.container.zh: 跟踪已发放且被确定为有缺陷的组件物料的容器。
NCRDefectData.container.en: The container that tracked the component material issued, that has been determined to be defective.

NCRDefectData.lot.zh: 对于未作为InSite容器跟踪的组件，通常使用批号来跟踪组件；在这种情况下，已发现有缺陷的组件。
NCRDefectData.lot.en: For components not tracked as InSite containers, a lot number is often used to track the component; in this case, the component that has been found to be defective.

NCRDefectData.parent.zh: 包含此 CDO 的 CDO 的 Id。
NCRDefectData.parent.en: Id of the CDO containing this CDO.

NCRDefectData.product.zh: 此产品是已发放且发现有缺陷的组件产品。
NCRDefectData.product.en: This product is the component product issued that was found to be defective.

NCRDefectData.referenceDesignator.zh: 标识有缺陷的组件物料发放到容器时所在的具体位置。
NCRDefectData.referenceDesignator.en: Identification of where the defective component material was positioned phsically when issued to the container.

NonconformanceReport.chargeToStep.zh: ChargeToStep是问题发生的处理步骤。即将创建的不符合报告将跟踪此步骤。
NonconformanceReport.chargeToStep.en: The ChargeToStep is the processing step where the problem occurred. This step will be tracked by the nonconformance report that is about to be created.

NonconformanceReport.closeDate.zh: 记录不符合状态设置为“已关闭”日期的TimeStamp。
NonconformanceReport.closeDate.en: TimeStamp that records the date the status of the nonconformance was set to "closed".

NonconformanceReport.closeDateGmt.zh: 记录不符合状态设置为“已关闭”日期的TimeStamp。
NonconformanceReport.closeDateGmt.en: TimeStamp that records the date the status of the nonconformance was set to "closed".

NonconformanceReport.container.zh: 此不符合报告所适用的容器。
NonconformanceReport.container.en: The container to which this nonconformance report applies.

NonconformanceReport.correctiveActionCom.zh: 对修复此不符合所记录的具体问题而采取步骤的文档记录。
NonconformanceReport.correctiveActionCom.en: Documentation of the steps that were taken to fix the specific problem documented by this nonconformance.

NonconformanceReport.creationDate.zh: 创建此不符合的NCRCreate事务的TxnDate时间戳。
NonconformanceReport.creationDate.en: The TxnDate timestamp for the NCRCreate transaction which created this nonconformance.

NonconformanceReport.creationDateGmt.zh: 创建此不符合的NCRCreate事务的TxnDate时间戳。
NonconformanceReport.creationDateGmt.en: The TxnDate timestamp for the NCRCreate transaction which created this nonconformance.

NonconformanceReport.failureInvestigatio.zh: 导致此不符合所描述问题的促成因素的文档记录。
NonconformanceReport.failureInvestigatio.en: Documentation of contributing factors that resulted in the problem described by this nonconformance.

NonconformanceReport.lastRevTxn.zh: 对此不符合执行的最后一次被配置为可逆的事务。
NonconformanceReport.lastRevTxn.en: The last transacation perfomed against this nonconformance that is configured to be reversible.

NonconformanceReport.ncrCauseCode.zh: 识别物料失效的根本原因。
NonconformanceReport.ncrCauseCode.en: Identifies the Root Cause of why the material failed.

NonconformanceReport.ncrCauseCodeGroup.zh: 表示一组NCRCauseCode的用户代码对象组。NCRCauseCodeGroup用于组织NCRCauseCode，使用户更容易找到相关的CauseCode。
NonconformanceReport.ncrCauseCodeGroup.en: A User Code Object Group that represents a group of NCRCauseCodes. NCRCauseCodeGroups are used to organize NCRCauseCodes, so the user can more easily find the pertinent CauseCode.

NonconformanceReport.ncrFailureType.zh: 提供对不符合失败进行分类的方法。例如“可重复”与“间歇性”。
NonconformanceReport.ncrFailureType.en: Provides a means to categorize Nonconformance failures. For example "repeatable" vs. "intermittent".

NonconformanceReport.ncrResolutionCode.zh: 识别为解决不合格所采取的措施。例如“原样使用”或“报废”。
NonconformanceReport.ncrResolutionCode.en: Identifies what was done to resolve a Nonconformance. Examples would be "Use As Is" or "Scrap".

NonconformanceReport.ncrStatus.zh: 不符合的当前状态。此值用于区分打开和关闭的不符合。有效值及其含义：1=打开，2=关闭
NonconformanceReport.ncrStatus.en: Current status of the Nonconformance. This value is used to distinguish between Nonconformance that are open and closed. Valid values and their meanings are: 1= Open 2 = Closed

NonconformanceReport.preventiveActionCom.zh: 对为确保此类问题不再发生而采取行动的文档记录。
NonconformanceReport.preventiveActionCom.en: Documentation of the actions that were taken to ensure that this type of problem does not continue to occur.

NonconformanceReport.relatedNonconforman.zh: 如果此不符合是针对用作另一容器中组件的容器注册的，则此“相关不符合”标识跟踪在更高级别容器中发现的原始问题的不符合。
NonconformanceReport.relatedNonconforman.en: If this nonconformance was registered against a container that was used as a component in another container, this "related nonconformance" identifies the nonconformance that tracks the original problem that was found in the higher-level container.

NonconformanceReport.task.zh: 添加此不符合报告所针对的任务。
NonconformanceReport.task.en: The Task for which this NonconformanceReport was added.

NumberingRule.sequenceLength.en: The maximum length of the number that will be used in the sequence.

NumberingRule.txnDataKey.zh: 当使用Values列表生成下一个序列时使用的字段。Txn Key的解析值将存储在TxnData列表中，以允许每个设置使用多个序列。例如，一个编号规则设置可由多个设备用于生成

NumberingRule.useHexadecimalValue.zh: 用于配置编号规则使用十六进制值而非整数的标志
NumberingRule.useHexadecimalValue.en: A flag to configure Numbering Rule to use Hexadecimal value instead of Integer

NumberingRule.usePrefixBased.en: Use Prefix Based Last Assigned Sequence

NumberingRule.useValues.en: Flag indicating whether to use the Values list to get the next sequence instead of the Sequence Length.

NumberingRuleMap.category.en: A list of categories that support auto number generation.

Operation.actionsMenu.en: Actions menus are used to create set of items linked to UIVirtualPages.

Operation.autoAdjustReason.zh: ObjectGroup用于提供对象列表，例如特定类型的资源、产品或用户代码列表。这些列表通常用于验证和选择。例如，工序包含对LossCodeGroup的引用。此列表中的条目定义容器在该工序时执行工作的有效Loss（原因）代码。ObjectGroup实例包括特定对象列表和ObjectGroup列表。任何给定ObjectGroup的对象列表限制为特定类型（或其任何派生类型）。同样，ObjectGroup内的ObjectGroup列表也限制为相同类型（或其任何派生类型）。
Operation.autoAdjustReason.en: An ObjectGroup is used to provide a list of objects, such as a list of Resources, Products or User Codes of a particular type. These lists are typically used for validation and selection. For example, an Operation includes a reference to a LossCodeGroup. The entries in this list define the valid Loss (reason) Codes for work performed while a Container is at that Operation. An instance of an ObjectGroup includes a list of specific objects and a list of ObjectGroups. This list of objects for any given ObjectGroup is restricted to a specific type (or any of its derived types). Likewise, the list of ObjectGroup s within the ObjectGroup is restricted to the same type (or any of its derived types).

Operation.bonusReasons.zh: 此工序允许的Bonus代码列表的Id。
Operation.bonusReasons.en: Id of the List for Bonus codes allowed at this Operation.

Operation.containerDefectReasons.zh: 此工序允许的Defect代码列表的Id。
Operation.containerDefectReasons.en: Id of the List for Defect codes allowed at this Operation.

Operation.defaultRollupReason.zh: 此原因代码被放入作为详细信息汇总（rollup）生成的历史记录中。
Operation.defaultRollupReason.en: This reason code is placed in the history records for those generated as summaries (rollups) of the details.

Operation.inTransit.en: Determines if Containers at this Operation are considered In-Transit. This is used as selection criteria for reporting and validation for Shop Floor transactions.

Operation.inventoryPoint.zh: 确定此工序处的容器是否被视为在库存中。用作车间事务报告和验证的选择标准。

Operation.notes.en: Notations and comments associated with this object.

Operation.outsideServicePoint.zh: 确定此工序处的容器是否在工厂外。例如，此工序的工作由供应商/分包商执行。用作车间事务报告和验证的选择标准。
Operation.outsideServicePoint.en: Determines if Containers at this Operation are outside the factory. For example, the work at this Operation is performed by a Vendor/sub-contractor. This is used as selection criteria for reporting and validation for Shop Floor transactions.

Operation.printQueue.zh: InSite 可用于打印标签的打印机。
Operation.printQueue.en: Printers InSite can use to print labels.

Operation.rejectIncomingNcContainer.zh: 标识具有一个或多个未关闭不符合的容器是否可移动到该工序的步骤。
Operation.rejectIncomingNcContainer.en: Identifies whether Containers with one or more open Nonconformances can be moved to steps for this Operation.

Operation.reworkReasons.zh: 此工序允许的Process Rework代码列表的Id。
Operation.reworkReasons.en: Id of the List for Process Rework codes allowed at this Operation.

Operation.schedulingDetail.zh: 此工序的排程详细信息

Operation.shipmentDestinations.zh: 表示一组 ShipmentDestination 的命名对象组，ShipmentDestination 是容器被运往的工厂或客户。ShipmentDestination 还包含路由信息，当 Ship 事务向目标站点发送远程事务时，RemoteProcessingInfo 对象会使用该信息。
Operation.shipmentDestinations.en: A Named Object Group that represents a group of ShipmentDestination which is the factory or customer to which the container is shipped. ShipmentDestinaiton also contains routing information used by the RemoteProcessingInfo object when the Ship transaction is sending remote transactions to a destination site.

Operation.summaryThruput.zh: ThruputReportingLevel定义此工序保留吞吐量信息的容器级别。如果设置了SummaryThruput标志，则无论级别如何，信息均保留在最高层容器。
Operation.summaryThruput.en: ThruputReportingLevel defines the container level at which thruput information is kept for this operation. If the SummaryThruput flag is set, then the information is kept at the top-most container, regardless of its level.

Operation.thruputReportingLevel.zh: ThruputReportingLevel定义此工序保留吞吐量信息的容器级别。如果设置了SummaryThruput标志，则无论级别如何，信息均保留在最高层容器。
Operation.thruputReportingLevel.en: ThruputReportingLevel defines the container level at which thruput information is kept for this operation. If the SummaryThruput flag is set, then the information is kept at the top-most container, regardless of its level.

Operation.useQueue.zh: 定义此工序的队列用法。如果要求队列，则在记录任何工作之前必须执行事务（MoveIn）。
Operation.useQueue.en: Defines the usage of queue at this operation. If a queue is required, a transaction (MoveIn) must be performed prior to any work being recorded.

Operation.wipMsgDefMgr.zh: 附加到建模实体实例，包含适用于该实体的消息。当被要求提供其WIP消息时，建模实体将要求其WIPMsgDefMgr提供已过滤的WIP消息列表，仅包含适用于当前情况（步骤、操作和标签）的消息。WIPMsgDefMgr将检查AllKey WIPMsgKey（如果指定，包含适用于所有步骤的消息），并遍历OperationKeys和LabelKeys列表中的条目，过滤找到的每条消息。
Operation.wipMsgDefMgr.en: Attached to an instance of a modeling entity, this contains the messages that apply to the entity. When asked to supply its WIP Messages, a modeling entity will ask its WIPMsgDefMgr to supply a list of WIP Messages that have been filtered to include only the messages that apply to the current circumstances (step, operation and label). The WIPMsgDefMgr will check the AllKey WIPMsgKey (which contains a message that applies to all steps) if specified, and run through the entries in the OperationKeys and LabelKeys lists and filter each message found.

Operation.workCenter.zh: 执行工作的工作中心的Id。
Operation.workCenter.en: Id of the Work Center where the work is performed.

PackageCreationTemplate.approvalTemplate.en: An approval sheet is used to collect signatures of approvers who are making decisions regarding the status of an object. The template is used to pre-define the sheets that will be attached to the object.

Path.name.en: Unique name for this Path (unique within the context of the associated Step).

Path.reEntryStep.zh: 返工后重新进入的步骤 → WorkflowStep
Path.reEntryStep.en: Step to Re-enter After Rework → WorkflowStep

Path.returnToStep.zh: 选择此To-Step隐含定义的路由末尾的默认To-Step。通常用于在子工作流完成时（例如完成返工后）知道下一步去向。
Path.returnToStep.en: Default To-Step at the end of the Route implicitly defined by selecting this To-Step. This is typically used to know where to go at the completion of a sub-workflow (i.e., after completing rework).

Path.rptBulkDelta.zh: 原始工作流步骤与备用工作流步骤之间的批量处理时间差异。
Path.rptBulkDelta.en: Difference in bulk processing time between the original workflow steps and alternate workflow steps.

Path.rptUnitDelta.zh: 原始工作流步骤与备用工作流步骤之间的单位处理时间差异。
Path.rptUnitDelta.en: Difference in unit processing time between the original workflow steps and alternate workflow steps.

Path.toStep.zh: 此路径的To-Step的Id。From-Step和To-Step的组合必须唯一。
Path.toStep.en: Id of the To-Step for this Path. The combination of From-Step and To-Step must be unique.

Path.txnDetails.zh: 描述此路径处理（事务类型）的相关事务详细信息的Id。
Path.txnDetails.en: Id of the associated Transaction Details which describes the processing (transaction type) for this Path.

PathSelector.description.zh: 此路径选择器的描述。如果未指定，默认为此路径选择器的名称

PathSelector.effectiveFromDate.zh: 如果指定，这是此路径选择器开始可用的起始日期和时间。
PathSelector.effectiveFromDate.en: If specified, this is the starting date and time when this Path Selector becomes available.

PathSelector.effectiveFromDateGmt.zh: 如果指定，这是此路径选择器开始可用的起始日期和时间。

PathSelector.effectiveThruDate.zh: 如果指定，这是此Bin不再可用的结束日期和时间。
PathSelector.effectiveThruDate.en: If specified, this is the ending date and time when this Bin becomes no longer available.

PauseTaskHistory.container.zh: 容器描述离散的工作单元或离散的物料数量（即物料批次、序列化组件或序列化物料件、唯一标识的包含产品的包装或容器等）。容器可以直接包含数量信息（重量、计数等），也可以包含其他容器（子容器）的分组。
PauseTaskHistory.container.en: A Container describes a discrete unit of work or a discrete quantity of material (i.e., batch of material, a serialized component or serialized piece of material, a uniquely identified package or vessel that contains product, etc.) A Container can include quantity information (weight, count, etc.) directly, or it can include a grouping of other containers (child containers).

PauseTaskHistory.electronicProcedure.zh: 提供在Spec处执行一系列任务（Tasks）的框架。电子规程（Electronic Procedure）定义一组指令（用于执行一组任务的检查表），并由一个或多个任务列表（TaskLists）组成。
PauseTaskHistory.electronicProcedure.en: Provides the framework for executing a series of Tasks at the Spec. An Electronic Procedure defines a set of instructions (a checklisst for performing a set of tasks), and is compose of one ore more TaskLists.

PauseTaskHistory.integrationTxn.zh: 在复合/容器/资源事务后插入 TxnId 与历史主线。
PauseTaskHistory.integrationTxn.en: Inserts the TxnId after a compound/container/resource transaction with history mainline.

PauseTaskHistory.pauseReason.en: Reason for pausing working on a Task

PauseTaskHistory.step.zh: 步骤是工作流中的单个跟踪点。步骤列表是工作流中的主要数据结构。路径控制步骤之间允许的移动。每个步骤包含零个或多个链接到另一个步骤的路径。每个步骤中的一个路径被标识为默认路径。步骤通常表示工作流中的单个处理点，它引用规格，规格描述要执行的工作。步骤可以引用另一个工作流，在这种情况下，步骤表示一系列处理点。
PauseTaskHistory.step.en: A step is an individual tracking point within a workflow. The list of steps is the primary data structure within a workflow. Paths control the allowable movements between steps. Each Step contains zero or more Paths, which link to another Step. One Path at each Step is identified as the default Path. A Step normally represents an individual processing point in a workflow, where it references a Spec which in turn describes the work that is to be performed. A Step can reference another workflow, in which case the step represents a series of processing points.

PauseTaskHistory.task.zh: TaskListDetail 标识要为 TaskList 完成的特定 Task。
PauseTaskHistory.task.en: The TaskListDetail identifies a specific Task to be completed for a TaskList.

PauseTaskHistory.txnDate.zh: 执行服务时的日期和时间。如果留空，InSite 将使用数据库系统时钟来确定交易日期。
PauseTaskHistory.txnDate.en: The date and time the service was performed. If left blank InSite uses the database system clock to determine the transaction date.

PauseTaskHistory.txnDateGmt.zh: 执行服务时的日期和时间。如果留空，InSite 将使用数据库系统时钟来确定交易日期。
PauseTaskHistory.txnDateGmt.en: The date and time the service was performed. If left blank InSite uses the database system clock to determine the transaction date.

Phase.allowReassignment.zh: 1 = 发送给指定角色内的用户 2 = 发送给任何用户 3 = 不允许重新分配
Phase.allowReassignment.en: 1 = To a user within the specified Role(s) 2 = To any user 3 = Reassignment not allowed

Phase.assignee.zh: 负责处理此对象的人员
Phase.assignee.en: The person responsible for the processing of this object

Phase.assigneeOption.zh: 受分配人选项的枚举：1 = 受分配人 2 = 所有者 3 = 协作者
Phase.assigneeOption.en: Enumeration for the Assignee Option: 1 = Assignee 2 = Owner 3 = Collaborator

Phase.assigneeRole.zh: 如果指定，流程对象的受分配人必须具有此角色，并且如果此对象是 ProcessModel 的一部分（相对于模板），该角色必须对 QualityObject 的组织有效。
Phase.assigneeRole.en: If specified, the assignee of a process object must have this role, and the role must be valid for the organization of the QualityObject if this object is part of a ProcessModel (versus a template).

Phase.autoComplete.zh: 如果设置此项，阶段将自动从“已完成”变为“已关闭”。
Phase.autoComplete.en: If this is set, the stage will go from Completed to Closed automatically.

Phase.autoCompleteFailure.zh: 标识 ProcessObject 的自动完成是否失败。此标志目前仅对 ProcessModel 实现。
Phase.autoCompleteFailure.en: Identifies whether AutoComplete failed for the ProcessObject. This flag is currently only implemented for the ProcessModel.

Phase.changeHistory.zh: 每个建模实体都包含 Change Status。它用于记录当前的变更（维护）状态（例如，特定 Product Definition 的维护正在进行中），并跟踪最后一次更改的人员和时间。这应该可扩展为随时间变化的完整历史记录。
Phase.changeHistory.en: Every modeling entity includes a Change Status. It is used to record the current Change (Maintenance) Status (i.e., maintenance is currently in progress for a specific Product Definition) and to track who made the last change and when. This should be extendible to a complete history over time.

Phase.checklist.zh: 检查表连接到流程对象或模板，并包含从检查表模板复制的条目。
Phase.checklist.en: Checklists are connected to process objects or templates and contain entries copied from Checklist Template.

Phase.completeBy.zh: 处理必须在 CompleteWithin 指定的时间范围内完成。处理开始时，会创建计划条目并设置此字段。
Phase.completeBy.en: Processing must be complete within the timeframe specified by CompleteWithin. Upon the start of processing, a schedule entry is created and this field is set.

Phase.completeByGmt.zh: 此功能必须完成的日期。
Phase.completeByGmt.en: The date by which this function must be completed.

Phase.completeWithinQty.zh: 此值将与 CompleteWithinUOM 相乘，以计算 CompleteWithin 字段值。
Phase.completeWithinQty.en: This value will be multiplied by the CompleteWithinUOM to calculate the CompleteWithin field value.

Phase.completeWithinUom.zh: 描述用于持续时间的不同度量 1=小时 24=天 168=周
Phase.completeWithinUom.en: Describes the different measurements used for a duration 1=Hour(s) 24=Day(s) 168=Week(s)

Phase.dataPointCollection.zh: 标识要为 ProcessObject 收集的数据点。数据点按组结构化，每个组内包含数据点列表。
Phase.dataPointCollection.en: Identifies the data points to collect for the ProcessObject. The data points are structured as groups, with lists of data points within each group.

Phase.defaultAssigneeInfo.zh: 如果受分配人信息具有默认值，则此值为 True。
Phase.defaultAssigneeInfo.en: The value is True if Assignee Info has default value.

Phase.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
Phase.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

Phase.documentSet.zh: 文档集是一个或多个文档的列表。大多数建模实体包含对文档集的引用。在此上下文中，文档用于提供扩展（非结构化）信息，例如产品图纸、扫描图像、相关的现有制造规范或操作程序。每个文档（CDO）实例包括外部文档的标识符（即文件名或URL）和对用于呈现文档的程序的引用。
Phase.documentSet.en: A Document Set is a list of one or more documents. Most Modeling entities include a reference to a Document Set. Documents are used in this context to provide extended (unstructured) information, such as product drawings, scanned images, relating existing manufacturing specifications, or operating procedures. Each instance of a Document (CDO) includes an identifier for the external document (i.e., a file name or a URL) and a reference to the program used for presenting the document.

Phase.firstRoutedOn.zh: ProcessObject 首次路由的日期。后续重新路由不会更改此字段。
Phase.firstRoutedOn.en: The date when the ProcessObject was first routed. Subsequent re-routings will not change this field.

Phase.firstRoutedOnGmt.zh: ProcessObject 首次路由的日期（GMT）。后续重新路由不会更改此字段。
Phase.firstRoutedOnGmt.en: The date (GMT) when the ProcessObject was first routed. Subsequent re-routings will not change this field.

Phase.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。
Phase.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

Phase.isRequired.zh: 指示是否可以从流程中移除此项。
Phase.isRequired.en: Indicates whether this item can be removed from the process.

Phase.lastApprovalRouted.zh: 始终反映为计划路由的最后一个 ApprovalSheet。
Phase.lastApprovalRouted.en: Always reflects the last ApprovalSheet that was routed for the Plan.

Phase.lastCompletedBy.zh: 标识完成 ProcessObject 的员工。
Phase.lastCompletedBy.en: Identifies the employee credited with completing the ProcessObject.

Phase.lastCompletedOn.zh: 此 ProcessObject 上次完成/执行的日期。
Phase.lastCompletedOn.en: The date on which this ProcessObject was last completed/executed.

Phase.lastCompletedOnGmt.zh: 此 ProcessObject 上次完成/执行的日期（GMT）。
Phase.lastCompletedOnGmt.en: The date (GMT) on which this ProcessObject was last completed/executed.

Phase.lastStage.zh: 流程对象在处理过程中会经历多个阶段。
Phase.lastStage.en: A process object progresses through several stages during its processing.

Phase.name.zh: 名称子实体的唯一名称。
Phase.name.en: Unique name for the name subentity.

Phase.outstandingDetailStatus.zh: 该字段在完成时对所有明细进行设置，并在对象移至“已完成”或“已作废”阶段时清除。
Phase.outstandingDetailStatus.en: The field is set at the time of completion for all of the details and cleared when the object is moved to a Completed or Voided stage.

Phase.parent.zh: 包含此 CDO 的 CDO 的 Id。
Phase.parent.en: Id of the CDO containing this CDO.

Phase.stage.zh: 流程对象在处理过程中会经历多个阶段。
Phase.stage.en: A process object progresses through several stages during its processing.

PhaseTemplate.allowReassignment.zh: 1 = 发送给指定角色内的用户 2 = 发送给任何用户 3 = 不允许重新分配
