ProcessModel.name.zh: 名称子实体的唯一名称。
ProcessModel.name.en: Unique name for the name subentity.

ProcessModel.outstandingDetailStatus.zh: 该字段在完成时对所有明细进行设置，并在对象移至“已完成”或“已作废”阶段时清除。
ProcessModel.outstandingDetailStatus.en: The field is set at the time of completion for all of the details and cleared when the object is moved to a Completed or Voided stage.

ProcessModel.parent.zh: 包含此 CDO 的 CDO 的 Id。
ProcessModel.parent.en: Id of the CDO containing this CDO.

ProcessModel.stage.zh: 流程对象在处理过程中会经历多个阶段。
ProcessModel.stage.en: A process object progresses through several stages during its processing.

ProcessModelTemplate.allowReassignment.zh: 1 = 发送给指定角色内的用户 2 = 发送给任何用户 3 = 不允许重新分配
ProcessModelTemplate.allowReassignment.en: 1 = To a user within the specified Role(s) 2 = To any user 3 = Reassignment not allowed

ProcessModelTemplate.assignee.zh: 被分配来处理此对象的员工。
ProcessModelTemplate.assignee.en: The employee that is assigned to process this object.

ProcessModelTemplate.assigneeOption.zh: 受分配人选项的枚举：1 = 受分配人 2 = 所有者 3 = 协作者
ProcessModelTemplate.assigneeOption.en: Enumeration for the Assignee Option: 1 = Assignee 2 = Owner 3 = Collaborator

ProcessModelTemplate.assigneeRole.zh: 如果指定，流程对象的被分配者必须具有此角色。
ProcessModelTemplate.assigneeRole.en: If specified, the assignee of a process object must have this role.

ProcessModelTemplate.autoComplete.zh: 如果设置此项，阶段将自动从“已完成”变为“已关闭”。
ProcessModelTemplate.autoComplete.en: If this is set, the stage will go from Completed to Closed automatically.

ProcessModelTemplate.changeHistory.zh: 每个建模实体都包含 Change Status。它用于记录当前的变更（维护）状态（例如，特定 Product Definition 的维护正在进行中），并跟踪最后一次更改的人员和时间。这应该可扩展为随时间变化的完整历史记录。
ProcessModelTemplate.changeHistory.en: Every modeling entity includes a Change Status. It is used to record the current Change (Maintenance) Status (i.e., maintenance is currently in progress for a specific Product Definition) and to track who made the last change and when. This should be extendible to a complete history over time.

ProcessModelTemplate.defaultAssigneeInfo.zh: 如果 Assignee Info 具有默认值，则返回 true。
ProcessModelTemplate.defaultAssigneeInfo.en: Return true if Assignee Info has default value.

ProcessModelTemplate.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
ProcessModelTemplate.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

ProcessModelTemplate.documentSet.zh: 文档集是一个或多个文档的列表。大多数建模实体包含对文档集的引用。在此上下文中，文档用于提供扩展（非结构化）信息，例如产品图纸、扫描图像、相关的现有制造规范或操作程序。每个文档（CDO）实例包括外部文档的标识符（即文件名或URL）和对用于呈现文档的程序的引用。
ProcessModelTemplate.documentSet.en: A Document Set is a list of one or more documents. Most Modeling entities include a reference to a Document Set. Documents are used in this context to provide extended (unstructured) information, such as product drawings, scanned images, relating existing manufacturing specifications, or operating procedures. Each instance of a Document (CDO) includes an identifier for the external document (i.e., a file name or a URL) and a reference to the program used for presenting the document.

ProcessModelTemplate.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
ProcessModelTemplate.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

ProcessModelTemplate.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例进行更改。
ProcessModelTemplate.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance

ProcessModelTemplate.notes.zh: 与此对象关联的注释和评论。
ProcessModelTemplate.notes.en: Notations and comments associated with this object.

ProcessModelTemplate.revision.zh: 修订版本（在基础实体上下文中唯一）
ProcessModelTemplate.revision.en: Revision (unique within the context of the base entity)

ProcessModelTemplate.setupAccess.zh: 用于验证用户对特定建模记录的访问权限。必须首先将一个或多个 Setup Access 分配给 Role。每个建模记录将有一个 Setup Access。当建模记录被事务处理时，系统将比较其 Setup Access。
ProcessModelTemplate.setupAccess.en: This is used to verify the user's access to a particular modeling record. One or more Setup Access must first be assigned to a Role. Each modeling record will have one Setup Access. When a modeling record in transacted the system will compare its Setup Ac

ProcessModelTemplate.status.zh: 确定此实例的当前状态（活动、非活动）。有效值及其含义为：1 = 活动 2 = 非活动。注意，对于活动与非活动修订版本，没有强制执行的验证（规则）。
ProcessModelTemplate.status.en: Determines the current status (Active, In-Active) of this instance. Valid values and their meanings are: 1 = Active 2 = Inactive Note there are no validations (rules enforced) concerning active vs. inactive revisions.

ProcessModelTemplateBase.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
ProcessModelTemplateBase.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

ProcessModelTemplateBase.revOfRcd.zh: 此基础实体当前修订版本的Id。
ProcessModelTemplateBase.revOfRcd.en: Id of the current revision for this Base entity.

ProcessTimer.changeHistory.zh: 每个建模实体都包含 Change Status。它用于记录当前的变更（维护）状态（例如，特定 Product Definition 的维护正在进行中），并跟踪最后一次更改的人员和时间。这应该可扩展为随时间变化的完整历史记录。
ProcessTimer.changeHistory.en: Every modeling entity includes a Change Status. It is used to record the current Change (Maintenance) Status (i.e., maintenance is currently in progress for a specific Product Definition) and to track who made the last change and when. This should be extendible to a complete history over time.

ProcessTimer.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
ProcessTimer.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

ProcessTimer.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
ProcessTimer.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

ProcessTimer.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例进行更改。
ProcessTimer.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance

ProcessTimer.notes.zh: 与此对象关联的注释和评论。
ProcessTimer.notes.en: Notations and comments associated with this object.

ProcessTimer.revision.zh: 修订版本（在基础实体上下文中唯一）
ProcessTimer.revision.en: Revision (unique within the context of the base entity)

ProcessTimer.status.zh: 确定此实例的当前状态（活动、非活动）。有效值及其含义为：1 = 活动 2 = 非活动。注意，对于活动与非活动修订版本，没有强制执行的验证（规则）。
ProcessTimer.status.en: Determines the current status (Active, In-Active) of this instance. Valid values and their meanings are: 1 = Active 2 = Inactive Note there are no validations (rules enforced) concerning active vs. inactive revisions.

ProcessTimer.timerType.zh: TimerType 的枚举：1 = 仅最小值 2 = 仅最大值 3 = 最小值和最大值
ProcessTimer.timerType.en: Enumeration for TimerType 1 = Min only 2 = Max only 3 = Min and Max

ProcessTimer.wipMsgDefMgr.zh: WIP消息定义，包含适用于此实体的所有WIP消息的WIP消息键列表。
ProcessTimer.wipMsgDefMgr.en: WIP Message Definition which contains a list of WIP message keys that contain all of the WIP messages that apply to this entity.

ProcessTimerBase.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
ProcessTimerBase.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

ProcessTimerBase.revOfRcd.zh: 此基础实体当前修订版本的Id。
ProcessTimerBase.revOfRcd.en: Id of the current revision for this Base entity.

ProcessTimerType.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
ProcessTimerType.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

ProcessTimerType.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
ProcessTimerType.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

ProcessTimerType.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。
ProcessTimerType.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions).

ProcessTimerType.notes.zh: 与此对象关联的注释和评论。
ProcessTimerType.notes.en: Notations and comments associated with this object.

ProcessTimerType.setupAccess.zh: 用于验证用户对特定建模记录的访问权限。必须首先将一个或多个 Setup Access 分配给 Role。每个建模记录将有一个 Setup Access。当建模记录被事务处理时，系统将比较其 Setup Access。
ProcessTimerType.setupAccess.en: This is used to verify the user's access to a particular modeling record. One or more Setup Access must first be assigned to a Role. Each modeling record will have one Setup Access. When a modeling record in transacted the system will compare its Setup Ac

Product.accumulateExposure.zh: 指示当材料退回并从仓库重新取回时是否累积暴露时间的标志。
Product.accumulateExposure.en: Flag indicating whether the exposure time is accumulated when the material is returned and retrieved back from store.

Product.adjustmentType.zh: 此字段定义调整的类型（例如百分比或数量）。所选类型决定如何解释和应用 AdjustmentValue 以进行自动调整计算。
Product.adjustmentType.en: This field defines the type of the adjustment (e.g. Percentage or Quantity). The chosen type determines how the AdjustmentValue is interpreted and applied for the auto-adjustment calculations.

Product.adjustmentValue.zh: 此字段定义基于所选 AdjustmentType 用于自动调整计算的值。
Product.adjustmentValue.en: This field defines the value used for auto-adjustments calculations based on the chosen AdjustmentType.

Product.allowAllRevisionsAsSubstitute.zh: 当为 true 时，允许将产品的所有修订版本用于物料需求。
Product.allowAllRevisionsAsSubstitute.en: When true it will allow all revisions of the product to be issued for a material requirement

Product.alternateName.zh: 用于报告目的。可用于表示 SAP Id。
Product.alternateName.en: Used for reporting purpose. Can be used to represent the SAP Id.

Product.billOfProcess.zh: 工艺清单（Bill Of Process）用于指定对规范（spec）的覆盖，并分配给容器、制造订单或产品。
Product.billOfProcess.en: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

Product.binList.en: The Bin List for a Product.

Product.bom.zh: 物料清单（BOM）定义了生产特定产品所需的物料。
Product.bom.en: A bill of material defines the materials needed to produce a specific product.

Product.changeHistory.zh: 每个建模实体都包含 Change Status。它用于记录当前的变更（维护）状态（例如，特定 Product Definition 的维护正在进行中），并跟踪最后一次更改的人员和时间。这应该可扩展为随时间变化的完整历史记录。
Product.changeHistory.en: Every modeling entity includes a Change Status. It is used to record the current Change (Maintenance) Status (i.e., maintenance is currently in progress for a specific Product Definition) and to track who made the last change and when. This should be extendible to a complete history over time.

Product.containerNumberingRule.zh: 此字段用于定义对象的编号规则。
Product.containerNumberingRule.en: This field is used to define the numbering rule for the object.

Product.currentCost.zh: 当前每单位成本（如果有）

Product.customer.zh: 与此产品定义关联的客户（如果有）。
Product.customer.en: Customer with whom this product definition is associated (if any).

Product.customerProductNumber.zh: 表示此产品的客户标识符的文本字符串（如果有）
Product.customerProductNumber.en: Text string that represents the Customers Identifier for this product (if any)

Product.defaultStartLocation.zh: 由 LotStart 用于默认启动批次的工作流和步骤。如果设置此值，必须指向库存步骤。
Product.defaultStartLocation.en: Used by LotStart to default the Workflow and Step to start the lot in. This value if set must point to an inventory step.

Product.defaultStartOwner.zh: LotStart 期间使用的默认所有者。
Product.defaultStartOwner.en: The default Owner used during LotStart.

Product.defaultStartReason.zh: LotStart 期间使用的默认开始原因。
Product.defaultStartReason.en: The default Start Reason used during LotStart.

Product.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
Product.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

Product.device.zh: i) 从 IDV 的数字值获得的设备。ii) 例如：a. 6309
Product.device.en: i) The device obtained from the numerical values of IDV. ii) E.g.: a. 6309

Product.deviceVersion.zh: i) 从 IDV 的字母值获得的设备版本。ii) 例如：a. AEH
Product.deviceVersion.en: i) The device version obtained from the alphabetical values of IDV. ii) E.g.: a. AEH

Product.documentSet.zh: 此产品定义关联的文档集（如果有）。这些文档可用于任何目的（此产品的图纸、附加产品描述等）。酌情提供选项（车间 UI 和建模 UI）以按要求显示此文档。
Product.documentSet.en: Associated document set for this product definition (if any). These documents can be used for any purpose (drawing of this product, addition product description, etc.). Options are provided as appropriate (Shop Floor UI and Modeling UI) to display this document on request.

Product.erpRoute.zh: 标识此产品的特定 ERP 工艺路线。在大多数情况下，ERP 在产品与 ERP 工艺路线之间具有 1 对 1 的关系。
Product.erpRoute.en: Identifies the specific ERP Route for this product. In most instances an ERP has a 1 for 1 relationship between a Product and an ERP Route

Product.erpbom.zh: 物料清单（BOM）定义了生产特定产品所需的物料。ERP BOM引用ERP路线中的步骤，而不是引用InSite工作流中的步骤。
Product.erpbom.en: A bill of material (BOM) defines the materials needed to produce a specific product. An ERP BOM references steps in an ERP route instead of referencing steps in an InSite workflow.

Product.exposureDuration.zh: 暴露持续时间（小时）。值为 0 表示不需要暴露持续时间，因此材料可以无限期使用。
Product.exposureDuration.en: Exposure Duration in hours. A value of 0 means no exposure duration required. Hence the material can be used without time limit.

Product.externallyControlled.zh: 向 LiveConnect 逻辑标识此产品通过外部应用程序控制。
Product.externallyControlled.en: Identifies to LiveConnect logic that this product is controlled via an external application.

Product.fefoEnforce.zh: FEFOEnforceType 的枚举。0=不强制，1=强制，2=警告，3=警告并需要电子签名

Product.fefoOverrideESigRequirement.zh: 当 FEFO 规则被覆盖时的可选 ESigRequirement。与 FEFOEnforce 类型 3（WarnWithEsig）一起使用。如果选择了 FEFOEnforce 类型 WarnWithESig，则在满足 FEFOOverrideESigRequirement 的情况下允许发料继续进行。
Product.fefoOverrideESigRequirement.en: The optional ESigRequirement when the FEFO rule is being overridden. Used in conjunction with a FEFOEnforce type of 3,WarnWithEsig. If a FEFOEnforce type of WarnWithESig is selected, the issue is allowed to proceed provided the FEFOOverrideESigRequirement is met

Product.formatCode.zh: 用于区分不同产品级别的格式代码。
Product.formatCode.en: The format code to differentiate the different levels of Products.

Product.gdpw.zh: 每片晶圆的总芯片数。在分选期间使用。
Product.gdpw.en: Gross Die Per Wafer. Used during Sorting.

Product.glEntity.zh: 此产品的 ERP 会计 ID。用于在 ERP 中处理杂项交易。
Product.glEntity.en: ERP Accounting ID for this product. Used to transact miscellaneous transactions within the ERP.

Product.holdStatus.zh: Hold Status 的实例用于跟踪对象的保持状态。
Product.holdStatus.en: An instance of Hold Status is used to track the hold state of objects.

Product.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
Product.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

Product.inspectAll.zh: 如果设置了此标志，则每个采样率 = 1，因此每个容器都将被采样。
Product.inspectAll.en: If flag is set every sample rate = 1 so every container will be sampled

Product.inventoryControlled.zh: 标识此产品是否受 ERP 库存系统中的库存控制。受库存控制的产品必须分配有特定的库存桶或子工厂才能在 ERP 中进行交易。
Product.inventoryControlled.en: Identifies if this product is under inventory control within the ERP inventory system. A product under Inventory control must have a specific inventory bucket or sub-factory assigned to it to transact within the ERP.

Product.isAvailable.zh: 指示产品是否可用于开始或排程批次的标志。
Product.isAvailable.en: Flag indicating whether the product is available to start or schedule a lot with.

Product.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例进行更改。
Product.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance

Product.isMultiProducts.zh: 指示产品需要子产品的标志。
Product.isMultiProducts.en: flag to indicate the Product required sub products

Product.isPhantom.zh: 表示这是一个虚拟产品。虚拟产品不是实际材料，而是通过将 BOM 结构中的组件项目分组而添加的人工构造，以减少 BOM 维护。
Product.isPhantom.en: Denotes this is a phantom product. Phantom product are not actual materials, but are artificial constructs added from grouping component items in a BOM structure to reduce BOM maintenance.

Product.lotControlled.zh: 向 LiveConnect 标识是否需要为此产品将批次/批号报告回 ERP。
Product.lotControlled.en: Identifies to LiveConnect if a batch/lot id needs to be reported back to the ERP for this product

Product.lotSize.zh: 用于报告目的的自由数字字段。
Product.lotSize.en: Free numeric field used for reporting purpose.

Product.maskSet.zh: 为掩模组设置掩模层。每层可以有一个或多个掩模ID。
Product.maskSet.en: Setup the Mask Layers for a Mask Set. Each layer can have one or more Mask Ids.

Product.materialCategory.zh: 进一步对材料进行分类的有效值。
Product.materialCategory.en: Valid values to further categorize a material.

Product.materialType.en: Identifies the valids types of materials.

Product.maxReturns.zh: 允许的最大退货次数。值为 0 表示不允许退货。
Product.maxReturns.en: The maximum number of returns allowed. A value of 0 means no return.

Product.minQtyReorderEmailGroup.zh: 最小再订货量邮件组 → EmailGroup
Product.minQtyReorderEmailGroup.en: Min Reorder Quantity Email Group → EmailGroup

Product.notes.zh: 与此对象关联的注释和评论。
Product.notes.en: Notations and comments associated with this object.

Product.numberOfCols.zh: 指示 BGA 产品的列数。
Product.numberOfCols.en: Indicate the number of columns for BGA products.

Product.numberOfRows.zh: 指示 BGA 产品的行数。
Product.numberOfRows.en: Indicate the number of rows for BGA products.

Product.objectType.zh: i) 过程规格类型。ii) 记录的系统标识。iii) 此字段将自动更新。
Product.objectType.en: i) The process specification type. ii) System identification for the record. iii) This field will be automatically updated.

Product.opn.zh: 订购零件号的自由字段。
Product.opn.en: Free field for the Ordering Part Number.

Product.opnRevision.zh: 订购零件号版本的自由字段。
Product.opnRevision.en: Free field for the Ordering Part Number Revision.

Product.plannedCost.zh: 每单位计划成本（如果有）

Product.productFamily.zh: 关联的产品族（如果有）。产品族用于对产品进行分组，并通过定义适用于族内所有产品的属性（以及覆盖工作流实体中的值）来简化维护。
Product.productFamily.en: Associated Product Family (if any). Product Families are used to group products and simplify maintenance by defining attributes (and overriding values in workflow entities) that apply to all products within the Family.

Product.productSubProductList.zh: 子产品列表，要定义为子产品的产品列表。
Product.productSubProductList.en: Sub-Product List, the list of products to be define as sub-products

Product.productType.zh: 此产品定义的产品类型代码。产品类型代码的示例可能包括：WIP（在制品）FG（成品）SFG（半成品）RM（原材料）
Product.productType.en: Product Type code for this Product definition. Examples of Product Types codes may include: WIP (Work in Process) FG (Finished Goods) SFG (Semi-Finished Goods) RM (Raw Material)

Product.productVariation.zh: 可以使用的附加产品标识符
Product.productVariation.en: Additional product identifier that can be used

Product.revision.zh: 修订版本（在基础实体上下文中唯一）
Product.revision.en: Revision (unique within the context of the base entity)

Product.rptMinimumValue.zh: 这是允许的最小 RPT 值。默认设置为 1。用户可以在 > 1.0 的情况下更改。
Product.rptMinimumValue.en: This is the Minimum RPT value allowed. Default is set to 1. User can change as long as > 1.0.​

Product.samplingPlan.zh: 用于定义产品的抽样计划。抽样计划包含产品样本测试的详细信息，例如测试地点、AQL 水平和转换规则。
Product.samplingPlan.en: Used to Define a sampling plan for a Product. The sample plan contains the details about the Sample Test for a Product such as where it is to be tested, AQL Level, and switching rules.

Product.scsFieldMp.zh: 用于区分材料页面和 PN 页面
Product.scsFieldMp.en: To differentiate between Material Page and PN page

Product.serialControlled.zh: 向 LiveConnect 标识是否需要将序列 ID 报告回 ERP。
Product.serialControlled.en: Identifies to LiveConnect if a serial ids needs to be reported back to the ERP

Product.serialId.zh: 用于进一步标识材料的可选属性。例如 SRAM ID。
Product.serialId.en: Optional attribute to further identify the material. E.g. SRAM ID.

Product.setupAccess.zh: 用于验证用户对特定建模记录的访问权限。必须首先将一个或多个 Setup Access 分配给 Role。每个建模记录将有一个 Setup Access。当建模记录被事务处理时，系统将比较其 Setup Access。
Product.setupAccess.en: This is used to verify the user's access to a particular modeling record. One or more Setup Access must first be assigned to a Role. Each modeling record will have one Setup Access. When a modeling record in transacted the system will compare its Setup Ac

Product.slitCount.zh: 指示将对父容器执行的分割次数。
Product.slitCount.en: Indicates the number of splits that will be performed against the parent container.

Product.slitProduct.zh: 如果已填充，则分割容器将被分配新产品。
Product.slitProduct.en: If populated, the split containers will be assigned the new product.

Product.splitNumberingRule.zh: 可选字段，用于在分割期间指定子批次的编号规则。
Product.splitNumberingRule.en: Optional field to specify the Numbering Rule for child lots during Split.

Product.status.zh: 确定此实例的当前状态（活动、非活动）。有效值及其含义为：1 = 活动 2 = 非活动。注意，对于活动与非活动修订版本，没有强制执行的验证（规则）。
Product.status.en: Determines the current status (Active, In-Active) of this instance. Valid values and their meanings are: 1 = Active 2 = Inactive Note there are no validations (rules enforced) concerning active vs. inactive revisions.

Product.stdCost.zh: 每单位标准成本（如果有）

Product.stdStartQty.zh: 如果指定，此值用作容器开始交易的默认值。
Product.stdStartQty.en: If specified, this value is used as the default for a Container Start transaction.

Product.stdStartQty2.zh: 如果指定，此值用作容器开始交易的默认值。
Product.stdStartQty2.en: If specified, this value is used as the default for a Container Start transaction.

Product.stdStartUom.zh: 用于容器开始交易的计量单位。
Product.stdStartUom.en: Unit of measure to use for a Container Start transaction.

Product.stdStartUom2.zh: 用于容器开始交易的计量单位。
Product.stdStartUom2.en: Unit of measure to use for a Container Start transaction.

Product.stockPointControlled.zh: 标识此产品是否受 ERP 库存系统中的位置控制。受位置控制的产品必须为其分配 ERP 位置才能在 ERP 中进行交易。
Product.stockPointControlled.en: Identifies if this product is under location control within the ERP inventory system. A product under location control must be have an ERP location assigned to it to be able to transact within the ERP

Product.subFactory.zh: 业务组织的进一步结构，将工厂细分为区域。这可能是由于库存考虑或车间考虑。
Product.subFactory.en: Further structuring of the business organization that sub divides the factory into areas. This can be due to Inventory considerations or shop floor considerations.

Product.subLotMinQty.zh: 为装配子批次流程考虑子批次生成的最小数量。由 SchedulingTxn 用于默认 InProcessSplitSubLotMinQty。
Product.subLotMinQty.en: The minimum quantity to consider sub-lot generations for Assembly Sub Lot process. Used by SchedulingTxn to default the InProcessSplitSubLotMinQty.

Product.subLotQty.zh: 为装配子批次流程生成的每个子批次的数量。由 SchedulingTxn 用于默认 InProcessSplitSubLotQty。
Product.subLotQty.en: The quantity for each sublot to generate for Assembly Sub Lot process. Used by SchedulingTxn to default the InProcessSplitSubLotQty.

Product.targetDurationPerUnit.zh: BI 目标每单位持续时间

Product.targetRolledThroughputYield.zh: BI 目标滚动通过率良率

Product.targetUnitsPerHour.zh: BI 目标每小时单位数

Product.tcReleaseStatus.zh: Teamcenter 发布状态 - 指示 TC 状态的字符串字段
Product.tcReleaseStatus.en: Teamcenter Release Status - string field indicating TC Status

Product.thawingDuration.zh: 解冻持续时间（小时）。值为 0 表示不需要解冻持续时间。
Product.thawingDuration.en: Thawing duration in hours. A value of 0 means no thawing duration required.

Product.totalProcessTime.zh: 将一个产品批次通过给定的工艺规范/工作流和默认数量进行处理。
Product.totalProcessTime.en: It takes a product lot to process through a given process spec/workflow and default qty.

Product.totalProcessTimeBulk.zh: 批量处理容器/批次时的总处理时间。整个批次作为一个单元处理。处理时间不依赖于批次/容器中的单位数量。TPT Bulk 基于默认数量。
Product.totalProcessTimeBulk.en: The total process time where containers/lots are processed in bulk. The entire lot is processed as one unit. There is no dependence on the process time for the qty of units in the lot/container. TPT Bulk based on Default Qty.

Product.totalProcessTimeUnit.zh: 按单位处理容器/批次时的总处理时间。批次中的每个单位独立处理。批次中的单位数量影响工序步骤的处理时间。
Product.totalProcessTimeUnit.en: The total process time where containers/lots are processed by units. Each unit is the lot is processed independently. The quantity of units in the lot impact the process time at a process step.

Product.unitsPerStrip.zh: 用于报告目的的自由数字字段。
Product.unitsPerStrip.en: Free numeric field used for reporting purpose.

Product.uom2.zh: 此字段由 MOM 接口设置，并反过来用于设置 Standard Start UOM2。非持久性。由 CVE 设置。
Product.uom2.en: This field is set by the MOM Interface and is, in turn, used to set the Standard Start UOM2. Non-persistent. Set by CVE

Product.wipMsgDefMgr.zh: WIP消息定义，包含适用于此实体的所有WIP消息的WIP消息键列表。
Product.wipMsgDefMgr.en: WIP Message Definition which contains a list of WIP message keys that contain all of the WIP messages that apply to this entity.

Product.workflow.zh: 创建此定义描述的产品时使用的工作流。产品类型代码确定这是否为必填项。例如，WIP 产品需要工作流，而原材料产品则不需要。
Product.workflow.en: Workflow to be used when creating the product described by this definition. Product type code determines if this is a required entry. For example, WIP products require a Workflow and Raw Material products do not.

ProductBase.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
ProductBase.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

ProductBase.revOfRcd.zh: 此基础实体当前修订版本的Id。
ProductBase.revOfRcd.en: Id of the current revision for this Base entity.

ProductFamily.containerNumberingRule.zh: 此服务用于维护将用于自动生成名称的属性。
ProductFamily.containerNumberingRule.en: This service is used to maintain properties that will be used to auto generate names.

ProductFamily.currentCost.zh: 此产品族内产品的当前每单位成本
ProductFamily.currentCost.en: Current cost per unit for Products within this Family

ProductFamily.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
ProductFamily.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

ProductFamily.documentSet.zh: 此产品族内产品的关联（外部）文档。这些文档可用于任何目的（此产品的图纸、附加产品描述等）。
ProductFamily.documentSet.en: Associated (external) documents for Products within this Family. These documents can be used for any purpose (drawing of this product, addition product description, etc.).

ProductFamily.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
ProductFamily.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

ProductFamily.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。
ProductFamily.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions).

ProductFamily.notes.zh: 与此对象关联的注释和评论。
ProductFamily.notes.en: Notations and comments associated with this object.

ProductFamily.plannedCost.zh: 此产品族内产品的每单位计划成本。
ProductFamily.plannedCost.en: Planned cost per unit for Products within this Family.

ProductFamily.samplingPlan.zh: 用于定义产品的抽样计划。抽样计划包含产品样本测试的详细信息，例如测试地点、AQL 水平和转换规则。
ProductFamily.samplingPlan.en: Used to Define a sampling plan for a Product. The sample plan contains the details about the Sample Test for a Product such as where it is to be tested, AQL Level, and switching rules.

ProductFamily.setupAccess.zh: 用于验证用户对特定建模记录的访问权限。必须首先将一个或多个 Setup Access 分配给 Role。每个建模记录将有一个 Setup Access。当建模记录被事务处理时，系统将比较其 Setup Access。
ProductFamily.setupAccess.en: This is used to verify the user's access to a particular modeling record. One or more Setup Access must first be assigned to a Role. Each modeling record will have one Setup Access. When a modeling record in transacted the system will compare its Setup Ac

ProductFamily.splitNumberingRule.zh: 可选字段，用于在分割期间指定子批次的编号规则。
ProductFamily.splitNumberingRule.en: Optional field to specify the Numbering Rule for child lots during Split.

ProductFamily.stdCost.zh: 此产品族内产品的每单位标准成本
ProductFamily.stdCost.en: Standard cost per unit for Products within this Family

ProductFamily.stdStartQty.zh: 此产品族内产品的容器开始交易的默认数量
ProductFamily.stdStartQty.en: Default quantity for a Container Start transaction for Products within this Family

ProductFamily.stdStartQty2.zh: 此产品族内产品的容器开始交易的默认第二数量。此字段仅用于使用辅助计量单位跟踪的产品。
ProductFamily.stdStartQty2.en: Default second quantity for a Container Start transaction for Products within this Family. This field is used only for products that use secondary unit of measure tracking.

ProductFamily.stdStartUom.zh: 用作容器开始交易默认值的计量单位。
ProductFamily.stdStartUom.en: Unit of measure to use as a default for the Container Start transaction.

ProductFamily.stdStartUom2.zh: 对于使用辅助计量单位跟踪的产品，用于容器开始交易的辅助计量单位。
ProductFamily.stdStartUom2.en: Secondary unit of measure to use for a container Start transaction for products that use secondary unit of measure tracking.

ProductFamily.wipMsgDefMgr.zh: 附加到建模实体实例，包含适用于该实体的消息。当被要求提供其WIP消息时，建模实体将要求其WIPMsgDefMgr提供已过滤的WIP消息列表，仅包含适用于当前情况（步骤、操作和标签）的消息。WIPMsgDefMgr将检查AllKey WIPMsgKey（如果指定，包含适用于所有步骤的消息），并遍历OperationKeys和LabelKeys列表中的条目，过滤找到的每条消息。
ProductFamily.wipMsgDefMgr.en: Attached to an instance of a modeling entity, this contains the messages that apply to the entity. When asked to supply its WIP Messages, a modeling entity will ask its WIPMsgDefMgr to supply a list of WIP Messages that have been filtered to include only the messages that apply to the current circumstances (step, operation and label). The WIPMsgDefMgr will check the AllKey WIPMsgKey (which contains a message that applies to all steps) if specified, and run through the entries in the OperationKeys and LabelKeys lists and filter each message found.

ProductFamily.workflow.zh: 在此产品族内创建产品时使用的工作流。
ProductFamily.workflow.en: Workflow to be used when creating a product within this Family.

ProductMaterialListItem.adjustmentType.zh: 此字段定义调整的类型（例如百分比或数量）。所选类型决定如何解释和应用 AdjustmentValue 以进行自动调整计算。
ProductMaterialListItem.adjustmentType.en: This field defines the type of the adjustment (e.g. Percentage or Quantity). The chosen type determines how the AdjustmentValue is interpreted and applied for the auto-adjustment calculations.

ProductMaterialListItem.adjustmentValue.zh: 此字段定义用于自动调整计算的值，基于所选的调整类型。
ProductMaterialListItem.adjustmentValue.en: This field defines the value used for auto-adjustments calculations based on the chosen Adjustment Type.

ProductMaterialListItem.allowAllRevision.zh: 为 true 时，将允许物料需求使用产品的所有修订版。
ProductMaterialListItem.allowAllRevision.en: When true it will allow all revisions of the product to be allowed for the material requirement

ProductMaterialListItem.allowOverConsump.zh: 此标志确定物料消耗检查是否允许发放多于 MaterialListItem 条目中指定的物料。
ProductMaterialListItem.allowOverConsump.en: This flag determines if the material consumption check will allow more materials to be issued than specified in the MaterialListItem entry

ProductMaterialListItem.allowSubstitutio.zh: 允许替代要发放的产品。
ProductMaterialListItem.allowSubstitutio.en: Allow substitution of the product to be issued.

ProductMaterialListItem.allowUnderConsum.zh: 此标志确定物料消耗检查是否允许发放少于 MaterialListItem 条目中指定的物料。
ProductMaterialListItem.allowUnderConsum.en: This flag determines if the material consumption check will allow less materials to be issued than specified in the MaterialListItem entry

ProductMaterialListItem.assemblySequence.zh: 物料应被组装的顺序。仅当物料分配给步骤/规格时，此值才使用。
ProductMaterialListItem.assemblySequence.en: Sequence the item should be assembled. The value is only used if the item is assigned to a Step/Spec

ProductMaterialListItem.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
ProductMaterialListItem.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

ProductMaterialListItem.effectiveFromDat.zh: 如果指定，这是此需求变为可用的开始日期和时间。
ProductMaterialListItem.effectiveFromDat.en: If specified, this is the starting date and time when this Requirement becomes available.

ProductMaterialListItem.effectiveFromDat.zh: 如果指定，这是此需求变为可用的开始日期和时间。
ProductMaterialListItem.effectiveFromDat.en: If specified, this is the starting date and time when this Requirement becomes available.

ProductMaterialListItem.effectiveThruDat.zh: 如果指定，这是此需求不再可用的结束日期和时间。
ProductMaterialListItem.effectiveThruDat.en: If specified, this is the ending date and time when this Requirement becomes no longer available.

ProductMaterialListItem.effectiveThruDat.zh: 如果指定，这是此需求不再可用的结束日期和时间。
ProductMaterialListItem.effectiveThruDat.en: If specified, this is the ending date and time when this Requirement becomes no longer available.

ProductMaterialListItem.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。
ProductMaterialListItem.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

ProductMaterialListItem.isImage.zh: 与物料列表项关联的图像
ProductMaterialListItem.isImage.en: Image associated to the material list item

ProductMaterialListItem.isSourceProduct.zh: 指示是否应将产品用作构建目标产品的源物料的标志。
ProductMaterialListItem.isSourceProduct.en: Flag indicating whether the Product should be used as the source material to build the target Product.

ProductMaterialListItem.name.zh: 名称子实体的唯一名称。
ProductMaterialListItem.name.en: Unique name for the name subentity.

ProductMaterialListItem.parentRevision.zh: 修订版本（在基础实体上下文中唯一）
ProductMaterialListItem.parentRevision.en: Revision (unique within the context of the base entity)

ProductMaterialListItem.phantomBill.zh: 物料清单定义了生产特定产品所需的物料。虚拟 BOM 是不存在实际装配的产品的物料清单，仅用于保存一组相关组件。当这种逻辑组件分组用于许多成品时，创建虚拟 BOM 以减少维护工作，这样逻辑组件组的维护可以在一处完成。注意物料列表项上直接引用的虚拟 BOM 通常只是指向与物料列表项关联的产品定义的 BOM 的指针。
ProductMaterialListItem.phantomBill.en: A bill of material defines the materials needed to produce a specific product. A Phantom Bill is a bill of material for a product that does not exist as an actual assembly, but is created only for the purpose of holding a group of related components. A phantom bill is created to reduce maintenance efforts, when such a logical grouping of components is used for many finished products, so that the maintenance of the logical group of components can be done in one place only. Note the Phantom Bill referenced on the material list item directly will ordinarily just be a pointer to a bill defined as part of the associated Product referenced by the material list item.

ProductMaterialListItem.producingOrder.zh: 最长 255 个字符的字符串字段。

ProductMaterialListItem.qty2Required.zh: 如果跟踪多个数量，则此组件项所需的数量。
ProductMaterialListItem.qty2Required.en: Quantity of this component item required, if multiple quantities are being tracked.

ProductMaterialListItem.qtyIssued.zh: 已为该物料发放的材料数量（单独）
ProductMaterialListItem.qtyIssued.en: Material quantity (individual) that has been issued for the item

ProductMaterialListItem.qtyRequired.en: Quantity of this component item required.

ProductMaterialListItem.referenceDesigna.zh: 此物料放置在装配体上或内部的特定位置。
ProductMaterialListItem.referenceDesigna.en: The specific position on or in the assembly where this item is placed.

ProductMaterialListItem.scrapPercent.zh: 此物料预计报废的百分比。
ProductMaterialListItem.scrapPercent.en: Percent of this item expected to be scrapped.

ProductMaterialListItem.scsIsComponentIs.zh: 指示物料是通过 CEP Component Issue 还是 SCS Material Consumption 逻辑消耗的标志。
ProductMaterialListItem.scsIsComponentIs.en: Flag to denote if the material is to be consumed via CEP Component Issue or SCS Material Consumption logic

ProductMaterialListItem.setupQty.zh: 初始化处理资源所需的此组件项的数量。
ProductMaterialListItem.setupQty.en: The amount of this component item needed to initialize the processing resource.

ProductMaterialListItem.setupQty2.zh: 初始化处理资源所需的此组件项的数量。
ProductMaterialListItem.setupQty2.en: The amount of this component item needed to initialize the processing resource.

ProductMaterialListItem.spec.zh: Process Spec（规范）的实例描述了工作流中某个步骤发生的处理。它引用了许多其他建模组件，包括操作、指令集、设置、数据收集定义和资源。规范还包括详细的排程和处理参数信息。规范由工作流中的步骤引用（使用）。许多工作流步骤可以使用一个规范。规范用于定义要执行的处理。操作用于定义物料在工厂中流动或移动的规则。有关排程详细信息，请参阅操作定义。
ProductMaterialListItem.spec.en: An instance of a Process Spec (Spec) describes the processing that takes place at a Step within a Workflow. It references many other Modeling components including an Operation, InstructionSet, Setup, Data Collection Definitions and Resources. Specs also include detailed scheduling and processing parameter information. A Spec is referenced (used) by a Step within a Workflow. Many Workflow Steps can use one Spec. A Spec is used to define the processing that is to be performed. An Operation is used to define (rules for) the flow or movement of Material through the Factory. See the Operation Definition for Scheduling Details information.

ProductMaterialListItem.uom.en: The unit of measure for the QtyRequired.

ProductMaterialListItem.uom2.en: The unit of measure for Qty2Required.

ProductMaterialListItem.vendorControl.zh: 指示此物料是否需要供应商信息。
ProductMaterialListItem.vendorControl.en: Denotes whether Vendor information is required for this item.

ProductType.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
ProductType.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

ProductType.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
ProductType.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

ProductType.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。
ProductType.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions).

ProductType.notes.zh: 与此对象关联的注释和评论。
ProductType.notes.en: Notations and comments associated with this object.

ProductType.setupAccess.zh: 用于验证用户对特定建模记录的访问权限。必须首先将一个或多个 Setup Access 分配给 Role。每个建模记录将有一个 Setup Access。当建模记录被事务处理时，系统将比较其 Setup Access。
ProductType.setupAccess.en: This is used to verify the user's access to a particular modeling record. One or more Setup Access must first be assigned to a Role. Each modeling record will have one Setup Access. When a modeling record in transacted the system will compare its Setup Ac

ProductType.wipMsgDefMgr.zh: 包含此CDO的WIP消息的WIP消息定义
ProductType.wipMsgDefMgr.en: WIP Message Definition which contains WIP messages for this CDO

QtyAdjustReason.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
QtyAdjustReason.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

QtyAdjustReason.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
QtyAdjustReason.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

QtyAdjustReason.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。
QtyAdjustReason.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions).

QtyAdjustReason.notes.zh: 与此对象关联的注释和评论。
QtyAdjustReason.notes.en: Notations and comments associated with this object.

QtyAdjustReason.setupAccess.zh: 用于验证用户对特定建模记录的访问权限。必须首先将一个或多个 Setup Access 分配给 Role。每个建模记录将有一个 Setup Access。当建模记录被事务处理时，系统将比较其 Setup Access。
QtyAdjustReason.setupAccess.en: This is used to verify the user's access to a particular modeling record. One or more Setup Access must first be assigned to a Role. Each modeling record will have one Setup Access. When a modeling record in transacted the system will compare its Setup Ac

QtyHistory.closeWhenZero.zh: 指示交易是否会关闭任何其数量被交易设为零的容器。
QtyHistory.closeWhenZero.en: Indicates if the transaction would close any containers whose quantities were set to zero by the transaction.

QtyHistory.integrationTxn.zh: 在复合/容器/资源事务后插入 TxnId 与历史主线。
QtyHistory.integrationTxn.en: Inserts the TxnId after a compound/container/resource transaction with history mainline.

QtyHistory.resource.zh: 更改数量时容器正在其上处理的资源。
QtyHistory.resource.en: The resource the container was being processed on when the quantities were changed.

QtyHistory.thruputReportingLevel.zh: 用于调整吞吐量的容器级别，以说明处理前与处理后发生的数量变化。为了正常运行，必须与 Thruput 交易使用的 ThruputReportingLevel 匹配。通常此字段从 CVE 中获取值，该 CVE 从操作中查找 ThruputReportingLevel，并且不允许用户更新此字段。
QtyHistory.thruputReportingLevel.en: The Container Level at which to adjust thruput, to account for quantity changes that happened before processing versus after processing. For correct functioning, must match the ThruputReportingLevel used by the Thruput transaction. Typically this field gets its value from a CVE that looks up the ThruputReportingLevel from the operation, and users are not allowed to update this field.

QtyHistory.thruputSummary.zh: 是否在 ChangeQtyDetail 记录中调整吞吐量。
QtyHistory.thruputSummary.en: Whether to adjust thruput in the ChangeQtyDetail records .

QtyHistory.unitsLost.zh: 在此交易中数量变为零的单位。
QtyHistory.unitsLost.en: Units whose quantity went to zero for this transaction.

QtyHistoryDetails.adjustThruput.zh: 指示是否调整了吞吐量。

QtyHistoryDetails.changeQtyType.zh: 1 = 缺陷，2 = 损失，3 = 销售，4 = 调整，5 = 奖励，6 = 购买
QtyHistoryDetails.changeQtyType.en: 1 = defect, 2 = loss, 3 = sell, 4 = adjust, 5 = bonus, 6 = buy

QtyHistoryDetails.chargeToStep.zh: 通常，数量变化会立即被记录。但在某些情况下，在一个步骤执行的测试可能表明更早的步骤导致了数量变化。此字段允许系统记录导致数量变化的步骤。
QtyHistoryDetails.chargeToStep.en: Normally, a change in quantity is noted immediately. However, in some cases, a test performed at a step may show that an earlier step caused a change in quantity. This field allows the system to note the step that caused the quantity to change.

QtyHistoryDetails.childrenLost.en: The number of child containers lost.

QtyHistoryDetails.closeWhenZero.zh: 指示如果 Qty 或 Qty 字段变为 0 是否关闭容器。
QtyHistoryDetails.closeWhenZero.en: To indicate whether to close the container if Qty or Qty fields become 0.

QtyHistoryDetails.comments.zh: 包含用户为特定容器输入的备注。
QtyHistoryDetails.comments.en: Contains notes which the user entered for the specific container.

QtyHistoryDetails.container.zh: 从中产生损失的特定容器。
QtyHistoryDetails.container.en: The specific container from which the loss was taken.

QtyHistoryDetails.countsAgainstProductio.zh: 记录损失是否计入生产。这样可以启用用于产量计算的选项。
QtyHistoryDetails.countsAgainstProductio.en: Records whether or not the losses are charged against Production. This enables options used for yield calculations.

QtyHistoryDetails.integrationTxn.zh: 在复合/容器/资源事务后插入 TxnId 与历史主线。
QtyHistoryDetails.integrationTxn.en: Inserts the TxnId after a compound/container/resource transaction with history mainline.

QtyHistoryDetails.isRollup.zh: 指示此数量历史详细信息是否是子容器数量更改的汇总（摘要）。
QtyHistoryDetails.isRollup.en: Indicates if this qty history details is a rollup (summary) of qty changes for child containers.

QtyHistoryDetails.operation.zh: 容器进行数量更改交易的操作。
QtyHistoryDetails.operation.en: The operation at which the container had the change quantity transacted.

QtyHistoryDetails.product.zh: 容器中损失数量的产品。
QtyHistoryDetails.product.en: The product in the container that lost quantity.

QtyHistoryDetails.qty.zh: 特定容器损失的材料数量。
QtyHistoryDetails.qty.en: The amount of material lost for the specific container.

QtyHistoryDetails.qty2.zh: 如果容器使用辅助计量单位进行跟踪，则这是特定容器损失的材料数量。

ResourceStatusHistory.oldResourceStatusR.en: A Resource Status Reason Code is used to provide an added level of detail describing the reason for the current status of a Resource. For example, the current status may be REPAIR. A Status Reason Code can be used to provide additional details such as the type of repair that is being performed. ResourceStatusHistory.oldRun.en: Run number before this transaction was completed. Run numbers are often used to indicate a period of processing when the machine has been running without any maintenance or configuration change, and thefore is likely to be processing consistently . The value is often set (incremented) as part of the Resource Setup transaction. All Throughput and Movement transactions record this value in their history transactions.

ResourceStatusHistory.oldUpdateLastStatu.zh: 描述上次事务中LastStatusChangeDate如何更新的逻辑。有效值 = {1, 2, 3}。此值决定LastStatusChangeDate的值是否更新。值为1表示如果以下任何一项为真，则更新LastStatusChangeDate：有效原因、状态、运行或设置。值为2表示在所有条件下都更新LastStatusChangeDate。值为3表示不更新LastStatusChangeDate。
ResourceStatusHistory.oldUpdateLastStatu.en: The logic describing how the LastStatusChangeDate was udated on the previous transaction. Valid values = { 1, 2, 3 }. This value determine if the value of LastStatusChangeDate gets updated or not. A value of 1 indicates to update the LastStatusChangeDate if any of the following is true: valid reason, status, run, or seup. A value of 2 indicates to update LastStatusChangeDate under all conditions. A value of 3 indicates no update to the LastStatusChangeDate.

ResourceThruputHistory.resource.zh: 资源描述工厂内的任何非物料实体。资源的常见用途（也是最具体的示例）是描述机器。资源与单个工厂关联，以定义其物理位置。资源还属于零个或多个资源组，以提供逻辑分组。资源是静态（建模）实体。每个资源可以有一个资源状态条目，以跟踪为每个状态类别定义的当前状态。应用程序提供了三个特定的状态类别：生产、预防性维护和日志。生产用于确定生产可用性。预防性维护用于跟踪资源的每个预防性维护的当前状态。日志用于提供记录自由格式评论并可选分配预定义状态和原因代码的机制。客户可以定义额外的日志类型状态类别，以多种用户定义的方式同时跟踪资源状态。
ResourceThruputHistory.resource.en: A Resource describes any non-material entity within a factory. The common use (and most concrete example) of a Resource is to describe a Machine. Resources are associated with a single factory, to define their physical location. Resources also belong to zero or more Resource Groups, to provide a logical grouping. A Resource is a static (modeling) entity. Each Resource can have a Resource Status entry to track the current status for each Status Category defined. The application is delivered with three specific Status Categories. They are Production, Preventative Maintenance and Log. Production is used to determine availability for production. Preventative Maintenance is used to track the current status of each Preventative Maintenance for a Resource. Log is used to provide a mechanism for logging freeform comments and optionally assigning predefined status and reason codes. Customers can define additional Log-type Status Categories to concurrently track Resource status is multiple user-defined ways.

ResourceThruputHistory.run.zh: 当前设置编号。此值用于标识使用特定设置执行的所有工作。该值作为资源设置事务的一部分进行设置（递增）。所有吞吐量和移动事务都在其历史事务中记录此值。
ResourceThruputHistory.run.en: Current Setup number. This value is used to identify all of the work that is performed using a specific Setup. The value is set (incremented) as part of the Resource Setup transaction. All Throughput and Movement transactions record this value in their history transactions.

ResourceThruputHistory.setup.zh: 设置定义描述了所需的工作、所需的物料，并估计完成特定任务设置所需的时间。设置定义的典型用途是描述为处理一批或多批物料而准备机器所需的条件。设置可以引用外部文档和/或指令集来描述所需的设置工作。每个设置还可以包含对要下载到机器的配方文件的引用。配方文件作为文档存储。关联的文档查看器是用于将配方下载到机器而启动的程序。
ResourceThruputHistory.setup.en: A Setup Definition describes the work required, materials required, and estimates how long it will take to setup for a specific task. A typical use of a Setup Definition is to describe what it will take to prepare a machine for processing a batch or multiple batches of material. A Setup can reference an external document and/or an InstructionSet to describe the setup work required. Each Setup can also include a reference to a Recipe file for downloading to a machine. Recipe files are stored as Documents. The associated Document Viewer is the program to launch for downloading (the recipe) to a machine.

ResourceThruputHistory.uom.en: Unit of measure for the first quantity.

ResourceThruputHistory.uom2.en: Unit of measure for the 2nd quantity.

ReworkStatus.reworkReason.en: Reference to the (user defined) reason code describing why this Container is being reworked. This value is used for inquiries and reporting (i.e., Rework by Reason Code Analysis).

SalesOrder.uom2.zh: 标识为履行此销售订单而要生产的（最终）次要计量单位。仅当产品容器使用次要计量单位跟踪时才使用此字段。
SalesOrder.uom2.en: Identifies the (final) secondary UOM to be produced in fulfillment of this Sales Order. This field is only use if the product containers use secondary unit of measure tracking.

SalesOrder.wipMsgDefMgr.zh: 附加到建模实体实例，包含适用于该实体的消息。当被要求提供其WIP消息时，建模实体将要求其WIPMsgDefMgr提供已过滤的WIP消息列表，仅包含适用于当前情况（步骤、操作和标签）的消息。WIPMsgDefMgr将检查AllKey WIPMsgKey（如果指定，包含适用于所有步骤的消息），并遍历OperationKeys和LabelKeys列表中的条目，过滤找到的每条消息。
SalesOrder.wipMsgDefMgr.en: Attached to an instance of a modeling entity, this contains the messages that apply to the entity. When asked to supply its WIP Messages, a modeling entity will ask its WIPMsgDefMgr to supply a list of WIP Messages that have been filtered to include only the messages that apply to the current circumstances (step, operation and label). The WIPMsgDefMgr will check the AllKey WIPMsgKey (which contains a message that applies to all steps) if specified, and run through the entries in the OperationKeys and LabelKeys lists and filter each message found.

SampleDataPoint.changeHistory.zh: 每个建模实体都包含 Change Status。它用于记录当前的变更（维护）状态（例如，特定 Product Definition 的维护正在进行中），并跟踪最后一次更改的人员和时间。这应该可扩展为随时间变化的完整历史记录。
SampleDataPoint.changeHistory.en: Every modeling entity includes a Change Status. It is used to record the current Change (Maintenance) Status (i.e., maintenance is currently in progress for a specific Product Definition) and to track who made the last change and when. This should be extendible to a complete history over time.

SampleTest.allowMoveOnFailure.en: Indicates if the container can be moved if a sample test is rejected.

SampleTest.aqlRejectReasons.zh: 提供样本失败的拒收原因列表。仅用于计数型样本类型。将向用户显示原因列表，他们可以为每个原因输入失败的样本数。
SampleTest.aqlRejectReasons.en: Provides a list of reject reasons for sample failures. This is used for counted sample types only. The user will be displayed a list of reasons and they can enter the number of samples that failed for each reason.

SampleTest.changeHistory.zh: 每个建模实体都包含 Change Status。它用于记录当前的变更（维护）状态（例如，特定 Product Definition 的维护正在进行中），并跟踪最后一次更改的人员和时间。这应该可扩展为随时间变化的完整历史记录。
SampleTest.changeHistory.en: Every modeling entity includes a Change Status. It is used to record the current Change (Maintenance) Status (i.e., maintenance is currently in progress for a specific Product Definition) and to track who made the last change and when. This should be extendible to a complete history over time.

SampleTest.classification.zh: 用于对质量对象进行分类。这是在样本测试失败时创建生产事件的默认分类。
SampleTest.classification.en: Used to classify QualityObjects. This is the default classification used for creating a Production even upon the failure of the Sample Test.

SampleTest.decreaseByRejectCountReason.zh: 指示容器的数量将使用选定的损失原因代码按拒绝计数减少。
SampleTest.decreaseByRejectCountReason.en: Indicates the container’s qty will be reduced by the Reject Count using the selected Loss Reason Code.

SampleTest.decreaseBySampleSizeReason.zh: 指示容器的数量将使用选定的损失原因代码按抽样大小减少。可用于减少容器数量以进行破坏性测试。
SampleTest.decreaseBySampleSizeReason.en: Indicates the Container’s quantity will be reduced by the Sample Size using the selected Loss Reason Code. Can be used to reduce the containers qty for destructive testing.

SampleTest.defaultFailureMode.zh: 指示容器的数量将使用选定的损失原因代码按拒绝计数减少。
SampleTest.defaultFailureMode.en: Indicates the container’s qty will be reduced by the Reject Count using the selected Loss Reason Code.

This should be extendible to a complete history over time.

This item is specified in the Product where, for purchased products, one can relate the product to a list of sources where the product can be purchased. scsBinDefinition.binCount.zh: 具有指定BinCode的基板上的设备数量。
scsBinDefinition.binCount.en: The number of devices on the substrate with the specified BinCode.

scsBinDefinition.binDescription.en: A description of the specified BinCode (e.g., 100MHz).

scsBinDefinition.binQuality.en: Describes the quality of the specified BinCode.

scsBinDefinition.pick.zh: Pick = True表示应处理具有此BinCode的设备。Pick = False表示不应处理具有此BinCode的设备。
scsBinDefinition.pick.en: Pick = True indicates that devices with this BinCode should be processed. Pick = False indicates that devices with this BinCode should not be processed.

scsSchedulingMatrix.scsProcessSpec.zh: 过程规格指处理批次所需的加工规格。必须将过程规格分配给批次（通过批次调度），然后才能进入生产。

scsSchedulingMatrix.scsProduct.en: A Product is typically a definition of what kind of material needs to be provided to a customer or what kind of material is being used as a raw material or other component in a manufacturing process. Products can belong to a Product Family. A product to

scsSchedulingMatrix.scsSpec.zh: 规范（Spec）描述了在工作流中的步骤处进行的处理。它引用了许多其他建模组件，包括工序、设置、数据收集定义和资源。规范还包括详细的调度和...
scsSchedulingMatrix.scsSpec.en: A specification (Spec) describes the processing that takes place at a Step within a Workflow. It references many other Modeling components including an Operation, Setup, Data Collection Definitions and Resources. Specs also include detailed scheduling and

scsSchedulingMatrixDetail.durationPerUni.zh: 此值指定处理单个单元所需的时间。用于周期时间和成本核算计算。
scsSchedulingMatrixDetail.durationPerUni.en: This value specifies the amount of time needed to process a single unit. This is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

scsSchedulingMatrixDetail.fastCycleTime.zh: 这是一个计算值，表示使用此Spec处理标准尺寸批次物料所需的时间，假设队列时间较快。例如，用于确定作业可以多快通过工厂加速。该值的计算使用其他CDO的属性。这意味着更改工作中心值等会影响此值。因此，应在每次需要时重新计算该值。持久化的值仅在保存此Spec时的时间点有效。
scsSchedulingMatrixDetail.fastCycleTime.en: This is a calculated value that denotes the time required processing a standard size batch of material using this Spec, assuming fast queue time. This is used to determine, for example, how quickly a job can be expedited through the Factory. The calculation for this value uses attributes of other CDOs. This means that changing a Work Center value, for example, can effect this value. This means that this value should be calculated each time that it is needed. The value that is persisted will only be valid as of the point in time that this Spec was saved.

scsSchedulingMatrixDetail.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。
scsSchedulingMatrixDetail.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

scsSchedulingMatrixDetail.normalCycleTim.zh: 这是一个计算值，表示使用此Spec处理标准尺寸批次物料所需的时间，假设正常队列时间。该值的计算使用其他CDO的属性。这意味着更改工作中心值等会影响此值。因此，应在每次需要时重新计算该值。持久化的值仅在保存此Spec时的时间点有效。
scsSchedulingMatrixDetail.normalCycleTim.en: This is a calculated value that denotes the time required processing a standard size batch of material using this Spec, assuming normal queue time. The calculation for this value uses attributes of other CDOs. This means that changing a Work Center value, for example, can effect this value. This means that this value should be calculated each time that it is needed. The value that is persisted will only be valid as of the point in time that this Spec was saved.

scsSchedulingMatrixDetail.runRateOption.zh: 此选项确定运行速率是以每单位小时数还是每小时单位数指定。数值及其含义为：1 = 每单位小时数（RunRateTime）2 = 每小时单位数（RunRateQty）
scsSchedulingMatrixDetail.runRateOption.en: This option determines if run rate is specified as hours per unit or units per hour. The values and their meanings are: 1 = Hours per unit (RunRateTime) 2 = Units per hour (RunRateQty)

scsSchedulingMatrixDetail.setupTime.zh: 此值指定在此操作处进行 Setup 所需的时间。用于周期时间和成本核算计算。
scsSchedulingMatrixDetail.setupTime.en: This value specifies the time required for a Setup at this Operation. This is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

scsSchedulingMatrixDetail.stdBatchSize.zh: 此值指定使用此Spec处理的物料批次的标准尺寸。用于周期时间和成本核算计算。
scsSchedulingMatrixDetail.stdBatchSize.en: This value specifies the standard size of a batch of material processed using this Spec. This is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

scsSchedulingMatrixDetail.timePerBatch.zh: 此值指定处理单个批次所需的时间。
scsSchedulingMatrixDetail.timePerBatch.en: This value specified the time needed to process a single Batch.

scsSchedulingMatrixDetail.unitsPerHour.zh: 此值指定每小时处理的单位数。用于周期时间和成本核算计算。
scsSchedulingMatrixDetail.unitsPerHour.en: This value specifies the number of units processed in an hour. This is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

scsSchedulingMatrixDetail.unscheduledTim.zh: 未包含在UPH、HPU或批次时间条目中的处理时间。
scsSchedulingMatrixDetail.unscheduledTim.en: Process time that is not contained in the UPH,HPU or Batch Time entries.

scsSchedulingMatrixDetail.yield.zh: 指定使用此 Spec 处理时预期的标准良率。此值用于周期时间和成本核算计算。
scsSchedulingMatrixDetail.yield.en: Specifies the standard yield expected for processing with this Spec. This value is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

SessionValues.factory.en: Describes a Factory to the application. Factories are defined within an Enterprise. Users are authorized to perform work (Services) within Factories. Products include a list of the Factories where they can be manufactured. A Factory contains zero or more Locations.

SessionValues.layoutImage.zh: 用于定义一个或多个资源在布局中的位置的设置。它供自定义应用程序用于在用户界面上排列资源。
SessionValues.layoutImage.en: Setup used to define the locations of one or more Resources in a layout. It is meant for custom applications to use to arrange Resources on a user interface.

SessionValues.locationIconId.en: Default identifier for the Icon to display with an instance of a Location

SessionValues.operation.zh: 工序是跟踪库存和生产活动的制造或加工点。工序描述诸如原因代码、工作中心以及物料通过工作流步骤的允许事务。相比之下，规格定义在工序处执行的特定加工。工序还提供过程的一般规则并提供一般报告结构。工序由工作流步骤处的规格引用。
SessionValues.operation.en: An Operation is a manufacturing or processing point where inventory and production activities are tracked. The Operation describes such things as the reason codes, the work center, and the allowed transactions for the movement of material through a workflow step. In contrast, specifications define the specific processing that is performed at an operation. The Operation also provides the general rules for the process and provides a general reporting construct. An Operation is referenced by a specification at a workflow step.

SessionValues.resource.zh: Resource描述工厂内的任何非物料实体。Resource的常见用途（也是最具体的示例）是描述机器。Resource与单个工厂关联以定义其物理位置。Resource还属于零个或多个Resource Group以提供逻辑分组。Resource是静态（建模）实体。每个Resource可以有一个Resource Status条目，用于跟踪每个已定义状态类别的当前状态。应用程序附带三个特定的状态类别：生产、预防性维护和日志。生产用于确定生产可用性。预防性维护用于跟踪Resource的当前预防性维护状态。日志用于提供记录自由格式注释以及可选分配预定义状态和原因代码的机制。客户可以定义其他状态类别，以多种用户定义的方式同时跟踪Resource状态。
SessionValues.resource.en: A Resource describes any non-material entity within a factory. The common use (and most concrete example) of a Resource is to describe a Machine. Resources are associated with a single factory, to define their physical location. Resources also belong to zero or more Resource Groups, to provide a logical grouping. A Resource is a static (modeling) entity. Each Resource can have a Resource Status entry to track the current status for each Status Category defined. The application is delivered with three specific Status Categories. They are Production, Preventative Maintenance and Log. Production is used to determine availability for production. Preventative Maintenance is used to track the current Preventative Maintenance status for a Resource. Log is used to provide a mechanism for logging freeform comments and optionally assigning predefined status and reason codes. Customers can define additional Status categories to concurrently track Resource status is multiple user-defined ways.

SessionValues.serviceTypeId.en: CDO Definition Id of Default Service

SessionValues.spec.zh: 规格（Spec）描述了在工作流中的步骤处发生的处理。它引用许多其他建模组件，包括工序、设置、数据采集定义和资源。规格还包括详细的计划和加工参数信息。规格被工作流中的步骤引用（使用）。许多工作流步骤可以使用一个规格。规格用于定义要执行的处理。工序用于定义物料通过工厂的流动或移动的（规则）。请参阅工序定义以获取计划详细信息。
SessionValues.spec.en: A specification (Spec) describes the processing that takes place at a Step within a Workflow. It references many other Modeling components including an Operation, Setup, Data Collection Definitions and Resources. Specs also include detailed scheduling and processing parameter information. A Spec is referenced (used) by a Step within a Workflow. Many Workflow Steps can use one Spec. A Spec is used to define the processing that is to be performed. An Operation is used to define (rules for) the flow or movement of Material through the Factory. See the Operation Definition for Scheduling Details information.

SessionValues.workCenter.zh: Work Center 通常是执行类似性质工作的区域。Work Center 包含零个或多个 Operation。Work Center 是 InSite 中执行调度的组件。调度可以按员工或资源进行。如果多个 Operation 共享员工、资源或两者，则 Work Center 可以有多个 Operation。例如，名为 Grind 的 Operation 和名为 Polish 的 Operation 使用相同的资源，因此它们指向同一 Work Center 进行调度。也可以一个 Operation 对应一个 Work Center。
SessionValues.workCenter.en: A work center is typically an area where work of a similar nature is performed. A work Center contains zero or more operations. The work center is the component through which scheduling is performed through InSite. Scheduling can be conducted according to either employees or resources. A work center may have multiple operations if the operations are sharing employees, resources, or both. For example, an operation called Grind and an operation called Polish both use the same resources so they point to the same work center for scheduling purposes. There can also be one operation to one work center.

SessionValues.workCenterIconId.zh: 与工作中心实例一起显示的图标的默认标识符。
SessionValues.workCenterIconId.en: Default identifier for the Icon to display with an instance of a Work Center

SessionValues.workstation.en: The default Workstation for the Employee.

Setup.changeHistory.zh: 每个建模实体都包含 Change Status。它用于记录当前的变更（维护）状态（例如，特定 Product Definition 的维护正在进行中），并跟踪最后一次更改的人员和时间。这应该可扩展为随时间变化的完整历史记录。
Setup.changeHistory.en: Every modeling entity includes a Change Status. It is used to record the current Change (Maintenance) Status (i.e., maintenance is currently in progress for a specific Product Definition) and to track who made the last change and when. This should be extendible to a complete history over time.

A Customer definition typically refers to a company other than your own, but it can also be used for a factory or department that requires goods and services from another factory or department within the enterprise.

ShipmentDestination.factory.en: A Factory often represent a physical or logical plant. A Factory can be any division, department, section, or group that is separated for accounting and reporting purposes. A Factory often represents a physical manufacturing building.

ShipmentDestination.localContainerStatus.zh: 本地站点上容器在发送到ShipmentDestination时被设置的状态。此容器的当前状态。此值用于区分活动、已关闭和已删除的容器。有效值及其含义：0 = 已删除 1 = 活动 2 = 已关闭 3 = 在途（已发货）4 = 已发放（组件）已删除的容器是指所有事务（包括Create（或Split-to）事务）都已反转的容器。
ShipmentDestination.localContainerStatus.en: Status of the Container on the Local Site that is being set when it is sent to the ShipmentDestination. Current status of this Container. This value is used to distinguish between Containers that are active, closed and those that have been deleted. Valid values and their meanings are: 0 = Deleted 1 = Active 2 = Closed 3 = In Transit (shipped) 4 = Issued (component) A deleted Container is one where all of the transactions, including the Create (or Split-to) transaction have been reversed.

ShipmentDestination.location.zh: 定义工厂内的物理位置。可以是定义整个工厂的单个位置，也可以是存放区域内每个箱体的单独位置。每个Container都包含一个Location属性，用于标识Container的物理位置并生成按位置统计的WIP等报告。
ShipmentDestination.location.en: Defines a physical location within a Factory. This can be as high level as a single Location that defines the entire Factory or as specific as individual Locations for each bin within a holding area. Every Container includes a Location attribute. This is used to identify the physical location of the Container and produce reports such as WIP by Location.

ShipmentDestination.remoteContainerStatu.en: Status of the Container on the Remote Site that is being set when it is received at the ShipmentDestination. Current status of this Container. This value is used to distinguish between Containers that are active, closed and those that have been deleted. Valid values and their meanings are: 0 = Deleted 1 = Active 2 = Closed 3 = In Transit (shipped) 4 = Issued (component) A deleted Container is one where all of the transactions, including the Create (or Split-to) transaction have been reversed.

ShopFloorSettings.level.zh: 容器级别是分配给容器的跟踪指定。该级别标识容器在容器结构中的位置。在InSite中，容器定义为工厂中生产的产品的一个离散集合。每个容器都有唯一的标识符，用于追溯和执行车间事务。常用的级别名称有批次（batch）和批次（lot）。容器级别根据各公司的具体需求进行定义。一些行业特定级别的示例包括卷（roll）、箱（bin）和盒（cassette）。许多公司还在更大的父容器内跟踪更小的级别。在InSite中，这通过多级跟踪实现。父级和子级容器通过Associate、Combine或Group Start事务关联。例如，一组容器可以有一个父容器（批次级别）和关联的子容器（托盘级别）。容器组也可以有超过两个级别。
ShopFloorSettings.level.en: A Container Level is the tracking designation assigned to a container. The level identifies the position of the container within a container structure. A container is defined within InSite as a discrete collection of products produced in a factory. Each container has a unique identifier used for traceability and performance of shop floor transactions. Commonly used level names are batch and lot. Container Levels are defined to meet the specific requirements of each company. Examples of some industry-specific levels are roll, bin, and cassette. Many companies also track smaller levels within the larger, parent container. With InSite, this is accomplished through multi-level tracking. Parent and child level containers are associated using the Associate, Combine or Group Start transactions. For example, a group of containers can have a parent with a batch level and associated child containers with tray levels. Container groups can also have more than two levels.

ShopFloorSettings.notes.en: Notations and comments associated with this object.

ShopFloorSettings.owner.zh: 每个容器都有一个关联的所有者代码。所有者代码用作分组，以区分容器进行查询和处理。所有者代码的示例有“制造”、“工程”、“原型”、“销售样品”等。
ShopFloorSettings.owner.en: Every Container has an associated Owner Code. The owner code is used as a grouping to separate Containers for inquiry and processing. Examples of Owner Code are "Manufacturing", "Engineering", "Prototypes", "SalesSamples", etc.

ShopFloorSettings.productType.zh: 产品类型代码用于区分产品类型，例如在制品、原材料、成品等。
ShopFloorSettings.productType.en: Product Type Codes are used to differentiate between types of product such as WIP, Raw Material, Finished Goods, etc.

ShopFloorSettings.startReason.zh: 每个 Container 都有关联的 Start Code。Start Code 可用于 WIP Status 查询的选择条件以及事务报告（基于事务历史记录）。
ShopFloorSettings.startReason.en: Each Container has an associated Start Code. Start Codes are available for selection criteria on WIP Status Inquiries and for transaction reporting (based on the transaction history).

ShopFloorSettings.workflow.zh: 工作流定义了制造过程所需的路线和加工，是InSite工厂模型的主要驱动对象。当容器被创建（启动）时，它引用一个工作流（以及该工作流中的一个步骤）。Start事务的默认工作流是产品定义中引用的工作流。工作流是由路径和返工路径链接的步骤的集合。步骤引用其他工作流或规格，规格引用工序。注意，步骤、规格和工序的定义控制工作流中任何单独点的加工细节。
ShopFloorSettings.workflow.en: A Workflow defines the route and processing required for a manufacturing process, and is the primary driving object of the InSite factory model. When a Container is created (started) it references a Workflow (and a Step within that Workflow). The default Workflow for the Start transaction is the Workflow referenced in the Product definition. A Workflow is a collection of Steps that are linked by Paths and ReworkPaths. Steps reference either other Workflows or Specs, and a Spec references an Operation. Note that the definition of Step, Spec, and Operation controls the processing details at any individual point in the workflow.

SPCChartDef.displayOnException.en: When checked, Only out of control charts are displayed. In control charts (non-exceptions) are not displayed NOR kept in the output folder.

SPCChartDef.docToView.zh: 大多数建模实体包含对文档的引用。在此上下文中，文档用于提供扩展（非结构化）信息，例如产品图纸、扫描图像、相关的现有制造规范或操作程序。每个文档（CDO）实例包括外部文档的标识符（即文件名或URL）和对用于呈现文档的程序的引用。文档还用于定义要下载到机器的配方文件。在这种情况下，呈现文档意味着将其呈现（下载）给机器。
SPCChartDef.docToView.en: Most Modeling entities include a reference to a document. Documents are used in this context to provide extended (unstructured) information, such as product drawings, scanned images, relating existing manufacturing specifications, or operating procedures. Each instance of a document (CDO) includes an identifier for the external document (i.e., a file name or a URL) and a reference to the program used for presenting the document. Documents are also used to define recipe files for downloading to machines. In this case, presenting the Document means presenting it (downloading it) to a machine.

SPCChartDef.spcChartType.zh: 定义 SPC 软件可以绘制的所有支持的图表。用作创建 SPCSetup 时的模板。注意，名称字段必须与 Statit 识别的图表命令匹配。

SPCChartDef.spcRules.zh: 链接到物理SPC规则文件，并由SPC设置用于定义应用于SPC图表的规则。注意，名称字段必须与Statit环境中设置的规则名称匹配。
SPCChartDef.spcRules.en: Links to a physical SPC rules file and is used by SPC Setup to define the rules to be applied to an SPC Chart. Note that the Name field must match the rule name setup in the Statit environment.

SPCChartDef.triggerOcaPs.zh: 指示SPC.DLL在此图表包含产生规则违规的数据点时执行所有已配置OCAP的标志。
SPCChartDef.triggerOcaPs.en: A flag that instructs the SPC.DLL to perform all of the OCAPs that are configured when this chart contains data points that produce rule violations.
