Spec.allowCountVariance.en: Flag indicating whether Count Variance recording is allowed for the step.

Spec.allowDefectQty.zh: 指示是否允许收集缺陷数量的标志。
Spec.allowDefectQty.en: Flag indicating whether the Defect Qty is allowed to collect.

Spec.allowDummyQty.zh: i) 设置是否允许在track out和move out期间收集虚拟数量。
Spec.allowDummyQty.en: i) Set whether the collection of dummy quantity during track out and move out is allowed.

Spec.allowMaterialLoading.zh: 指示批次是否可以在其步骤中加载到设备的标志。
Spec.allowMaterialLoading.en: Flag indicating whether the lot can be loaded into the equipment at its step.

Spec.allowNumberOfStrips.zh: i) 设置是否允许在track out和move out期间收集条带数量。
Spec.allowNumberOfStrips.en: i) Set whether the collection of number of strips during track out and move out is allowed.

Spec.allowOtherResource.zh: 允许执行上次移动的资源以外的其他资源。
Spec.allowOtherResource.en: Allow other resource than the resource that performed last movement

Spec.allowRejectsRecording.zh: i) 设置操作是否允许记录拒收。
Spec.allowRejectsRecording.en: i) Set whether the operation allows reject recording.

Spec.allowReprocess.zh: 允许容器重复移动通过/进入此Spec。通常用于在先前测试无效时通过自动化测试设备重新运行容器。
Spec.allowReprocess.en: Allow a Container to be Moved through/into this Spec repeatedly. Commonly used to rerun a Container through automated testing equipment if the previous test was invalid

Spec.allowReworkTo.zh: 确定引用此Spec的步骤是否可以是返工事务的To-Step。
Spec.allowReworkTo.en: Determines if a Step that references this Spec can be the To-Step for a Rework Transaction

Spec.allowReworkableRejectQty.zh: i) 设置是否允许在记录拒收时收集可返工拒收。
Spec.allowReworkableRejectQty.en: i) Set whether the collection of re-workable rejects during rejects recording is allowed.

Spec.allowSplitUnProcessed.zh: 指示在Track Out期间是否显示Split Un-Processed字段的标志。
Spec.allowSplitUnProcessed.en: Flag indicating whether to display the Split Un-Processed fields during Track Out.

Spec.allowUnidentifiableRejectQty.zh: i) 设置是否允许在记录拒收时收集无法识别的拒收。
Spec.allowUnidentifiableRejectQty.en: i) Set whether the collection of unidentifiable rejects during rejects recording is allowed.

Spec.autoCreateFirstInsertion.zh: 指示批次移入WIP步骤后是否立即自动创建第一个插入的标志。
Spec.autoCreateFirstInsertion.en: Flag indicating whether to automatically create the first insertion right after the lot moves into a WIP step.

Spec.autoFillDataPointHistoryValue.zh: 此布尔值用于从上一条最新记录自动填充数据收集值。
Spec.autoFillDataPointHistoryValue.en: This Boolean is to auto filling data collection values from previous latest record

Spec.autoMoveOut.zh: i) 当前插入完成后自动移出。
Spec.autoMoveOut.en: i) Auto move out when the current insertion has completed.

Spec.autoRejectsRescreens.zh: 用于指定在检测到拒绝时是否自动创建新插入的字段。值 3 表示将自动创建重筛直至第 3 次插入（即直至第 2 次重筛）。对于晶圆加工，只有选定的晶圆
Spec.autoRejectsRescreens.en: Field used to specify whether to automatically create a new insertion if there is a reject detected. A value of 3 means rescreen will be automatically created up to the 3rd insertion (i.e. up to 2nd rescreen). For Wafer Processing, only wafers selected to

Spec.autoRemoveMaterials.zh: 指示设备中最后一批track out后是否从设备中移除所有物料的标志。
Spec.autoRemoveMaterials.en: Flag indicating whether to remove all the materials from the equipment after the last lot in the equipment tracks out.

Spec.autoSelectTrackOutLots.zh: i) 在track out期间选择其中一个批次时，自动选择一起track in到设备的其余批次。
Spec.autoSelectTrackOutLots.en: i) Automatically select the rest of the lots that were track in together into the equipment when one of them is selected during track out.

Spec.autoSetMoveOutQty.zh: 指示是否自动设置移出数量的标志。如果设置为false，则要求用户输入移出数量。
Spec.autoSetMoveOutQty.en: Flag indicating whether to automatically set the move out quantity. If set to false the user is required to enter the move out quantity.

Spec.autoSetTestProgram.zh: 指示是否自动为测试步骤设置测试程序的标志。如果设置为true，将使用在TestProgramSetup中找到的第一个与Process Spec、ProcessType和Spec匹配的记录。
Spec.autoSetTestProgram.en: Flag indicating whether to automatically set the test program for test steps. If set to true the first record found in TestProgramSetup that matches the Process Spec, ProcessType and Spec will be used.

Spec.autoSetTrackInQty.zh: 指示是否自动设置Track In数量的标志。
Spec.autoSetTrackInQty.en: Flag indicating whether the Track In Qty will be automatically set.

Spec.autoSetTrackOutQty.zh: 指示在Track Out期间是否自动设置批次的Track Out数量的标志。
Spec.autoSetTrackOutQty.en: Flag indicating whether to automatically set the Track Out Qty for the lot during Track Out.

Spec.binSplitRequired.zh: i) 指示是否拆分上次分箱操作中记录的Bin的标志。ii) 这是为了处理在下一个PDA计算操作中拆分PBI Bin的情况。
Spec.binSplitRequired.en: i) Flag indicating whether to split the bins recorded in the last binning operation. ii) This is to cater for the case where PBI bins are split out at the next PDA calculation operation.

Spec.binType.zh: i) 命名数据对象。ii) 提供有效的Bin类型列表。iii) 例如BIN或BUCKET。
Spec.binType.en: i) Named data object. ii) Provides a valid list of bin types. iii) E.g. BIN or BUCKET.

Spec.changeHistory.zh: 每个建模实体都包含 Change Status。它用于记录当前的变更（维护）状态（例如，特定 Product Definition 的维护正在进行中），并跟踪最后一次更改的人员和时间。这应该可扩展为随时间变化的完整历史记录。
Spec.changeHistory.en: Every modeling entity includes a Change Status. It is used to record the current Change (Maintenance) Status (i.e., maintenance is currently in progress for a specific Product Definition) and to track who made the last change and when. This should be extendible to a complete history over time.

Spec.checkPrinting.zh: 指示是否检查打印自动化要求的标志。
Spec.checkPrinting.en: Flag indicating whether to check for Printing Automation requirements.

Spec.checkScanning.zh: 指示是否检查扫描要求的标志。
Spec.checkScanning.en: Flag indicating whether to check for Scanning requirements.

Spec.consolidatePreviousBins.zh: i) 设置是否将前一次插入的Bin添加到当前插入的Bin中。ii) 仅合并GOOD和NOTREQUIRED Bin。
Spec.consolidatePreviousBins.en: i) Set whether previous insertion’s bins are added to the current insertion bins. ii) Only GOOD and NOTREQUIRED bins will be consolidated.

Spec.consolidatePreviousRejects.zh: i) 设置是否将前一次插入的拒收添加到当前插入的拒收中。
Spec.consolidatePreviousRejects.en: i) Set whether previous insertion's rejects are added to the current insertion rejects.

Spec.defaultMaterialWipLocation.zh: 物料退料事务期间将物料退回到的WIP位置。
Spec.defaultMaterialWipLocation.en: The WIP location to withdraw the material to during Material Withdrawal transaction.

Spec.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
Spec.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

Spec.dispatchPlan.zh: 用于在步骤处 Track In 时调度批次的计划。
Spec.dispatchPlan.en: Plan used for dispatching lots for Track In at a step.

Spec.documentSet.zh: 对提供与此Spec处理相关附加信息的文档的引用。该文档可以在操作员请求时作为引用此Spec的服务的一部分显示。
Spec.documentSet.en: Reference to a Document that provides additional information relating to processing with this Spec. This Document may be displayed (upon Operator request) as part of a service that is referencing this Spec.

Spec.electronicProcedure.zh: 提供在Spec处执行一系列任务（Tasks）的框架。
Spec.electronicProcedure.en: Provides the framework for executing a series of Tasks at the Spec.

Spec.electronicProcedureBase.zh: 多态电子程序基准 revision 字段 → ElectronicProcedureBase
Spec.electronicProcedureBase.en: Polymorphic electronic procedure baseline revision field → ElectronicProcedureBase

Spec.externalInterface.zh: 用于在Shop Floor服务执行期间触发以DLL（即Custom Proc）编写的自定义逻辑的Setup。如果在Shop Floor服务执行期间相应的启用标志设置为true，则将调用ExternalInterface Custom Proc。
Spec.externalInterface.en: Setup used to trigger custom logic written in a DLL (i.e. Custom Proc) during an execution of a Shop Floor service. The ExternalInterface Custom Proc will be called if the respective enable flag is set to true during the execution of a Shop Floor service.

Spec.holdLotIfLimitsNotFound.zh: i) 如果找不到限制条件，则保持批次的标志。
Spec.holdLotIfLimitsNotFound.en: i) Flag to hold the lot if limits criteria could not be found.

Spec.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
Spec.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

Spec.inputCarrierFamily.zh: TrackInLot 期间预期的输入 Carrier Family。
Spec.inputCarrierFamily.en: The expected input Carrier Family during TrackInLot.

Spec.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例进行更改。
Spec.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance

Spec.isSubCon.zh: 指示该Spec是否为子控制Spec的标志。
Spec.isSubCon.en: Flag indicating whether the spec is a sub-con spec.

Spec.isTest.zh: 指示该步骤是否为测试步骤的标志。
Spec.isTest.en: Flag indicating whether the step is a test step.

Spec.isWaferProcessing.zh: 指示 WIP 规范是否使用晶圆进行跟踪的标志。如果此标志设置为 true，则所有加工都必须使用容器和晶圆刻号进行。
Spec.isWaferProcessing.en: Flag indicating whether the WIP Spec is tracked using wafers. If this flag is set to true all processing must be done using Container and Wafer Scribe Number.

Spec.maxEquipmentPerLot.zh: i) 定义批次允许在其中处理的设备最大数量。ii) 默认值为0，表示无限制。
Spec.maxEquipmentPerLot.en: i) Defines the maximum number of equipment the lot is allowed to process in. ii) The default value is 0 meaning unlimited.

Spec.maxInsertion.zh: i) 批次在操作中允许进行的最大插入次数。ii) 此值将被复制到批次的插入信息中以供可能修改。这是为了允许逐案处理，其中批次允许超过此
Spec.maxInsertion.en: i) The maximum number of insertions a lot is allowed to go through at the operation. ii) This value will be copied to the lot’s insertion information for possible modification. This is to allow case-by-case basis where the lot is allowed to go beyond thi

Spec.maxLotsPerUser.zh: 每个用户的最大批次数量。

Spec.maxQueueTime.zh: 此值在当前版本的InSite中未实现。此值确定使用此Spec的步骤中容器可以保持排队状态的最大时间长度。MaximumQueueTimeAction的值确定如果排队时间超过此值要采取的操作。
Spec.maxQueueTime.en: This is not implemented in the current version of InSite. This value determines the maximum length of time a Container can remain in an in-queue state at the Step that uses this Spec. The value for MaximumQueueTimeAction determines the action to take if the in-queue time exceeds this value.

Spec.maxQueueTimeAction.zh: 此值在当前版本的InSite中未实现。此值用于确定对于排队时间超过允许的队列时间（MaxQueueTime）的容器启动服务（事务）时采取的操作。此选项的值为：0 = 不采取操作 1 = 向操作员警告 2 = 向操作员警告并要求密码才能继续 3 = 将容器置于保留状态 4 = 不允许事务继续 这些值及其关联操作旨在匹配字段验证的值和操作。此操作适用于将容器从排队状态更改为处理中状态的任何服务。
Spec.maxQueueTimeAction.en: This is not implemented in the current version of InSite. This value is used to determine the action to take when a Service (transaction) is started for a Container that has been in-queue longer than the allowable queue time (MaxQueueTime). The values for this option are: 0 = No action 1 = Warning to Operator 2 = Warning to Operator requiring a password to continue 3 = Place container on Hold 4 = Do not allow transaction to continue These values and their associated actions are intended to match the values and actions for field validations. This action applies to any service that changes a Container from an In-Queue to an In-Process state.

Spec.notRequiredBinsLocation.zh: 将NOTREQUIRED Bin从主批次拆分后移动到的位置。当存在NOTREQUIRED Bin时，ASPEN过程会使用此位置。
Spec.notRequiredBinsLocation.en: The location to move NOTREQUIRED bins to after they are split from the main lot. This is used by the ASPEN process when NOTREQUIRED bins exist.

Spec.notes.zh: 与此对象关联的注释和评论。
Spec.notes.en: Notations and comments associated with this object.

Spec.objectType.zh: i) 此字段将自动更新。ii) Spec的系统标识。
Spec.objectType.en: i) This field will be automatically updated. ii) System identification for the spec.

Spec.operation.zh: 执行此工作的操作。创建新步骤（使用此Spec）时，此值用作默认操作。如果指定，则必须是有效（已定义）的操作。
Spec.operation.en: Operation where this work is to be performed. This value is used as the default Operation when a new Step is created (using this Spec). If specified, this must be a valid (defined) Operation

Spec.optional.zh: 指定步骤是否被视为可选且可以跳过。
Spec.optional.en: Specifies whether the step is considered optional and can be skipped

Spec.outputCarrierFamily.zh: WIP中载具跟踪的预期输出载具族。
Spec.outputCarrierFamily.en: The expected output Carrier Family for Carrier Tracking in WIP.

Spec.pdaLimitsRequired.zh: 指示是否需要PDA限制验证的标志。
Spec.pdaLimitsRequired.en: Flag indicating whether PDA Limits verification is required.

Spec.postProductionAction.zh: 当已配置生产后程序的制造订单完成生产时要执行的操作：1 - EnableProcedure 2 - RequireProcedure
Spec.postProductionAction.en: What to do when production completed for an Mfg Order with a configured post-production procedure 1 - EnableProcedure 2 - RequireProcedure

Spec.processCode.zh: i) 定义有效的工艺代码。ii) 每个代码用于表示Aspen工艺代码。iii) Aspen工艺代码实际上是路径中的一个步骤。iv) 工艺代码可以在同一路径内重复。
Spec.processCode.en: i) Defines valid process codes. ii) Each code is used to represent an Aspen process code. iii) The Aspen process code is actually a step in a route. iv) The process code can be repeated within the same route.

Spec.recipeFile.zh: 大多数建模实体包含对文档的引用。在此上下文中，文档用于提供扩展（非结构化）信息，例如产品图纸、扫描图像、相关的现有制造规范或操作程序。每个文档（CDO）实例包括外部文档的标识符（即文件名或URL）和对用于呈现文档的程序的引用。文档还用于定义要下载到机器的配方文件。在这种情况下，呈现文档意味着将其呈现（下载）给机器。
Spec.recipeFile.en: Most Modeling entities include a reference to a document. Documents are used in this context to provide extended (unstructured) information, such as product drawings, scanned images, relating existing manufacturing specifications, or operating procedures. Each instance of a document (CDO) includes an identifier for the external document (i.e., a file name or a URL) and a reference to the program used for presenting the document. Documents are also used to define recipe files for downloading to machines. In this case, presenting the Document means presenting it (downloading it) to a machine.

Spec.recipeFileBase.zh: 多态配方文档基准 revision 字段 → DocumentBase
Spec.recipeFileBase.en: Polymorphic recipe/document baseline revision field → DocumentBase

Spec.removeDateCode.zh: i) 在Lot Schedule Cancel期间，当批次移动到Die Bank Inventory步骤时，Remove Date Code步骤属性用于将日期代码置空。ii) 此逻辑仅用于所有ASSEMBLY Process Spec。
Spec.removeDateCode.en: i) The Remove Date Code step attribute is used to nullify the Date Code when a lot moves to a Die Bank Inventory step during Lot Schedule Cancel ii) This logic is used for all the ASSEMBLY Process Specs only.

Spec.requireMaxTimeWindow.zh: 指示是否检查批次启动的最大时间窗口的标志。
Spec.requireMaxTimeWindow.en: Flag indicating whether to check for any Max Time Window to initiate for a lot.

Spec.requirePreProductionProcedure.zh: 标识在预生产程序完成之前容器移动被阻止的步骤。
Spec.requirePreProductionProcedure.en: Identifies step at which container movement blocked until Pre-Production Procedure is complete.

Spec.requireTrackInQty.zh: i) 设置是否需要track in数量。
Spec.requireTrackInQty.en: i) Sets whether the track in quantity is required.

Spec.resourceGroup.en: The list of resources that are valid for this spec.

Spec.revision.zh: 修订版本（在基础实体上下文中唯一）
Spec.revision.en: Revision (unique within the context of the base entity)

Spec.runNumberSetup.zh: 用于设置一个名称，该名称引用编号规则，该规则将用于生成分配给事务（如Track In Lot）的序列。其Details子实体列表字段将用于存储生成的运行编号。
Spec.runNumberSetup.en: Used to setup a Name that references a Numbering Rule that will be used to generate the sequence assigned to a transaction like Track In Lot. Its Details sub-entity list field will be used to store the Run Numbers generated.

Spec.sameParentLot.zh: 用于指示同一设备中正在处理（或将要处理）的批次是否必须属于同一父批次的标志。
Spec.sameParentLot.en: Flag used to indicate whether or not lots processing (or to be processed) in the same equipment must belong to the same parent lot

Spec.schedulingDetail.zh: 此规范的调度详细信息。

Spec.scsRecipeConfigRequired.zh: 此字段将在Setup和TrackIn期间使用，以提供与配方建模状态相关的附加信息。
Spec.scsRecipeConfigRequired.en: This field will be used during Setup and TrackIn to provide additional information related to the status of Recipe Modeling.

Spec.scsSpecSlotMappingRequired.zh: 指示分配的批次是否使用需要执行槽位映射要求的Spec。
Spec.scsSpecSlotMappingRequired.en: Indicate wheter the assign lot is using Spec that need to perform Slot Mapping Requirement

Spec.setDateCode.zh: 指示在移动批次期间是否设置日期代码的标志。
Spec.setDateCode.en: Flag indicating whether to set the date code during Move Lot.

Spec.setQtyFromWafers.zh: 指示是否根据晶圆记录设置批次数量的标志。如果良品数量大于0，则使用良品数量，否则使用 NDPW。
Spec.setQtyFromWafers.en: Flag indicating whether to set the lot's Qty from the wafers' records. The Good Qty will be used if it is greater than 0. Otherwise the NDPW will be used.

Spec.setup.zh: 此规格要使用的设置详情的引用。如果指定，必须是有效（已定义）的设置。
Spec.setup.en: Reference to the Setup details to use with this Spec. If specified, this must be a valid (defined) Setup.

Spec.setupAccess.zh: 用于验证用户对特定建模记录的访问权限。必须首先将一个或多个 Setup Access 分配给 Role。每个建模记录将有一个 Setup Access。当建模记录被事务处理时，系统将比较其 Setup Access。
Spec.setupAccess.en: This is used to verify the user's access to a particular modeling record. One or more Setup Access must first be assigned to a Role. Each modeling record will have one Setup Access. When a modeling record in transacted the system will compare its Setup Ac

Spec.setupBase.zh: 多态换线基准 revision 字段 → SetupBase
Spec.setupBase.en: Polymorphic setup/changeover baseline revision field → SetupBase

Spec.specBase.zh: 规格对应的基线版本 → SpecBase
Spec.specBase.en: Baseline version corresponding to specification → SpecBase

Spec.status.zh: 确定此实例的当前状态（活动、非活动）。有效值及其含义为：1 = 活动 2 = 非活动。注意，对于活动与非活动修订版本，没有强制执行的验证（规则）。
Spec.status.en: Determines the current status (Active, In-Active) of this instance. Valid values and their meanings are: 1 = Active 2 = Inactive Note there are no validations (rules enforced) concerning active vs. inactive revisions.

Spec.stepLogic.zh: i) 命名数据对象。ii) 提供有效的步骤逻辑列表，每个都必须由定制应用程序识别。
Spec.stepLogic.en: i) Named data objects. ii) Provides a valid list of Step Logic each must be recognized by a customized application.

Spec.testIqcRequired.zh: 指示是否需要测试 IQC 的标志。
Spec.testIqcRequired.en: Flag indicating whether Test IQC is required.

Spec.uom.zh: 批次移入规格时要设置的单位（UOM）。
Spec.uom.en: The UOM to set a lot to when it moves into the spec.

Spec.uom2.zh: 批次移入规格时要设置的第二个单位（UOM2）。
Spec.uom2.en: The UOM2 to set a lot to when it moves into the spec.

Spec.useEquipmentMatrix.zh: 指示是否应使用设备矩阵来提取可用于 Track In 的可用设备。
Spec.useEquipmentMatrix.en: Flag indicating whether the Equipment Matrix should be used to pull out available equipment for track in.

Spec.validateActiveMfgOrder.zh: 此字段启用或禁用分配给资源的活动生产订单的验证过程。启用后，将在过程中验证容器的生产订单。
Spec.validateActiveMfgOrder.en: This field enables or disables the validation process for active mfg order assigned to the resource. When enabled, the container's mfg order will be validated during the process.

Spec.validateLotSamplingComplete.zh: 如果为 True，则验证批次抽样是否已完成
Spec.validateLotSamplingComplete.en: If True Validates that the Lot Sampling has been completed

Spec.validateMaterialConsumption.zh: 此标志确定是否应对此规格强制执行材料消耗检查
Spec.validateMaterialConsumption.en: This flag determines if the material consumption check should be enforced for this spec

Spec.verifyStepCycleTime.zh: 指示是否检查步骤周期时间设置（StepCycleTimeSetup）的标志。
Spec.verifyStepCycleTime.en: Flag indicating whether to check the StepCycleTimeSetup.

Spec.verifyWafersGoodQty.zh: 指示是否将晶圆的总良品数量与移出数量进行核对的标志。如果不一致，则不允许移出。
Spec.verifyWafersGoodQty.en: Flag indicating whether to verify the total Good Qty of the wafers against the move out quantity. If different do not allow move out.

Spec.warningQueueTime.zh: 此功能在当前版本的 InSite 中未实现。此值指定容器在触发警告之前可保持排队状态的时间长度。
Spec.warningQueueTime.en: This is not implemented in the current version of InSite. This value specifies the length of time a Container can remain in an in-queue state before a warning is to be triggered.

Spec.wipMsgDefMgr.zh: WIP消息定义，包含适用于此实体的所有WIP消息的WIP消息键列表。
Spec.wipMsgDefMgr.en: WIP Message Definition which contains a list of WIP message keys that contain all of the WIP messages that apply to this entity.

Spec.yieldOffDefects.zh: 指示是否应剔除收集到的缺陷的标志。
Spec.yieldOffDefects.en: Flag indicating whether the defects collected should be yielded off.

SpecBase.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
SpecBase.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

SpecBase.revOfRcd.zh: 此基础实体当前修订版本的Id。
SpecBase.revOfRcd.en: Id of the current revision for this Base entity.

SpecSchedulingDetail.durationPerUnit.zh: 此值指定处理单个单元所需的时间。用于周期时间和成本核算计算。
SpecSchedulingDetail.durationPerUnit.en: This value specifies the amount of time needed to process a single unit. This is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

SpecSchedulingDetail.fastCycleTime.zh: 这是一个计算值，表示使用此Spec处理标准尺寸批次物料所需的时间，假设队列时间较快。例如，用于确定作业可以多快通过工厂加速。该值的计算使用其他CDO的属性。这意味着更改工作中心值等会影响此值。因此，应在每次需要时重新计算该值。持久化的值仅在保存此Spec时的时间点有效。
SpecSchedulingDetail.fastCycleTime.en: This is a calculated value that denotes the time required processing a standard size batch of material using this Spec, assuming fast queue time. This is used to determine, for example, how quickly a job can be expedited through the Factory. The calculation for this value uses attributes of other CDOs. This means that changing a Work Center value, for example, can effect this value. This means that this value should be calculated each time that it is needed. The value that is persisted will only be valid as of the point in time that this Spec was saved.

SpecSchedulingDetail.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。
SpecSchedulingDetail.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

SpecSchedulingDetail.normalCycleTime.zh: 这是一个计算值，表示使用此Spec处理标准尺寸批次物料所需的时间，假设正常队列时间。该值的计算使用其他CDO的属性。这意味着更改工作中心值等会影响此值。因此，应在每次需要时重新计算该值。持久化的值仅在保存此Spec时的时间点有效。
SpecSchedulingDetail.normalCycleTime.en: This is a calculated value that denotes the time required processing a standard size batch of material using this Spec, assuming normal queue time. The calculation for this value uses attributes of other CDOs. This means that changing a Work Center value, for example, can effect this value. This means that this value should be calculated each time that it is needed. The value that is persisted will only be valid as of the point in time that this Spec was saved.

SpecSchedulingDetail.runRateOption.zh: 此选项确定运行速率是以每单位小时数还是每小时单位数指定。数值及其含义为：1 = 每单位小时数（RunRateTime）2 = 每小时单位数（RunRateQty）
SpecSchedulingDetail.runRateOption.en: This option determines if run rate is specified as hours per unit or units per hour. The values and their meanings are: 1 = Hours per unit (RunRateTime) 2 = Units per hour (RunRateQty)

SpecSchedulingDetail.setupTime.zh: 此值指定在此操作处进行 Setup 所需的时间。用于周期时间和成本核算计算。
SpecSchedulingDetail.setupTime.en: This value specifies the time required for a Setup at this Operation. This is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

SpecSchedulingDetail.spec.zh: 关联的母规格定义 → Spec

SpecSchedulingDetail.stdBatchSize.zh: 此值指定使用此Spec处理的物料批次的标准尺寸。用于周期时间和成本核算计算。
SpecSchedulingDetail.stdBatchSize.en: This value specifies the standard size of a batch of material processed using this Spec. This is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

SpecSchedulingDetail.timePerBatch.zh: 此值指定处理单个批次所需的时间。
SpecSchedulingDetail.timePerBatch.en: This value specified the time needed to process a single Batch.

SpecSchedulingDetail.unitsPerHour.zh: 此值指定每小时处理的单位数。用于周期时间和成本核算计算。
SpecSchedulingDetail.unitsPerHour.en: This value specifies the number of units processed in an hour. This is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

SpecSchedulingDetail.unscheduledTime.zh: 未包含在UPH、HPU或批次时间条目中的处理时间。
SpecSchedulingDetail.unscheduledTime.en: Process time that is not contained in the UPH,HPU or Batch Time entries.

SpecSchedulingDetail.yield.zh: 指定使用此 Spec 处理时预期的标准良率。此值用于周期时间和成本核算计算。
SpecSchedulingDetail.yield.en: Specifies the standard yield expected for processing with this Spec. This value is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

SplitHistory.childCount.zh: 从源容器（FromContainer）中拆分出的容器数量。
SplitHistory.childCount.en: The number of containers split out of the FromContainer.

SplitHistory.closed.zh: 指示源容器是否因其所有数量被拆分到其他容器而关闭。
SplitHistory.closed.en: Indicates whether the FromContainer was closed due to all of its quantity being split out to other containers.

SplitHistory.fromContainer.zh: 拆分物料/容器的来源容器。
SplitHistory.fromContainer.en: The container in which the split material/containers originated.

SplitHistory.integrationTxn.zh: 在复合/容器/资源事务后插入 TxnId 与历史主线。
SplitHistory.integrationTxn.en: Inserts the TxnId after a compound/container/resource transaction with history mainline.

SplitHistory.qty.zh: 从源容器拆分出的物料量。
SplitHistory.qty.en: The amount of material split out of the FromContainer.

SplitHistory.qty2.zh: 使用与数量字段不同的计量单位从源容器拆分出的物料量。
SplitHistory.qty2.en: The amount of material split out of the FromContainer using a different unit of measure than the Qty Field

SplitHistory.unitCount.zh: 从 FromContainer 拆分出的单位容器数量。
SplitHistory.unitCount.en: The number of unit containers split out of the FromContainer.

ss_Surveillance.changeHistory.zh: 每个建模实体都包含 Change Status。它用于记录当前的变更（维护）状态（例如，特定 Product Definition 的维护正在进行中），并跟踪最后一次更改的人员和时间。这应该可扩展为随时间变化的完整历史记录。
ss_Surveillance.changeHistory.en: Every modeling entity includes a Change Status. It is used to record the current Change (Maintenance) Status (i.e., maintenance is currently in progress for a specific Product Definition) and to track who made the last change and when. This should be extendible to a complete history over time.

StartHistoryDetail.billOfProcess.zh: 工艺清单（Bill Of Process）用于指定对规范（spec）的覆盖，并分配给容器、制造订单或产品。
StartHistoryDetail.billOfProcess.en: Bill Of Process is used to specify overrides to a specification (spec), and is assigned to a container, manufacturing order or a product.

StartHistoryDetail.carrier.zh: 载体是容纳物料的物理实体，用于批处理。载体是类似容器、大桶、桶、托盘等的资源。
StartHistoryDetail.carrier.en: A carrier is a physical entity that holds material which is used in batch processing. Carriers are resources like: Vessels, Vats, drums, trays etc.

StartHistoryDetail.childCount.zh: 创建的顶级容器的子容器数量。
StartHistoryDetail.childCount.en: Child count of the top level container created.

StartHistoryDetail.consumingOrder.zh: 消耗订单是字符串字段。
StartHistoryDetail.consumingOrder.en: Consuming Order is a String field

StartHistoryDetail.container.zh: 容器描述离散的工作单元或离散的物料数量（即物料批次、序列化组件或序列化物料件、唯一标识的包含产品的包装或容器等）。容器可以直接包含数量信息（重量、计数等），也可以包含其他容器（子容器）的分组。
StartHistoryDetail.container.en: A Container describes a discrete unit of work or a discrete quantity of material (i.e., batch of material, a serialized component or serialized piece of material, a uniquely identified package or vessel that contains product, etc.) A Container can include quantity information (weight, count, etc.) directly, or it can include a grouping of other containers (child containers).

StartHistoryDetail.containerComments.zh: 分配给容器的备注/注释，而不是分配给交易。
StartHistoryDetail.containerComments.en: Notes/Comments assinged to the container, as opposed to assigned to the transaction.

StartHistoryDetail.customer.zh: 开始时容器被分配到的客户。
StartHistoryDetail.customer.en: Customer container is assigned to at the time of the start.

StartHistoryDetail.description.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
StartHistoryDetail.description.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

StartHistoryDetail.direction.zh: 指定物料安装在机器上的方向 - 0、90、180 等
StartHistoryDetail.direction.en: Specifies the direction the material is mounted on a machine - 0, 90, 180, etc

StartHistoryDetail.dueDate.zh: 容器计划完成处理的日期。
StartHistoryDetail.dueDate.en: Date the container is scheduled to be finished processing.

StartHistoryDetail.dueDateGmt.zh: 到期日（DueDate）的 GMT 换算。

StartHistoryDetail.expirationDate.zh: 在此日期/时间之后，容器不再被视为一等质量。
StartHistoryDetail.expirationDate.en: The date/time after which the Container is no longer considered first quality.

StartHistoryDetail.holdMessage.zh: 如果指定，要显示的保留消息。
StartHistoryDetail.holdMessage.en: Hold Message to be displayed if specified

StartHistoryDetail.inQualityControl.zh: 此标志设置为改进报告并防止受影响产品的发运。
StartHistoryDetail.inQualityControl.en: This flag set to improve reporting and prevent shipping of affected product.

StartHistoryDetail.integrationTxn.zh: 在复合/容器/资源事务后插入 TxnId 与历史主线。
StartHistoryDetail.integrationTxn.en: Inserts the TxnId after a compound/container/resource transaction with history mainline.

StartHistoryDetail.location.zh: 标识容器开始时的物理位置。
StartHistoryDetail.location.en: Identifies the physical location of the Container when it was started.

StartHistoryDetail.loopPass.zh: Container移动后仍留在同一步骤的次数
StartHistoryDetail.loopPass.en: The number of times the container has moved and remained at the same step

StartHistoryDetail.mfgOrder.zh: 开始时容器被分配到的生产订单。生产订单通常是由 ERP 系统管理的调度结构。
StartHistoryDetail.mfgOrder.en: The manufacturing order the container was assigned to at the time of the start. Manufacturing orders are typically scheduling constructs managed by an ERP system.

StartHistoryDetail.operation.zh: 容器开始时的操作（工厂中要执行工作的逻辑或物理描述）。
StartHistoryDetail.operation.en: The operation (logical or physical description of where work in the factory is to be performed) where the container was started.

StartHistoryDetail.owner.zh: 每个容器都有一个关联的所有者代码。所有者代码用作分组，以区分容器进行查询和处理。所有者代码的示例有“制造”、“工程”、“原型”、“销售样品”等。
StartHistoryDetail.owner.en: Every Container has an associated Owner Code. The owner code is used as a grouping to separate Containers for inquiry and processing. Examples of Owner Code are "Manufacturing", "Engineering", "Prototypes", "SalesSamples", etc.

StartHistoryDetail.plannedProduct.zh: 所有处理完成后此容器的预期最终产品。
StartHistoryDetail.plannedProduct.en: Expected resulting product for this container after all processing is complete.

StartHistoryDetail.plannedQty.zh: 所有处理完成后此容器预期可用的数量。
StartHistoryDetail.plannedQty.en: Qty expected to be available from this container after all processing is complete.

StartHistoryDetail.plannedQty2.zh: 所有处理完成后此容器预期可用的数量。
StartHistoryDetail.plannedQty2.en: Qty expected to be available from this container after all processing is complete.

StartHistoryDetail.plannedQtyUom.zh: 第一个计划数量的计量单位。
StartHistoryDetail.plannedQtyUom.en: Unit of measure for the first planned quantity.

StartHistoryDetail.plannedQtyUom2.zh: 第二个计划数量的计量单位。
StartHistoryDetail.plannedQtyUom2.en: Unit of measure for the second planned quantity.

StartHistoryDetail.plannedStartDate.zh: 计划在此容器上开始处理的日期。
StartHistoryDetail.plannedStartDate.en: The date when processing is scheduled to commence on this container.

StartHistoryDetail.plannedStartDateGmt.zh: 计划在此容器上开始处理的日期。
StartHistoryDetail.plannedStartDateGmt.en: The date when processing is scheduled to commence on this container.

StartHistoryDetail.product.zh: 产品通常定义需要提供给客户的材料种类，或在制造过程中用作原材料或其他组件的材料种类。产品可属于产品系列。要制造的产品将具有关联的工作流。工作流的属性可被覆盖以特定于产品。
StartHistoryDetail.product.en: A Product is typically a definition of what kind of material needs to be provided to a customer or what kind of material is being used as a raw material or other component in a manufacturing process. Products can belong to a Product Family. A product to be manufactured will have an associated Workflow. Attributes of the Workflow may be overridden to be product specific.

StartHistoryDetail.productionComplete.zh: 将容器标记为已完成生产的标志。
StartHistoryDetail.productionComplete.en: Flag to mark the container as having completed production.

StartHistoryDetail.qty.en: Quantity of the container at the time of the start.

StartHistoryDetail.qty2.en: Quantity of the container at the time of the start.

StartHistoryDetail.requestDate.zh: 通常为客户要求此容器发货的日期。
StartHistoryDetail.requestDate.en: Typically, the date the customer requested this container be shipped.

StartHistoryDetail.resource.zh: 开始时容器所关联的机器或其他资源。
StartHistoryDetail.resource.en: The machine or other resource the container is associated with at the time of the start.

StartHistoryDetail.salesOrder.zh: 销售订单定义客户在某个日期前期望的产品数量。这相当于典型（ERP）销售订单上的行项目。容器可选地分配给销售订单（通过将销售订单指定为属性）。这提供了将在制品（容器）与客户订单相关联的机制。
StartHistoryDetail.salesOrder.en: A Sales Order defines a quantity of product expected by a customer by a date. This equates to a line item on a typical (ERP) Sales Order. Containers are optionally assigned to a Sales Order (by specifying the Sales Order as an attribute). This provides the mechanism for relating WIP (Containers) to Customer Orders.

StartHistoryDetail.samplingLot.zh: 用于关联一组Container进行抽样。例如，入库检验批次中多个Container来自同一物料批次，收货时间不同但执行一次AQL抽样。
StartHistoryDetail.samplingLot.en: Used to associate a group of containers for sampling. For example, an Incoming inspection lot where multiple containers are from the same lot of material, received at different times but has one AQL Sampling.

StartHistoryDetail.samplingRequired.zh: 确定此Container是否需要抽样。值为true时需要抽样。
StartHistoryDetail.samplingRequired.en: Determines if sampling is required for this container. Sampling is required when value is true

StartHistoryDetail.shapeName.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
StartHistoryDetail.shapeName.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

StartHistoryDetail.spcChartSaveOptionsEn.en: 1.Always - Automatically creates and saves the chart image 2.On Failure - Only creates and saves the SPC chart image if a SPC failure resulted 3.Never - never generates a SPC Chart image

StartHistoryDetail.startReason.zh: 每个容器都有相关联的开始原因。开始原因可用于 WIP 状态查询的筛选条件和交易报告（基于交易历史）。
StartHistoryDetail.startReason.en: Each Container has an associated Start Reason. Start reasons are available for selection criteria on WIP Status Inquiries and for transaction reporting (based on the transaction history).

StartHistoryDetail.supplyFromType.zh: 此实体的描述。如果未指定，默认为此实体的名称。
StartHistoryDetail.supplyFromType.en: Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

StartHistoryDetail.unitCount.zh: 创建的顶级容器的单位数量。
StartHistoryDetail.unitCount.en: Unit count of the top level container created.

StartHistoryDetail.vendorItem.zh: Vendor Items 是供应商销售的产品。此项目在 Product 中指定，对于采购产品，可以将产品关联到可购买该产品的来源列表。此外，在向容器发放组件时，可以指定用于满足组件需求的 VendorItem。
StartHistoryDetail.vendorItem.en: Vendor Items are the products the vendor sells. This item is specified in the Product where, for purchased products, one can relate the product to a list of sources where the product can be purchased. In addition, when issuing components to a container, one can specify the VendorItem used to fulfill the component requirement.

StartHistoryDetail.workstation.zh: Resource描述工厂内的任何非物料实体。Resource的常见用途（也是最具体的示例）是描述机器。Resource与单个工厂关联以定义其物理位置。Resource还属于零个或多个Resource Group以提供逻辑分组。Resource是静态（建模）实体。每个Resource可以有一个Resource Status条目，用于跟踪每个已定义状态类别的当前状态。应用程序附带三个特定的状态类别：生产、预防性维护和日志。生产用于确定生产可用性。预防性维护用于跟踪Resource的当前预防性维护状态。日志用于提供记录自由格式注释以及可选分配预定义状态和原因代码的机制。客户可以定义其他状态类别，以多种用户定义的方式同时跟踪Resource状态。
StartHistoryDetail.workstation.en: A Resource describes any non-material entity within a factory. The common use (and most concrete example) of a Resource is to describe a Machine. Resources are associated with a single factory, to define their physical location. Resources also belong to zero or more Resource Groups, to provide a logical grouping. A Resource is a static (modeling) entity. Each Resource can have a Resource Status entry to track the current status for each Status Category defined. The application is delivered with three specific Status Categories. They are Production, Preventative Maintenance and Log. Production is used to determine availability for production. Preventative Maintenance is used to track the current Preventative Maintenance status for a Resource. Log is used to provide a mechanism for logging freeform comments and optionally assigning predefined status and reason codes. Customers can define additional Status categories to concurrently track Resource status is multiple user-defined ways.

StartReason.setupAccess.en: This is used to verify the user's access to a particular modeling record. One or more Setup Access must first be assigned to a Role. Each modeling record will have one Setup Access. When a modeling record in transacted the system will compare its Setup Ac

StartReason.wipMsgDefMgr.zh: 包含此CDO的WIP消息的WIP消息定义
StartReason.wipMsgDefMgr.en: WIP Message Definition which contains WIP messages for this CDO

StepSchedulingDetail.durationPerUnit.zh: 此值指定处理单个单元所需的时间。用于周期时间和成本核算计算。
StepSchedulingDetail.durationPerUnit.en: This value specifies the amount of time needed to process a single unit. This is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

StepSchedulingDetail.fastCycleTime.zh: 这是一个计算值，表示使用此Spec处理标准尺寸批次物料所需的时间，假设队列时间较快。例如，用于确定作业可以多快通过工厂加速。该值的计算使用其他CDO的属性。这意味着更改工作中心值等会影响此值。因此，应在每次需要时重新计算该值。持久化的值仅在保存此Spec时的时间点有效。
StepSchedulingDetail.fastCycleTime.en: This is a calculated value that denotes the time required processing a standard size batch of material using this Spec, assuming fast queue time. This is used to determine, for example, how quickly a job can be expedited through the Factory. The calculation for this value uses attributes of other CDOs. This means that changing a Work Center value, for example, can effect this value. This means that this value should be calculated each time that it is needed. The value that is persisted will only be valid as of the point in time that this Spec was saved.

StepSchedulingDetail.forwardCycleTime.zh: 这是从此步骤到工作流结束（沿从此步骤开始的默认路径）的所有 NormalCycleTime 之和。此值的计算使用其他 CDO 的属性。这意味着更改工作中心值等可能会影响此值。因此应在每次需要时重新计算此值。持久化的值仅在保存此规格的时间点有效。
StepSchedulingDetail.forwardCycleTime.en: This is the sum of all NormalCycleTime from this step through the end of the Workflow (following defaults Paths from this Step forward). The calculation for this value uses attributes of other CDOs. This means that changing a Work Center value, for example, can effect this value. This means that this value should be calculated each time that it is needed. The value that is persisted will only be valid as of the point in time that this Spec was saved.

StepSchedulingDetail.forwardYield.zh: 从此步骤到工作流结束（沿从此步骤开始的默认路径）的标准（累计）良率。此值的计算使用其他 CDO 的属性。这意味着更改工作中心值等可能会影响此值。因此应在每次需要时重新计算此值。持久化的值仅在保存此规格的时间点有效。
StepSchedulingDetail.forwardYield.en: Standard (cumulative) yield from this step through the end of the Workflow (following defaults Paths from this Step forward). The calculation for this value uses attributes of other CDOs. This means that changing a Work Center value, for example, can effect this value. This means that this value should be calculated each time that it is needed. The value that is persisted will only be valid as of the point in time that this Spec was saved.

StepSchedulingDetail.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。
StepSchedulingDetail.isFrozen.en: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

StepSchedulingDetail.normalCycleTime.zh: 这是一个计算值，表示使用此Spec处理标准尺寸批次物料所需的时间，假设正常队列时间。该值的计算使用其他CDO的属性。这意味着更改工作中心值等会影响此值。因此，应在每次需要时重新计算该值。持久化的值仅在保存此Spec时的时间点有效。
StepSchedulingDetail.normalCycleTime.en: This is a calculated value that denotes the time required processing a standard size batch of material using this Spec, assuming normal queue time. The calculation for this value uses attributes of other CDOs. This means that changing a Work Center value, for example, can effect this value. This means that this value should be calculated each time that it is needed. The value that is persisted will only be valid as of the point in time that this Spec was saved.

StepSchedulingDetail.runRateOption.zh: 此选项确定运行速率是以每单位小时数还是每小时单位数指定。数值及其含义为：1 = 每单位小时数（RunRateTime）2 = 每小时单位数（RunRateQty）
StepSchedulingDetail.runRateOption.en: This option determines if run rate is specified as hours per unit or units per hour. The values and their meanings are: 1 = Hours per unit (RunRateTime) 2 = Units per hour (RunRateQty)

StepSchedulingDetail.setupTime.zh: 此值指定在此操作处进行 Setup 所需的时间。用于周期时间和成本核算计算。
StepSchedulingDetail.setupTime.en: This value specifies the time required for a Setup at this Operation. This is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

StepSchedulingDetail.stdBatchSize.zh: 此值指定使用此Spec处理的物料批次的标准尺寸。用于周期时间和成本核算计算。
StepSchedulingDetail.stdBatchSize.en: This value specifies the standard size of a batch of material processed using this Spec. This is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

StepSchedulingDetail.timePerBatch.zh: 此值指定处理单个批次所需的时间。
StepSchedulingDetail.timePerBatch.en: This value specified the time needed to process a single Batch.

StepSchedulingDetail.unitsPerHour.zh: 此值指定每小时处理的单位数。用于周期时间和成本核算计算。
StepSchedulingDetail.unitsPerHour.en: This value specifies the number of units processed in an hour. This is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

StepSchedulingDetail.unscheduledTime.zh: 未包含在UPH、HPU或批次时间条目中的处理时间。
StepSchedulingDetail.unscheduledTime.en: Process time that is not contained in the UPH,HPU or Batch Time entries.

StepSchedulingDetail.yield.zh: 指定使用此 Spec 处理时预期的标准良率。此值用于周期时间和成本核算计算。
StepSchedulingDetail.yield.en: Specifies the standard yield expected for processing with this Spec. This value is used in cycle time and Cost Accounting calculations.

SwitchingRule.changeHistory.zh: 每个建模实体都包含 Change Status。它用于记录当前的变更（维护）状态（例如，特定 Product Definition 的维护正在进行中），并跟踪最后一次更改的人员和时间。这应该可扩展为随时间变化的完整历史记录。
SwitchingRule.changeHistory.en: Every modeling entity includes a Change Status. It is used to record the current Change (Maintenance) Status (i.e., maintenance is currently in progress for a specific Product Definition) and to track who made the last change and when. This should be extendible to a complete history over time.

SwitchingRuleDetails.eMailDistribution.zh: 应接收特定于此切换规则的电子邮件消息的人员列表

SwitchingRuleDetails.expression.en: A Unified Expression used to determine if a switching rule is allowed to be triggered. An expression can be used alone or in conjunction with X out of Y Containers. Expressions must return a Boolean.

SwitchingRuleDetails.fromInspectionLevel.en: This will be the Current Inspection Level

SwitchingRuleDetails.isFrozen.zh: 确定是否允许对此实例（或其任何修订版本）进行更改。

SwitchingRuleDetails.lastContainerSetCou.zh: 表达式 X out of Y 中 Y 的值。即回溯确定是否应切换规则时考虑的样本数量。
SwitchingRuleDetails.lastContainerSetCou.en: The Y value for the number of containers in the expression X out of Y. Its the number of samples to look back to determine if a rule should be switched

SwitchingRuleDetails.passOrFailContainer.zh: 表达式 X out of Y 中 X 的值。即在确定是否应切换规则时，在给定数量的容器中通过或失败的容器数量。
SwitchingRuleDetails.passOrFailContainer.en: The X value for the number of containers in the expression X out of Y. The number of containers passed or failed out of a given number of containers when determining if a rule should be switched

SwitchingRuleDetails.requireNotification.zh: 此字段用于在规则可切换时触发电子邮件通知
SwitchingRuleDetails.requireNotification.en: This field is used to trigger email notifications when a rule is available to be switched

SwitchingRuleDetails.switchingRule.zh: 所属的切换规则（必填） → SwitchingRule (SwitchingRuleId)

SwitchingRuleDetails.switchingRuleType.zh: 用于标识切换规则的测试类型。例如，如果 5 个容器中有 2 个通过测试，则使用此切换规则。通过 = 1，失败 = 2
SwitchingRuleDetails.switchingRuleType.en: Used to identify the Switching rule test type For example, I want to use this switching rule if 2 out of 5 containers Passed testing. Passed = 1 Failed = 2

TargetSystem.processingFolder.zh: 部署和激活的处理文件夹。
TargetSystem.processingFolder.en: Processing folder for deployment and activation.

TargetSystem.serverType.zh: 目标系统的服务器类型。例如 QA、Test 或 Production。

TargetSystem.userName.zh: 连接到目标系统时要使用的用户名。
TargetSystem.userName.en: User Name to use when connecting to the target system.

TaskItem.advanceToNextTask.zh: 此字段在执行期间用于定义当前任务的最小迭代次数完成后，系统是否应自动开始下一个任务。
TaskItem.advanceToNextTask.en: This field is used during the execution time to define whether the system should begin the next task automatically after the minimum number of iterations for the current task have been completed.

TaskItem.allocatedTime.zh: 为任务分配的持续时间
TaskItem.allocatedTime.en: Time as a duration allocated for the task

TaskItem.dataCollectionDefBase.zh: 关联的数据采集基线版本 → DataCollectionDef
TaskItem.dataCollectionDefBase.en: Associated data collection baseline revision → DataCollectionDef

TaskItem.documentSet.zh: 文档集是一个或多个文档的列表。大多数建模实体包含对文档集的引用。在此上下文中，文档用于提供扩展（非结构化）信息，例如产品图纸、扫描图像、相关的现有制造规范或操作程序。每个文档（CDO）实例包括外部文档的标识符（即文件名或URL）和对用于呈现文档的程序的引用。
TaskItem.documentSet.en: A Document Set is a list of one or more documents. Most Modeling entities include a reference to a Document Set. Documents are used in this context to provide extended (unstructured) information, such as product drawings, scanned images, relating existing manufacturing specifications, or operating procedures. Each instance of a Document (CDO) includes an identifier for the external document (i.e., a file name or a URL) and a reference to the program used for presenting the document.

TaskItem.eSigRequirement.zh: 包含应为任务收集的签名列表。
TaskItem.eSigRequirement.en: Contains the list of signatures that should be collected for the Task.

TaskItem.instruction.zh: 关于如何执行任务给用户的说明。
TaskItem.instruction.en: Instructions for the user on how to execute the Task.

TaskItem.instructionType.zh: InstructionType 的枚举。1 = 通过/失败 2 = 数据收集 3 = 确认 4 = 计算
TaskItem.instructionType.en: Enumeration for the InstructionType. 1 = Pass/Fail 2 = Data Collection 3 = Acknowledgement 4 = Computation

TaskItem.maxIterations.zh: 任务可执行的最大次数。
TaskItem.maxIterations.en: The maximum number of times that the Task may be executed.

TaskItem.minIterations.zh: 任务必须执行的最小次数。
TaskItem.minIterations.en: The minimum number of times a task must be executed.

TaskItem.name.zh: 名称子实体的唯一名称。
TaskItem.name.en: Unique name for the name subentity.

TaskItem.reportInstruction.zh: 关于如何执行任务给用户的说明。主要用于不支持标记和标签的报告目的。
TaskItem.reportInstruction.en: Instructions for the user on how to execute the Task. Used primarly for reporting purposes where markup and tags are not supported.

TaskItem.sequence.zh: 标识任务在其父任务列表中的其他任务上下文中显示和/或处理的顺序。
TaskItem.sequence.en: Identifies the order in which the Task displayed and/or processed within the context of the other Tasks in its parent TaskList.

TaskItem.taskList.zh: 关联的母任务列表 → TaskList

TaskItem.taskType.zh: 标识这是开始流程任务、结束流程任务还是常规任务。这标识容器何时被分配到工作站或工作单元以进行生产线清线。
TaskItem.taskType.en: Identifies whether this is a Start Process Task, an End Process Task, or a Regular Task. This identifies when the Container is assigned to the Workstation or WorkCell for line clearance purposes.

TaskItem.trainingReqGroup.zh: 用户必须具备这些培训要求才能执行此任务。
TaskItem.trainingReqGroup.en: The user must have these Training Requirements in order to execute this Task.

TaskItem.valueAdd.zh: 表示这是增值任务；用于报告

TaskItem.variantExpression.zh: 要解析的变体表达式，用于筛选出可配置活动。
TaskItem.variantExpression.en: Variant expression to be resolved to allow for filtering out configurable activities.

TaskList.changeHistory.zh: 每个建模实体都包含 Change Status。它用于记录当前的变更（维护）状态（例如，特定 Product Definition 的维护正在进行中），并跟踪最后一次更改的人员和时间。这应该可扩展为随时间变化的完整历史记录。
TaskList.changeHistory.en: Every modeling entity includes a Change Status. It is used to record the current Change (Maintenance) Status (i.e., maintenance is currently in progress for a specific Product Definition) and to track who made the last change and when. This should be extendible to a complete history over time.

Terminal.spec.zh: 规格（Spec）描述了在工作流中的步骤处发生的处理。它引用许多其他建模组件，包括工序、设置、数据采集定义和资源。规格还包括详细的计划和加工参数信息。规格被工作流中的步骤引用（使用）。许多工作流步骤可以使用一个规格。规格用于定义要执行的处理。工序用于定义物料通过工厂的流动或移动的（规则）。请参阅工序定义以获取计划详细信息。
Terminal.spec.en: A specification (Spec) describes the processing that takes place at a Step within a Workflow. It references many other Modeling components including an Operation, Setup, Data Collection Definitions and Resources. Specs also include detailed scheduling and processing parameter information. A Spec is referenced (used) by a Step within a Workflow. Many Workflow Steps can use one Spec. A Spec is used to define the processing that is to be performed. An Operation is used to define (rules for) the flow or movement of Material through the Factory. See the Operation Definition for Scheduling Details information.

Terminal.uiPortalProfile.zh: Camstar Portal UI的用户偏好设置。
Terminal.uiPortalProfile.en: User preferences for Camstar Portal UI

ThruputHistory.childCount.zh: 指示与正在执行服务的父容器关联的直接子容器数量。
ThruputHistory.childCount.en: This indicates the number of direct child containers associated to the parent container for which the service is being performed.

ThruputHistory.container.zh: 此字段引用用户为推进（Thruput）指定的容器。
ThruputHistory.container.en: This field refers to the container that the user has specified for thruput.

ThruputHistory.integrationTxn.zh: 在复合/容器/资源事务后插入 TxnId 与历史主线。
ThruputHistory.integrationTxn.en: Inserts the TxnId after a compound/container/resource transaction with history mainline.

ThruputHistory.operation.zh: 容器正在推进（Thruput）的操作。与汇总推进（Summary Thruput）标志结合使用。
ThruputHistory.operation.en: The operation at which the container is being thruput. Used in conjunction with Summary Thruput flag.

ThruputHistory.owner.zh: 事务发生时容器的Owner属性。提供此字段便于报告。
ThruputHistory.owner.en: The Owner attribute of the container at the time of the transaction. This field is provided for ease of reporting.

ThruputHistory.product.zh: 事务发生时容器的Product属性。提供此字段便于报告。
ThruputHistory.product.en: The Product attribute of the container at the time of the transaction. This field is provided for ease of reporting.

ThruputHistory.qty.zh: 正在处理的物料数量。每个数量都有对应的计量单位。注意，如果同时跟踪两个计量单位，Qty2字段也将包含一个值。
ThruputHistory.qty.en: The quantity of material being processed. Each quanity has a corresponding Unit of Measure. Note that if two Units of Measure are being tracked concurrently, the Qty2 field will also contain a value.

ThruputHistory.qty2.zh: 正在处理的物料数量。每个数量都有对应的计量单位。仅当需要同时跟踪2个计量单位时才使用此字段。例如，指定容器时可能需要同时记录长度和重量作为数量。
ThruputHistory.qty2.en: A quantity of material being processed. Each quantity has a corresponding unit of measure. This field is only used if 2 units of measure need to be tracked at once. For instance, when specifying a container one might need to record both length and weight as quantities.

ThruputHistory.resource.zh: 此对象指示用于处理容器的资源。资源定义为需要跟踪/测量的非 WIP 实体，例如机器、人员或存储位置。
ThruputHistory.resource.en: This object indicates which resource was used to process the container. A resource is defined as a non-WIP entity which needs to be tracked/measured, such as a machine, person or storage location.

ThruputHistory.run.zh: 事务发生时Resource ProductionStatus中的“Run”字段。提供此字段便于报告。
ThruputHistory.run.en: The "Run" field from the Resource ProductionStatus at the time of the transaction. This field is provided for ease of reporting.

ThruputHistory.setup.zh: 事务发生时Resource ProductionStatus中的“Setup”字段。提供此字段便于报告。
ThruputHistory.setup.en: The "Setup" field from the Resource ProductionStatus at the time of the transaction. This field is provided for ease of reporting.

ThruputHistory.thruputAllQty.zh: 用于指示容器的全部数量是否将移至下一个操作。值“true”（已勾选）表示容器的全部数量将移动。值“false”要求用户为每个正在推进的容器输入适当的数量。
ThruputHistory.thruputAllQty.en: Used to indicate whether or not entire quantity of the container will be moved to the next operation. A "true" value (checked) indicates that the entire quantity of the container will be moved. A "false" value requires that the user enter appropriate quantities for each container being thruput.

ThruputHistory.unitCount.zh: 这是正在执行服务的容器结构内的单位容器数量。
ThruputHistory.unitCount.en: This is the number of unit containers within the container structure for which the service is being performed.

ThruputHistory.uom.zh: 与Qty字段中存储的数量对应的计量单位。
ThruputHistory.uom.en: The Unit of Measure corresponding to the quantity stored in the Qty field.

ThruputHistory.uom2.zh: 与Qty2字段中存储的数量对应的计量单位。
ThruputHistory.uom2.en: The Unit of Measure corresponding to the quantity stored in the Qty2 field.

ThruputHistoryDetail.childCount.zh: 由 ThruputDetail 写入的实际子容器数量（ChildCount）。
ThruputHistoryDetail.childCount.en: The actual ChildCount written by the ThruputDetail.

ThruputHistoryDetail.container.en: The container from the thruput detail.

ThruputHistoryDetail.integrationTxn.zh: 在复合/容器/资源事务后插入 TxnId 与历史主线。
ThruputHistoryDetail.integrationTxn.en: Inserts the TxnId after a compound/container/resource transaction with history mainline.

ThruputHistoryDetail.qty.zh: 由 ThruputDetail 写入的实际数量（Qty）。
ThruputHistoryDetail.qty.en: The actual Qty written by the ThruputDetail.

ThruputHistoryDetail.qty2.zh: 由 ThruputDetail 写入的实际数量 2（Qty2）。
ThruputHistoryDetail.qty2.en: The actual Qty2 written by the ThruputDetail.

ThruputHistoryDetail.thruputAllQty.zh: 由 ThruputDetail 写入的 ThruputAllQty。

ThruputHistoryDetail.unitCount.zh: 由 ThruputDetail 写入的实际单位数量（UnitCount）。
ThruputHistoryDetail.unitCount.en: The actual UnitCount written by ThruputDetail.

TxnDetails.toContainerLevel.zh: Container实例描述一个离散工作单元（如物料批次），包括其在制造过程中的当前状态、谱系信息及其与其他Container的关系。Container通常代表一个物料批次，也可以代表一组物料批次。分组允许对一组相关的Container应用单个事务。例如，跟踪单个包装并将其分组到一个纸箱中，当纸箱移动时，其中的所有包装也随之移动。级别代码用于定义层级中的容器级别。例如，Lot可能包含Wafers，Wafers又包含Die。每个级别（Lot、Wafer、Die）都有相关的Level Code。Level Code的属性用于定义级别之间的关系和其他验证。
TxnDetails.toContainerLevel.en: An instance of a Container describes a discrete unit of work (i.e., batch of material) including its current status within the manufacturing process, genealogy information and its relationship to other Containers. A Container typically represents a batch of material. It can also represent a group of batches of material. The grouping allow a single transaction to be applied to a related set of Containers. An example of this is tracking individual Packages and grouping them in a Carton. When the Carton is moved, all of the Packages within the Carton are moved as well. Level codes are used to define a container level within a hierarchy. For example, a Lot may contain Wafers, which in turn contain Die. Each of these levels (Lot, Wafer, and Die) are have an associated Level Code. The attributes of the Level Code are used to define the relationship and other validations between levels.

TxnDetails.toContainerOption.zh: 如果Transaction Type为Combine，则此选项用于确定Combine的细节：1=创建目标Container（如果配置了自动命名），2=合并到特定Container（如果不存在则创建）。
TxnDetails.toContainerOption.en: If the Transaction Type is Combine then this option is used to determine specifics of the Combine: 1 = Create the To-Container (using auto-naming if configured) 2 = Combine to a Specific Container (and create it if it does not exist)

TxnDetails.txnType.zh: 要使用的事务类型：1=移动到To-Step，2=返工到To-Step，3=在To-Step合并到另一个Container。
TxnDetails.txnType.en: Type of transaction to use: 1 = Move to the To-Step 2 = Rework to the To-Step 3 = Combine to another Container at the To-Step

WorkCenter.resourceGroup.zh: ObjectGroup用于提供对象列表，例如特定类型的资源、产品或用户代码列表。这些列表通常用于验证和选择。例如，工序包含对LossCodeGroup的引用。此列表中的条目定义容器在该工序时执行工作的有效Loss（原因）代码。ObjectGroup实例包括特定对象列表和ObjectGroup列表。任何给定ObjectGroup的对象列表限制为特定类型（或其任何派生类型）。同样，ObjectGroup内的ObjectGroup列表也限制为相同类型（或其任何派生类型）。
WorkCenter.resourceGroup.en: An ObjectGroup is used to provide a list of objects, such as a list of Resources, Products or User Codes of a particular type. These lists are typically used for validation and selection. For example, an Operation includes a reference to a LossCodeGroup. The entries in this list define the valid Loss (reason) Codes for work performed while a Container is at that Operation. An instance of an ObjectGroup includes a list of specific objects and a list of ObjectGroups. This list of objects for any given ObjectGroup is restricted to a specific type (or any of its derived types). Likewise, the list of ObjectGroup s within the ObjectGroup is restricted to the same type (or any of its derived types).

WorkCenter.setupAccess.zh: 用于验证用户对特定建模记录的访问权限。必须首先将一个或多个 Setup Access 分配给 Role。每个建模记录将有一个 Setup Access。当建模记录被事务处理时，系统将比较其 Setup Access。
WorkCenter.setupAccess.en: This is used to verify the user's access to a particular modeling record. One or more Setup Access must first be assigned to a Role. Each modeling record will have one Setup Access. When a modeling record in transacted the system will compare its Setup Ac

WorkCenter.wipMsgDefMgr.zh: 附加到建模实体实例，包含适用于该实体的消息。当被要求提供其WIP消息时，建模实体将要求其WIPMsgDefMgr提供已过滤的WIP消息列表，仅包含适用于当前情况（步骤、操作和标签）的消息。WIPMsgDefMgr将检查AllKey WIPMsgKey（如果指定，包含适用于所有步骤的消息），并遍历OperationKeys和LabelKeys列表中的条目，过滤找到的每条消息。
WorkCenter.wipMsgDefMgr.en: Attached to an instance of a modeling entity, this contains the messages that apply to the entity. When asked to supply its WIP Messages, a modeling entity will ask its WIPMsgDefMgr to supply a list of WIP Messages that have been filtered to include only the messages that apply to the current circumstances (step, operation and label). The WIPMsgDefMgr will check the AllKey WIPMsgKey (which contains a message that applies to all steps) if specified, and run through the entries in the OperationKeys and LabelKeys lists and filter each message found.

WorkCenter.workSchedule.zh: 此工作中心的工作排程的Id。
WorkCenter.workSchedule.en: Id of the Work Schedule for this Work Center.

Workflow.changeHistory.zh: 每个建模实体都包含 Change Status。它用于记录当前的变更（维护）状态（例如，特定 Product Definition 的维护正在进行中），并跟踪最后一次更改的人员和时间。这应该可扩展为随时间变化的完整历史记录。
Workflow.changeHistory.en: Every modeling entity includes a Change Status. It is used to record the current Change (Maintenance) Status (i.e., maintenance is currently in progress for a specific Product Definition) and to track who made the last change and when. This should be extendible to a complete history over time.

Workflow.erpRoute.zh: ERP路线是与InSite工作流最接近的ERP概念。InSite中的ERPRoute对象旨在镜像ERP中的路线定义，其中存储在ERP中的定义是“主”定义，而InSite ERPRoute通过LiveConnect填充。ERPRoute用于将InSite的Moves和ComponentIssues与发生事务的ERPStep相关联。ERP路线中的步骤通常比InSite工作流中的步骤定义在更汇总的级别。
Workflow.erpRoute.en: ERP Routes are the closest ERP concept to an InSite workflow. The ERPRoute object in InSite is meant to be a mirror of the route definitions in the ERP, where the definition stored in the ERP is the "master" and the InSite ERPRoute is populated via LiveConnect. The ERPRoute is used to be able to relate InSite Moves and ComponentIssues to the ERPStep where the transaction occurred. Steps in an ERP route are usually defined at a more summarized level than is true for steps in an InSite workflow.

Workflow.erpRouteBase.zh: ERP 工艺路线基线引用

Workflow.firstStep.zh: 如果为工作流定义了任何步骤，则必须将一个步骤标识为第一步。这是标准路线的起点。
Workflow.firstStep.en: If any Steps are defined for a workflow then one must be identified as the first Step. This is the starting point for the Standard Route.

Workflow.schedulingRoute.zh: 调度路径是一个建模对象，允许配置特定调度路径，而无需利用 ERP 路径。您可以定义和应用备用调度路径，用于标识调度集成的步骤。调度路径实例将优先于 ERP 路径。如果应用未配置或检测到调度路径，则默认使用 ERP 路径。
Workflow.schedulingRoute.en: Scheduling Route is a modeling object that allows configuration of specific scheduling routes without leveraging ERP routes. You can define and apply an alternative scheduling route that can be used to identify steps for scheduling integration. Instances of scheduling routes will take precedent over ERP route. If no Scheduling Routes are configured or detected by the application, the ERP Route will be used by default.

Workflow.status.zh: 确定此实例的当前状态（活动、非活动）。有效值及其含义为：1 = 活动 2 = 非活动。注意，对于活动与非活动修订版本，没有强制执行的验证（规则）。
Workflow.status.en: Determines the current status (Active, In-Active) of this instance. Valid values and their meanings are: 1 = Active 2 = Inactive Note there are no validations (rules enforced) concerning active vs. inactive revisions.

Workflow.totalCycleTime.zh: 这是通过工作流（遵循默认路径）的所有总和。注意：此值的计算使用其他CDO的属性。这意味着，例如更改工作中心值会影响此值。因此，每次需要时都应重新计算此值。持久化的值仅在保存此Spec时的时间点有效。
Workflow.totalCycleTime.en: This is the sum of all through the Workflow (following defaults Paths). Note: The calculation for this value uses attributes of other CDOs. This means that changing a Work Center value, for example, can effect this value. This means that this value should be calculated each time that it is needed. The value that is persisted will only be valid as of the point in time that this Spec was saved.

Workflow.totalYield.zh: 通过工作流（遵循默认路径）的标准（累积）良率。注意：此值的计算使用其他CDO的属性。这意味着，例如更改工作中心值会影响此值。因此，每次需要时都应重新计算此值。持久化的值仅在保存此Spec时的时间点有效。
Workflow.totalYield.en: Standard (cumulative) yield through the Workflow (following defaults Paths). Note: The calculation for this value uses attributes of other CDOs. This means that changing a Work Center value, for example, can effect this value. This means that this value should be calculated each time that it is needed. The value that is persisted will only be valid as of the point in time that this Spec was saved.

Workflow.wipMsgDefMgr.zh: WIP消息定义，包含适用于此实体的所有WIP消息的WIP消息键列表。
Workflow.wipMsgDefMgr.en: WIP Message Definition which contains a list of WIP message keys that contain all of the WIP messages that apply to this entity.

WorkflowBase.iconId.zh: 与此 Base Entity 关联的图标的标识符。
WorkflowBase.iconId.en: Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

WorkflowBase.revOfRcd.zh: 此基础实体当前修订版本的Id。
WorkflowBase.revOfRcd.en: Id of the current revision for this Base entity.

WorkflowStep.defaultPath.zh: 步骤的默认出站路径 → Path

WorkflowStep.isLastStep.en: Whether the step is an end step

WorkflowStep.onDefaultRoute.zh: 是否位于默认路由（Standard Route）上
WorkflowStep.onDefaultRoute.en: Whether it is on the default route (Standard Route)

WorkflowStep.optional.zh: 步骤是否可选，可选值：NotSet, Yes, No
WorkflowStep.optional.en: Whether the step is optional; optional values: NotSet, Yes, No

WorkflowStep.schedulingRouteStep.zh: 排程工艺步骤引用 → RouteStep

WorkflowStep.sequence.zh: 步骤在工作流中的相对顺序（只读）
WorkflowStep.sequence.en: Relative order of the step in the workflow (read-only)

WorkflowStep.wipMsgLabel.zh: WIP消息标签，用于关联特定消息
WorkflowStep.wipMsgLabel.en: WIP message label for associating specific messages
